title: Senior Nutrition Sales Executive - Chennai
description:
Main Purpose of the Role
   

  

 Contribute to the long\-term growth of Abbott Nutrition products in territory by increasing awareness among Health Care Professionals on the important role of nutrition in improving quality of life, and the superiority of Abbott products to competitor brands. Gain new business and grow existing business through a multichannel, customer engagement strategy that builds HCP confidence in and loyalty to Abbott brand products.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Understand the market and category opportunities within territory to identify opportunities for market share growth at the customer/account level
* Maintain deep, current knowledge about medical and nutritional science, the evolving healthcare landscape, and emerging digital trends to support selling and educating a broad and deep network of HCPs about Abbott products
* Develop and execute on multichannel customer engagement plans that generate demand for Abbott brand product and grow recommendation and market share
* Leverage information about customer segmentation, type and behaviors to inform customer engagement and account management strategies
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with HCPs throughout the customer account, at different levels of responsibility and influence using existing relationships with HCPs and others to expand customer network
* Secure commitment to recommend Abbott products as the brand of choice by increasing HCP knowledge about the role and importance of nutrition on patient quality of life at key points Revision A throughout the patient care journey; and the role of Abbott’s products in increasing quality nutrition through consultative selling dialogues
* Define and deliver ‘Unique Value Proposition’ from the HCP’s perspective (including but not limited to the positioning of Abbott brand products) by continuously uncovering the needs and priorities of individual HCPs using multichannel touchpoints and engagement activities
* Effectively deliver a consultative sales call from the perspective of the HCP (and their patients) to expand HCP’s knowledge of nutritional interventions and the measurable benefits of Abbott brand products, anticipate and manage objections, and gain clear commitment to recommending Abbott products and other brand\-building activities
* Establish target customers and develop clear customer plans to achieve coverage, frequency and call rate objectives
* Implement customer segmentation, identify new leads/customers and ensure timely reporting of daily activities as per the SFE SOP
* Use data and insights from digital and other omnichannel activities to refine HCP profiles and choose engagement activities that will fit the needs, preferences and goals of each individual HCP
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Marketing, SFE, CRM, etc..) to support patient education regarding nutrition and Abbott brands, to influence customer and patient choice of nutrition products, and deliver a consistent, end\-to\-end customer engagement experience
* Measure progress against customer and account objectives, per the account plan, and take action to ensure targets and KPIs are met (monthly, quarterly, annually) as assigned by the Sales Manager
* Act in alignment with compliance and regulatory expectations


 Education Level Major/Field of Study Graduate Medicine, science, pharmaceuticals/ nutrition
   

  

* Minimum of 1 years’ experience in Pharma/Nutrition Industry
* Upto 5 years’ experience for Grade 12 and 5\+ years’ experience for Grade 13
* Should achieve a 60% in the written test
* Has excellent product knowledge and is able to translate that knowledge into effective in\-clinic performance
* Good understanding of nutrition science
* Ability to establish connect and develop contacts and relationships, with ease
* Knows his numbers well and is an good team player collaborates where possible

**Job Description**

 Freshservice is expanding what “AI\-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.
   

  





 This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands\-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post\-sale. You'll be the AI subject\-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.
   

  





 You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs\-of\-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent\-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal\-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof\-of\-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de\-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business\-case models that the wider SE team can self\-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one\-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go\-to expert.


**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**



* 8\+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands\-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM\-based solutions in a customer\-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG\-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production\-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one\-size\-fits\-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof\-of\-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX\-leader audience or down to a hands\-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.



**Nice to Have**

title: Consulting Manager
description:
Job Summary
  
Consulting Manager role for a global organization focusing on property and casualty insurance clients responsible for driving complex consulting engagements optimizing business processes and enhancing operational efficiency in a hybrid work model. The role demands eight to ten years of relevant experience and deep domain expertise to deliver measurable outcomes for insurers.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Lead end to end consulting engagements for property and casualty insurance clients by defining problem statements structuring approach and ensuring delivery of measurable business outcomes that strengthen client competitiveness and operational resilience.
  
Oversee analysis of underwriting policy administration billing and claims processes to identify efficiency gaps control weaknesses and transformation opportunities that improve loss ratios service quality and regulatory compliance.
  
Provide expert guidance on property and casualty insurance products rating methodologies and risk selection practices to help clients refine portfolio strategies and enhance sustainable profitability.
  
Drive development of detailed business requirements user stories and process maps for core insurance platforms and surrounding applications to support system enhancements and digital transformation initiatives.
  
Coordinate with client stakeholders across business operations technology and compliance functions to align consulting recommendations with strategic priorities and practical implementation constraints.
  
Develop clear and compelling presentations reports and business cases that translate complex analysis and insurance concepts into actionable insights for executives and operational leaders.
  
Collaborate with technology teams to support design and validation of solutions such as workflow automation data analytics models and self service capabilities that streamline property and casualty insurance operations.
  
Monitor engagement progress through well defined milestones risks and dependencies while recommending corrective actions to maintain scope quality and timelines in a hybrid work environment.
  
Guide change management activities by proposing communication plans training approaches and adoption metrics that help client teams embrace new processes and systems without disruption to daily service delivery.
  
Evaluate key performance indicators across claims handling customer service and policy servicing to recommend continuous improvement initiatives that enhance client satisfaction and reduce operating costs.
  
Support sales and account teams by contributing domain expertise solution concepts and effort estimates for proposals targeting property and casualty insurance organizations.
  
Ensure that all consulting deliverables reflect current regulatory expectations market trends and emerging risks in property and casualty insurance so clients can make informed strategic decisions.
  
Document lessons learned reusable frameworks and best practices from each engagement to strengthen organizational knowledge capital and improve future project effectiveness.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Bring eight to ten years of experience in consulting or business analysis roles with a strong focus on property and casualty insurance operations and transformation programs.
  
Demonstrate in depth understanding of underwriting workflows policy lifecycle management claims adjudication and associated controls within property and casualty insurance.
  
Exhibit proficiency in process analysis requirements gathering and stakeholder management to translate client needs into practical and clearly defined consulting deliverables.
  
Apply solid analytical and problem solving skills using data driven approaches to evaluate performance metrics and recommend realistic improvement options for insurance clients.
  
Show familiarity with core insurance platforms and related tools used in property and casualty carriers to effectively support system enhancement and modernization initiatives.
  
Display strong communication and presentation capabilities to engage diverse stakeholders and explain complex property and casualty topics in accessible business language.
  
Maintain adaptability to work in a hybrid model with effective time management and collaboration skills that support cross functional project teams across locations.

title: Portfolio Business Manager - Capco Corporate Services
description:
**Job: Portfolio Business Manager**


**About Us**


*"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by* *Avtar \& Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*

***WHY JOIN CAPCO?***



You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.


***MAKE AN IMPACT***



Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.


***\#BEYOURSELFATWORK***



Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.


***CAREER ADVANCEMENT***


*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*


***DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION***


*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*


**Business Manager: Job Description**



The Business Manager is the engine that turns the business's commercial ambition into action, orchestrating teams across Capco's global organization to align resources, remove barriers and deliver at pace.



This is a senior business leadership role, requiring an executive mindset and the experience, judgement and credibility to operate effectively with senior leaders, navigate complexity, challenge constructively and influence outcomes across teams and geographies, often with limited direct authority.


**Role purpose**



The Business Manager is responsible for ensuring their area of the business \[global client account, capability, or alternative] operates effectively and delivers against its commercial, operational and people objectives.



Working as a trusted partner to the relevant Partner(s), they connect client and sales teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions to translate business priorities into coordinated execution.



The Business Manager brings together the right stakeholders, information and decisions at the right time, resolving dependencies, creating accountability and maintaining momentum across a highly collaborative environment.


**Key responsibilities**


* **Stakeholder management \& business orchestration:** Build and actively manage relationships across client and account teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions. Navigate competing perspectives and use influence to align stakeholders around shared priorities, remove barriers and drive collective ownership for delivery.
* **Business performance:** Own the management rhythm for the business area, bringing together commercial, financial, operational, resourcing and people information to provide a clear view of performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive action.
* **Planning \& forecasting:** Lead integrated planning and forecasting across sales, demand, supply, recruitment and financial performance, ensuring assumptions and priorities are aligned across teams.
* **Strategy execution:** Translate global priorities into practical plans, mobilize the relevant teams and maintain momentum and accountability through delivery.
* **Commercial \& client alignment:** Work closely with account and sales teams to understand pipeline, client demand and growth priorities, ensuring these translate into operational and workforce plans.
* **Resourcing \& recruitment:** Connect client demand with workforce supply, skills and recruitment to ensure the business has the right capability and capacity at the right time.
* **Financial management:** Drive financial discipline across the business area, supporting budget management, margin improvement, investment decisions and management of financial risks.
* **People \& talent:** Drive workforce and talent planning, including capacity, attrition, development priorities and succession, working closely with business and people leaders.
* **Business improvement \& operational excellence:** Use data and insight to challenge the status quo, identify opportunities to improve performance and mobilize stakeholders to deliver change. Champion and inform the development of Capco's operational processes and tooling to support broader organizational adoption.


**What success looks like**



A successful Business Manager creates a business that feels joined up rather than siloed, with clear priorities, strong accountability and effective execution.



They ensure that sales ambition, client demand, workforce capacity, financial plans and operational execution are connected, even where delivery requires multiple teams, functions or regions to work together.



Business leaders have a clear view of performance, priorities and emerging risks; stakeholders understand their accountabilities and dependencies; regional and global teams work effectively towards shared goals; and decisions translate into action and measurable outcomes.



Success will be measured against a defined set of KPIs agreed with the relevant business leaders, reflecting the commercial, operational and people priorities of the business area.


***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

### **Job Description**


Spendflo is the AI\-native procurement platform for modern CFOs and finance teams. We combine intake\-to\-procure automation, AI\-driven spend insights, and in\-house procurement experts to help companies buy, renew, and manage SaaS (and vendor spend broadly) , cutting costs significantly while removing the manual work from procurement. Our platform orchestrates the full procurement workflow across finance, procurement, IT, and legal, automating intake and approvals while our expert buyers handle vendor negotiation directly, so customers get both software\-driven visibility and human\-led savings. We're building the future of SaaS procurement, and we're looking for ambitious, analytical, and relationship\-driven individuals to join us on that journey.

 **What You’ll Do**

  

As an Associate Consultant, SaaS, you’ll work closely with customers, SaaS vendors, and internal stakeholders to drive successful procurement outcomes and deliver exceptional buying experiences.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Drive cost savings and improve turnaround times across customer procurement requests
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, and renewals with leading global SaaS vendors
* Build and maintain strong relationships with SaaS Account Executives and vendor partners to unlock the best possible deals
* Deliver a smooth and efficient buying experience for both customers and vendors
* Use data, benchmarking, and market insights to identify savings opportunities and procurement strategies
* Collaborate with CXOs, procurement leaders, and customer stakeholders to understand business needs and improve outcomes
* Provide timely updates, maintain process discipline, and ensure high\-quality customer communication throughout the procurement lifecycle
* Contribute to building scalable procurement processes and best practices as Spendflo continues to grow

 **Why Join Spendflo?**

  

At Spendflo, procurement is not just an operations role — it’s strategic, high\-impact, and customer\-facing. This role is ideal for individuals who want to:

* Transition from traditional SaaS sales into strategic procurement and negotiation
* Leverage their commercial and relationship\-management skills from the buyer’s side of the table
* Work with top SaaS companies and global stakeholders across the procurement ecosystem
* Become an expert negotiator in one of the fastest\-growing segments of the SaaS industry
* Gain deep exposure to modern SaaS tools and how high\-growth companies operate
* Be part of a startup where your ideas, ownership, and contributions directly shape the business

 **What We’re Looking For**

  

Required Qualifications

* 0–2 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, SaaS Sales, Account Management, or related customer\-facing roles
* Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Analytical mindset with comfort working with numbers, pricing, and data insights
* High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong relationship\-building skills with customers and external partners

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Exposure to the SaaS industry or SaaS procurement
* Prior startup experience
* Experience working in customer\-facing or revenue\-focused environments

 **What Success Looks Like**

* Delivering measurable savings and procurement efficiency for customers
* Building trusted relationships with SaaS vendors and customer stakeholders
* Becoming a go\-to expert for SaaS negotiations and procurement strategy
* Contributing to scalable processes that help shape the future of Spendflo’s Procurement Services team

  

Ready to Build the Future of SaaS Procurement?

  

If you’re excited about negotiation, problem\-solving, customer experience, and working at the intersection of SaaS and strategy, we’d love to meet you.

title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer\-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value\-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross\-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof\-of\-concepts and executive engagement.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof\-of\-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years overall experience including 3\+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre\-sales and solution consulting customer\-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.
* Based in or able to work from the target territories: Mumbai, Hyderabad or Bangalore.
* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.


****Nice to Have****
* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands\-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy\-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
* The candidate should be curious, energetic, commercially aware, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of customer\-facing engagements from preparation through follow\-up.


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health \& wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
   

  

 Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 As a Sales Advisor at H\&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We are looking for people with…
   

  





 → Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.
   

  





 And people who are…
   

  





 → Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in\-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.
   

  





 → Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.
   

  





 → Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.
   

  





 → Flexible and action oriented.
   

  





  

  





**WHO WE ARE**




 H\&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H\&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

 · You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H\&M group.
   

  





 · We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.
   

  





  

  





**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.
   

  





 \*\* We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

 This is a Part\-time position for our store. The position reports to the Store Manager.

Innovapptive is a **category\-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.


Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including **Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining** to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard\-dollar results, such as:

Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high\-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next\-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting\-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.


Today, with over **300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3\-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

### **The Opportunity**


The Director – Product Management (Operations) will own and scale Innovapptive’s Operations product suite, driving innovation, frontline productivity, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers in asset\-intensive and manufacturing industries. title: Staff Application Engineer – ECO Timing
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18886 **Date posted** 09/20/2026
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years deep in the trenches of timing signoff and design closure, and you know the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that misses by three months because someone ignored a critical timing path in the second pass. You are the engineer who gets called when a customer's design is stuck at 95% timing closure and no one can figure out why. You do not just run tools, you understand what the tools are actually doing under the hood, and you know when to trust the results and when to dig deeper.


Working across P\&R, STA, and ECO flows is second nature to you. You have debugged parasitic extraction issues at 3nm, optimized PPA targets on real silicon projects, and written enough TCL and Perl scripts to automate workflows that used to take days. You are comfortable sitting with a customer's design team in Hyderabad one day and presenting technical tradeoffs to their management the next, translating between "this violates setup by 200ps" and "this impacts your product schedule by two weeks."


You do not wait for perfect data. You work with what you have, ask the right questions, and move. At Synopsys, you will work with customers who are pushing the limits of semiconductor design, and what you enable will directly affect whether their chips work.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Work directly with customers and partners to diagnose and resolve complex timing, extraction, and design closure issues on live silicon projects using Synopsys STA, ECO, and P\&R tools
* Collaborate with R\&D teams to shape product roadmaps, validate new features, and translate real\-world customer pain points into actionable technical specifications
* Deploy best practices for timing signoff, parasitic annotation, and physical design methodologies to help customers hit aggressive PPA targets on advanced nodes
* Deliver technical training and product demos to customer engineering teams and Synopsys field staff, covering STA flows, ECO strategies, and design implementation techniques
* Support customer project execution from early design phases through tapeout, providing hands\-on guidance on constraint setup, timing closure, and multi\-die design challenges
* Partner with Sales and customer technical managers to identify design bottlenecks, scope technical solutions, and communicate product value at both engineering and executive levels
* Script automation solutions in TCL, Perl, and other languages to streamline customer workflows and reduce turnaround time on critical design tasks

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to achieve faster design closure and meet tapeout schedules on complex, multi\-die designs at 5nm and below
* Reduce customer project turnaround times by introducing engineering techniques and automation that eliminate manual bottlenecks
* Influence the development roadmap of Synopsys timing and ECO products by providing R\&D with actionable feedback from real customer engagements
* Build Synopsys' reputation as the trusted partner for timing signoff and design closure across the semiconductor industry in India and beyond
* Empower customer teams and internal field engineers through knowledge transfer, training, and technical mentorship that raises the bar for design execution
* Accelerate adoption of new Synopsys product releases by being the technical bridge between early access programs and production customer deployments
* Help customers optimize Power, Performance, and Area outcomes that directly affect the competitiveness and success of their silicon products

### **What You'll Need**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline
* 6\-8 years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor design, with direct work in Place \& Route, Static Timing Analysis, extraction, and Engineering Change Order flows
* Deep technical expertise with timing and physical constraint methodologies, parasitic annotation, and timing analysis for complex IC designs
* Proven experience executing silicon chip projects through physical design and timing closure, especially on advanced technology nodes like 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm
* Strong scripting skills in TCL and Perl, with the ability to automate design tasks and build custom flows
* Solid understanding of ASIC design flow, VLSI fundamentals, and CAD engineering principles across the full design cycle
* Experience working directly with customers or cross\-functional teams in a technical support, applications engineering, or field engineering capacity is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, understand their timing violations in the first 20 minutes, and outline a closure plan before you leave
* You explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and management, without losing the nuance or oversimplifying the problem
* You are proactive about solving problems, you do not wait to be told what to do when a customer design is stuck, you dig in and figure it out
* You stay organized and focused when managing multiple customer engagements, product validation tasks, and internal collaboration threads at the same time
* You are genuinely curious about new technologies and design methodologies, and you actively seek out ways to improve your skills and expand your technical toolkit
* You thrive on collaboration and knowledge sharing, whether that is training a customer team on best practices or working with R\&D to refine a product feature

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will join the ECO Field team at Synopsys in Hyderabad, a highly skilled group focused on enabling customer success in timing signoff and design closure. The team partners with R\&D, Sales, and technical managers to deliver industry\-leading solutions, drive new product adoption, and address complex technical challenges. Together, you will foster a culture of technical excellence, build deep expertise, and help customers achieve their design goals faster and more efficiently.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Dir, Software Engrg Mgmt
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

About the team


The CRM \& Industry Workflows (CRM\&I) engineering organisation builds the products that make ServiceNow's CRM vision real: Workplace Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, Sales \& Order Management, and the shared CRM Foundation that underpins them all. Our teams operate from IDC, AMS, and EMEA, and our work spans the full spectrum — from foundational platform capabilities to the agentic experiences that define how enterprises serve their employees and customers.

  

We are in the middle of a fundamental shift. AI is not a layer we are adding on top — it is the new baseline. We are rewriting how products are built, how engineers work, and what 'done' means. If you are energised by that shift and want to lead teams that are living it, read on.


The role


This Director of Software Engineering leads the Workplace engineering pillar within CRM\&I. You will own Workplace Service Delivery and its adjacent integrations with CSM and FSM — building the employee and customer facing experiences that handle millions of service interactions across our largest enterprise customers.

  

What makes this role distinct from a traditional engineering director role is the AI\-native mandate. You will not manage teams that use AI as a productivity tool — you will build and lead an organisation that operates as an AI\-native engineering system. Your engineers work more like architects and verifiers than individual contributors typing every line: they decompose problems into agent\-sized tasks, curate the context that makes agent output reliable, and own the verification harnesses that ensure correctness at scale.

  

You will report to the Senior Director, CRM\&I Engineering and work closely with Workplace product management, platform engineering, and senior stakeholders to shape and deliver the Workplace roadmap for the next three to five years.


What you get to do


Lead and develop an AI\-native engineering organisation

* Build and lead two to three engineering managers who coach their teams to operate with AI\-native practices as the default — not the exception.
* Model and scale the shift from implementation\-speed metrics to judgment metrics: specification quality, architectural soundness, and verification rigour.
* Cultivate a culture where engineers own the correctness of output whether a human or an agent produced it, and are accountable for autonomous decision quality in production.


Drive the Workplace product roadmap

* Partner with product management and UX to define, own, and execute the Workplace Service Delivery roadmap — including employee self\-service, request management, and WSD×CSM/FSM integration.
* Translate ambitious product goals and ambiguous problem statements into precise, testable specifications that both engineers and AI agents can act on with high accuracy.
* Make sound architectural and sequencing decisions early, before agent workstreams begin, and course\-correct quickly when output diverges from intent.


Build reliable AI\-native systems

* Design the verification and guardrail harnesses — automated tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and least\-privilege execution environments — that make agent\-generated output trustworthy at scale.
* Oversee context engineering across your teams: instruction files, architectural decision records, golden examples, and agent\-readable documentation that drive reliable results from AI coding agents.
* Own AI reliability in production: monitor for hallucinations, behavioural drift, and safety regressions; maintain agent observability; and implement rollback mechanisms when autonomous behaviour deviates from intent.


Raise the bar on quality, security, and delivery

* Set and hold the standard for enterprise\-grade software quality — accessible, progressive, and responsive web and mobile experiences at the scale our customers demand.
* Champion security\-minded engineering practices specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection defence, secret and data leakage controls, and tool\-access governance.
* Treat the development process itself as a product: trace failures back to missing specs or context gaps, refine evaluation harnesses, and raise team\-wide throughput and reliability.


Develop the next generation of engineering leaders

* Mentor and grow engineering managers and senior engineers, investing in their technical depth, leadership range, and AI\-native fluency.
* Create a talent environment where engineers who are energised by the AI\-native shift can build careers through some of the most advanced systems in enterprise software.

 **Qualifications**  

To be successful in this role


Experience

* 15\+ years of experience designing and shipping scalable enterprise software products, with significant time in technical leadership roles.
* Demonstrated track record of building and leading engineering teams that have delivered real production systems using AI\-native methods — agentic coding tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and autonomous agent architectures.
* Experience in CRM, ITSM, workplace service delivery, or related enterprise domains preferred.


AI\-native engineering fluency

* Agentic AI and autonomous systems. Hands\-on experience designing and operating autonomous agent systems — planning loops, dynamic tool invocation, memory management, execution policies, and multi\-agent collaboration — that select and sequence actions reliably in production.
* Context engineering. Skill in designing what information models receive, when it is retrieved, and how context evolves. Includes assembling instruction files, documentation, examples, and architectural constraints, as well as architecting retrieval systems, vector databases, and long\-term memory frameworks.
* Verification and harness design. Experience building the guardrail systems that make agent output reliable at scale: property\-based and mutation tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and provenance and permission controls.
* Outcome evaluation. Ability to develop measurable frameworks — benchmarks, golden datasets, continuous evaluation pipelines, and drift detection — that hold production AI to the same rigour as deterministically testable software.
* Security and reliability mindset. Working knowledge of risks specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, tool\-access governance, and model abuse, translated into concrete engineering controls.


Leadership and collaboration

* Strong written and verbal communication — able to operate as a credible technical voice with product, platform, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and make clear decisions under uncertainty without waiting for perfect information.
* Conviction to influence product vision and roadmap, paired with the humility to listen, learn, and adapt.


Forward deployed engineering

* Customer\-embedded delivery. Experience leading or participating in forward deployed engineering (FDE) engagements — working on\-site or in close collaboration with strategic customers to accelerate time\-to\-value, co\-develop solutions, and unblock adoption of product capabilities.
* Translating customer context into product decisions. Ability to synthesise what you learn at the customer boundary — pain points, integration constraints, workflow gaps, and adoption blockers — into precise product requirements and engineering priorities that feed back into the core roadmap.
* Executive and technical credibility with customers. Comfortable presenting architecture decisions, roadmap trade\-offs, and delivery progress to both customer engineering leads and C\-suite stakeholders, earning trust through technical depth and clear communication rather than sales framing.
* Rapid scoping and delivery under constraints. Skilled at decomposing ambiguous customer problems into tightly scoped engineering workstreams with clear success criteria, then driving rapid iteration cycles — days to weeks, not quarters — while managing risk and communication on both sides.
* Cross\-functional coordination in a customer environment. Experience coordinating across product, sales, and professional services teams while embedded with a customer — navigating competing priorities, escalation paths, and success handoffs without losing engineering focus.


Technical depth

* Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, and modern software development practices.
* Solid data modelling background — relational and otherwise — with experience building systems where data model quality is a first\-class concern.
* Proficiency with AI/ML fundamentals: model training and evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic failure modes of LLMs, sufficient to reason about and debug model\-driven behaviour in production.


Even better if you have

* Experience with the ServiceNow platform — scoped application architecture, Glide APIs, or platform engineering at scale.
* Hands\-on exposure to multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and the operational realities of shipping to thousands of enterprise customers simultaneously.
* Experience building and operating agentic systems in a regulated or enterprise\-compliance context.
* Prior experience managing distributed engineering organisations across time zones.
* Direct experience leading forward deployed engineering engagements — co\-developing solutions alongside strategic customers, accelerating adoption of complex capabilities, and feeding field learnings back into the product roadmap.


Why ServiceNow


We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a professional environment built on collaboration and inclusion. This is an organisation where people with strong aptitude and conviction grow fast — working on some of the most advanced enterprise technology in the world, with teams that take the craft seriously.

  

If you want to lead engineering at the frontier of what AI\-native product development actually looks like in production — not in a lab, but at enterprise scale — this is the role.

  

For more information


www.servicenow.com/careers

Cloud Operations and Platform Reliability

 Social Gear serves advertisers across India, the US, UK, Canada, UAE, and Singapore.

**How success is measured** 




 New advertisers and agencies acquired · Revenue closed · Ad spend managed through the platform · Pipeline\-to\-close conversion · Retention and account growth · Target achievement.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* ₹8–18 LPA fixed \+ uncapped performance commissions

 Email your resume to hr@mymanhattancom.com with a short note —

title: Manager - Brand Sales
description:
**About the Role** 




 Logline AI is an AI\-native creative studio building AI\-powered production and storytelling for entertainment and media. We're looking for a
 **sales professional** 
 to open doors and close deals with brands and agencies — selling Logline as a
 **creative production partner** 
 , not an ad\-inventory or media\-buying vendor.
 



 The right person understands what makes a piece of content good, has sat in rooms where creative ideas get pitched and greenlit, and is equally comfortable being the one to open the account and the one who can speak knowledgeably about the craft once they're in it.
 



  





**It will be based in either Kolkata or Mumbai, based on candidates preference.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Prospect and open relationships** 
 with brand marketing teams and agencies (creative, content, digital, and integrated agencies — not media\-buying desks) to bring in content mandates: branded films, DVCs, branded series, AFPs, integrated IP, and AI\-native production.
* **Pitch and close** 
 — run the sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract: pitch development (working closely with creative/ideation), proposals, pricing conversations, negotiation, and closing.
* **Execute against the GTM plan** 
 set by the lead — target the account segments and formats prioritized (including CSR/ESG, founder/legacy, innovation, and employer branding budget lines, alongside standard branded/animated content) and feedback market signal to refine it.
* **Stay close to the content and agency ecosystem** 
 — know which agencies are pitching what, which brands have non\-BAU budget lines open, and where Logline's AI\-native production gives a genuine edge (speed, cost, native\-language, format innovation).
* **Represent Logline** 
 at industry events, festivals, and client meetings to build visibility as a serious creative studio, not just a tech vendor.
* **Work closely with the creative/ideation team** 
 to shape pitches that are credible as content, not just as a sales deck — you should be able to give informed creative feedback, not only manage the relationship.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **Background in content, entertainment, or creative production sales/business development** 
 — agency business development, production house client servicing, OTT/studio partnerships, or similar. Prior experience at a creative or production agency, content studio is strongly preferred.
* **Not** 
 a background purely in media/ad\-spot sales, programmatic, or performance marketing sales — this role sells craft and IP, not impressions or airtime.
* Demonstrated ability to
 **originate and close deals independently** 
 — you should be comfortable owning a pipeline from cold outreach to signed contract, not just managing inbound accounts.
* Existing
 **relationships within brand marketing teams and/or agencies** 
 are a strong plus.
* Comfort discussing creative formats and production intelligently with clients — enough fluency in the craft to be a credible creative partner in the room, not just a deal\-closer.
* Understanding of (or genuine interest in) how AI is changing content production — you don't need to be technical, but you should be able to explain and sell the AI\-native angle with conviction.
* Self\-starter who can operate with a lean team and build process as you go.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience selling into non\-BAU budget lines (CSR, ESG, innovation, employer branding) in addition to standard brand/marketing budgets.
* Familiarity with animation, VFX, or regional/native\-language production as content formats.
* Existing relationships with agencies or brand houses

title: International Sales - Home & Personal Care Ingredients/Chemicals
description:
**The Opportunity** 




  





 We are looking for a Category Manager to join Elchemy's growing sales team. This is a high\-ownership, target\-driven role focused on building new customer relationships and generating business from the ground up.
 



  





 You will be responsible for identifying potential customers, reaching out to decision\-makers, understanding their requirements, developing qualified opportunities, and working towards converting them into customers.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys sales, talking to customers, hunting for opportunities, and working in a fast\-paced environment. You will get hands\-on exposure to B2B sales, specialty chemicals, sourcing, and global trade while working closely with experienced sales and cross\-functional teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Generate new business opportunities for Elchemy’s products \& services for the global market focusing on the personal care and home care industry.
* Understand customer requirements and close business by learning about their products, applications, volumes, pricing, and sourcing needs, and taking opportunities from initial conversation to quotation, negotiation, and closure.
* Find and reach out to new customers through email, phone, LinkedIn, industry databases, and other channels. Research companies, find the right contacts, and build a steady pipeline of prospects.
* Build strong customer and supplier relationships and work closely with sales, sourcing, procurement, and operations teams to ensure requirements are handled smoothly and orders are fulfilled on time.
* Manage sourcing and procurement by finding the right suppliers, checking availability and pricing, getting quotes, and working with suppliers to meet customer requirements.
* Meet business targets and maintain sales discipline by keeping the CRM updated, following up regularly, and delivering against targets for new customers, revenue, gross margin, and sales activity. Continuously learn about chemicals, suppliers, customers, and markets.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in chemical/ingredient sales, business development, inside sales, or a similar customer\-facing role.
* Sales mindset: Strong desire to build new business, comfortable with cold outreach, rejection, and persistent follow\-ups.
* Ownership: Someone who takes responsibility for outcomes, not just activities, and is comfortable working towards clear targets.
* Learning agility: Curiosity and willingness to develop an understanding of specialty chemicals, applications, and international markets.
* Tech\-savvy: Comfortable working with CRM systems, LinkedIn, digital prospecting tools, and data to improve sales effectiveness.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred, but not mandatory for candidates with strong sales experience.



  





**Who is a good fit?** 




  





 We are looking for someone who is hungry to build, comfortable with rejection, and relentless about follow\-ups. You don't need to know everything about chemicals or international trade on day one. What matters more is your ability to learn quickly, communicate effectively, create opportunities, and consistently execute. If you enjoy the thrill of finding a prospect, starting a conversation, turning a requirement into an opportunity, and eventually winning the business \- this role is for you.
 



  





**About Elchemy** 




  





 Elchemy is a tech\-enabled, cross\-border specialty chemicals distribution platform helping companies across the US and Europe source high\-quality chemical raw materials from trusted manufacturers across Southeast Asia and beyond. In just four years of operations, Elchemy has scaled rapidly, serving customers in over 60 countries and building active partnerships with 200\+ suppliers across more than 15 manufacturing geographies. Our platform supports a wide range of specialty chemical applications, helping businesses access the right materials with confidence and speed. Our vision is to build the world's largest global specialty chemicals distributor, reimagining the industry through technology\-led discovery, seamless fulfillment, and data\-driven decision\-making. Elchemy is backed by marquee investors. Our team brings together professionals who have built and scaled startups and worked across global multinational organizations. We believe exceptional outcomes are driven by exceptional people, and we are building a team of ambitious, high\-impact performers who challenge conventions and raise the bar every day. Read more about us at www.elchemy.com

title: Analyst GTB Sales
description:
Join us as an Analyst GTB Sales, where you will support the origination and management of deposits and liquidity solutions for corporate and financial institution clients. Develop high\-quality pitch materials, RFP responses and client proposals to support mandate conversion. Participate in client discussions covering cash management, liquidity, payments, trade finance and working capital solutions. Support the origination and structuring of trade and working capital transactions, including documentary trade, receivables finance, payables finance and open account solutions. Work closely with Treasury, Product, Risk, Legal and Operations teams to structure solutions that meet client needs within Barclays’ risk appetite. Support end\-to\-end deal execution, including approvals, documentation and handover to implementation teams. Maintain accurate pipeline reporting, deal tracking and revenue forecasting, ensuring strong CRM hygiene and timely updates. Develop an understanding of client treasury needs, supply chain dynamics and working capital cycles. Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and progressively establish direct client relationships. Stay informed on market developments, competitive dynamics and regulatory considerations impacting transaction banking across Singapore and APAC. Ensure adherence to Barclays policies, AML, KYC, sanctions and applicable regulatory requirements. Proactively identify and escalate conduct, risk and control\-related concerns.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should
   

  

  

* Have strong knowledge of transaction banking products, including liquidity, payments, trade finance and working capital solutions.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, execution, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Have the ability to understand client requirements and translate them into appropriate banking solutions.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities within defined timelines.
* Have a strong understanding of risk, controls and regulatory requirements.
* Be able to work effectively with senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, Treasury, Risk, Legal and Operations.


**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in Transaction Banking, Trade \& Working Capital, Liquidity, Payments, Cash Management or a related role.
* Good understanding of liquidity, payments, trade and working capital solutions.
* Familiarity with corporate treasury concepts, trade documentation and cross\-border transaction flows.
* Strong analytical, execution and stakeholder management skills.


**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of India regulatory requirements and APAC trade corridors.
* Experience supporting corporate and/or financial institution clients.
* Exposure to deposits, liquidity management, cash management, payments, trade finance or working capital solutions.
* Experience in preparing client pitches, RFP responses and transaction proposals.
* Understanding of treasury and working capital optimisation.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as
   

  

  

* Transaction Banking product knowledge
* Sales origination and client engagement
* Deal structuring and execution
* Commercial and analytical thinking
* Stakeholder management
* Communication and presentation
* Risk and control awareness
* Pipeline and revenue management
* Attention to detail and execution discipline


 Job location is Mumbai.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To generate revenue and promote the bank's diverse product and service offerings to various customer segments.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification of potential customers, analysing their needs and preferences, and staying abreast of emerging market trends and competitor strategies.
* Creation of detailed profiles for target customer segments, outlining their demographics, financial habits, and pain points to tailor sales approaches and product recommendations.
* Relationship management of potential and existing customer relations through the execution of high\-quality customer support, by responding to queries and resolving issues, gaining their customer trust, and understanding their financial goals and challenges.
* Understanding of the features, benefits, risks, and compliance requirements of various banking products and services offered. Understanding of the key features, benefits, risks, enhancements, and regulatory requirements of new and existing banking products, and communicate insights clearly to potential customers to address their financial needs.
* Development of compelling sales pitches and proposals that showcase the value proposition of the bank's offerings to convert leads into customers, and negotiation of terms that are beneficial for both the client and the bank.
* Collection and analysis of customer feedback on various products, services, and overall experience, to support the development of reports that communicate key findings to relevant stakeholders, to inform product development and sales strategies.
* Monitoring of lead conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and other relevant metrics to assess sales performance and identify areas for improvement.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**3rd \- 6**

 requirements)

title: Senior Executive – Accounts Receivable (AR)
description:
The individual will be responsible for proactively managing overdue receivables, reducing ageing, improving collection effectiveness and ensuring timely resolution of customer account discrepancies.



The position requires **hands\-on working knowledge of SAP**, particularly in relation to customer accounts, open item management, payment allocation, account reconciliation, reporting and AR closing activities.



The Senior Executive will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders including Sales, Customer Service, Credit, Treasury and Finance teams to ensure timely collection of receivables, accurate cash application, resolution of disputes and smooth month\-end closing.



The role requires a high level of ownership, communication skills, analytical ability and a strong collection mindset. The successful candidate should be comfortable handling customer conversations, including difficult collection discussions and payment negotiations, independently driving issues through to resolution.

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  


* Manage end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable and Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) activities for assigned customer accounts.
* Monitor AR ageing and proactively follow up on overdue and long\-outstanding receivables.
* Make regular calls and send emails to customers for payment follow\-up, obtain payment commitments and track payments until closure.
* Handle collection conversations professionally and manage difficult payment\-related discussions where required.
* Prioritize high\-value, overdue and high\-risk customer accounts and escalate collection risks appropriately.
* Perform customer account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, payments, credit notes, deductions and open items.
* Perform cash application and payment allocation and resolve unapplied, unallocated and unidentified customer payments.
* Follow up and resolve customer disputes, deductions, short payments and billing\-related queries in coordination with internal stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute Statements of Account and follow up on customer discrepancies.
* Monitor customer payment behaviour, overdue balances and support DSO improvement and collection targets.
* Support bad debt provision, doubtful debt and write\-off activities.
* Perform assigned month\-end and quarter\-end AR closing activities, including reconciliation, open item review, ageing validation and unapplied cash review.
* Perform Intercompany AR/AP reconciliations and resolve outstanding differences.
* Manage the AR/customer mailbox and ensure timely response and resolution of customer and internal queries.
* Use SAP for customer account management, open item review, payment allocation, reconciliation and AR reporting.
* Prepare AR ageing, collection, DSO and other management reports.
* Maintain documentation of customer communications, collection actions, payment commitments, disputes and escalations.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to process improvement, standardization and automation initiatives.
* Support SOP documentation, cross\-training and backup arrangements within the team.

  


**Candidate Requirements**

  


**Education \& Experience**


* Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable / Collections / O2C.
* Experience in a Shared Services Centre (SSC), Global Business Services or multinational environment is preferred.

  


**Must\-Have Technical Skills**


* Strong knowledge of end\-to\-end AR/O2C processes.
* Hands\-on experience in customer collections and direct customer calling for overdue payments.
* Ability to obtain and follow up on payment commitments.
* Strong knowledge of AR ageing, overdue debt management and DSO.
* Experience in customer account reconciliation and Intercompany reconciliation.
* Experience in cash application, payment allocation and resolution of unapplied payments.
* Knowledge of customer disputes, deductions, short payments and billing queries.
* Experience in month\-end/quarter\-end AR closing activities.
* Understanding of bad debt provision and write\-off processes.
* Hands\-on SAP/ERP knowledge is mandatory; SAP FI experience is preferred.
* Strong MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and data analysis.

  


**COMMUNICATION \& BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Confidence in communicating and negotiating with customers over calls and emails.
* Strong collection mindset with proactive and persistent follow\-up.
* Ability to independently manage assigned customer accounts and drive issues to closure.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and reconciliation skills.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and ownership.
* Ability to prioritize workload and meet strict deadlines.
* Good stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Self\-organized, reliable, adaptable and team oriented.
* German language knowledge is an advantage but not mandatory.

  


**PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE**


* Experience supporting EMEA or international customers/entities.
* Shared Services / Global Finance SSC experience.
* SAP FI – Accounts Receivable experience.
* Experience with Power BI and AR reporting dashboards.
* Experience in process improvement, automation or finance transformation initiatives.

  


**KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**


* Timely collection and reduction of overdue receivables.
* Improvement in AR ageing and DSO.
* Timely completion of customer calls and collection follow\-ups.
* Accurate customer account reconciliation and cash application.
* Timely resolution of unapplied cash, disputes and deductions.
* Timely completion of month\-end and quarter\-end activities.
* Accurate and timely AR reporting.
* Compliance with agreed SLAs and company policies.

title: Distribution Executive - US Hotels
description:
**Location:** 
 Pune, Yerwada (work from office)
 



**Shift:** 
 5 PM – 3 AM IST (Monday to Friday)
 



**CTC:** 
 4\-6 LPA
 



  





**About Atica** 




 Atica is a tech\-first sales and revenue partner for hotels across the United States. We build the technology and run the commercial operation that grows revenue for 200\+ properties — sales, revenue management, distribution and digital — from independents to hotels operating under Marriott, IHG, Hyatt, Choice and Wyndham.
 



  





**Find out more:** 




 https://www.aticaglobal.com https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica\-global
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 Distribution is how Atica's hotels reach global B2B demand — through wholesalers and bed banks (Hotelbeds, WebBeds, Roibos, World2Meet, Travel Funders Network), travel management platforms (Engine, Bnberry) and redistribution partners (Nuitee).
 



  





 We are appointing a Manager to own that function end to end: the partner relationships, the commercial terms behind them, the channel and rate strategy across the portfolio, and the team that runs it.
 



  





 The mandate is to grow distribution's contribution to revenue, open the channels worth opening, close the ones that are not, and build the team and process behind it.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Partner strategy and commercial ownership
* Own every demand partner relationship and the commercial terms behind it: performance reviews, negotiation, escalation, and keeping Atica's hotels prioritised on their platforms.
* Segment the partner portfolio by fit and contribution, and decide where to invest and where to withdraw.
* Open new channels end to end evaluate the opportunity, negotiate terms, contract, and see the first properties live and producing.
* Grow partner penetration and revenue contribution across every active channel.



  





**Channel and rate strategy** 




  




* Decide the channel mix by property and market, and set rate positioning and allotment alongside Revenue Management, who own final pricing.
* Manage redistribution and leakage risk to protect rate integrity across the portfolio.
* Audit content, pricing and offers for accuracy and commercial compliance.



  





**Building the function** 




  




* Hire, develop and lead the Distribution team.
* Turn recurring problems into a standard process, and decide what gets automated.
* Work with Product and Tech on what gets built — workflow gaps, feature requests and internal tooling.



  





**Across the business** 




  




* Partner with Sales and Revenue Management on hotel\-level commercial objectives.
* Engage US hotel stakeholders, Directors of Sales, Revenue Managers directly.



  





**How You'll Be Measured** 



* Revenue contribution from distribution.
* Partner penetration across active channels.
* Strength of the partner ecosystem, including how quickly escalations are resolved.
* Percentage of hotels live on channel within SLA.
* The team's performance and delivery quality.



  





 In your first quarter you will have met every partner, formed a view on which relationships are underperforming, and made the case for where we invest. Within the year, distribution contributes materially more revenue, the channel mix reflects a deliberate strategy, and the team is one you have built.
 



  





**What You Bring** 



* 1\-3 years in hotel distribution, contracting, wholesale, global sales, or a comparable commercial role in hospitality or travel.
* Working knowledge of the wholesale channel: contracting, allotments, rate fencing, markup chains and redistribution. From either side of the table if you have contracted hotels for a bed bank, that translates directly.
* A negotiation track record. You have owned commercial conversations with partners and moved the terms.
* Clear, structured stakeholder communication, and the ability to push back when it matters.
* Evidence of building process operational complexity turned into something documented and repeatable.
* Ownership of an outcome rather than a workflow.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* People management experience.
* TMC or B2B2C channel exposure.
* Familiarity with the US hotel market.
* Please Note Before Applying

**About Company**
