title: Portfolio Business Manager - Capco Corporate Services
description:
**Job: Portfolio Business Manager**


**About Us**


*"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by* *Avtar \& Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*

***WHY JOIN CAPCO?***



You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.


***MAKE AN IMPACT***



Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.


***\#BEYOURSELFATWORK***



Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.


***CAREER ADVANCEMENT***


*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*


***DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION***


*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*


**Business Manager: Job Description**



The Business Manager is the engine that turns the business's commercial ambition into action, orchestrating teams across Capco's global organization to align resources, remove barriers and deliver at pace.



This is a senior business leadership role, requiring an executive mindset and the experience, judgement and credibility to operate effectively with senior leaders, navigate complexity, challenge constructively and influence outcomes across teams and geographies, often with limited direct authority.


**Role purpose**



The Business Manager is responsible for ensuring their area of the business \[global client account, capability, or alternative] operates effectively and delivers against its commercial, operational and people objectives.



Working as a trusted partner to the relevant Partner(s), they connect client and sales teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions to translate business priorities into coordinated execution.



The Business Manager brings together the right stakeholders, information and decisions at the right time, resolving dependencies, creating accountability and maintaining momentum across a highly collaborative environment.


**Key responsibilities**


* **Stakeholder management \& business orchestration:** Build and actively manage relationships across client and account teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions. Navigate competing perspectives and use influence to align stakeholders around shared priorities, remove barriers and drive collective ownership for delivery.
* **Business performance:** Own the management rhythm for the business area, bringing together commercial, financial, operational, resourcing and people information to provide a clear view of performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive action.
* **Planning \& forecasting:** Lead integrated planning and forecasting across sales, demand, supply, recruitment and financial performance, ensuring assumptions and priorities are aligned across teams.
* **Strategy execution:** Translate global priorities into practical plans, mobilize the relevant teams and maintain momentum and accountability through delivery.
* **Commercial \& client alignment:** Work closely with account and sales teams to understand pipeline, client demand and growth priorities, ensuring these translate into operational and workforce plans.
* **Resourcing \& recruitment:** Connect client demand with workforce supply, skills and recruitment to ensure the business has the right capability and capacity at the right time.
* **Financial management:** Drive financial discipline across the business area, supporting budget management, margin improvement, investment decisions and management of financial risks.
* **People \& talent:** Drive workforce and talent planning, including capacity, attrition, development priorities and succession, working closely with business and people leaders.
* **Business improvement \& operational excellence:** Use data and insight to challenge the status quo, identify opportunities to improve performance and mobilize stakeholders to deliver change. Champion and inform the development of Capco's operational processes and tooling to support broader organizational adoption.


**What success looks like**



A successful Business Manager creates a business that feels joined up rather than siloed, with clear priorities, strong accountability and effective execution.



They ensure that sales ambition, client demand, workforce capacity, financial plans and operational execution are connected, even where delivery requires multiple teams, functions or regions to work together.



Business leaders have a clear view of performance, priorities and emerging risks; stakeholders understand their accountabilities and dependencies; regional and global teams work effectively towards shared goals; and decisions translate into action and measurable outcomes.



Success will be measured against a defined set of KPIs agreed with the relevant business leaders, reflecting the commercial, operational and people priorities of the business area.


***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

title: Senior Manager
description:
Job Description: Domain Expertise, GTM \& Agentic Solutions · Insurance Innovation \& New Market Solutions
  

Be the insurance voice that turns AI prototypes into market\-ready stories.
  

EXL's Insurance Innovation and New Market Solutions team is built to work differently from the rest of the organization. We're reshaping how EXL goes to market, moving from selling effort to selling outcomes and positioning the company as an AI\-first product business. As we scale, we need a deep P\&C insurance expert who can sit between our build team and the market, making sure the agentic solutions we create solve real problems and reach the field in language clients understand.
  

We're looking for an Insurance P\&C SME to be that voice. It's a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role at the center of the team, working shoulder to shoulder with the build team, account managers, partners, and leadership to turn domain insight into prototypes, and prototypes into stories the market acts on.
  

  

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT
  

* You're the bridge between deep insurance expertise and cutting\-edge AI, shaping both what we build and how we take it to market.
* Real influence. Your feedback changes the product, and your collateral shapes how the market hears it.
* You make the whole GTM engine smarter, arming account managers with both the story and the substance.
* Speed. You see an idea go from prototype to market\-ready in weeks, not quarters.

WHAT YOU BRING
  

* Deep P\&C insurance expertise, ideally from years inside or close to carriers, with real fluency in claims, underwriting, and the economics that drive them.
* The credibility to educate account managers and senior insurance stakeholders and earn their trust.
* A genuine feel for AI and agentic solutions, enough to review prototypes critically and picture where they fit in real workflows.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, turning the build team's work into clear collateral, messaging, and decks the market understands.
* Curiosity and a research mindset, turning what you see in the market into insight the whole team can use.
* Enough organization to keep a few initiatives on track without losing the plot.

WHAT YOU'LL HAVE
  

The full range of tools you need: our latest agentic prototypes to demo, AI\-enabled productivity and research tools, the full Microsoft Office suite, and direct access to the build team and the people making the decisions.
  

WHY JOIN
  

This is a rare chance to put deep insurance expertise at the center of an AI\-first business as it scales. Your judgment will shape the products we build, your collateral will arm the teams who win the deals, and your read on the market will guide where we go next. If you know P\&C inside out and want to be at the front of how AI is changing it, this role is built for you.
  
* Responsibilities: • P\&C domain expertise. Be the team's go\-to authority on property and casualty insurance, fluent in the workflows, pain points, and economics that matter to carriers, so everything we build and pitch is grounded in how the industry actually works.
* Prototype review and feedback. Review the prototypes the build team creates, pressure\-test them against real P\&C use cases, and share clear, practical feedback that makes each solution sharper and more convincing.
* Collateral and messaging. Turn domain insight into market\-ready collateral and messaging: sharp decks, narratives, and proof points that account managers can carry into the field.
* GTM enablement. Connect with account managers and client executives to educate them on our agentic offerings and equip them to take the story to market. When it helps, you may be invited into client meetings, though the front\-line sales conversations sit onshore.
* Intelligence across GTM. Channel what you learn from prototypes, account managers, and the market back into GTM, so our positioning, collateral, and pursuit strategy keep getting smarter.
* Initiative coordination. Keep the key build and GTM initiatives moving with a light touch on owners, timelines, and dependencies, so nothing important stalls.

  
Qualifications: Bachelor Degree in relevant field with 10 \- 12 years of relevant experience

 Role Purpose
 
 Build and grow Troovy’s General Trade business across the assigned territory through strong distribution, outlet development and disciplined market execution. Lead the frontline sales team to drive secondary sales, productive outlets, repeat orders and sustainable market growth.
 



 This is an execution\-intensive field role for someone who understands that sustainable growth comes from strong market coverage, disciplined follow\-ups, product availability, visibility, and repeat offtake.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 
**Market Development** 



* Map the complete retail outlet universe across assigned markets, routes and clusters.
* Identify high\-potential outlets, competitor\-dominated stores and underserved markets.
* Open new outlets and ensure they become productive through structured follow\-ups.
* Develop new beats and improve coverage across priority territories.
* Expand Troovy’s presence across relevant grocery, snacks and impulse\-purchase outlets.



**Secondary Sales and Repeat Offtake** 



* Achieve assigned primary and secondary sales targets.
* Drive repeat orders from existing outlets instead of focusing only on new outlet additions.
* Identify non\-moving, low\-productivity and lapsed outlets and take corrective action.
* Improve average sales per outlet, order frequency and average order value.
* Expand SKU penetration within existing productive outlets.
* Work with the frontline team to convert trials into sustained retail offtake.



**Distributor and Beat Management** 



* Work closely with assigned distributors to execute territory sales plans.
* Plan daily beats, outlet coverage and market\-working priorities.
* Ensure adequate distributor inventory and availability of priority SKUs.
* Monitor stock movement, ageing and replenishment requirements.
* Improve distributor productivity, service levels and order fulfilment.
* Support timely collections and resolution of distributor or retailer issues.



**Team Management and Field Execution** 



* Guide and monitor PSRs/DBSMs mapped to the territory.
* Set daily priorities and review outlet visits, orders, additions and repeat performance.
* Conduct regular joint market working and provide on\-field coaching.
* Ensure the team follows defined beats, reporting processes and execution standards.
* Identify performance gaps and implement clear, measurable corrective actions.



**Visibility and Market Activation** 



* Ensure effective product visibility, merchandising and POSM deployment.
* Execute sampling activities, retailer engagement initiatives and local market activations.
* Monitor the condition and utilisation of deployed branding and visibility assets.
* Maintain execution quality across priority outlets and high\-potential clusters.



**Market Intelligence** 



* Track competitor products, pricing, margins, schemes, visibility and new launches.
* Capture retailer and consumer feedback and communicate actionable insights.
* Identify local opportunities, market barriers and emerging consumption patterns.
* Use market data to improve route planning, assortment and outlet\-level execution.



**Reporting and Process Discipline** 



* Maintain accurate daily records of market visits, orders, outlet additions and repeat sales.
* Ensure all activities and transactions are recorded correctly in the designated sales systems.
* Review territory performance using outlet, distributor and salesperson\-level data.
* Submit timely reports on sales, collections, stock, coverage, visibility and competition.
* Maintain data accuracy and immediately escalate inconsistencies or execution issues.


 Key Performance Indicators
 * Primary and secondary sales achievement
* New outlets added and activated
* Productive outlet percentage
* Repeat outlet percentage and order frequency
* Average order value and average sales per outlet
* Market and beat coverage
* SKU penetration
* Distributor stock availability and productivity
* Collection performance
* Frontline team performance
* Visibility and activation quality
* Reporting accuracy and process compliance

title: GTM Lead - B2B
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Sneakare is a New Delhi\-based, fastest\-growing sneaker care brand, built for people who genuinely love what they are wearing on their feet. We market premium, no\-nonsense products — cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions — designed to help sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear what they love, longer. We started small, made it to Shark Tank India, and haven't slowed down since. Our team is young, fast\-moving, and obsessed with getting things right — whether that's a product formula, a listing copy, or a customer interaction. We care about quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




 We're looking for an experienced GTM Lead to build and own Sneakare's B2B business, largely from scratch. The mandate starts with two known pillars — brand collaborations and corporate gifting — and extends to identifying and standing up whatever other B2B channels make sense for the brand (distribution/wholesale, hospitality, institutional bulk orders, etc.). This is a strategy\-plus\-execution role: you'll define the B2B GTM plan with the Founder, then build and run the pipeline yourself in the early stages.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\.  Corporate Gifting:** 




 • Build a pipeline of corporate clients (HR/admin/procurement teams) for bulk/festive/onboarding gifting orders
 



 • Own pricing, packaging, and proposal templates for corporate orders, including customization options
 



 • Manage the deal cycle from pitch to contract to delivery, coordinating with ops/warehouse on fulfillment timelines
 



 • Build repeat relationships aimed at annual/recurring gifting contracts rather than one\-off orders
 



  





**2\. Brand Collaborations:** 




 • Identify and pitch co\-branded product or campaign opportunities with complementary brands
 



 • Negotiate collaboration terms (commercials, exclusivity, timelines) and manage the partnership through to launch
 



 • Work with marketing/product on execution — packaging, launch content, and joint promotion
 



  





**3\. New B2B Channels (Build\-Out):** 




 • Scope and validate additional B2B revenue channels — e.g. distributor/wholesale partnerships, hotel/airline amenity kits, event and gifting agencies, marketplace B2B — and bring recommendations to the Founder
 



 • Pilot one or two of these channels, defining what a repeatable sales motion looks like before scaling
 



 • Build the playbook (pricing, pitch, process) for each channel you stand up, so it can eventually be handed off or scaled
 



  





**4\. Pipeline, Deal Cycle \& Reporting:** 




 • Own the full deal cycle — prospecting, pitching, negotiation, contracting, and post\-sale account management
 



 • Maintain a live pipeline/CRM view of leads, deal stage, and expected revenue
 



 • Track B2B revenue against targets and report performance regularly to the Founder and leadership
 



  





**5\. Marketing \& Representation:** 




 • Work with marketing to build B2B collateral — decks, case studies, one\-pagers — that support the sales pitch
 



 • Represent Sneakare at industry events, expos, and networking forums to build pipeline and brand visibility in the B2B space
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months):** 




 • A qualified, trackable B2B pipeline exists (not just informal conversations) with clear deal stages and expected value
 



 • Corporate gifting is generating consistent month\-on\-month revenue, with at least a few clients converted to repeat/annual contracts
 



 • At least one brand collaboration has been pitched, negotiated, and launched
 



 • A recommendation (backed by a small pilot) exists for at least one new B2B channel beyond gifting and collabs
 



 • Leadership has a regular, reliable view of B2B revenue and pipeline health
 








**Requirements:** 




 • 6\-8 years of experience in B2B sales, corporate gifting, partnerships, or key account management
 



 • Proven track record of building a pipeline from scratch and closing corporate/B2B deals
 



 • Experience in a D2C, FMCG, or lifestyle brand background preferred
 



 • Strong negotiation, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills
 



 • Excellent communication and presentation skills — comfortable pitching to corporate and institutional buyers
 



 • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building a vertical largely from scratch with limited existing playbook, and turning ambiguity into a structured plan
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment
 



  





**Experience:** 
 6\-8 years
 



**Location:** 
 Kirti Nagar, Delhi (Onsite)
 



**Department:** 
 B2B / Business Development

 Full\-time
 



**CTC:**

 We are looking for a
 
**Brand Solutions Manager / Brand Partnerships Manager**

**own the entire brand partnership cycle**

**influencer marketing solutions and campaign strategies** 

 .

**lead generation → discovery → proposal → negotiation → closure → handover** 

 .
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and identify opportunities for repeat business and upselling.
* Coordinate with the internal Operations and Creator teams to ensure smooth campaign handover.
* Maintain accurate sales pipelines, follow\-ups and revenue projections.
* Track industry trends, brand campaigns and emerging opportunities.
* Take ownership of monthly and quarterly business targets.


-

 At Creators Yug™, we believe in giving people ownership.
 





 We are looking for someone who can:
 




**See → Understand → Strategize → Pitch → Close → Own.** 





 You should be able to manage your business pipeline independently without requiring the Founder for every conversation or decision.
 





 If a client has a challenge, you should be able to understand the requirement and develop a solution.
 





 If a deal is stuck, you should be able to identify the reason and find a way forward.
 




**Your responsibility is not just to generate leads — it is to build business.** 




  




**What We're Looking For** 
* 2–5 years of experience in
 
**B2B sales, brand partnerships, influencer marketing, digital marketing or media sales** 

 .
* Strong understanding of the Indian brand and digital marketing ecosystem.
* Existing relationships with brands/agencies will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
* Ability to understand client requirements and create solutions.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Comfortable working with revenue targets.
* Proactive, accountable and solution\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently and manage the complete sales cycle.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets / Excel and presentation tools.



  




**Key KPIs** 


 Performance will primarily be measured through:
 



* New business generated.
* Monthly and quarterly revenue.
* Qualified leads generated.
* Conversion and closure rate.
* Average deal value.
* Repeat business from existing clients.
* Client relationship quality.
* Sales pipeline health and accuracy.
* Timely follow\-ups and proposal submissions.
* Ability to independently manage and close opportunities.


**Growth Opportunity** 


 High\-performing team members can grow into:
 




**Brand Partnerships Manager → Senior Manager → Business Development Lead → Head of Brand Partnerships → Business/Revenue Leadership** 





 We want people who don't just want to
 
**sell campaigns** 

 , but want to help build the
 
**business and the brand partnerships function at Creators Yug™** 

 .
 




  




**Who Should Apply?** 


 If you are someone who:
 



* Loves talking to brands.
* Enjoys building relationships.
* Can understand a business problem and create a solution.
* Is confident in negotiations.
* Takes ownership of targets.
* Doesn't wait for instructions.
* Wants to build something rather than simply follow a process.





 ﻿
 





**We'd love to hear from you.** 




**Don't just bring us leads.** 




**Bring us opportunities, relationships and business.** 




**Creators Yug™ — Building a future where creators drive commerce at scale.**

description:

At Safe, we’ve built an AI\-driven engine that finally gives the C\-Suite a clear, quantified, and real\-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide **certainty**.



We are a **$170M Series C\-funded** category leader. We don’t play in the mid\-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to **serve 10% of the Fortune 500**, protecting global icons such as **Apple, Netflix, AT\&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret**.



As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high\-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.


### **The Culture Memo: Our Operating System**



Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high\-intensity, mission\-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.


* **Extreme Ownership:** We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.
* **The Elite Standard:** We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier\-1 quality every time.
* **Methodology \& Rigor:** We don’t wing it. From **Force Management** and **MEDDICC** in sales to **data\-driven sprints** in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.
* **Radical Candor:** We move too fast for politics or sugar\-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.
* **The Series C Hustle:** We have the stability of a well\-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

### **The Perks \& Ownership:**



We want our team to feel like owners because they **are** owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.


* **Meaningful Equity:** Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.
* **Unlimited Leaves:** We don’t believe in clock\-watching. We offer **unlimited leave** because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We provide top\-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.
* **Career Trajectory:** We are growing aggressively. For high\-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

  


  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Primary role is to work with the Threat Research team focussing on vulnerability research to analyze affected products, versions, affected path, and trigger conditions for newly released vulnerabilities
* Utilize vulnerability and exploit intel feeds to identify newly disclosed CVEs or critical vulnerabilities without CVEs which are being exploited in the wild
* Setup a lab to generate PoC and detection queries using SAFE Query Language
* Coordinate with the SAFE Exploit Research team to build exploits for these CVEs
* Identify compensating controls that can be implemented to reduce the risk from these CVEs
* Continuous research on latest security trends and novel attacks based on Threat \& Vulnerability feeds
* Proactively collaborate within the Threat Research and the Programme Management team
### **Essential Skills, Experience and Qualifications:**


* M.Tech or B.Tech / B.E. / BCA in Computer Science or Information Technology
* Must have hands\-on experience in solving **CTF challenges**
* Must have experience in effectively **utilizing LLMs for vulnerability research**
* Contributions to open source tools, CVEs advisories, or published research
* Hands\-on knowledge of port scanners, vulnerability scanners and exploitation framework
* Hands\-on experience with building modules/templates for detection or scanning in platforms like Nuclei, Metasploit, etc.
* Able to work independently with minimum supervision
* Effective communication, and interpersonal skills

Any of the following certifications would be preferred:


* **OSCP**
* **CPTS**
* **CRTO**
If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, **we want to hear from you!**

7\. Team Integration: Working cohesively within the central team to balance day\-to\-day project workflows and field demands.


**Academic Qualification \& Experience**
----------------------------------------

2\.Experience: 6 to 10 years of experience in marketing operations, terminology know\-how, and market research.
  

3\.Portfolio Scale: Operational tracking of an INR 100 Cr annual category expense across 50 to 100 active vendor accounts.  

  



**Technical Skills/Knowledge**
------------------------------


1\.Marketing Sourcing Lifecycle: Complete command over marketing terminology, BTL activation frameworks, and media planning streams.
  

2\.Sourcing Analytics: Mastery of comparative statement compilation, data tracking toolkits, and supplier quote auditing.

5\.Office Productivity: Advanced capability in MS Excel and MS Office for managing spend reports and baseline tracking data.  

  



**Behavioural Skills**

2\.Effective Communication: Clear verbal and written interaction skills to bridge internal marketing units and external service providers.
  

3\.Process Orientation: Disciplined adherence to established procurement compliance metrics and audit trails.
  

4\.Analytical Ability: Strong problem\-solving aptitude to evaluate complex proposals and resolve technical ambiguities.

**What will it be like to work for Hero**

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. Our products help prevent falls, fractures, and mobility\-related complications using clinically validated wearable medical devices. We work closely with leading hospitals, rehabilitation centers, physiotherapists, and senior living communities to bring impactful healthcare innovations to market.

 We are looking for a passionate and result\-oriented Sales Executive to drive customer acquisition and business growth across hospitals, physiotherapy clinics, rehabilitation centers, senior living facilities, home healthcare providers, distributors, and other healthcare institutions.  The Account Executive role is a sales role responsible for account retention as well as growth within the account by introducing new products and services.
   

  

**About Gartner Midsize Enterprise (MSE):**
 MSE represents one of Gartner’s largest sales populations across the US, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific. This high\-growth sales organization acquires and supports our High Tech and End User client accounts with annual revenue targets between $10 million and $1 billion per year.
   

  

**Understanding The Work Environment \& Standards Across MSE:**
 Gartner MSE operates in a hybrid work environment. This means working virtually and in the office. We have in\-office experiences which can be as often as several times each week like 1:1’s with your manager, team meetings, and upskilling sessions. Coming together with colleagues in our Gartner office is a great way to build relationships across the business while collaborating, learning, and growing together.
   

  

 At Gartner MSE, our sales associates play a key role in partnering with C\-Level executives. We believe a professional appearance and workspace play a big part in building trust and credibility. As such, we maintain a business casual dress code.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Build trust\-based, value\-added relationships with C\-Level prospects to quickly uncover the mission critical priorities and determine how Gartner can support success.
* Develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting through to close.
* Conduct calls with C\-Level prospects to qualify, showcase capabilities, and close the business.
* Collaborate with internal partners across the business to bring Gartner to life through portal walkthroughs and proof of concepts.
* Continually build a pipeline of high\-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met.
* Deliver against assigned annual quota for your territory.


**What you will need:**
* 2\-6 years of experience in a professional setting with proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets
* Proven demonstration of intellect, drive, executive presence, and sales acumen
* Experience selling IT, staffing/recruiting or professional services solutions highly preferred
* Experience selling to and/or influencing C\-Level Executives.
* Competitive drive with a collaborative approach. You aspire to be the best and inspires those around you. You challenge yourself by setting goals, crushing them, and helping your teammates do the same.
* Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sales process.
* Willingness to live within a commutable distance to the location required for this role.
* Relocation assistance is available for qualifying candidates.
* Bachelor's degree desired

* We'll invest in you. At Gartner, you'll get more than just a job. You'll get everything you need to build an exciting, rewarding career.

* Rewards and recognition. Annual "Winners Circle" event, an all\-expense paid trip for our top performers each year.
* Consistent quarter over quarter growth. Gartner is purposefully built to adjust, adapt and pivot our strategy when macro\-environmental shifts occur.


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
   

  

 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
 Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
   

  

 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

 We deliver from Gurgaon and sell into India, Europe and the Gulf.
 



  





 We are hiring our first full\-cycle Account Executive for the Europe and Gulf
 



 market.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL SELL
 



  





 AI driven new age Software services. You will not be selling man\-hours but outcomes.
 



  





 Buyers are CIOs, Chief Digital Officers, Heads of Digital Transformation,
 



 supply chain heads and CFOs at mid\-sized and large enterprises across DACH,
 



 France, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 



  





 • Own the full cycle: build the target list, run outbound, qualify, run
 



  discovery, shape the commercial terms, close.
 



 • Run first discovery calls yourself, with enough technical fluency to tell a
 



  data problem from a workflow problem and to know which of our modules fits.
 



 • Bring the founders and delivery engineers into a deal at the right moment
 



  rather than the first one.
 



 • Keep CRM accurate enough that the pipeline forecast holds up.
 



 • Feed what you hear in the market back into how we position the work.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 • 2\+ years selling B2B software or technology services, with some of it into
 



  Europe or the Gulf.
 



 • Evidence that you have closed, not only sourced. Tell us deal sizes and
 



  cycle lengths.
 



 • Written English strong enough that a cold note to a German CIO does not read
 



  as a template.

 • Comfort selling something technical you did not build. You will be asked
 



  about data residency, model hosting and integration, and you need to hold
 



  the first round of those questions on your own.
 



  





 A PLUS, NOT A REQUIREMENT
 



  





 • French or German at business level.
 



 • Experience selling into retail, CPG, manufacturing or distribution.
 



 • Time at a firm under fifty people, where the lead list is something you build.
 



  





 WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH YOUR TIME
 



  





 • You are the first AE on this market. The territory, the sequences and the

  manufacturers and healthcare platforms. Case studies and figures are on
 



  granaura.ai.
 



 • We hire senior engineers only, from the IITs and Tier\-1 institutes. Founded

title: Client Partner, K12 - Cialfo
description:
What This Role Is
   

  

 Across the Americas \- from US school districts to Latin American international schools, counselors are the single point of contact between a student's ambition and the university system that will decide their future. Most of them are doing this work manually — tracking hundreds of applications in spreadsheets, chasing document deadlines by email, and making recommendations without the data to back them. When that system breaks down, it isn't a productivity problem. It's a missed deadline that closes a door a student spent years working toward.
   

  

 Cialfo exists to close that gap, and how well that gap gets closed depends on two things happening at once: schools already on the platform getting real value out of it, and new schools discovering that this is the platform their counseling team actually needs.
   

  

 That is what this role owns. You are the person a portfolio of high schools across North and South America trusts to make Cialfo work for them, and you are also the person who walks into a school that has never heard of Cialfo and makes the case for why that should change. Saige, our AI layer, is live, and part of what you own is making sure both existing and new schools actually adopt it rather than let it sit unused.
   

  

 You own the renewal and growth of an existing book of schools, and the identification and close of new ones, across two markets that don't behave the same way — US schools and Latin American schools have different buying rhythms, different stakeholders, and often different languages. This role owns the health, retention, and growth of an assigned portfolio of US and LATAM K12 school accounts, operating from India on US hours.
   

  

 What Makes This Role Different
   

  

 Most account management roles in EdTech ask you to defend a territory. Most new\-business roles ask you to build one from nothing. This role asks you to do both at once — which means you never fully switch off the instinct that wins new logos, and you never fully switch off the instinct that keeps existing ones. It also asks you to do it across two distinct markets under one remit, rather than one clean, homogenous territory.
   

  

 It also asks you to do this across one of the widest timezone gaps in the Manifest portfolio. Being based in India while owning an Americas book of business isn't a limitation to work around — it's part of how Cialfo builds a genuinely global support model, and it means the muscle you build here (structured handoffs, tight written communication, deliberate scheduling around narrow overlap windows) is a distinct capability, not a compromise.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem gives you something a standalone vendor doesn't have: when a school's ambitions extend beyond counseling — university outreach or student placement pathways — you can point to Explore or Kaaiser as part of the same infrastructure, rather than referring the school elsewhere. No competitor in this market holds that full arc.
   

  

 The broader overseas education industry is contracting. Cialfo is growing. That gap is the argument for why now is the right time to be inside a school's counseling office, not outside it.
   

  

 What You Own
   

  

**Existing school relationships across the Americas**
* Own the renewal and health of a defined portfolio of high school accounts across both US and Latin American markets
* Build direct relationships with counselors, IT teams, and school leadership — not just your primary point of contact
* Identify and resolve account risk before it becomes churn


**New school acquisition across the Americas**
* Build and work a pipeline of prospective schools across both markets
* Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract
* Translate Cialfo's platform value into terms that land with a counseling team meeting it for the first time, adjusting the pitch to how each market actually buys


**Onboarding and platform adoption**
* Lead onboarding and training tailored to each stakeholder group, from counselors to senior leadership, whether the school is new or renewing
* Drive adoption of Saige and other newer product features against each school's actual counseling workflow
* Ensure every stakeholder group understands the platform well enough to rely on it during peak application season


**Account growth and expansion**
* Build account\-specific growth plans using engagement and outcome data, not general upsell targets
* Identify where a school's needs extend into other parts of the Manifest ecosystem and translate that into commercial opportunity
* Present renewal and expansion proposals with the credibility of someone who has actually used the data


**Client operations**
* Keep account records, interaction history, and pipeline status current in the CRM
* Translate recurring client feedback into structured input for the product team
* Structure your workflow and handoffs around narrow daily overlap windows that shift depending on whether you're working US or Latin American hours


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The markers below reflect where the Cialfo Americas client success and growth function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first three months, you know your existing portfolio well enough to have a point of view on which accounts are healthy in both markets, and you've built a working rhythm that makes the most of narrow live\-overlap windows rather than fighting them — you've started building a real pipeline of prospective schools rather than a list of names.
   

  

 By six months, your existing accounts show visibly higher adoption of features like Saige than when you started, and you've closed or are close to closing your first new schools in at least one of the two markets, without the timezone gap ever becoming the client's problem to manage.
   

  

 By twelve months, you've built a portfolio that runs on trust rather than maintenance across both the US and Latin American book, and a track record of new schools who chose Cialfo because of how you made the case to them. What you built — on both sides of the book, in both markets — outlasts the individual deals.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

 What You Bring
   

  

 You've spent the better part of five years or more in customer success, account management, business development, or client\-facing strategic consulting, ideally with exposure to SaaS, EdTech, or B2B technology sold into schools or comparable institutions. You've done both sides of this job before — closing new business and running an existing book — and you don't think of them as different skill sets, just different conversations.
   

  

 You read data and use it to make decisions about an account before the client asks you to, not after. You track what a portfolio is worth today and what it should be worth, and you build the case to close that gap yourself — whether that gap is a renewal at risk or a school that hasn't signed yet.
   

  

 You're comfortable moving between a counselor who's never used a CRM and a head of school who wants a strategic conversation about outcomes — and you adjust your approach for each without losing credibility with either. You're equally comfortable adjusting your approach between a US school district and a Latin American international school, because you know these aren't the same conversation wearing different accents.
   

  

 You're fluent in English and comfortable working in Spanish or Portuguese, since a meaningful part of this book won't run in English at all.
   

  

 You've built relationships across significant timezone gaps before, or you know exactly how you'd approach it: tight written communication, no reliance on catching people live, and a schedule structured enough that narrow overlap windows are a constraint you plan around, not an excuse.
   

  

 This is a role with a defined book of accounts, an open territory of prospects, and real autonomy in how you manage both. You don't need someone checking in on your renewal strategy or your pipeline weekly.
   

  

 You're coachable. This function is still being refined, and the person who thrives here treats feedback as part of getting better at the job, not as a threat to how they already do it.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what Cialfo is building for schools across the Americas and your first reaction was that you already know exactly which relationships you'd deepen and which doors you'd knock on first — in both markets. That's the person this role is for.
   

  

 Why Manifest
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically, the relationships you build with schools across the Americas — new and existing, in two markets that don't run the same way — are what turn Cialfo from a platform some schools use into the platform counseling teams across the hemisphere choose by default.
   

  

 Cialfo is part of Manifest Global — a multi\-brand group building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.

title: Portfolio Business Manager - Capco Corporate Services
description:
**Job: Portfolio Business Manager**


**About Us**


*"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by* *Avtar \& Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*

***WHY JOIN CAPCO?***



You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.


***MAKE AN IMPACT***



Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.


***\#BEYOURSELFATWORK***



Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.


***CAREER ADVANCEMENT***


*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*


***DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION***


*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*


**Business Manager: Job Description**



The Business Manager is the engine that turns the business's commercial ambition into action, orchestrating teams across Capco's global organization to align resources, remove barriers and deliver at pace.



This is a senior business leadership role, requiring an executive mindset and the experience, judgement and credibility to operate effectively with senior leaders, navigate complexity, challenge constructively and influence outcomes across teams and geographies, often with limited direct authority.


**Role purpose**



The Business Manager is responsible for ensuring their area of the business \[global client account, capability, or alternative] operates effectively and delivers against its commercial, operational and people objectives.



Working as a trusted partner to the relevant Partner(s), they connect client and sales teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions to translate business priorities into coordinated execution.



The Business Manager brings together the right stakeholders, information and decisions at the right time, resolving dependencies, creating accountability and maintaining momentum across a highly collaborative environment.


**Key responsibilities**


* **Stakeholder management \& business orchestration:** Build and actively manage relationships across client and account teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions. Navigate competing perspectives and use influence to align stakeholders around shared priorities, remove barriers and drive collective ownership for delivery.
* **Business performance:** Own the management rhythm for the business area, bringing together commercial, financial, operational, resourcing and people information to provide a clear view of performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive action.
* **Planning \& forecasting:** Lead integrated planning and forecasting across sales, demand, supply, recruitment and financial performance, ensuring assumptions and priorities are aligned across teams.
* **Strategy execution:** Translate global priorities into practical plans, mobilize the relevant teams and maintain momentum and accountability through delivery.
* **Commercial \& client alignment:** Work closely with account and sales teams to understand pipeline, client demand and growth priorities, ensuring these translate into operational and workforce plans.
* **Resourcing \& recruitment:** Connect client demand with workforce supply, skills and recruitment to ensure the business has the right capability and capacity at the right time.
* **Financial management:** Drive financial discipline across the business area, supporting budget management, margin improvement, investment decisions and management of financial risks.
* **People \& talent:** Drive workforce and talent planning, including capacity, attrition, development priorities and succession, working closely with business and people leaders.
* **Business improvement \& operational excellence:** Use data and insight to challenge the status quo, identify opportunities to improve performance and mobilize stakeholders to deliver change. Champion and inform the development of Capco's operational processes and tooling to support broader organizational adoption.


**What success looks like**



A successful Business Manager creates a business that feels joined up rather than siloed, with clear priorities, strong accountability and effective execution.



They ensure that sales ambition, client demand, workforce capacity, financial plans and operational execution are connected, even where delivery requires multiple teams, functions or regions to work together.



Business leaders have a clear view of performance, priorities and emerging risks; stakeholders understand their accountabilities and dependencies; regional and global teams work effectively towards shared goals; and decisions translate into action and measurable outcomes.



Success will be measured against a defined set of KPIs agreed with the relevant business leaders, reflecting the commercial, operational and people priorities of the business area.


***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

**About Artarium**

Artarium is a home décor and lifestyle brand offering a wide range of premium decorative products, including God Idols, Resin \& Polyresin décor, Brass products, Wall Art, Figurines, Car Dashboard Idols, and other artistic home décor pieces.

We are looking for an experienced and customer\-focused **Store Executive** who can confidently understand our entire product range, explain product features and materials to customers, drive sales, and efficiently manage store inventory and day\-to\-day operations.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Customer Handling \& Sales**

* Welcome and assist customers in the store and understand their requirements.
* Explain Artarium's products, designs, materials, sizes, finishes, usage, and pricing in a clear and convincing manner.
* Develop strong product knowledge across all Artarium categories.
* Recommend suitable products based on the customer's home décor needs, gifting requirements, budget, and preferences.
* Demonstrate products and explain the unique features, craftsmanship, material, and finishing.
* Handle customer queries, objections, negotiations, and product\-related concerns professionally.
* Convert walk\-in customers into sales and consistently work towards achieving individual and store sales targets.
* Upsell and cross\-sell complementary products wherever relevant.
* Build long\-term relationships with customers and encourage repeat purchases.

**2\. Product Knowledge**

The candidate should be comfortable learning and explaining different materials and product categories, including:

* Resin and Polyresin products
* Home décor products
* God Idols and religious décor
* Brass products and brass décor
* Wall Art
* Figurines and sculptures
* Geometric décor
* Car Dashboard Idols
* Decorative accessories
* Gifting products

The candidate should be able to understand the **material, quality, finishing, design, size, weight, usage, care instructions, and key selling points** of products and communicate these effectively to customers.

**3\. Inventory Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day store inventory and stock movement.
* Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing products.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile them with system records.
* Monitor fast\-moving, slow\-moving, and damaged products.
* Ensure products are properly tagged, displayed, stored, and maintained.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and operations team for stock replenishment.
* Raise requirements for products that are running low or out of stock.
* Maintain proper records of stock transfers, returns, replacements, and damaged items.
* Assist in regular stock audits and inventory reconciliation.

**4\. Store Operations**

* Ensure the store is clean, organised, and visually appealing at all times.
* Maintain proper product displays according to Artarium's merchandising guidelines.
* Ensure all products have correct pricing and product information.
* Check product condition before displaying or handing over products to customers.
* Support opening and closing store activities.
* Maintain proper billing and sales documentation.
* Coordinate with the backend, warehouse, accounts, and management teams whenever required.
* Follow all store SOPs and company policies.

**5\. Customer Experience**

* Provide a premium and personalised shopping experience to every customer.
* Understand customer requirements before recommending products.
* Explain product care and handling instructions where required.
* Handle customer complaints professionally and escalate issues to the Store Manager when necessary.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude while dealing with customers.

**Required Skills**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent customer\-handling and selling skills.
* Good understanding of retail sales processes.
* Strong interest in **home décor, lifestyle products, art, interiors, or decorative products**.
* Ability to quickly learn and understand different materials such as **resin, polyresin, brass, wood/plyresin, MDF, metal, etc.**
* Good product presentation and demonstration skills.
* Basic understanding of inventory management and stock reconciliation.
* Comfortable using POS systems, billing software, Excel/Google Sheets, and inventory management systems.
* Good numerical and organisational skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a retail team.
* Target\-oriented and proactive approach.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:

* Home Décor
* Furniture
* Lifestyle Retail
* Luxury Retail
* Handicrafts
* Interior Décor
* Art \& Sculptures
* Furniture \& Furnishing
* Gift \& Lifestyle Products
* Religious / Spiritual Products
* Resin / Polyresin Products
* Brass / Metal Décor

**Qualification**

* Graduate / Undergraduate with relevant retail experience.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in retail sales, preferably in **home décor, furniture, lifestyle, handicrafts, or similar product categories**.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Store sales and achievement of monthly targets
* Conversion of walk\-in customers
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Upselling and cross\-selling
* Customer satisfaction
* Inventory accuracy
* Stock availability and replenishment
* Reduction in stock discrepancies and damages
* Store presentation and product merchandising

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be a **sales\-oriented, well\-presented and customer\-friendly individual** who has a genuine interest in home décor and understands how to sell premium decorative products.

The person should have the ability to **quickly understand Artarium's complete product portfolio**, learn the materials and craftsmanship behind each product, and confidently explain the products to customers.

Experience in **resin/polyresin, home décor, furniture, handicrafts, lifestyle or premium retail** will be highly preferred.

You will manage the sales pipeline, maintain accurate interaction records, negotiate pricing and terms, and prioritize opportunities that improve conversion and commercial outcomes. Success means building a reliable local customer base, strengthening relationships through responsive solution selling, and consistently achieving assigned sales targets. This is an onsite, field\-oriented role requiring regular travel, customer meetings, independent execution, and ownership of the complete sales process.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Generate qualified local leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationship\-led outreach, expanding the opportunity base and improving the consistency of customer acquisition.
* Identify prospective customers, businesses, architects, interior designers, and builders whose requirements align with Ultrafresh’s modular home solutions and commercial growth priorities.
* Conduct face\-to\-face meetings, diagnose customer requirements, and present relevant kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliance solutions that improve fit, confidence, and conversion.
* Build trusted customer relationships through timely follow\-up and responsive engagement, protecting satisfaction while increasing referrals, repeat opportunities, and successful project progression.
* Own the sales pipeline by tracking opportunity stages, prioritizing high\-potential prospects, and maintaining accurate customer interaction records for disciplined follow\-through.
* Analyse customer needs and recommend effective solutions, balancing functional requirements, design expectations, pricing considerations, and commercial feasibility during the sales process.
* Negotiate pricing and terms within approved parameters, protecting customer value and business margins while moving qualified opportunities toward closure.
* Deliver assigned sales targets and objectives by managing daily field activity, conversion priorities, and pipeline coverage across the local base location.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to customer conversations, enabling clear recommendations, credible value articulation, and commercially sound closures.
* Demonstrate independence and teamwork in a field\-sales environment, taking ownership of local execution while coordinating effectively with internal colleagues and customer stakeholders.
* Communicate fluently in English and Hindi, with proficiency in at least one regional language, to build trust and conduct effective consultations across the assigned market.
* Apply structured pipeline management and accurate customer\-record discipline to prioritize opportunities, maintain visibility, and improve follow\-up quality throughout the sales cycle.
* Use customer\-need analysis and consultative selling to connect individual requirements with suitable modular products, supporting stronger conversion and customer satisfaction.
* Own a two\-wheeler and be prepared for regular field travel, customer meetings, networking, and face\-to\-face business development within the local market.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling modular kitchens, home interiors, or other modular products can shorten the learning curve and strengthen solution credibility with customers.
* Existing relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, or local business networks can accelerate qualified lead generation and improve market access.
* A proven record of meeting sales targets in the local base location demonstrates the commercial ownership needed to succeed in this role.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring at least two years of direct, field, or B2C sales experience, with evidence that you can build a local pipeline and convert opportunities into measurable revenue.
* You communicate confidently in English and Hindi and can engage customers in at least one regional language, adapting your presentation to different needs, backgrounds, and decision\-making styles.
* You are comfortable working independently in the field while contributing to a team environment, taking responsibility for prospecting, meetings, follow\-ups, records, negotiations, and target delivery.
* You listen carefully to customer requirements and translate them into practical product recommendations, helping prospects understand the value of modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances.
* You bring disciplined pipeline habits, accurate record keeping, and consistent follow\-through so every qualified opportunity receives the right attention at the right stage.
* You own a two\-wheeler and are willing to travel locally for customer meetings, networking, referrals, and relationship development.
* Familiarity with modular or concept\-based product selling, plus an existing network among architects, interior designers, or builders, will help you create momentum faster.
* Most importantly, you are commercially driven, relationship\-oriented, and motivated by achieving clear sales objectives while ensuring customers receive solutions that fit their practical and lifestyle requirements.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a fast\-growing home lifestyle brand with more than 200 studios across India, giving you access to a broad market and meaningful local sales opportunities.
* Sell a differentiated portfolio spanning modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, allowing you to solve complete home improvement needs rather than isolated product requirements.
* Work with the backing of the TTK Prestige Group while combining craftsmanship, technology, and innovation to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality.
* Build a career in consultative field sales where disciplined execution, customer relationships, and measurable commercial outcomes directly shape business growth.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A role with direct ownership of local market development, customer acquisition, pipeline quality, negotiations, and sales\-target achievement.
* Exposure to a growing home interiors business with a broad product portfolio, studio network, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and opportunities to build valuable market relationships.
* A customer\-facing environment where strong performance can be demonstrated through qualified lead generation, conversion, relationship quality, and consistent commercial delivery.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**About Research Ramp** 




 Research Ramp Private Limited is a DPIIT\-recognised company based in Kolkata. We help researchers, PhD scholars and faculty members prepare and publish their work in reputed journals. Our support includes manuscript editing, journal selection, responding to reviewer comments, and submission support for Scopus\-, Web of Science\-, and EI\-indexed journals. Our clients come from India, Malaysia, China, the Middle East and other countries.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a driven person with a sales mindset who also understands the academic world. You will find new clients, start conversations, follow up patiently, and turn interested researchers into paying clients. You will handle both Indian and foreign leads.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •    Research and build lists of potential clients such as PhD scholars, early career researchers and faculty members in India and abroad.

 •    Keep every lead list accurate, organised and free of duplicates.
 



 •    Reply to incoming enquiries from WhatsApp, email, the website and social media quickly and professionally.
 



 •    Send personalised outreach messages to new prospects. No bulk spam.
 



 •    Follow up with leads regularly and politely until there is a clear yes or no.
 



**How we will measure your work** 




 •    Number of qualified leads handed to the business development team each week
 



 •    Number of consultation calls booked
 



 •    Number of new partnerships started
 



**Qualifications** 




 •    A Master's degree (completed or final year) in any field. Management, commerce, life sciences, engineering, social sciences and similar fields are all welcome.
 



 •    Some research exposure, such as a dissertation, thesis, research project or published paper.
 



 •    Excellent written English. Most of this job happens on WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn.
 



 •    Confident spoken English for calls.
 



 •    Prior experience in sales, lead generation, business development, client servicing or a similar internship.
 



 •    Comfortable with Google Sheets or Excel, LinkedIn, WhatsApp Business and email.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Sales Executive** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai, New Delhi, and Kolkata, India
 



**Experience:** 
 2\-4 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Ultrafresh is a leading modular kitchen and home interior brand transforming houses into stylish, functional homes. Powered by the TTK Prestige Group, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, with regional offices in Delhi, Bengaluru, and Kolkata and more than 200 studios across India. Ultrafresh serves customers through kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, combining design\-led thinking with practical home solutions. Its advanced manufacturing capabilities and focus on innovation support consistent product quality and scalable customer delivery. The business blends craftsmanship and technology to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality, while its studio network enables local engagement and consultation. As one of India’s fastest\-growing home lifestyle brands, Ultrafresh is expanding its reach by connecting customers with solutions tailored to their requirements, budgets, and living spaces. The company’s sales teams play a direct role in converting customer needs into satisfying, commercially successful home interior outcomes.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Sales Executive, you will own customer acquisition and revenue development across your assigned local market. You will generate demand through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationships with customers, architects, interior designers, builders, and relevant businesses. Through face\-to\-face consultations, you will understand requirements, present suitable modular kitchen and home interior solutions, and convert qualified opportunities into sales. You will manage the sales pipeline, maintain accurate interaction records, negotiate pricing and terms, and prioritize opportunities that improve conversion and commercial outcomes. Success means building a reliable local customer base, strengthening relationships through responsive solution selling, and consistently achieving assigned sales targets. This is an onsite, field\-oriented role requiring regular travel, customer meetings, independent execution, and ownership of the complete sales process.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Generate qualified local leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationship\-led outreach, expanding the opportunity base and improving the consistency of customer acquisition.
* Identify prospective customers, businesses, architects, interior designers, and builders whose requirements align with Ultrafresh’s modular home solutions and commercial growth priorities.
* Conduct face\-to\-face meetings, diagnose customer requirements, and present relevant kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliance solutions that improve fit, confidence, and conversion.
* Build trusted customer relationships through timely follow\-up and responsive engagement, protecting satisfaction while increasing referrals, repeat opportunities, and successful project progression.
* Own the sales pipeline by tracking opportunity stages, prioritizing high\-potential prospects, and maintaining accurate customer interaction records for disciplined follow\-through.
* Analyse customer needs and recommend effective solutions, balancing functional requirements, design expectations, pricing considerations, and commercial feasibility during the sales process.
* Negotiate pricing and terms within approved parameters, protecting customer value and business margins while moving qualified opportunities toward closure.
* Deliver assigned sales targets and objectives by managing daily field activity, conversion priorities, and pipeline coverage across the local base location.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to customer conversations, enabling clear recommendations, credible value articulation, and commercially sound closures.
* Demonstrate independence and teamwork in a field\-sales environment, taking ownership of local execution while coordinating effectively with internal colleagues and customer stakeholders.
* Communicate fluently in English and Hindi, with proficiency in at least one regional language, to build trust and conduct effective consultations across the assigned market.
* Apply structured pipeline management and accurate customer\-record discipline to prioritize opportunities, maintain visibility, and improve follow\-up quality throughout the sales cycle.
* Use customer\-need analysis and consultative selling to connect individual requirements with suitable modular products, supporting stronger conversion and customer satisfaction.
* Own a two\-wheeler and be prepared for regular field travel, customer meetings, networking, and face\-to\-face business development within the local market.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling modular kitchens, home interiors, or other modular products can shorten the learning curve and strengthen solution credibility with customers.
* Existing relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, or local business networks can accelerate qualified lead generation and improve market access.
* A proven record of meeting sales targets in the local base location demonstrates the commercial ownership needed to succeed in this role.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring at least two years of direct, field, or B2C sales experience, with evidence that you can build a local pipeline and convert opportunities into measurable revenue.
* You communicate confidently in English and Hindi and can engage customers in at least one regional language, adapting your presentation to different needs, backgrounds, and decision\-making styles.
* You are comfortable working independently in the field while contributing to a team environment, taking responsibility for prospecting, meetings, follow\-ups, records, negotiations, and target delivery.
* You listen carefully to customer requirements and translate them into practical product recommendations, helping prospects understand the value of modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances.
* You bring disciplined pipeline habits, accurate record keeping, and consistent follow\-through so every qualified opportunity receives the right attention at the right stage.
* You own a two\-wheeler and are willing to travel locally for customer meetings, networking, referrals, and relationship development.
* Familiarity with modular or concept\-based product selling, plus an existing network among architects, interior designers, or builders, will help you create momentum faster.
* Most importantly, you are commercially driven, relationship\-oriented, and motivated by achieving clear sales objectives while ensuring customers receive solutions that fit their practical and lifestyle requirements.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a fast\-growing home lifestyle brand with more than 200 studios across India, giving you access to a broad market and meaningful local sales opportunities.
* Sell a differentiated portfolio spanning modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, allowing you to solve complete home improvement needs rather than isolated product requirements.
* Work with the backing of the TTK Prestige Group while combining craftsmanship, technology, and innovation to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality.
* Build a career in consultative field sales where disciplined execution, customer relationships, and measurable commercial outcomes directly shape business growth.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A role with direct ownership of local market development, customer acquisition, pipeline quality, negotiations, and sales\-target achievement.
* Exposure to a growing home interiors business with a broad product portfolio, studio network, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and opportunities to build valuable market relationships.
* A customer\-facing environment where strong performance can be demonstrated through qualified lead generation, conversion, relationship quality, and consistent commercial delivery.

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
