title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
**About BeFiSc** 




 BeFiSc is a financial data intelligence and risk technology company helping businesses make safer, faster, and smarter decisions. We work with organizations across Fintech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, and Financial Services.
 



 Our core focus is Fraud Prevention, Risk Analysis, and Financial Data Intelligence. Using technology, APIs, data analytics, and large\-scale data processing, we help businesses detect suspicious patterns, assess customer and transaction risks, verify identities and businesses, and turn complex financial data into actionable insights.
 



 Our solutions support critical use cases including customer onboarding, underwriting, fraud detection, identity and employment verification, financial analysis, due diligence, and risk monitoring.
 



**Role Description** 




 We are looking for an Enterprise Sales Manager to drive new business acquisition and enterprise account closures in the assigned region. The candidate will be responsible for identifying prospects, building a strong sales pipeline, engaging decision\-makers, conducting product discussions, managing proposals, negotiating commercials, and closing business with relevant enterprise clients.
 



 The ideal candidate should have at least 2 years of relevant B2B or enterprise sales experience, preferably across FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, SaaS, Technology, or Financial Services. This role requires strong sales discipline, relationship\-building ability, consultative selling skills, and ownership of regional business development.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Drive new business acquisition across assigned regional markets and target customer segments.
* Identify, research, and engage enterprise prospects across Banks, NBFCs, FinTechs, Insurance, Digital Lending companies, and Financial Services organizations.
* Build and manage a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, referrals, events, outreach, and business development activities.
* Connect with decision\-makers and key stakeholders to understand business needs, risk use cases, data requirements, and potential opportunities.
* Conduct product discussions, demos, discovery calls, and solution presentations in coordination with internal teams.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from lead qualification to proposal, negotiation, commercial discussion, closure, and handover.
* Prepare proposals, pricing inputs, meeting notes, follow\-up trackers, pipeline updates, and sales reports.
* Maintain CRM discipline by updating opportunities, follow\-ups, client interactions, pipeline stage, and next steps accurately.
* Coordinate with Product, Technology, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Customer Success teams during sales discussions, closures, and client handovers.
* Contribute to regional sales strategy, market feedback, competitor insights, and continuous improvement in sales processes.



**Required Skills** 



* Strong B2B or enterprise sales, business development, and account closure skills.
* Ability to identify prospects, engage decision\-makers, and manage enterprise sales conversations.
* Good understanding of consultative selling, solution positioning, proposal management, and negotiation.
* Strong communication, presentation, persuasion, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to manage sales pipeline, follow\-ups, CRM updates, and multiple opportunities effectively.
* Good market research, prospecting, and stakeholder mapping abilities.
* Comfort working with internal teams across Product, Technology, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Customer Success.
* Ownership, accountability, target orientation, persistence, and strong execution discipline.



**Required Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, Management, Finance, Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Sales, B2B Sales, Business Development, SaaS Sales, FinTech Sales, or a similar sales\-focused role.
* Relevant experience in new business acquisition, enterprise client engagement, proposal management, negotiation, and account closure.
* Strong ability to manage pipeline, follow\-ups, meetings, commercial discussions, and sales documentation.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned region as required for client meetings and business development activities.



**Preferred or Good to Have** 



* Experience in FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, SaaS, Technology, or Financial Services.
* Experience selling to Banks, NBFCs, FinTechs, Insurance companies, Digital Lending companies, or enterprise financial institutions.
* Understanding of APIs, risk products, fraud detection, financial data intelligence, onboarding, underwriting, or data analytics solutions.
* Experience with CRM tools, sales dashboards, proposal tools, pipeline trackers, or lead management platforms.
* Experience working in a startup or growing technology organization.
* Strong professional network in the assigned region or target industry segment.
* Experience coordinating with cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders during enterprise sales closures.

* Prior early\-stage or founding\-sales experience



  





**CTC \- Upto 10 lacs**

title: Account Manager - GCC, GCC , AWS India
description:
**Description**
 Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider? Amazon Web Services India Private Limited is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for world\-class candidates to join our enterprise business.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 As a GCC Account Manager for AWS India, your responsibilities will include building and driving the strategy to increase AWS adoption and market penetration across Global Capability Centers (GCCs) operating in India. You will be responsible for carrying out global account strategy locally and building long\-term business and technology partnerships with these strategic engineering and innovation hubs that shape global cloud architecture.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The candidate would drive A/ Internal Digital Transformation B/ Cloud Migration \& Platform Modernization C/ Data\-driven Innovation and D/ Generative AI conversations, sales plays and adoption across GCC operations.
* The candidate would drive regular and deeper executive engagement between GCC India leadership, global parent organization stakeholders, and AWS teams to ensure "Top to Top" connect from both sides.
* The candidate would have the charter of driving regular, strategic, business transformation \& roadmap oriented conversations with GCC Heads, Engineering Leaders, and Center of Excellence (CoE) owners with regards to cloud architecture decisions, workload migrations, and innovation initiatives.
* The candidate would have the charter of engaging with GCC Engineering Heads, Product Development leaders, and Horizontal leaders to drive success of their Migration/Modernization strategy.
* He/she should be able to provide guidance \& leadership to the extended teams and drive execution excellence behind the success of projects and Pilots.
* The candidate will lead collaboration initiatives including hackathons, immersion days, and tech days to showcase AWS capabilities, build technical mindshare, and accelerate adoption.
* The candidate would be able to evangelize with GCC CTO/CIO offices and replicate successful cloud adoption patterns across different Lines of Business (LOBs) and geographies. Also, interface with Product Engineering \& Innovation teams to influence global product and platform transformation decisions.
* The candidate would work closely with GSIs and ISVs that support GCC operations and ensure alignment with global account teams to convert local initiatives into global\-scale consumption.
* The candidate would ensure all local operations and cloud implementations follow Indian data sovereignty, privacy, and regulatory requirements while maintaining global architecture standards.
* The ideal candidate will possess a key account management or business development background that enables them to engage at all levels of a GCC organization, including C\-levels, Engineering Heads, and technical architects of both the India operations and global parent organization.
* The candidate will demonstrate a strong technical competency focused on cloud computing, modern application development, and the evolving GCC landscape in India.
* The candidate should be a self\-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a coverage plan and business objectives, connecting AWS's global account strategy with India's growing GCC ecosystem.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As an Account Manager for GCC practice, you will be the owner of your assigned GCC accounts and will focus on driving digital transformation and cloud adoption through meaningful engagement with GCC leaders, Engineering Heads, architects, developers, and global stakeholders.
   

  

* In this role, you will partner closely with AWS global account teams, local partners, and internal stakeholders to represent the entire portfolio of AWS products and services across your assigned GCC customer base.
* You will act as a thought leader, trusted advisor, and local champion who helps influence technology decisions, accelerate cloud workload migrations, and unlock new innovation opportunities that scale globally.
* Research and preparation for the day's customer meetings and calls with GCC leaders and global stakeholders
* Collaborate with Cross\-functional teams (Global Account Managers, SA, ProServe, Partner teams) on pitches, demos, and technical engagements
* Customer meeting(s) and customer cadence calls with GCC India teams and global parent organization
* Stakeholder mapping across GCC India operations and global leadership
* Plan and execute in\-person engagement activities (hackathons, immersion days, tech showcases)
* Ensure high standards and maintain SFDC hygiene with clear linkage between local initiatives and global consumption


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
* 7\+ years of sales or account management experience
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or business\-related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with GCC Companies to achieve sales
* MBA or relevant experience
* Proven track record of driving cloud adoption and influencing technology decisions at engineering and product development organizations

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI\-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
   

  

 We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
   

  

 Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM \+ AI conversation \- shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
* You will lead India Presales and a team of \~10\-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid\-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.


**What Work Looks Like**
* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO\-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10\-15\-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution\-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI\-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI\-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time


**Role expectations**
* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.
* Raise the talent bar. Build a high\-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.
* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.
* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 12–15\+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.
* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross\-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.


**Why this role is different**
 You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.
   

  

**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Tech Modernization – Senior Manager
description:
**Technology Strategy and Transformation – Senior Manager – Technology Modernization**
 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients define and accelerate technology modernization journeys that unlock growth, simplify complexity and create future\-ready technology landscapes
   

  

**Practice:** 
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network

 Technology Modernization Strategy, Application Modernization

 15\+ years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growth? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choices? Do you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
   

  

 If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategies, target\-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C\-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business\-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.
   

  

 We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep\-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end\-to\-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high\-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:
   

  

**Modernization Strategy \& Value Agenda:** 
 Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes
 **Technology Estate \& Application Portfolio Assessment:** 
 Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non\-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio\-level priorities
 **Target Architecture \& Modernization Pathways:** 
 Shape target\-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation
 **Modernization Roadmap, Business Case \& Decision Governance:** 
 Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade\-offs and realize measurable business value
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy \& Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization\-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.
   

  

 The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.
   

  

 The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade\-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long\-term architecture fit.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap**
* Lead enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes
* Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business\-aligned technology modernization priorities
* Assess current\-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems
* Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools
* Shape target\-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction
* Define modernization guiding principles, decision \& prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices
* Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners
* Build multi\-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness
* Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed\-to\-market


**Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture \& Planning**
* Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential
* Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities
* Define application modernization pathways for target applications
* Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options
* Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies
* Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity
* Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API\-led integration, microservices, event\-driven architecture, cloud\-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform\-based modernization
* Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future\-ready application architecture
* Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


**Executive advisory and Growth**
* Lead CxO\-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade\-offs and enterprise transformation decisions
* Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions
* Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership\-ready points of view
* Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive\-ready solution narratives
* Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client
* Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks
* Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


**Core Skillsets \& Tools**
**Technology Modernization Advisory**
* Strong understanding of how enterprise technology modernization enables business growth, agility, resilience, cost optimization, speed\-to\-market and technology simplification
* Ability to assess complex technology estates across applications, platforms, integrations, data dependencies, AI, engineering, infrastructure touchpoints, cloud footprint, vendor ecosystem and technology debt
* Strong capability in legacy application modernization, technology debt assessment, modernization prioritization and investment sequencing across large enterprise landscapes
* Experience in developing modernization value cases that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes such as run\-cost reduction, risk reduction, improved resilience, faster change velocity and business capability enablement
* Familiarity operating model implications of modernization, including product\-centric delivery, platform operating models, engineering maturity, governance and change readiness
* Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise value chain


**Application Architecture, Engineering and AI**
* Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data \& AI architecture, cloud architecture and transition architecture in modernization contexts
* Deep understanding of modern application architecture patterns such as domain\-driven design, modular architecture, microservices, event\-driven architecture, API\-led integration, cloud\-native application design and strangler\-based modernization
* Strong understanding of application modernization pathways including trade\-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity
* Experience with aging application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end\-of\-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes
* Practical understanding of modern engineering practices such as AI driven SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, Kubernetes and platform engineering
* Strong understanding of frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, COBIT, IT4IT, business capability modelling, modernization maturity assessment and technology value assessment
* Good understanding of cloud, data and AI architecture concepts, including Azure/AWS/GCP, data lake, data fabric, real\-time data processing, semantic models, AI/ML integration, GenAI enablement and AI\-ready application architecture
* Familiarity with platform ecosystems across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, hyperscalers, integration platforms, data platforms, observability tools and engineering toolchains


**Consulting And Communication Skills**
* Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, assessment design, facilitation, business case development and executive storytelling
* Ability to engage senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity, influence client leadership and create alignment across business and technology teams
* Experience in independently leading client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling modernization narratives and shape opportunities
* Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits and senior client relationship development


**Read More About Us.**
* The rise of forerunners
* Recent Blogs


**What’s in it for you?**
* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting:**
 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in\-country teams to deliver cutting\-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network
   

  

 Accenture Capability Network \| Accenture in One Word
   

  

 At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high\-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
   

  

 You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent\-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands\-on builder, deep product architect, and first\-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain\-Specific AI Integration**
 Architect Intent\-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high\-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
   

  

 Context\-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain\-specific Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
   

  

 Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core\-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
   

  

**Product Delivery \& SDLC Acceleration**
 Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain\-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
   

  

 Establish Guardrails \& AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human\-in\-the\-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2\).
   

  

 Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature\-to\-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge\-case test generation.
   

  

**Forward\-Deployed Customer Engagement**
 Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
   

  

 Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high\-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
   

  

 Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C\-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Must\-Have Qualifications And Experience**
 Experience: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5\+ years spent delivering high\-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
   

  

 Technical Fluency: Deep, hands\-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE\-based assistants.
   

  

 Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
   

  

 Background in customer\-facing technical roles such as Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:**

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
   

  

**What To Know**
* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.


 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
   

  

**About Commvault**
 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI\-powered platform combines best\-in\-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning\-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Commvault is seeking a Customer Trust Lead to support customer and prospect security and compliance inquiries and help build confidence in Commvault’s security, privacy, and resilience posture. As a member of the Trust organization, this role serves as a key external\-facing representative, engaging with customers to explain security and compliance concepts and guide discussions toward meaningful, business\-aligned outcomes across security, privacy, data governance, AI, and resilience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customer\-facing security and compliance inquiries, including questionnaires, due diligence requests, and customer calls.
* Clearly explain Commvault’s security, privacy, data governance, AI, and resilience posture to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Assess and communicate security and compliance risk at the appropriate level, helping customers move beyond unnecessary detail to focus on true business impact and effective mitigation strategies.
* Review security\- and compliance\-related contract language and customer requirements in partnership with Legal and other internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to provide accurate, consistent, and timely responses.
* Represent the Commvault brand externally with exceptional professionalism, polish, and sound judgment.


**Who you are?**
* 5\+ years of experience
* Thorough knowledge of broad security, trust, risk, or compliance topics
* Experience in customer\-facing roles.
* Strong understanding of information security, privacy, and risk management principles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and credibly.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Expertise with common security and compliance frameworks and standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, privacy regulations).
* Customer\-focused, calm, and confident in high\-stakes or ambiguous situations.
* Able to balance attention to detail with big\-picture judgment.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and trusted by both customers and internal teams.


 Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.
   

  

 Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com.

title: POC Technical Lead - Senior Principal Consultant
description:
**POC Technical Lead, Applied AI**
**About The Role**
 WRL is looking for a hands\-on
 **POC Technical Lead, Applied AI** 
 to turn validated research hypotheses and enterprise business problems into working, measurable, and transfer\-ready AI prototypes.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of applied AI research, solution architecture, and rapid prototyping. Partnering with researchers, domain specialists, business stakeholders, and engineering teams, you will design prototype architectures, build end\-to\-end proofs of concept, evaluate technical alternatives, and determine whether a solution is ready to move into development.
   

  

 This is not a coordination\-only or presentation\-focused role. You will write and review code, integrate AI models with enterprise data and systems, build evaluation frameworks, and lead the technical execution of PoCs.
   

  

 Once a PoC is validated, you will prepare the architecture, code, evaluation evidence, technical documentation, and implementation recommendations required for Winfo’s Development and Deployment teams to productize and scale the solution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Translate research hypotheses and business requirements into focused, time\-bound POC plans.
* Define the minimum prototype needed to test technical feasibility and potential business value.
* Design end\-to\-end architectures for applied AI, generative AI, and agentic solutions.
* Build working PoCs using LLMs, RAG, agents, machine learning, multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, APIs, and enterprise integrations.
* Compare models, frameworks, prompting strategies, retrieval methods, and architecture alternatives using measurable evidence.
* Build evaluation harnesses covering quality, groundedness, robustness, latency, cost, safety, and operational complexity.
* Integrate prototypes with representative enterprise data, applications, APIs, and workflows.
* Ensure that code, configurations, prompts, datasets, experiments, and evaluation results are documented and reproducible.
* Identify reusable components, technical patterns, and potential WRL accelerators.
* Produce clear technical handoffs for Development and Deployment teams.
* Coordinate contributions from AI, engineering, data, cloud, security, product, and domain specialists.
* Mentor AI engineers, POC engineers, and interns.
* Provide technical evidence for decisions to scale, revise, pivot, replicate, transfer, or stop a PoC.


 The WRL operating model progresses qualified opportunities through Research, POC, Decision, and Transfer, with the POC leadership role accountable for prototype architecture and technical handoff.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* Proven experience designing and building end\-to\-end AI or machine\-learning PoCs.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python and modern AI development frameworks.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise integrations.
* Ability to convert ambiguous research or business requirements into a working prototype and measurable evaluation plan.
* Strong understanding of machine learning, generative AI, model evaluation, and software\-engineering fundamentals.
* Experience comparing models, technologies, platforms, and architectures using evidence.
* Practical knowledge of source control, testing, code review, containers, APIs, cloud platforms, and technical documentation.
* Experience working with researchers, software engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, security teams, and product teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, costs, limitations, and trade\-offs.
* Evidence of taking at least one AI initiative from concept through prototype and engineering or production handoff.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with OCI, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with MCP, multi\-agent orchestration, vector databases, knowledge graphs, MLOps, LLMOps, and AI observability.
* Experience integrating AI with Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Experience creating reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, or internal platforms.
* Exposure to healthcare, life sciences, BFSI, or other regulated industries.
* Contributions to open\-source projects, technical publications, patents, white papers, or developer communities.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small cross\-functional technical teams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* PoCs answer clearly defined business and technical questions.
* Prototype results are measurable, reproducible, and supported by evidence.
* Weak approaches are identified before significant production investment.
* Successful PoCs are transferred with clear architecture, code, evaluation results, risks, and implementation recommendations.
* Reusable components and patterns are identified across customer use cases.
* WRL develops a disciplined and repeatable POC capability.


**Who You Are**
 You are:
   

  

* A hands\-on builder who also thinks architecturally
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information
* Disciplined about experimentation, evidence, and evaluation
* Able to distinguish a polished demonstration from a validated PoC
* Provider\-agnostic and pragmatic about technology choices
* Conscious of quality, latency, cost, security, and maintainability
* Effective across research, engineering, business, and customer teams


**Why Join Winfo Research Labs?**
 You will join WRL at an early stage and help establish how enterprise AI ideas are converted into validated and reusable solutions.
   

  

 You will work across frontier AI, customer innovation, technical experimentation, and enterprise architecture, with the opportunity to see successful prototypes move into real customer environments.
   

  

**Own the journey from validated research hypothesis to working, evaluated, and transfer\-ready AI prototype.**

**About Neysa.ai** 








 Neysa is an AI Acceleration Cloud System provider, dedicated to democratizing AI adoption with purpose\-built platforms and services for AI\-native applications and workloads. Co\-founded by industry leaders, we empower businesses to discover, deploy, and scale Generative AI (Gen AI) and AI use cases securely and cost\-effectively. Our flagship platforms—Neysa Velocis, Neysa Overwatch, and Neysa Aegis—accelerate AI deployment, optimize network performance, and safeguard AI/ML landscapes. We are committed to enabling AI\-led innovation across industries and geographies.

 As the Head of Presales, you will lead Neysa's technical sales organization and serve as the bridge between our customers, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for building a high\-performing Presales function that drives enterprise customer success, accelerates revenue growth, and establishes Neysa as the trusted AI transformation partner for organizations adopting AI at scale.
 







 You will own the end\-to\-end technical engagement strategy—from solution discovery and architecture to demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), technical workshops, proposal development, and executive presentations. You will mentor and scale a team of Solution Architects and Presales Specialists while defining the operating framework, best practices, and technical sales methodologies that improve win rates and customer outcomes.
 







 If you are passionate about solving complex enterprise challenges through AI, cloud, and infrastructure technologies and enjoy influencing both technology and business decisions, this role offers an opportunity to shape the future of AI adoption in India.

**Presales Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Build, lead, and scale Neysa's Presales organization across key markets.
* Define the technical sales strategy, operating model, and engagement framework aligned with business goals.
* Establish best practices, governance, and standard operating procedures for solutioning, demonstrations, PoCs, and technical evaluations.
* Define and track key Presales performance metrics including technical win rate, PoC conversion, proposal turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.

* Act as a trusted technology advisor to customer executives, architects, and technical stakeholders.

* Develop reusable solution assets, reference architectures, proposal templates, battle cards, and demo environments.
* Enable Sales teams through technical training, competitive positioning, and product education.
* Support strategic RFPs, RFIs, and enterprise proposal responses with differentiated technical content.







**Product \& Engineering Collaboration** 



* Act as the Voice of the Customer by providing structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams.
* Influence product roadmap based on customer requirements, competitive insights, and emerging AI trends.
* Collaborate on developing solution accelerators and industry\-specific offerings.
* Market Intelligence
* Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, GPU Cloud, Cloud Computing, Networking, Kubernetes, Enterprise Infrastructure, and MLOps.
* Monitor competitive offerings and market trends to strengthen Neysa's positioning and technical differentiation.







**Team Leadership** 



* Hire, mentor, and develop a world\-class Presales team.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and customer obsession.
* Build capability development programs and establish career growth frameworks for the team.



**Qualifications** 




 Experience
 


* 12–18 years of experience in Enterprise Presales, Solution Consulting, Solution Architecture, or Technical Sales.
* At least 5 years of experience leading high\-performing Presales or Solution Consulting teams.
* Proven experience supporting enterprise sales teams in AI, Cloud, Infrastructure, SaaS, or Data Center technologies.
* Demonstrated success in influencing and closing large, complex enterprise deals.







**Technical Expertise** 



* Strong understanding of:
* AI Infrastructure and GPU Computing
* Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Hybrid and Multi\-Cloud Architectures
* Kubernetes, Containers, and Virtualization
* Enterprise Networking and Security
* MLOps, Data Platforms, and AI Deployment Frameworks

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
At Kapture CX, we are looking for a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
 in our Customer experience team.
   

  

**About Kapture CX**
 Founded in Bengaluru in 2014,
 **Kapture CX** 
 began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an
 **AI\-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises** 
 .
   

  

 Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its
 **AgentOS platform** 
 enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows — including
 **customer support, sales, collections, and claims** 
 .
   

  

 Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end\-to\-end across
 **voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels** 
 , with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision\-making is required.
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 As a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
**,** 
 you become the trusted technical advisor for our clients. You ensure customers successfully onboard, integrate, and scale on Kapture’s platform while proactively solving complex technical challenges and driving long\-term value.
   

  

**Sounds interesting?**
 Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
   

  

* You will lead client onboarding and integrations, working hands\-on with APIs, JSON payloads, and tools like Postman and cURL to ensure seamless adoption.
* You will own technical support and escalations, diagnosing issues using logs, Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, and collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to drive fast resolutions.
* You will build strong, trusted client relationships by acting as a technical advisor and advocate, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* You will proactively identify optimization opportunities, conduct platform health checks, and recommend technical strategies to help clients maximize ROI.
* You will document issues, resolutions, and RCAs while sharing feedback and insights to influence product improvements and best practices.


 This is a
 **Mumbai\-based role** 
 . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
   

  

**What does success look like in this role?**
 You consistently deliver smooth client experiences, resolve issues before they escalate, and help customers fully leverage Kapture’s platform to achieve measurable business impact.
   

  

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**
* You have strong hands\-on experience with API integrations and system troubleshooting.
* You are comfortable working directly with enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities.
* You can collaborate effectively with engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems in fast\-paced environments.


**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
* You can debug issues by inspecting logs, tracing errors, and identifying root causes quickly.
* You are proficient with modern tech stacks and monitoring tools like Kafka, Grafana, and Sentry (or similar).
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You take ownership and think proactively about client success and platform optimization.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* You have prior experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
* You are comfortable working with SQL/NoSQL databases and understanding data flows.
* You have exposure to chatbot technologies or AI\-driven automation platforms.
* You enjoy creating clear documentation, troubleshooting guides, and RCAs.


**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**
* An opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, clients, and business impact.
* Hands\-on exposure to large\-scale CX automation and AI\-powered platforms.
* Collaboration with highly skilled product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Strong growth opportunities in a fast\-scaling global SaaS organization, along with competitive compensation and performance\-linked rewards.

description:
**Accenture \| Industry and Enterprise Software and Platforms**
**Role: Data Center Network Consultant**
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune,
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About Us**
 Accenture is a leading technology consulting firm specializing in data center transformation and infrastructure optimization. We partner with hyperscalers, enterprises, and colocation providers to design scalable, efficient data center networks that support AI workloads, edge computing, and sustainable operations.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a seasoned Data Center Network Strategy Consultant to lead strategic planning for next\-generation data center infrastructures. You will evaluate existing data center fabrics, recommend modernization paths, and develop roadmaps that optimize for density, latency, power efficiency, and resilience. The ideal candidate combines deep data center expertise with consulting skills to deliver strategies to clients that reduce TCO and enable business agility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform in\-depth assessments of data center networks, including spine\-leaf architectures, top\-of\-rack switching, and interconnects for multi\-site fabrics.
* Design strategic roadmaps for data center evolution, integrating 400G/800G Ethernet, RDMA, liquid cooling, and sustainable power systems.
* Collaborate with C\-suite executives, managers, and engineering teams to align network strategies with capacity planning, migration to liquid\-cooled DCs, and hybrid cloud integration.
* Lead client workshops, RFx evaluations for DC vendors (e.g., Arista, NVIDIA, Schneider Electric), and PoCs for high\-performance fabrics.
* Analyze trends in AI\-driven workloads, edge data centers, and regulations (e.g., carbon reporting) to recommend future\-proof designs.
* Build financial models projecting ROI on DC expansions, including CapEx/OpEx for power, cooling, and network upgrades.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to thought leadership on data center whitepapers and conferences.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with GPU clustering for AI, and sustainable DC designs (e.g., PUE optimization), zero\-trust DC security.
* Background in hyperscale, colocation, or financial services data centers.
* Deep expertise in data center strategy, fleet operations, infrastructure consulting, and cloud transformation.
* Proficiency in DC modeling tools (e.g., 6Wind, Visio) and methodologies like TOGAF for enterprise architecture.
* Proven ability to present complex DC strategies to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI\-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
   

  

 We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
   

  

 Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM \+ AI conversation \- shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
* You will lead India Presales and a team of \~10\-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid\-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.


**What Work Looks Like**
* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO\-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10\-15\-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution\-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI\-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI\-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time


**Role expectations**
* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.
* Raise the talent bar. Build a high\-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.
* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.
* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 12–15\+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.
* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross\-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.


**Why this role is different**
 You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.
   

  

**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Senior Solutions Analyst
description:
**About Quantanite \& QiQ** 




 Quantanite is a BPO company that combines human agents with proprietary AI technology. QiQ (Quantanite iQ) is our flagship AI\-powered contact centre analytics platform built on cutting\-edge agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and large language models.
 



 QiQ functions as a virtual organization of specialized AI agents that analyze customer interactions, generate operational insights, and drive measurable business outcomes. The platform processes voice, email, and chat interactions through intelligent clusters (Operations, Quality, Voice of Customer) to surface KPI insights, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.
 



 We're looking for someone who has built agentic systems and can help design, architect, and deliver solutions for clients using this technology.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Senior Solutions Analyst, you'll work closely with the Solutions Architect to translate client needs into technical solutions built on agentic AI and knowledge graph architecture. You'll own the full discovery\-to\-delivery cycle for client implementations and feature development, and over time, you'll represent Solutions independently in client conversations and make real architectural decisions.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You'll design solutions that leverage agentic patterns, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and knowledge graphs to solve real contact centre problems. You'll also learn Quantanite's specific platform, clients, and domain so that you can eventually operate as a full Solutions Architect.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Client discovery and solutioning: Lead or co\-lead discovery calls with clients to understand their true operational problems, not just their stated requests. Propose solutions architected around agentic AI and knowledge graph patterns.
 



 ● BRD and HLD authorship: Own the creation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and High\-Level Design (HLD) documents that translate client needs into clear, actionable specifications for engineering. Contribute real architectural thinking, not just transcription.
 



 ● Architecture and design decisions: Make calls on solution shape: which problems need agentic systems vs. simpler approaches, how to layer knowledge graphs, when to build custom orchestration vs. use existing patterns. Own the trade\-offs (cost, speed, accuracy, complexity).
 



 ● Cross\-functional coordination: Work with engineering (QLabs), product, and PMO to move projects through the BRD → HLD → TDD → Implementation → As\-built chain. Be the connective tissue between business and engineering.
 



 ● Client representation: Sit in client meetings, present solutions, answer technical questions in real time, and build confidence that Quantanite can deliver. Represent Solutions credibly as a technical leader.
 



 ● QiQ platform ownership: Develop deep working knowledge of QiQ's architecture (agentic clusters, knowledge graph layers, KPI logic, process adherence frameworks) so you can design solutions that leverage it effectively and make informed decisions about extensions.
 



 ● Learning and growth: Master Quantanite's specific clients, domain (contact centres, BPO operations), and go\-to\-market positioning.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Technical Expertise** 




**Generative AI and agentic systems** 




 ● Hands\-on experience building agentic systems
 



 ● Deep understanding of multi\-agent orchestration, agent frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph
 



 ● Proven work with RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM context window management
 



 ● Experience with knowledge graphs or similar structured knowledge systems
 



 ● Can speak credibly about what's possible and what's not with current LLM technology
 



 ● Understands cost, latency, and token efficiency trade\-offs in system design
 



  





**Systems and architectural thinking** 




 ● Can decompose complex business problems into architectural solutions
 



 ● Understands when to build agentic systems vs. simpler rule\-based or API\-driven approaches
 



 ● Experience designing systems that scale (volume, complexity, cost)
 



 ● Can reason through trade\-offs and make justified design decisions
 



  





**Business and Communication** 




**Business acumen and problem translation** 




 ● Can understand client/stakeholder problems at a deep level and propose solutions that actually address root causes
 



 ● Can articulate technical solutions in business terms (impact, cost, risk, timeline)
 



 ● Comfortable with client\-facing conversations and requirements gathering
 



  





**Communication and presence** 




 ● Strong written communication: can author clear, precise technical specifications
 



 ● Strong verbal communication: can present to clients and executives without losing credibility
 



 ● Can think on your feet and handle real\-time questions in a meeting
 



 ● Naturally commands respect in rooms with non\-technical stakeholders
 



  





**Ownership and accountability** 




 ● Track record of seeing projects through from start to finish
 



 ● Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just activities
 



 ● Drives outcomes even when unclear or complex

description:

description:
**Role: Account Director\-BD \& CS (Full Time)** 




  





**Location:** 
 Work from office at Mumbai (Matunga). 5 days work week.
 



  





**About the company:** 




  





 At Hyperlink, we specialize in Multi\-Dimensional Storytelling. We craft tailor\-made communication strategies and immersive creative solutions for brands. We create world class experiences by providing solutions based on current trends, using cutting\- edge technology and recognizing the target audience’s inclinations. We are a collective of eager, fresh, perceptive minds, telling multi\-dimensional stories \-bridging the gap between the brand’s vision and the reality of a successful, seamless, and unforgettable experience.
 



  





 We engage and execute corporate as well as brand\-led events and activations ranging from awards shows, summits, conferences, reward and recognition programmes, school and college activations, mall promotions, cultural movements, digital events and more. We produce content for digital viewing as well as television \& films. We also help brands amplify events \& experiences through innovative, sometimes disruptive Marketing strategies.
 



  





 Started in Feb 2021, the company is incorporated by a bunch of Hyper\-Creative folks who come with a solid experience of crafting immersive solutions for more than two decades in the industry. Some of our esteemed clients at Hyperlink are Netflix, BAFTA, BCCL, WWM, Oriflame, Mahindra \& Mahindra and Aditya Birla Group.
 



  





**https://www.hyperlink.co.in/** 




  





**About the role:** 




  





 As a Client Service person, you are the face of Hyperlink when dealing with a client. You shall be the point of coordination between all involved in the event\-client, internal teams at Hyperlink including Production, Content, Design, Finance as well as external agency partners. Right from the initial client connect, closure of a brief to the end of an event, you shall be expected to ensure top quality project management \& the delivery of a seamless \& enriching experience for the client.
 



  





 The role requires you to service existing accounts \& as well as to build network with new brands to generate business.
 



  





 You should have the ability to research about avenues for building business through these new clients, prospecting including cold calls, presenting \& engaging the client about our offerings \& solutions, understand \& decode the client brief so as to work out a creative solution through the internal teams \& maintaining ongoing relationship with the client.
 



  





 As a custodian for building client delight, you will need to have proven project management \& planning skills, extreme attention to detail, experiential technology understanding \& ability to communicate well both verbally \& in written form while servicing the existing clients.
 



  





 You will need to be solution oriented, an effective negotiator and an excellent communicator in working with clients, agency partners and supply chain vendors, as well as with a small knit internal team. The ideal candidate will be a self\-starter with a passion for crafting creative experiences for brands and committed towards providing superior customer service with a high level of ownership.
 



 You will be required to demonstrate leadership skills through building teams, driving key process metrics, creating superlative work culture, bringing strong customer focus and leading the company to exponential growth.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



1. **Client servicing**


* Identifying and networking to generate business from the existing accounts, achieving profitability. Proactively following up with existing clients to get briefs for events that would have happened in the previous years.
* Mapping needs of new brands/clients \& generate business from them
* Meet the client to understand the brief and expectation on the event.
* Collaborate with the internal team\-concept, design, production \& tech for crafting the experience.
* Present the creative solution to client \& negotiate on the terms.



  





**2\.Event execution \& Operations:** 



* Coordinate with all stakeholders involved in the event to ensure the delivery of creatives, art work, set design and all other elements of the event.
* Lead the running of the show/show flow.
* Oversee the overall production quality of the event.
* Ensure closure of payment advice (PA) in co\-ordination with production \& Invoicing through finance.
* Ensure all Weekly Reports, HOD Meeting Reports are sent to Head of Department
* Collection of payment from clients for events executed



  





**Required Qualification, Experience \& skills:** 



* Graduation in any stream (a must) \& Post graduation in Marketing/Mass media/Advertising/Event Mgt (preferred)
* 8\+ years Client Service experience in the Events or BTL industry
* Strong relationship \& connect with marketing professionals/ brand managers/ decision makers among the corporate \& agencies.
* Understanding of brands \& their needs to connect with consumers/target audience
* Fair knowledge on event set ups
* Has exceptional attention to detail and the ability to plan and manage multiple tasks and projects in parallel despite tight deadlines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint is a must
* Experience in crafting narratives and engaging clients and agencies in long range strategic partnerships
* Highly customer oriented with proven ability to build internal and external relationships

title: Specialist- IT Procurement
description:
The Specialist – IT Procurement will support end\-to\-end sourcing and procurement activities for IT hardware, software, cloud, cybersecurity, telecom, and digital services across UPL's corporate and manufacturing environments. The role will ensure timely, cost\-effective, compliant, and business\-aligned procurement while supporting technology enablement and operational continuity. This position will work closely with IT, Finance, Legal, business stakeholders, vendors, OEMs, and implementation partners to manage RFx processes, commercial negotiations, vendor coordination, contract support, purchase execution, renewals, spend analysis, and procurement reporting.
 



  




* Manage sourcing and procurement activities for IT hardware, software, cloud, cybersecurity, telecom, digital services, and IT services in line with business requirements and procurement policies.
* Prepare and manage RFI, RFQ, and RFP documentation; coordinate with stakeholders and vendors; support evaluation of proposals based on technical, commercial, compliance, and service parameters.
* Support price discovery, benchmarking, total cost analysis, vendor negotiations, and commercial comparisons to enable value\-driven procurement decisions.
* Coordinate with Legal, IT, Finance, and vendors for contract review, agreement execution, amendments, renewals, SLAs, and documentation closure for IT hardware, software, cloud, and service contracts.
* Manage day\-to\-day coordination with OEMs, authorized distributors, system integrators, cloud providers, telecom partners, and service providers to ensure timely delivery, service compliance, and issue resolution.
* Support the complete procurement lifecycle from requirement gathering, vendor identification, quote comparison, PR/PO coordination, delivery tracking, invoice follow\-up, and payment support.
* Support vendor risk assessment, contract compliance, audit readiness, data privacy documentation, cybersecurity requirements, and adherence to internal procurement processes.
* Maintain procurement trackers, spend data, savings records, renewal calendars, vendor databases, and MIS reports to provide visibility on IT procurement activities and savings outcomes.
* Work closely with IT, plant teams, corporate functions, Finance, Legal, and suppliers to understand requirements, manage timelines, resolve queries, and ensure smooth procurement execution.

title: Sr. T&E Manager
