title: APAC Strategic Partner Manager, Systems Integrators
description:
Meta is seeking a Strategic Partner Manager to lead and grow relationships with System Integrators (SIs) within our Monetization Partnerships organization. These partners — including firms like Tech Mahindra, Persistent, Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, etc — serve as critical multipliers in Meta's partner ecosystem, enabling enterprise clients to activate Meta's products at scale through implementation services, managed solutions, and AI\-powered delivery.This role will own the end\-to\-end strategic relationship with top tier regional and global systems integrators, driving incremental revenue by enabling partners to build practices around Meta's monetization products — including ads, business messaging, commerce, and emerging AI agent capabilities. You will serve as the connective tissue between Meta's product roadmap and the partner's go\-to\-market execution, translating product capabilities into scaled revenue through joint solutions development and co\-sell motions.
   

  

 APAC Strategic Partner Manager, Systems Integrators Responsibilities:
   

  

* Own the strategic relationship with top\-tier System Integrators as the primary point of contact across executive, commercial, and technical stakeholders
* Define and execute a partner business plan encompassing revenue targets, product adoption milestones, and joint go\-to\-market initiatives
* Drive incremental monetization revenue by enabling SI partners to build and scale practices around Meta solutions
* Influence Meta's product roadmap through structured partner feedback loops
* synthesize market insights from SI engagements to inform product strategy
* Develop and execute partner enablement strategies that accelerate SI capability\-building
* Coordinate across Product, Partner Engineering, Sales, Business Development and Marketing to unlock partner\-driven growth opportunities and resolve operational blockers
* Represent Meta in executive meetings with SI leadership
* build and maintain C\-suite relationships that drive long\-term strategic alignment


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or strategic account management in digital advertising, marketing technology, or enterprise software
* Experience managing strategic relationships with System Integrators, management consultancies, or enterprise technology services firms
* Track record of driving measurable revenue and/or product adoption through partner channels
* Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy through partner and market insights
* Experience working cross\-functionally with teams in a fast\-paced technology environment
* Experience applying analytical methods to size market opportunities (TAM), prioritize partner investments, and measure partner performance


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with AI/ML go\-to\-market motions — particularly enabling partners to deliver AI\-powered solutions (e.g., agentic workflows, automation, GenAI applications)
* Familiarity with Meta's advertising, business messaging, or commerce products
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree
* Knowledge of client stacks and ecosystems
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Direct experience working at or with Accenture, Deloitte, CapGemini, IBM, or similar System Integrators


 About Meta:
   

  

 Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
   

  

 Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Senior Solution Architect, Mumbai
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud\-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
   

  

**What is The Role:**
 Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and tackle our customer’s business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be passionate about perfection; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.
   

  

 “We question the status quo, debate the best ways to accomplish our goals and hold ourselves and our teams to the highest standards of performance. We take pride in our ability to understand our customers needs and make recommendations that are based on extensive global experience across multiple use cases. We learn from our mistakes and losses and celebrate our successes with an eye towards constant improvement. Join this team if you are up for a compassionate, understanding and fair environment where you can really grow into the next phase of your career.” VP WW Solution Architecture, Elastic
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing:**
* Serving as the technical point of contact for your accounts and account managers in your assigned territory.
* Developing a deep understanding of customers’ goals and objectives, and articulating how our offerings address their needs.
* Crafting and owning value based relationships at all levels in customer organizations.
* Actively participating in all phases of planning and execution for your territory, from initial discovery to the technical win.
* Developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the Elastic products and solutions to demonstrate the value of our offerings in sales meetings, and at events such as meetups and conferences.
* Advising the sales team on effective ways of positioning Elastic products, solutions and services.
* Onboarding, educating and enabling our partners, and supporting them in sales cycles.
* Crafting collateral, contributing to programs and collaborating with other Elasticians to meet individual client needs.
* Being the voice of the customer and community to communicate needs, gaps, and improvements to our engineering and leadership teams.
* Deepening both your sales and technical skills through self driven education while taking advantage of all the professional development opportunities provided by Elastic.


**What You Bring:**
* A track record of success in a technical presales role—enough experience selling and implementing technology to earn your customer’s trust.
* A proven track record to articulate and sell the benefits of modern platforms, software and technologies.
* A real passion for being curious and a continuous learner. You are someone that invests in yourself as much as you invest in your professional relationships.
* A history of successful customer relations where you developed an understanding of what made a difference, and devised architectures that helped meet a goal, tackle a problem, or outpace competitors.
* An ability to influence. Have you more than once convinced a team you worked for, of an idea, technology, or architectural pattern?
* The ability to inspire groups, both large and small.
* A willingness to travel 30% within region, as well as occasionally internationally.


**Additional Information \- We Take Care of Our People:**
 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
   

  

 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
   

  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact \- We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

title: Sales Engineer - Mumbai
description:
Imagine yourself…
   

  

* Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
* Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.
* Contributing to a brighter, more sustainable future.


 At Hach (www.hach.com), a Veralto company, we ensure water quality for people around the world, and every team member play a vital role in that mission. Our founding vision is to make water analysis better—faster, simpler, greener, and more informative. We accomplish this through teamwork, customer partnerships, passionate experts, and reliable, easy\-to\-use solutions. As part of our team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll be part of a unique work environment where purpose meets possibility: where you’ll make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale by enabling the world’s everyday water needs, and where you’ll have opportunities to foster your professional development and fuel your career growth.
   

  

 Motivated by the highest possible stakes in climate change and global health, we’re working together within a rapidly digitizing industry to find innovative technologies that guarantee the safety of our water and our environment. More about us: https://www.hach.com/about\-us
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* Best in industry vacation quota
* Hybrid working
* Professional onboarding and training options
* Powerful team looking forward to working with you
* Career coaching and development opportunities
* Health and wellness benefits


 Reporting to the Sales Director , the
 **Sales Engineer – Mumbai** 
 is responsible for driving Sales growth for HACH brand products in respective territory / region from the Municipal Segment.
   

  

 This position is part of the Sales Municipal Team located in Mumbai and will be on remote work model.
   

  

**In this role, a typical day will look like:**
* Achieve monthly sales targets by managing funnel, converting leads to orders, and tracking order bookings and shipments.
* Identify and develop new business in government departments, municipal corporations, PHEDs, water boards, and consulting firms.
* Build strong relationships with EPCs, Main Civil Contractors, Electro\-Mechanical Contractors, System integrators, Automation System Houses and Project Consultants to track projects at DPR stages.
* Work closely with End Client, Consultants \& Authorized Distributors to have Speck Locking at DPR stages, to identify \& track upcoming projects, Live Tender bids \& published results, Lead quote to negotiations with EPCs/ System Integrators.
* Manage funnel progression on CRM (SFDC), prepare proposals, track tender bids, and negotiate quotes to close sales.
* Monitor government tenders (RFPs/RFQs) and lead the preparation of competitive proposals for water quality measurement analyzer solutions.
* Work with internal teams to ensure timely, compliant tender responses and close partnerships with consultants for water treatment projects.
* Establish relationships with key stakeholders, including engineers, project managers, and consultants, to influence purchasing decisions.
* Attend industry events to network, promote the brand, and stay updated on market trends and competition.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to design promotional campaigns for the water sector.
* Provide technical training and support to distributors, government officials, and EPC O\&M teams to ensure proper product use.
* Coordinate with Customer support, supply chain and service teams to ensure timely order fulfilment and customer satisfaction.
* Regularly track sales activities, customer feedback, and market trends, report to leadership \& collaborate for further strat \& activity plans.


**The essential requirements of the job include:**
* Engineering Graduate / Post Graduate in Science/Business Management working in the field of Direct Sales for Water Treatment \& Analysis Solutions.
* Minimum 4 – 7 years of Direct sales \& business development, preferably in water treatment, water quality monitoring, environmental solutions, or instrumentation in Govt – Public Infrastructure Sectors.
* In\-depth understanding Indian water sector, Govt Depts, Ministries, Administrative Wings, Operations \& Management Wings of Municipal Corporations, PHEDs, Municipalities, Urban \& Rural Water Bodies etc.
* Relationships with key\-stakeholders from Water Depts, Muni Corps, Consultants, EPCs, Electro\-mechanical Contractors, Automation System Houses, C\&I partners etc.
* Understanding and experience in Water Treatment \& Analytical instrumentation, Testing Technologies including chemical, biological, and physical water analysis.
* Familiar to water quality standards, monitoring requirements, and regulations in India.
* Candidate should be willing to relocate as part of job basis the requirement of business
* Strong written, verbal communication with problem solving / solutions approach and negotiation skills.
* Experience of working with renowned Indian or Global MNCs, working in matrix organization is preferred.
* Proven track record deliver Sales performance leading to growth is expected.
* Team player \& ability to collaborate with Sales teams and other Cross Functional teams like Service, Customer Support, Finance, etc.
* Process Oriented to deliver sustainable Results


 Travel: Upto 75%\- 80% of total time
   

  

 Hach is proud to part of the Water Quality segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

 Athena Instruments Pvt Ltd specializes in high\-precision laboratory equipment, providing innovative and reliable solutions to scientists, researchers, and industries worldwide. As an ISO 9001:2015\-certified company, Athena Instruments maintains strict quality standards in scientific instrumentation, accuracy, and performance. The company’s advanced product line includes nitrogen evaporators, probe sonicators, hydrogen and nitrogen gas generators, and custom scientific solutions tailored to specialized research needs. Athena Instruments serves a broad range of sectors, including pharmaceutical, bioanalytical, chemical, food, cosmetic, and paint and pigment industries, and partners with research labs across India, the USA, Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia, and Africa. The organization is dedicated to bridging innovation with precision, helping customers achieve confident, breakthrough results.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Associate role based in Mumbai. The Sales Associate will engage with laboratories, research institutions, and industrial clients to understand their scientific equipment needs and present suitable Athena Instruments solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include generating and qualifying leads, conducting product demonstrations, preparing quotations, and following up to close sales. The role also involves maintaining client relationships, managing inquiries, coordinating with internal technical and operations teams, and ensuring timely order fulfillment. The Sales Associate will keep accurate records of interactions and sales activities, participate in industry events when required, and contribute feedback to improve sales strategies and product positioning.

* Strong sales and customer relationship skills, including lead generation, prospecting, and negotiation.

* Effective communication and presentation skills, with clear, professional spoken and written English; additional regional languages are an advantage.
* Solid organizational and time\-management skills, including maintaining documentation and using CRM or sales tracking tools.
* Collaborative mindset to work closely with technical, service, and operations teams to address client requirements.
* Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, business, or a related field is preferred; relevant sales experience in B2B or scientific equipment is an asset.
* Comfort with traveling within the region for client meetings and willingness to participate in exhibitions or conferences as needed.
* Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, and a client\-focused approach to achieving sales targets and long\-term partnerships.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
**WHITE GLOBE GROUP** 





 Asia's Leading Multilingual Content \& Language Solutions Partner · Slator LSPI \#89 Globally, \#8 in Asia
 




**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**Inside Sales Executive — Enterprise Language \& Content Solutions** 




**Position Title** 




 Inside Sales Specialist (Business Development — Inside Sales)
 



**Function** 




 Sales \& Business Development
 



**Grade / Band** 
 Executive
 



**Location** 




 Mumbai (office\-based)
 



**No. of Positions** 
 6
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Director — Sales \& Business Development; works day\-to\-day with the Business Development Managers
 



**Experience** 




 1–4 years in B2B inside sales, lead generation or sales development
 



**Education** 




 Bachelor's degree; MBA in Marketing or Business preferred
 



**Compensation** 




**INR 4\.5 to 6 LPA fixed \+ monthly incentive: Avg. earning potential CTC: INR 6LPA to 8 LPA** 




**Recruitment Calendar** 
 September 2026
 



**1\. ABOUT WHITE GLOBE** 




 White Globe is a leading multilingual content and language solutions provider, combining deep human expertise with proprietary AI to help global enterprises communicate accurately in every market they operate in. We work across 350\+ languages and 1,000\+ language pairs, supported by a network of 125,000\+ language, culture and content experts operating from 500\+ cities under a 24×7 Follow\-the\-Sun delivery model.
 



 We hold Quintuple ISO certification — ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 13485, ISO 17100 and ISO 18587 — placing White Globe among the elite 1% of language service providers worldwide. To date, we have translated over one billion words for 2,750\+ enterprise clients across 60\+ industry verticals, including 50\+ Fortune 500 companies, and have featured in Slator's Language Service Provider Index for six consecutive years.
 



 Every engagement runs on
 **Lang Tech** 
 , our proprietary AI/ML\-based CAT and translation management platform, which integrates with leading content management systems, learning management systems, authoring tools and CRM platforms.
 



  





**2\. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




  





 You will be the engine behind our enterprise sales team: researching target accounts, spotting the triggers that create demand, running disciplined multi\-channel outreach, qualifying interest, and handing Business Development Managers meetings that are worth their time. You will also be the first responder to inbound enquiries, converting smaller, well\-defined requests directly.
 



**The mandate in one line** 




 Find the right companies at the right moment, start credible conversations with the right people, and convert them into qualified meetings and pipeline for White Globe's enterprise sales team.
 







**3\. WHAT YOU WILL HELP SELL** 




 White Globe sells six integrated solution lines. You are not expected to be a technical specialist in any of them. Still, you must understand each well enough to recognise a buying trigger, open a relevant conversation and ask good qualifying questions.
 **Solution Line** 




**t It Covers** 




**Buying Triggers to Watch For** 




**Language Solutions** 




 Certified, legal, patent and financial translation; interpretation; transcription; language training.
 



**Multilingual Technical Documentation** 




 S1000D and DITA migration, structured authoring, ASD\-STE100 rewriting, IETP and dealer\-portal deployment.
 







**Multilingual Medical \& Life Sciences** 




 Clinical trial documentation, regulatory submissions, EU MDR IFU and labelling, pharmacovigilance, medical writing.
 



  





**Multilingual eLearning** 




 Custom eLearning, instructional design, eLearning localisation, SCORM / xAPI packaging, LMS re\-deployment.
 







**Multilingual Marketing Enablement** 




 Transcreation, multilingual content, multilingual SEO and PPC, brand adaptation.
 



 Campaign launches, regional go\-to\-market, website relaunches, Bharat\-market expansion
 



**Multilingual Multimedia** 




 Voiceover and dubbing, subtitling and captions, animation, video production, accessible content.
 



 Product videos, corporate films, training videos, accessibility obligations
 







**4\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**a) Account Research and Targeting** 





 ▪  
 
 Build and maintain target account lists for assigned verticals and territories in line with the plans set by the Business Development Managers.
 




 ▪  
 
 Research target organisations for demand triggers: regulatory deadlines, product launches, export and market\-entry announcements, funding rounds, plant openings, leadership changes and RFP notices.
 




 ▪  
 
 Map the relevant contacts in each account — Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Documentation, Engineering, L\&D, Marketing and Procurement — and keep contact data accurate and compliant with DPDP and GDPR requirements.
 



**b) Multi\-Channel Outreach** 





 ▪  
 
 Run structured outreach cadences across cold calling, email, and LinkedIn (including Sales Navigator) to agreed daily and weekly activity standards.
 




 ▪  
 
 Write personalised, concise outreach that leads with the prospect's problem — a compliance deadline, a launch, a market — rather than a list of our services.
 




 ▪  
 
 Support account\-based campaigns, webinars and industry events run with Marketing, including pre\-event outreach and post\-event follow\-up.
 




 ▪  
 
 Persist through long, non\-linear buying cycles, re\-engaging dormant leads and lost opportunities at the right moment.
 



**c) Qualification and Handover** 





 ▪  
 
 Run first\-level discovery to establish need, content types and volumes, languages, timelines, current vendor, decision process and budget signals.
 




 ▪  
 
 Qualify leads against agreed criteria and book meetings between qualified prospects and the relevant Business Development Manager.
 




 ▪  
 
 Write clear handover notes so the Business Development Manager walks into the first meeting already informed — who the prospect is, what triggered the conversation and what was learned.
 




 ▪  
 
 Attend or support early\-stage calls where required, and keep the prospect warm between meetings.
 



**d) Inbound Enquiries and Transactional Sales** 





 ▪  
 
 Respond to inbound enquiries from the website, email, LinkedIn and referrals within the agreed response\-time standard.
 




 ▪  
 
 Scope, quote and close well\-defined transactional requests — for example certified translation, short document sets or subtitling — using approved rate cards, in coordination with Project Management.
 




 ▪  
 
 Identify inbound requests that point to a larger programme opportunity and route them to the Business Development Manager.
 



**e) CRM Discipline and Reporting** 





 ▪  
 
 Log every account, contact, activity and opportunity in the CRM accurately and on the same day — pipeline hygiene is a non\-negotiable performance standard.
 




 ▪  
 
 Report weekly on activity, conversion rates and pipeline sourced, and share what is and is not working in messaging and targeting.
 




 ▪  
 
 Feed market and competitor intelligence gathered from prospect conversations back to Sales, Marketing and Leadership.
 



  





  





**5\. PERSON SPECIFICATION** 




**a) Essential Qualifications** 





 ▪  
 
 Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, communications, engineering, life sciences or a related discipline.
 




 ▪  
 
 MBA in Marketing or Business preferred.
 



**b) Essential Experience** 





 ▪  
 
 1–4 years of B2B inside sales, lead generation, sales development or business development experience, ideally in a services industry — language services, eLearning, marketing services, IT/ITeS, SaaS or professional services.
 




 ▪  
 
 A measurable track record against activity and outcome targets — meetings booked, qualified leads generated, pipeline sourced or revenue closed.
 




 ▪  
 
 Hands\-on experience with a CRM and with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable prospecting tools.
 



**c) Skills and Competencies** 





 ▪  
 
**Written communication.** 
 Writes short, specific, error\-free emails that busy senior people actually answer.
 




 ▪  
 
**Telephone confidence.** 
 Comfortable cold calling senior stakeholders and handling objections without reading from a script.
 




 ▪  
 
**Research instinct.** 
 Curious enough to find out why a company might need us this quarter, not just that it exists.
 




 ▪  
 
**Qualification judgement.** 
 Knows the difference between a polite conversation and a real opportunity, and is honest about it.
 




 ▪  
 
**Discipline and resilience.** 
 Sustains high activity levels, accepts rejection as part of the job and keeps a clean pipeline.
 




 ▪  
 
**Learning agility.** 
 Picks up a technical and regulatory domain quickly and uses that knowledge in conversations.
 




 ▪  
 
**Collaboration.** 
 Works closely with Business Development Managers, Marketing and Project Management, and makes their work easier.
 



  





**6\. HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE MEASURED** 
**Measure** 




**What Good Looks Like** 




**Activity** 




 Consistent achievement of agreed daily and weekly outreach standards across calls, email and LinkedIn.
 



**Qualified meetings** 




 Number of meetings booked and held that the Business Development Manager accepts as qualified.
 



**Pipeline sourced** 




 Value of opportunities created in the CRM from self\-sourced leads each quarter.
 



**Conversion** 




 Proportion of qualified meetings that progress to proposal or pilot.
 



**Inbound response** 




 Enquiries answered within the agreed response\-time standard.
 



**Transactional revenue** 




 Revenue closed directly from inbound and small\-scope requests.
 



**CRM hygiene** 




 Complete, current and accurate records, auditable at any time.
 



**7\. COMPENSATION AND WHAT WE OFFER** 





 ▪  
 
**Earnings.** 
**INR 4\.5 to 6 LPA fixed** 
 , with a monthly incentive linked to qualified meetings, pipeline sourced and transactional revenue.
 




 ▪  
 
**Training.** 
 Structured onboarding across all six solution lines, the Lang Tech platform and the regulatory drivers behind them — so you can hold a credible conversation from your first month.
 




 ▪  
 
**Credibility in the market.** 
 Quintuple ISO certification, six consecutive years in the Slator LSPI and 50\+ Fortune 500 references behind every call you make.
 




 ▪  
 
**Growth.** 
 A clear route into a Business Development Manager role for consistent performers, typically within 18–24 months.
 



 White Globe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, background or ability.
 



**8\. HOW TO APPLY** 




 Send your CV to
 **hr@whiteglobe.co.in** 
 with the subject line
 **"Inside Sales — Enterprise"** 
 . Include a first\-touch cold email (under 150 words) that you would send to the Head of Regulatory Affairs at a medical device company preparing for EU MDR — we read it before we read the CV.

description:

 FatakSecure is a subsidiary of FatakPay Digital. It is licensed as Composite Corporate Agent to solicit and sale insurance products. **For more information, please visit www.fataksecure.com** 




  





**Role Description** 




  





 This is a full\-time role for Sales Lead – Embedded and Cross Sell Insurance for business sourced through Fatakpay platform. The role will be on\-site, located in Mumbai.

**Prior experience of digital insurance sales – preferably in insurance broking and/or lending business is mandatory**

 Own and drive the Core Attachment Rate (KPI) for insurance products embedded directly within the Fatakpay loan onboarding and disbursement journeys.



  




* **Customer Journey Mapping:** 
 Deeply analyze the Fatakpay loan customer journey to identify friction points, optimal drop\-in screens, and high\-intent moments to present insurance solutions.



  




* **UI/UX Collaboration:** 
 Partner with the Product and Tech teams to implement native, seamless, and frictionless single\-click insurance opt\-ins.



  





**Digital \& Performance Marketing Sales:** 
 Design data\-led digital communication strategies to cross\-sell insurance products to loan customers.
 



  





**Tele\-calling Engine Execution:** 
 Build, train, and optimize a high\-performing tele\-calling team to reach out to the Fatakpay customer base for higher\-ticket or personalized cross\-sell offerings.
 



  





**2\. Strategic Partnerships \& Analytics** 




  





**Insurer:** 
 Liaise with insurance companies to co\-create custom, cost\-effective sachet products and 
 



 negotiate competitive commissions and SLAs.
 



  





**Data\-Driven Decisions:** 
 Leverage customer loan data, repayment behavior, and demographic profiles to run predictive segmentations for targeted insurance cross\-selling.
 



  





**Funnel Optimization:** 
 Continuously monitor and report on the sales funnel—from impressions and clicks to quote generations and successful issuances
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* **Education:** 
 Post Graduate degree in Business administration preferred. Additional insurance certifications preferred (e.g., Licentiate from III) or Agent/ SP examination passed.



  




* **Experience and Skills**
* Minimum 5 years’ plus experience in Insurance Distribution, Fintech, or Insurtech ecosystems, with a heavy focus on
 **Embedded Insurance, Digital Sales and Tele\-calling Sales. Prior experience of digital insurance sales.**



  




* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Proven track record of managing insurance attachments in digital lending,



 NBFC, or banking environments. Proven experience in driving insurance sales through digital platforms and Tele\-calling sales channels
 



  




* **Analytical Mindset:** 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to use customer data and insights to



 improve conversion and customer engagement. Highly data\-oriented with the ability to look at a 
 



 loan funnel, identify drop\-offs, and design A/B tests for insurance banners/prompts.
 



  




* **Sales/Operations Leadership:** 
 Prior experience managing digital campaign tools as well as



 scaling and driving performance out of a tele\-calling sales team.

description:

**Technical Implementation Engineer — Customer Solutions \& Integrations**
**Role summary:** 
 Sits between Technical Implementation and Engineering — owns technical onboarding, data ingestion, and custom integration work for customers on the platform (ETM/VMDR context), with enough coding and
 **AI\-tooling fluency to automate repetitive implementation work rather than doing it manually each time.**
**Note \- Relocation to Pune is required for this role, Role may involve Night shifts. We work 3 days from Office in a week.**
* Core Responsibilities
+ Data ingestion \& onboarding: Build and validate CSV/bulk data ingestion pipelines into ETM (asset data, business context, criticality tags, third\-party vulnerability feeds)
+ API\-based integrations: Build custom solutions using Qualys APIs and third\-party APIs (ServiceNow, Jira, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender, SIEM/SOAR platforms, ticketing systems)
+ Customer\-facing technical work: Join customer calls to scope integration requirements, troubleshoot live issues, and walk technical stakeholders (network/security/IT teams) through implementation steps
+ Automation of implementation work itself: Use AI agents/scripting to templatize and speed up recurring implementation tasks (data mapping, connector setup, validation checks) rather than repeating manual work per customer
+ Documentation \& handoff: Produce clean runbooks/config docs so Support and the customer's own team can maintain the integration post\-go\-live


* AI \& Agentic Automation \- The engineer will be expected to use modern AI tooling as an engineering productivity layer. The role should be capable of evaluating and building workflows where AI/agents can assist with implementation activities such as:
+ Understanding customer integration requirements.
+ Mapping customer schemas to Qualys schemas.
+ Generating transformation logic.
+ Creating API integration code.
+ Analysing integration errors and logs.
+ Generating configuration templates.
+ Validating implementation prerequisites.
+ Generating customer\-specific implementation documentation.
+ Performing repetitive implementation checks.
+ Building internal agents that execute controlled implementation workflows.
+ Experience with tools such as GPT\-based agents, Claude\-based workflows, RAG, function/tool calling, MCP\-style integrations, RPA, or similar automation frameworks is valuable.
+ The expectation is not that the engineer is an AI researcher.
+ The expectation is that they understand how to apply AI safely and practically to reduce implementation effort and increase implementation consistency.


* Required Qualifications:
+ Programming proficiency (Python strongly preferred — scripting, API clients, data transformation)
+ Solid REST API experience (auth flows, pagination, rate limits, webhook handling)
+ Comfortable with CSV/structured data manipulation and data validation at scale
+ Working knowledge of at least one ticketing/ITSM platform integration (ServiceNow, Jira, Remedy)
+ Experience or strong aptitude with AI agent tooling (e.g., building/using agents for workflow automation — could be internal tooling, Claude/GPT\-based agents, or RPA\-adjacent tools)
+ Strong verbal communication — able to run technical discussions directly with customer engineering/network teams, not just write code


* Preferred Qualifications:
+ Prior exposure to Qualys VMDR/ETM, or a comparable VM platform (Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys competitors)
+ Experience with SOAR platforms or security automation
+ Familiarity with cloud platform APIs (AWS/Azure/GCP) for asset ingestion
+ Basic understanding of vulnerability management workflows (so they understand why the data matters, not just how to move it)

title: Business Development Associate: Critical Minerals, Battery Recycling & Clean Coal
description:
**Help Build India's Critical Minerals and Clean Energy Future, and Be Part of Something Historic** 




  





**Business Development Associate: Critical Minerals, Battery Recycling \& Clean Coal** 




*Novasensa \| Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site* 




  





 We are not looking to fill a seat. We are looking for a missionary, not a mercenary.
 



  





 Every country that has built lasting industrial strength did it because a small number of people decided a hard problem mattered enough to spend years on it. India's dependence on imported critical minerals, and the clean energy and mineral value it still burns or discards instead of recovering, are among those problems. Novasensa exists to fix them, and we believe the country that solves this first becomes a genuine global leader in the technologies that will define the next several decades.
 



  





 If you want a well\-defined job with a fixed playbook, this is not that role. If you want to be one of the small number of people who helped build something that mattered before most people believed it was possible, keep reading.
 



  





 That kind of work rarely feels comfortable while you're in it. It feels demanding, occasionally consuming, and, if you're the right fit, more engaging than anything with a fixed playbook ever could.
 



  





**What We Are Building** 




 Novasensa is a deep\-tech company developing two industrial technology platforms:
 



 ●    NovaGenesis is our hydrometallurgical platform for recovering critical and high\-value metals from lithium\-ion battery black mass and electronic waste.
 



 ●    NovaX is our dry, X\-ray Transmission\-based beneficiation platform for separating valuable minerals from waste material without water or chemical inputs.
 



 Our work spans critical minerals, battery recycling, e\-waste, coal beneficiation, mineral ores, circular economy infrastructure, and industrial decarbonisation.
 



  





 Novasensa is a Government of India designated Centre of Excellence under the National Critical Minerals Mission (NCMM) at IIT ISM Dhanbad, and was recognised at the Innovation Zero Awards from among more than 570 companies across 64 countries.
 



  





**Why This Role Is Different** 




 ●    Work closely with the founding team on live business development priorities from week one.
 



 ●    We keep the team small on purpose, so you get exposure to everything, not a narrow lane.
 



 ●    Work on active opportunities with major industrial organisations, not theoretical accounts.
 



 ●    Learn how a deep\-tech company moves from technology validation to commercial deployment.
 



 ●    Gain exposure to the complete business\-development cycle, from market research and initial outreach to proposal preparation and negotiation support.
 



 ●    Contribute to the commercial systems and partnership processes of a company still writing its own playbook.
 



 ●    ESOP eligibility opens after 9 months for people who prove they're owners, not employees.
 



  





**The Kind of Person We're Looking For** 




 ●    You see recovering critical minerals and cleaning up coal as a cause worth years of your career, not a stepping stone to somewhere else.
 



 ●    You want India to lead globally in critical minerals and clean energy, the technologies that matter for the next century, and you want to be one of the people who helped make that happen.
 



 ●    You are energised, not intimidated, by working on something genuinely new. This is not a market with an established playbook to copy from a competitor.
 



 ●    You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. If something is unfinished or unowned, you treat it as yours to pick up, not someone else's to assign.
 



 ●    You are drawn to hard, long problems. Our sales cycles run 9 to 18 months with many stakeholders. We are not optimising for quick wins.
 



 ●    You would rather build something 10x better than chase something incrementally better.
 



 ●    You want the satisfaction of being fully absorbed in difficult, meaningful work, not just the title of having worked on something meaningful.
 



  





 We are looking for someone with approximately two to five years of professional experience in one or more of the following:
 



 ●    B2B business development
 



 ●    Enterprise sales
 



 ●    Strategic partnerships
 



 ●    Founder's office
 



 ●    Management consulting
 



 ●    Industrial or technology commercialisation
 



 ●    Mining, metals, energy, cleantech, recycling, manufacturing, or infrastructure
 



  





 Prior sector experience is valuable but not mandatory. Genuine interest in this mission is not optional. You should also be someone who:
 



 ●    Can communicate clearly with senior executives, engineers, government officials, researchers, and business owners
 



 ●    Is comfortable learning technical concepts and translating them into commercial language
 



 ●    Writes clear emails, proposals, presentations, and meeting notes
 



 ●    Follows through without requiring repeated reminders
 



 ●    Can structure an ambiguous problem and identify the next practical action
 



 ●    Is comfortable initiating conversations and developing relationships from a cold start
 



 ●    Is comfortable working heavily with AI tools day to day. We'll train you on how to use them effectively, this isn't optional in how we operate
 



  





**What You Will Work On** 




**Business Development** 




 ●    Identify and qualify potential customers, technology partners, suppliers, and offtake partners
 



 ●    Develop relationships across mining, metals, coal, battery recycling, electronics, manufacturing, and clean technology
 



 ●    Conduct structured outreach through email, LinkedIn, industry networks, events, and direct introductions
 



 ●    Maintain ownership of opportunities from the first interaction through proposal stage, handing off for final negotiation and closure
 



 ●    Follow up consistently and ensure that opportunities do not lose momentum
 



  





**Founder's Office and Commercial Execution** 




 ●    Support the co\-founders in preparing for customer meetings, negotiations, and strategic discussions
 



 ●    Prepare proposals, presentations, commercial notes, meeting briefs, and follow\-up communications
 



 ●    Convert technical discussions into clear commercial actions and next steps
 



 ●    Coordinate internally with technical, research, operations, and finance teams
 



 ●    Track commitments, timelines, dependencies, and decision\-makers across active opportunities
 



 ●    Help improve Novasensa's CRM, reporting, and business\-development processes
 



  





**Partnerships and Ecosystem Development** 




 ●    Engage with private\-sector companies, government departments, research institutions, industry associations, and international partners
 



 ●    Support partnerships relating to technology deployment, feedstock supply, mineral recovery, equipment deployment, offtake, research, and market entry
 



 ●    Represent Novasensa professionally in meetings, conferences, delegations, and industry forums
 



 ●    Monitor relevant industrial, policy, and market developments
 



  





**This Role Is Not for You If** 




 ●    You are primarily seeking a short\-term role before moving to another sector
 



 ●    You prefer remote work, as this is a fully on\-site position
 



 ●    You need a company with a fully built playbook and no ambiguity
 



  





**What You Will Receive** 




 ●    Fixed compensation of ₹5 to ₹9 lakh per annum (approximately ₹41,700 to ₹75,000 per month), based on experience and demonstrated capability
 



 ●    Performance\-linked annual incentive
 



 ●    Eligibility for ESOP consideration after nine months for candidates who demonstrate exceptional performance and long\-term alignment
 



 ●    Direct mentorship and working exposure with the co\-founders
 



 ●    Participation in live commercial and strategic discussions
 



 ●    Exposure to leading organisations across mining, metals, battery recycling, clean energy, government, research, and international markets
 



 ●    Significant responsibility and career progression for candidates who consistently deliver
 



 ●    Relocation or housing support where applicable
 



  





**Location** 




 Delhi NCR. This is a full\-time, 100% on\-site position with an 18\-month minimum commitment from your start date. Candidates should already be based in Delhi NCR or be willing to relocate.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn with your resume and a brief response to the following questions:
 



 ●    This work asks people to spend years on a hard, unglamorous problem: recovering critical minerals and advancing India's clean energy transition. Why does that matter enough to you personally to make it your work?
 



 ●    Describe one situation in which you independently developed a relationship, opportunity, project, or initiative from the beginning.
 



 ●    Which of Novasensa's areas interests you most: critical mineral recovery, battery and e\-waste recycling, or mineral beneficiation, and why?
 



 ●    Are you currently based in Delhi NCR or willing to relocate?
 



  





 Generic applications that do not demonstrate genuine engagement with why this problem matters are unlikely to progress.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who wants to help build something that outlasts a resume line, not simply occupy a business\-development position.

**Data, AI \& Analytics**
* Familiarity with AI/ML use cases in utilities – energy forecasting, predictive maintenance, outage analytics

**Cloud \& Integration**
* Delivery experience on cloud platforms – Azure, AWS, or Oracle in a utility/energy context

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI\-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
   

  

 We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
   

  

 Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM \+ AI conversation \- shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
* You will lead India Presales and a team of \~10\-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid\-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.


**What Work Looks Like**
* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO\-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10\-15\-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution\-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI\-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI\-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time


**Role expectations**
* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.
* Raise the talent bar. Build a high\-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.
* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.
* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 12–15\+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.
* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross\-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.


**Why this role is different**
 You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.
   

  

**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

* Develop Client\-Ready Deliverables Create high\-quality presentations, reports, business cases, and implementation roadmaps that effectively communicate strategic recommendations and transformation plans.
* Drive Sustainability Transformation Initiatives Assist in projects focused on supply chain decarbonization, circular economy, traceability, responsible sourcing, and ESG\-related value chain transformations.
* Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Stakeholders Work closely with global client teams, industry experts, technology partners, and internal stakeholders to support project delivery and stakeholder management activities.
* Leverage Digital, AI \& Sustainability Technologies Assess supply chain technologies, utilize AI/GenAI\-enabled tools for analysis and reporting, and recommend digital solutions that improve efficiency, transparency, resilience, and sustainability outcomes

* Skillset to analyze large amounts of qualitative and quantitative data to draw insights and trends
* Structured problem solving and strong analytical skills

* Excellent communication skills and ability to leverage that to for project delivery and stakeholder management
* Building relationships with potential and existing clients and being responsible for business development in assigned areas
* Potential to work with diverse teams and to be able to foster learning, exchange and innovation
* Grasp of MS power point, Excel and Word is important. Other tools like Power BI and Tableau are a plus
* Familiarity with AI and GenAI tools and their application in supply chain and sustainability contexts, including data analysis, report generation, and scenario modelling


**Additional Information:**
 We are hiring across multiple roles! Experience in one or more categories listed below will be preferred.
   

  

**AREA 1: RISK \& RESILIENCE**
* Experience in Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) \- including supplier risk assessments, risk scoring frameworks, and sustainability\-linked due diligence
* Hands\-on experience with N\-tier visibility tools and scenario simulation
* Ability to design and implement supplier risk monitoring frameworks, including financial, operational, and ESG\-linked risk indicators
* Experience conducting supply chain risk mapping — identifying single points of failure, geographic concentration risks, and supplier dependency analysis
* Ability to develop risk mitigation roadmaps and resilience strategies that integrate sustainability considerations across supply chains
* Experience working with risk and resilience platforms such as Osapiens, Interos, or ProcessUnity


**OR**
**AREA 2: TRACEABILITY**
* Strong understanding of traceability regulations and standards including EUDR, CSDDD, PPWR, Digital Product Passport (DPP), and GS1 standards
* Experience designing and implementing traceability and transparency solutions across complex, multi\-tier supply chains
* Familiarity with Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), product\-level carbon footprint methodologies, and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approaches
* Knowledge of regulatory landscape including extended producer responsibility (EPR), waste management regulations, and product compliance frameworks (EU Taxonomy, CBAM)
* Experience with ESG data and technology architecture for traceability use cases
* Ability to gather business requirements, identify platform fits and gaps, and develop functional specifications for traceability and sustainability reporting use cases


**OR**
**AREA 3: CIRCULAR SUPPLY CHAINS**
* Strong experience working on circular economy projects across thematic areas such as plastic packaging, e\-waste, textiles
* Experience designing circular transformation strategies across supply chains — including reverse logistics, take\-back model design, and material flow analysis
* Knowledge of technology enablement and service plays that support circularity — including digital platforms (e.g. Agora) for tracking material flows and closed\-loop systems
* Understanding of circular strategy and business model design, including circular operating model design and sustainable product portfolio steering
* Proven experience with P\&L modelling, business model innovation, and go\-to\-market strategy in the context of circular product and service innovation
* Experience with supplier assessments and supplier development using tools such as Eco Vadis, with a focus on circular economy compliance


**OR**
**AREA 4: SUPPLY CHAIN DECARBONIZATION**
* Strong experience in supplier decarbonization managed programs — including supplier engagement \& onboarding, emissions baselining, and decarbonization roadmap development
* Experience with science\-based target setting (SBTi) and delivering science\-based targets as a service
* Deep understanding of Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions accounting, carbon neutrality strategies, and low\-carbon energy transition across key geographies (US, EU, India, Australia)
* Strong experience working on clean energy projects including onsite/offsite Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs), and carbon offsets
* Experience with ESG reporting frameworks and sustainability data platforms (SAP, Workiva, Enablon, Oracle, MSM) for carbon and climate disclosure use cases
* Understanding of ESG Intelligence capabilities including gap assessment vs ESG frameworks, GenAI\-powered sustainability report generation, and end\-to\-end ESG platform implementation

* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 Your specific project activities include performing diagnostics and customizing and implementing our analytical tools across the clients’ organization.
   

  

 You’ll work in teams playing an active role in the client engagement. You will use a tech\-enabled approach to tackle client challenges related to end\-to\-end supply chain planning from demand forecasting and inventory management to S\&OP, production planning and scheduling, and order management.
   

  

 The increasing complexity of integrated tactical and operational systems, combined with an explosion of data, makes these topics both top\-of\-mind and deeply challenging for many clients. Capitalizing upon your analytics and data science background, you will fortify and enhance Manufacturing and Supply Chain's (MSC’s) digital tools to customize the output to precise client situations. Most importantly, you will develop insights and implement solutions which produce tangible and lasting impact on our clients’ operational performance.
   

  

 Your client’s projects will range from quick diagnostics up to multi\-month digital implementations. In between studies, you will bring your learnings back to our internal team to help refine digital modules and ideate powerful new capabilities.
   

  

 Through your work, you’ll have opportunities to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. You’ll gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Master’s degree in an analytics/data centric area such as supply chain management, mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science, or industrial engineering
* 1\+ years of operations research, analytics and/or data science work in industry with a focus on supply chain topics (internships may count as work experience)
* Outstanding record of academic achievement
* Knowledge of analytical concepts relevant for supply chain optimization, such as statistics, time\-series analyses, and classical operations research methods, in particular mathematical programming (esp. mixed\-integer linear programming) and corresponding IT tools (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, AIMMs), and methods from applied statistics (esp. time series forecasting) and stochastic modelling and optimization (e.g., Markov Decision Processes)
* Understanding of IT (e.g. databases and data structures) and demonstrated knowledge of at least one standard programming language (e.g. Python, C\+\+, Java)
* Good understanding of supply chain concepts such as supply chain strategy, production management, scheduling, network design, inventory, and logistics
* Demonstrated strong conceptual and analytical skills; success in working on high impact cross\-functional teams; strong decision making and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated aptitude for analytics and data science, plus appropriate educational and on\-the\-job training
* Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities, and an entrepreneurial bent
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 60%, occasionally internationally
* Language fluency skills to communicate complex ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English

title: Account Executive
description:
About the Company
 



 TheHireHub.AI is a startup founded in 2025, building an AI\-driven recruitment platform that automates sourcing, screening, engagement, and coordination across the hiring process. Built on insights from more than 3,000 global hiring projects and over 20 years of executive search expertise, the platform helps mid\-market and growth\-stage companies hire faster and make smarter decisions. The company serves customers across India, APAC, and MEA, with a growing global footprint, and is headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. TheHireHub.AI empowers recruiters by reducing administrative work and enabling them to focus on strategic decision\-making, customer relationships, and quality hiring outcomes. As a privately held, pre\-seed startup with a small team, it offers a dynamic and growth\-oriented environment for people who value ownership, adaptability, and innovation. The company’s mission is to transform recruitment through AI\-driven solutions, while its core values emphasize innovation, efficiency, empowerment, and an inclusive workplace. This role will contribute directly to expanding adoption of the platform and helping hiring teams improve recruitment effectiveness.
 



 About the Role
 



 As an Account Executive, you will own the customer journey from qualified opportunity through closure, onboarding coordination, account development, and long\-term relationship management. You will sell TheHireHub.AI’s B2B SaaS platform by understanding recruitment and HR technology challenges, connecting those needs to relevant product capabilities, and building a credible business case. The role requires strong prospecting, consultative selling, commercial judgment, and disciplined execution. You will manage a revenue pipeline, forecast accurately, coordinate internal stakeholders, and ensure customers receive consistent value after the sale. Cross\-selling and upselling are core expectations, alongside end\-to\-end client ownership. Experience in B2B SaaS sales is essential, while exposure to HR technology and artificial intelligence is preferred. This is an onsite role based in Noida.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own the complete sales cycle from discovery and qualification through proposal, negotiation, closure, and transition into implementation, ensuring every stage advances measurable revenue outcomes.
* Build and manage a qualified enterprise pipeline through targeted prospecting, relationship development, referrals, and account research, maintaining consistent coverage against quarterly revenue goals.
* Lead consultative conversations with HR, recruitment, business, and technology stakeholders to identify challenges and position AI\-powered recruitment solutions around clear customer value.
* Develop and execute account expansion plans that increase customer lifetime value through relevant cross\-sell and upsell opportunities across products, teams, and use cases.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned clients, coordinating internal teams to resolve issues, protect relationships, and support successful long\-term adoption.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity stages, next steps, and forecasts so leadership has reliable visibility into pipeline health, risks, and expected bookings.
* Collaborate with marketing, solutions, implementation, and customer success teams to improve win rates, shorten sales cycles, and strengthen the overall customer experience.



 Essential Skills \& Technologies
 


* 3–5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with demonstrated ownership of pipeline creation, consultative selling, negotiations, closures, and revenue delivery.
* Strong account management capability, including cross\-selling, upselling, stakeholder mapping, renewal support, and end\-to\-end client relationship ownership.
* Excellent discovery, presentation, communication, objection\-handling, negotiation, and business\-case development skills across enterprise buying groups.
* Working proficiency with CRM platforms and sales productivity tools, including opportunity management, activity tracking, forecasting, and structured pipeline reviews.
* Ability to understand and communicate HR technology, artificial intelligence, recruitment automation, and employee experience concepts in commercially relevant language.



 Additional Plus
 


* Experience selling HR technology, recruitment software, employee experience, automation, or AI\-enabled enterprise software to business customers.
* Existing relationships with HR, recruitment, people operations, shared services, IT, or transformation leaders within mid\-market and enterprise organizations.
* Experience working in an early\-stage or high\-growth SaaS environment where ownership, adaptability, and speed of execution directly influence commercial outcomes.



 What You'll Bring
 


* A proven B2B SaaS sales track record with the discipline to build pipeline, run structured sales cycles, close business, and consistently deliver against revenue expectations.
* A customer\-first commercial mindset that turns discovery into relevant recommendations, builds executive trust, and identifies expansion opportunities without compromising long\-term relationships.
* Strong ownership across the full client lifecycle, including internal coordination, expectation management, issue resolution, adoption support, and account growth.
* Curiosity about HR technology and artificial intelligence, combined with the ability to learn complex products quickly and explain their business impact with clarity.



 Why Join Us
 



 TheHireHub.AI offers the opportunity to join a startup founded in 2025 and sell an AI\-driven recruitment platform addressing important hiring efficiency and decision\-making challenges for growing businesses. You will engage with customers seeking faster, smarter, and more effective ways to manage the recruitment lifecycle.
 



 This role gives you meaningful ownership across acquisition, closure, account expansion, and client relationships rather than limiting your impact to a single stage of the funnel. Your work will directly influence revenue growth, customer value, and the company’s position in the evolving HR technology market.
 



 You will collaborate with a small, growth\-oriented team and gain broad exposure to enterprise SaaS execution, recruitment technology, artificial intelligence, and cross\-functional operations. The environment rewards initiative, customer understanding, structured selling, and people who take responsibility for outcomes.
 



 What We Offer
 


* Opportunity to sell an AI\-driven B2B SaaS platform helping hiring teams automate recruitment and improve the speed and quality of hiring decisions.
* Broad commercial ownership across new business, client relationships, cross\-selling, upselling, and account growth in a collaborative onsite Noida environment.
* Exposure to enterprise sales, HR technology, artificial intelligence, and cross\-functional SaaS operations within a growing global startup.
* Competitive compensation and the opportunity to grow with a company operating at the intersection of recruitment, automation, and intelligent hiring technology.

The company provides comprehensive solutions across a wide material range, from standard carbon steel to exotic alloys such as Inconel, Hastelloy, Titanium, Duplex, and specialty alloys. DHRAX serves demanding industries including oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, chemical processing, marine and offshore, and construction. **Role Description** 
 The Tendering Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chhatral, responsible for managing the end\-to\-end tendering and bidding process for industrial piping products and solutions. Day\-to\-day activities include identifying relevant tenders, reviewing tender documents, preparing compliant technical and commercial proposals, and coordinating with internal teams such as sales, engineering, and procurement to gather accurate data and pricing. The role involves analyzing client requirements, monitoring submission timelines, maintaining tender documentation, and ensuring that all bids meet regulatory, contractual, and company standards. The Tendering Specialist will also support post\-tender clarifications, participate in negotiations when required, and provide regular reporting on tender status, win/loss analysis, and market trends.

* Strong attention to detail, proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and Word), and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Knowledge of international standards (ASTM, ASME, ANSI, DIN) and exposure to oil and gas, petrochemical, or related industries will be an advantage.

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. * Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization\-wide people initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* 3\-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages\- Python, JSON, Ruby, C\#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud\-native/cloud\-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)

* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation
* Hands\-on experience with CyberArk Privileged Cloud Suite, including migration from on\-prem (self\-hosted) environments to Privilege Cloud (PCloud), with strong exposure to SIA, SCA, SWS and WPM capabilities.
* Proven experience in implementing and managing SCIM\-based provisioning, Single Sign\-On (SSO) integrations, and identity lifecycle management within Privilege Cloud.
* Experience in integrating CyberArk solutions with SIEM platforms using secure tunnel configurations to enable centralized logging, monitoring, and compliance reporting.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 3\-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification


**Certifications:**
* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur


**What We Look For**
* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Sales
   

  

 Our Sales teams help to deliver Reckitt's purpose by building shared success with our customers, making access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment possible in\-stores and online. Within Sales, we're focused on achieving outperformance across all of our channels, operating in highly competitive categories. This focus results in a dynamic, fast paced environment where cross functional teams are encouraged to collaborate to achieve success. We have around 10,000 sales people across the world, within market roles and ranging in areas like Field Sales, Key Accounts, Trade Marketing and Category Development.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Embark on a fulfilling journey as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative with Reckitt. In this position, you'll harness your passion for the healthcare field to introduce life\-enhancing pharmaceutical products to professionals who care for patients every day. Armed with a deep understanding of our products and the compassion to make a difference, you'll be the bridge between our breakthrough solutions and the healthcare community. Join us and channel your drive into a career that helps improve lives.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Be the go\-to expert for product knowledge, providing insightful information on our pharmaceutical range and its application in therapy areas.
* Meet and exceed sales targets, ensuring Reckitt's pharmaceutical products reach the hands of healthcare providers.
* Develop lasting relationships with healthcare professionals, becoming a reliable source of expertise and support.
* Convey the benefits of our pharmaceutical products through engaging and informative presentations.
* Analyse market data to stay ahead of industry trends, identifying growth opportunities and delivering on them.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* A track record of success in pharmaceutical sales.
* A deep understanding of medical terminologies, products, and therapeutic areas.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect and influence healthcare professionals.
* A proactive approach to building and nurturing relationships with a diverse range of medical authorities.
* Committed to ethical practises and familiar with the regulatory landscape of the pharmaceutical industry.


 The skills for success
   

  

 Sales Targets, product Knowledge, Customer Relationships, Product Presentations, Market Analysis, Compliance, Territory Management, Training and Development, Sales Reporting, Collaboration.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.
