title: Senior Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
 As a Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for strategising, executing, optimising and scaling paid digital campaigns across multiple platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with the creative, social media, SEO, website and account management teams to ensure performance campaigns are aligned with broader brand and business objectives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who understands that performance marketing is not just about running ads — it is about understanding the business, audience, funnel, creative, landing experience, data and economics behind every campaign.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Performance Marketing Strategy
* Develop and execute comprehensive paid media strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
* Translate client business objectives into measurable digital marketing strategies and KPIs.
* Build full\-funnel campaigns across awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversion and remarketing.
* Develop media plans, budget allocations, campaign structures and performance forecasts.
* Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining efficiency and profitability.
* Analyse customer journeys and identify gaps across the acquisition funnel.
* Recommend the right platform, audience, creative and campaign mix based on business objectives.
* Campaign Management \& Optimisation
* Own end\-to\-end campaign execution across multiple client accounts.
* Manage significant monthly advertising budgets and ensure effective utilisation.
* Monitor and optimise budgets, bids, audiences, placements, keywords, creatives and conversion events.
* Conduct structured A/B testing across audiences, creatives, landing pages, offers and campaign strategies.
* Continuously optimise campaigns against CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rate and other business KPIs.
* Identify performance drops, diagnose root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Scale high\-performing campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.
* Stay updated with platform changes, algorithm updates, targeting capabilities and emerging performance marketing trends.
* Google Ads
* Manage and optimise Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube and remarketing campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research, search term analysis and competitor analysis.
* Build and optimise keyword, ad group and campaign structures.
* Manage bidding strategies, negative keywords, quality scores and conversion tracking.
* Develop strategies to improve CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPL and ROAS.
* Identify opportunities for budget expansion and campaign scaling.
* Meta Ads
* Develop and manage full\-funnel Meta advertising strategies.
* Manage prospecting, retargeting, lookalike and remarketing campaigns.
* Analyse audience behaviour and campaign\-level performance.
* Work closely with the creative team to develop performance\-led creative briefs.
* Identify creative fatigue and recommend new creative directions.
* Conduct systematic creative and audience testing.
* Optimise campaigns for lead generation, sales, traffic, engagement and other business objectives.
* LinkedIn Ads
* Plan and execute B2B campaigns across LinkedIn.
* Develop account, job\-title, industry, company and audience targeting strategies.
* Manage lead generation and conversion campaigns.
* Analyse lead quality and work with clients to improve campaign\-to\-sales outcomes.


**Website, AEO \& SEO**
* Work with the website and creative teams to improve landing pages and conversion journeys.
* Analyse landing\-page performance and identify conversion drop\-offs.
* Recommend improvements to page structure, messaging, CTAs and user experience.
* Manage and update client websites using WordPress or similar CMS platforms where required.
* Understand the relationship between paid media, SEO, landing pages and organic acquisition.
* Support SEO strategy through keyword research, competitor analysis, content optimisation and technical recommendations.
* Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.


**Analytics, Tracking \& Reporting**
* Own campaign tracking and measurement across client accounts.
* Set up and audit conversion tracking, pixels, events and campaign attribution.
* Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and advertising platform analytics.
* Analyse campaign and website data to identify actionable insights.
* Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting systems.
* Prepare weekly, monthly and campaign\-level performance reports.
* Go beyond reporting numbers — explain why performance changed, what it means for the business and what should be done next.
* Present performance insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.


**Client Management \& Strategy**
* Act as a senior performance marketing point of contact for assigned clients.
* Understand client businesses, sales cycles, customer acquisition economics and commercial objectives.
* Participate in client meetings and present campaign performance and recommendations.
* Proactively identify opportunities for growth, upselling and increased media investment.
* Challenge briefs when required and recommend better performance\-led approaches.
* Build strong relationships with clients through transparency, strategic thinking and measurable results.
* Work closely with Account Management, Creative, Social Media, SEO and Content teams to deliver integrated campaigns.


**Team Leadership**
* Mentor and guide junior performance marketing executives.
* Review campaign structures, optimisation plans and reports prepared by the team.
* Establish performance marketing processes, checklists and best practices.
* Delegate tasks effectively and ensure timely delivery across accounts.
* Conduct regular performance reviews of campaigns and team output.
* Help build a stronger performance marketing function within Represent Media.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5–7 years of hands\-on experience in performance marketing, preferably within a digital marketing agency.
* Strong expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Working knowledge of LinkedIn Ads.
* Strong understanding of full\-funnel digital marketing and customer acquisition.
* Experience managing and scaling meaningful advertising budgets.
* Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate and attribution.
* Hands\-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
* Good understanding of landing\-page optimisation and CRO.
* Working knowledge of SEO and website management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts in a fast\-paced agency environment.


**Bonus Points**
* Google Ads / Meta / LinkedIn certifications.
* Experience managing large monthly media spends.
* Experience with e\-commerce, lead generation and B2B campaigns.
* Experience with Google Tag Manager and advanced tracking setups.
* Experience with CRM integrations and lead\-quality tracking.
* Experience with Looker Studio or other reporting platforms.
* Experience working with WordPress.
* Experience mentoring or managing a performance marketing team.
* Strong understanding of creative testing and performance creative strategy.


**What We're Looking For**
**Ownership**
 You don't wait for someone to tell you that a campaign is underperforming. You identify the problem, understand why it is happening and act on it.
   

  

**Commercial Thinking**
 You understand that clicks and leads are not the final objective. Business growth is.
   

  

**Analytical Thinking**
 You enjoy working with data and can turn numbers into clear decisions.
   

  

**Strategic Thinking**
 You can look beyond individual campaigns and understand the entire customer acquisition funnel.
   

  

**Curiosity**
 Digital advertising changes constantly. You should actively test, learn and stay ahead of platform and algorithm changes.
   

  

**Communication**
 You can explain complex performance data in a simple, commercially relevant manner to both clients and internal teams.
   

  

**Leadership**
 You are comfortable taking ownership of accounts, guiding junior team members and raising the overall quality of the performance function.
   

  

**Experience**
 5–7 Years
   

  

**Location**
 Bengaluru
   

  

**Employment Type**
 Full\-Time

 Performance Marketing

title: Senior SEO Executive
description:
**Experience: 4 to 5 years minimum \| Reports to: SEO Manager** 




  





 About Dare Network, a growth marketing agency working with D2C and B2B clients across India, the GCC, the UK, and the US. We run performance marketing, SEO, web development, and content. \~28 people across Kochi and Bengaluru.
 



  





**About the role:** 
 You’ll own a portfolio of 4 to 6 client accounts end\-to\-end. For each account, you are the owner: strategy, execution, client conversations, reporting, outcomes. Not an executor waiting for briefs. Not a junior who needs a manager reviewing every deliverable. You already know what good SEO looks like and can run it without supervision.
 



 If you need a senior to tell you whether to prioritise a technical fix or a content gap, this role isn’t for you.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




 Strategy and planning
 


* Build 3, 6, and 12\-month SEO roadmaps per account
* Define keyword strategy, content priorities, technical priorities, link\-building approach
* Set realistic KPIs and timelines (no inflated promises to clients)



  





**Execution** 



* Technical audits using Screaming Frog, GSC, Ahrefs or SEMrush
* On\-page optimisation, internal linking, schema implementation
* Brief content writers and QA before publish
* Coordinate with the dev team on technical fixes (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow)
* Plan link\-building or digital PR
* Set up tracking: GA4, GSC, Looker Studio dashboards



  





**Client communication** 



* Lead monthly performance reviews and quarterly strategy reviews
* Respond to client queries within agreed SLAs
* Manage expectations honestly when results lag or scope shifts
* Handle escalations without pulling in the founder for routine issues



  





**Reporting** 



* Monthly performance reports per account, no fluff
* Quarterly business reviews with clear next steps
* Internal weekly status updates



  





**Must\-haves** 



* 4 to 5 years of SEO experience, ideally agency\-side
* Hands\-on across technical SEO, on\-page, content SEO, and off\-page. You can’t outsource your understanding of any of these.
* Proven multi\-industry experience. You’ve worked on D2C and B2B at minimum, and can adapt to a new industry quickly.
* Strong with Ahrefs or SEMrush, GSC, GA4, Screaming Frog, Looker Studio
* Comfortable with WordPress SEO; bonus for Shopify and Webflow
* Case studies or anonymised proof of work: rankings, traffic, lead/revenue impact. We need to see that you’ve done the work, not just described it on a CV.
* Strong written English. You’ll write client emails, reports, and content briefs for founders and CMOs.
* Comfortable on client calls. Most of our clients are founders or CMOs and they’ll know within 10 minutes if you’re winging it.



  





**Nice\-to\-haves** 



* International SEO experience across GCC, UK, or US markets
* B2B manufacturing or SaaS SEO experience
* Working knowledge of GEO/AEO (optimisation for LLM and AI search)
* Experience with HARO, digital PR, or link\-building partners
* Has mentored junior SEOs before



  





**What success looks like** 




  





**First 30 days** 



* Onboarded on all assigned accounts
* Audited the current state of each, flagged the real gaps
* Met every client and led at least one strategy call



  





**60 days** 



* Roadmaps in place per account
* Execution running on a weekly cadence
* Reporting templates standardised and delivered on time



  





**90 days** 



* Visible movement on at least 2 accounts (rankings, traffic, or conversions)
* Clients confident in your ownership. Founder no longer involved in day\-to\-day calls for your accounts.



  





**Non\-negotiables** 



* You own the account. If anything slips, please let us know first, not the client.
* Reports tell the truth. No hiding behind impressions or vanity rankings.
* You bring the thinking. You don’t escalate basics to the founder.



  





**Compensation based on experience. We offer competitive pay for senior operators who can run accounts without supervision. Discussed in the interview.**

title: Performance Marketer Executive
description:
Job Title: Performance Marketer Executive
 





 Experience: 2–3 years
 




  





**About the role:** 

 This is the level where you stop executing someone else's plan and start owning accounts. You run 3–5 client accounts end to end: structure, budgets, optimisation, scaling, and the client conversation around it all. Your Lead sets portfolio strategy and steps in on hard calls; everything else on your accounts is yours.
 





 You sit in the Performance Marketing department, work daily with the Creative (Paid Ads) team on what to produce next, and are the first person a client hears from when they have a question about their media.
 




  





**Key responsibilities:** 





 1\.Account ownership
 



* Own 3–5 accounts end to end on Meta and Google (plus other channels where relevant): campaign structure, budget allocation, bids, optimisation, and scaling decisions.
* Own spend pacing daily. Flag anomalies the day they appear, not in the monthly report.
* Handle first\-level client questions directly, without escalation.



  






 2\.Testing and optimisation
 



* Build and run a monthly testing roadmap per account: audiences, creatives, offers, placements, landing pages.
* Document learnings so wins compound across accounts instead of living in your head.
* Detect creative fatigue early and act before performance decays.



  






 3\.Reporting and client communication
 



* Own the reporting narrative for your accounts: what happened, why, and what we are doing next. Numbers without a story do not count as a report.
* Present results on client calls and defend media decisions with data.



  






 4\.Creative collaboration
 



* Brief the Creative team on what to produce based on performance data: which angles are winning, what to iterate, what to kill.
* Close the loop: report creative performance back so the next batch is better than the last.



  






 5\.Team
 





 Review launches by interns and executives on your accounts; catch errors before clients do.
 





 Mentor juniors informally. At this level, making others better is part of the job, not extra credit.
 




  





**Must have** 



* 2–3 years running paid campaigns hands\-on, with at least one account you scaled profitably and can walk us through in detail.
* Advanced Meta Ads and Google Ads; working knowledge of at least one more channel (TikTok, Snap, Amazon, or LinkedIn).
* Measurement fluency: GA4, pixel and Conversions API setup, UTM discipline, and a working grasp of CAC, ROAS, AOV, and LTV.
* Creative analysis: you can explain why an ad works (hook, angle, format) and spot fatigue in the data before it shows in results.
* Landing page and CRO fundamentals: you know when the problem is not the ads.
* Client\-ready communication, written and on calls.



  





**Good to have** 



* D2C experience across India, GCC, UK, or US markets.
* Experience briefing creative teams or working inside a creative\-performance feedback loop.
* Comfort using AI tools for analysis, reporting, and research, with judgment about when not to trust them.

*OGS India continues to expand its scale and capabilities through the integration of additional global operations, further strengthening its position as a strategic solutions engine for Omnicom.* 




**Let’s build what’s next.** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 This exciting role of a Search \& Social Manager – Media Solutions requires you to creatively manage team supporting digital media campaigns for our global brands. Your expertise of ad tech and knowledge of the Digital Life Cycle would make you a great fit for this position. This is a great opportunity to work closely with the Top Global brands and own large and reputed accounts. Need to support Global clients and account Managers of our Media Solutions team.

* Client Relationship Management: Serve as a primary point of contact for clients or stakeholders, understanding their business objectives, and maintaining strong relationships. Provide strategic recommendations, campaign updates, and insights to clients, ensuring their satisfaction and retention

title: Marketplace Manager - Amazon
description:

The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, improving product visibility, managing marketplace operations, optimizing advertising campaigns, and ensuring a seamless customer experience. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, hands\-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, and a deep understanding of marketplace growth strategies.

* Own end\-to\-end management of the Amazon Seller Central account.

* Manage catalog creation, product listings, variations, A\+ Content, Brand Store, and storefront optimization.
* Ensure catalog accuracy and maintain listing hygiene.
* Monitor account health and resolve policy, compliance, and suppression issues.

* Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and images.

**Pricing \& Competition**

 Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E\-commerce, or a related field.

title: Affiliate & API Partnership Manager
description:
**Affiliate \& API Partnership Manager** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




  





**About NIRA** 




  





 NIRA is an exciting fintech startup which, starting with credit, is building financial services for India’s mass market.
 



  





 Today, if you were to think of the largest financial brands in India, you’d think of the banks: HDFC, ICICI, Kotak etc. They all serve the richest cohort of India’s society. Over the last few years some newer brands have emerged that target upwardly mobile millennials; think Slice, Moneyview, Uni Cards etc. The mass market, or Middle India, remains a white space. This is the gap that NIRA is looking to fill.
 



  





 Launched in 2018, NIRA has found a very strong product market fit, and has established itself as the category leader for the mass market segment. Since the passing of Covid, the company grew quickly and achieved profitability in 2023\. Last year brought some challenging headwinds, but we weathered those well and are well placed for our next phase of growth. This is a huge market, we need to go after it.
 



  





 Beyond personal loans, we’ll introduce both new credit and non\-credit products. NIRA will become the holistic provider of financial services for Middle India.
 



 NIRA was acquired by Tilt in 2025\. It continues to operate under its own band.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We’re looking for a driven and analytical Affiliate \& API Partnership Manager to boost lead generation and approvals through affiliate and API vendor channels. You’ll manage partner relationships, track performance, and help scale our growth efficiently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Identify, onboard, and manage affiliate and API vendors.
* Optimize campaigns to improve lead\-to\-approval conversion.
* Monitor daily performance using tools like Appsflyer, and Excel.
* Negotiate payouts, track CAC, and remove fraudulent/non\-performing vendors.
* Collaborate with Tech, Risk, and Product teams for API integration and quality checks.
* Drive regular performance reviews and share actionable reports.
* Execute bulk communication campaigns to re\-engage or onboard partners.
* Share performance tracking reports with partners on a regular basis to enable transparency and iterations to campaign strategy.



  





**Requirements** 




  




* 2–5 years’ experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partnerships, or API Vendor Management.
* Strong analytical, coordination, and communication skills.
* Hands\-on experience in data tracking, campaign optimization, and reporting.
* Prior experience in fintech, NBFCs, or digital lending preferred though not essential.



  





**Performance Goals** 




  




* Increase approvals and lead quality through affiliate \& API channels.
* Maintain accurate, timely reports and improve efficiency month over month.
* Strengthen partnerships to drive consistent, high\-quality growth.



 If you’re proactive, data\-driven, and love scaling growth through smart partnerships, we’d love to connect!

title: GTM & Growth Intern
description:
**Location** 

 : Bangalore, hybrid
 




**Type** 

 : Full\-time internship
 




**Stipend** 

 : ₹25,000–₹35,000/month
 




  




**About Basenine** 


 Basenine is a branding and website studio working with B2B technology companies across the US, Europe and MENA.
 




  






 We’ve worked with 50\+ technology companies, including startups backed by
 
**a16z, Y Combinator, Peter Thiel and other leading investors** 

 .
 




  






 Until now, most of our growth has come through LinkedIn, referrals, partnerships and founder\-led outreach.
 




  






 We’re now building the next stage of our growth engine — and we’re looking for someone to help us do it.
 




  




**About the role** 


 We’re looking for someone who wants to learn
 
**how a B2B company actually grows** 

 by working on it hands\-on.
 




  






 This is not an operations or project management role.
 




  






 You’ll work directly with the founder across content, SEO, outbound, partnerships, launches and new distribution experiments.
 




  






 Some channels already have specialists working on them. Your job isn’t just to coordinate them — it’s to understand what they’re doing, research how we could do it better, and help us push things forward.
 




  






 You don’t need to already know every channel.
 





 But you should be curious enough to figure things out quickly.
 




  




**What you’ll work on** 
* Turn our client work, projects and learnings into LinkedIn posts, case studies and other content
* Help build and maintain a consistent content calendar
* Find interesting work and stories inside the company that we should be talking about publicly
* Repurpose one idea across LinkedIn, X, newsletters, video and other channels
* Work with our SEO agency to make sure the strategy and execution stay aligned with our business
* Research keywords, competitors, content opportunities and new distribution channels
* Help improve and experiment with our cold outbound campaigns
* Research prospects, partners, communities and people we should be building relationships with
* Help launch new Basenine offerings and experiments
* Track what is working and what isn’t
* Research how other B2B companies and agencies are growing
* Run small growth experiments and learn from the results
* Work with designers and technical team members whenever a campaign needs creative or automation support



  




**What we're looking for** 


 You might be a good fit if:
 



* You understand the fundamentals of marketing
* You’ve worked on content, social media, SEO, performance marketing, growth or a similar area before
* You enjoy researching why something works instead of blindly copying it
* You can write clearly
* You understand that distribution matters as much as creating something good
* You’re comfortable with tools, analytics and learning new platforms
* You take ownership instead of waiting for a detailed task list
* You’re interested in B2B marketing and technology
* You’re comfortable experimenting, failing and trying again



  




**Bonus points if you...** 
* Have worked with B2B SaaS or technology companies
* Understand SEO and keyword research
* Have managed LinkedIn or other social channels
* Have worked on landing pages
* Understand basic performance marketing
* Have used tools like Ahrefs, Search Console, GA4 or PostHog
* Have experimented with cold outbound
* Use AI regularly for research, writing or marketing workflows



  





**You don't need to know all of these already.** 




  




**What you'll learn** 


 You’ll get exposure to almost every part of growing a B2B services business:
 




**Content → SEO → outbound → partnerships → positioning → launches → analytics → distribution.** 




  






 You’ll also work alongside specialists in areas such as SEO, outbound and automation, rather than learning everything purely from theory.
 




  






 The goal is that you understand
 
**why** 

 these channels work, how they fit together and how to use them to drive actual business growth.
 




  






 We believe the fastest way to learn growth is to actually ship things, measure what happens and iterate.
 




  




**Think you'd be a good fit?** 


 If this sounds like you, fill in the application.

title: Senior Manager – Influencer, Creator & Partnerships
description:
**About Us**
 Wirality is building a creator, influencer and partnerships vertical.
   

  

 We are building it around a simple belief: as more of culture, attention and influence moves through people rather than traditional media channels, brands need a much stronger way to identify, access and work with the right creators, talent and communities.
   

  

 We will work across influencer marketing, creator partnerships, talent, brand collaborations, creator\-led IP, community\-led distribution and other opportunities that sit at the intersection of brands and people with influence.
   

  

 We are starting from zero.
   

  

 And we are looking for someone who wants to build it with us.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Manager – Influencer, Creator \& Partnerships** 
 to be part of the core team building this department.
   

  

 This is a commercial, client\-facing and execution\-focused role.
   

  

 You will be responsible for helping grow the business: identifying opportunities, contributing to new business, developing relationships with brands and creators, building solutions and independently managing large influencer and creator mandates.
   

  

 You won’t be joining an established department with a ready\-made playbook.
   

  

 You will be helping us build one.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Drive Business Growth


 Sales will be an important part of your role.
   

  

 You will be expected to identify opportunities, develop leads, participate in pitches, build proposals and help convert conversations into business.
   

  

 Opportunities can come from existing Wirality relationships as well as clients acquired independently.
   

  

 Over time, we expect you to develop and own a meaningful book of business.
   

  

 You should be comfortable speaking to marketers, understanding their problems and turning those conversations into commercially viable creator solutions.
   

  

* Build \& Manage Client Relationships


 Develop strong relationships with brands, marketing teams, agencies and other potential partners.
   

  

 You will independently manage key accounts and identify opportunities to grow those relationships through new campaigns, creators, partnerships and formats.
   

  

 We want you to understand the client’s business rather than simply execute the influencer brief handed to you.
   

  

 You should eventually become someone clients call when they are trying to understand what they should be doing with creators.
   

  

* Build the Creator \& Talent Network


 Develop and maintain a strong network across creators, influencers, celebrities, talent managers and emerging voices.
   

  

 The network should span nano and micro creators through to large creators and celebrity talent.
   

  

 You will be expected to continuously discover new creators, build relationships and understand what is happening across the Indian creator ecosystem.
   

  

 For important creators and talent relationships, we expect you to remain personally involved.
   

  

* Build \& Execute Creator Solutions


 Understand a client brief and translate it into the right creator solution.
   

  

**This Could Include**
* Influencer marketing campaigns
* Creator partnerships
* Celebrity and talent partnerships
* Brand collaborations
* Creator\-led IP
* UGC/creator ecosystems
* Community and distribution partnerships
* Long\-term creator programmes
* New formats that emerge as the creator economy evolves


 We aren’t looking for someone who responds to every brief with a spreadsheet of influencers.
   

  

 You should understand why a particular creator, community or format makes sense for a particular business problem.
   

  

* Own Campaigns End\-to\-End


 You should be capable of independently taking a campaign from brief to completion.
   

  

**That Means Understanding And Managing The Entire Lifecycle**
 Strategy; creator research and selection; creator outreach; commercials; negotiation; contracting; briefing; content approvals; execution; timelines; measurement; reporting and post\-campaign analysis.
   

  

 You will work with junior team members as the department grows, but you should understand the work well enough to step in and solve problems yourself.
   

  

* Own Campaign Economics


 Revenue alone isn’t enough.
   

  

 You will be responsible for ensuring the campaigns and accounts you manage make commercial sense.
   

  

 That means understanding budgets, negotiating effectively with creators and partners, protecting margins and identifying opportunities to improve profitability.
   

  

 You should understand the difference between generating revenue and generating good revenue.
   

  

* Help Build the Operating System


 We don’t want this to become a business dependent entirely on someone’s phonebook.
   

  

 You will help turn relationships and experience into infrastructure.
   

  

**That Includes Helping Build Systems Around**
 Creator discovery and classification; creator CRM and relationship management; historical pricing; campaign performance data; creator evaluation and scoring; briefing and shortlisting; contracting and payments; campaign measurement; and reporting.
   

  

 We want the department to become progressively smarter with every campaign it executes.
   

  

* Manage \& Develop the Team


 As the business grows, you will work with and manage junior team members across campaign management, creator relationships and partnerships.
   

  

 You will be expected to delegate effectively, build processes and help develop a team capable of independently managing campaigns.
   

  

 This is not only about getting your own work done. It is about helping build a team that can scale.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for someone with approximately
 **4–6 years** 
 of experience, with meaningful experience inside the influencer/creator ecosystem.
   

  

 You should ideally have worked at a leading influencer marketing agency, creator company, talent business or a similar organisation where influencer marketing was a core part of the business rather than an ancillary service.
   

  

 You should already understand how this industry works.
   

  

 That means knowing creators, understanding brands, knowing how commercials are negotiated, understanding campaign operations and having relationships you can activate.
   

  

 You should have independently managed significant influencer campaigns and be ready to take on greater commercial and business responsibility.
   

  

**Who Are We Looking For**
 This role will suit someone who is:
   

  

 Commercial.
   

  

 You like selling and don’t see new business as somebody else’s responsibility.
   

  

 Entrepreneurial.
   

  

 There isn’t an established machine waiting for you. You should be excited about helping build it.
   

  

 Networked.
   

  

 You have genuine relationships within the creator ecosystem and ideally across the brand/agency ecosystem as well.
   

  

 Hands\-on.
   

  

 You can contribute to a pitch in the morning, negotiate with creators in the afternoon and solve an execution problem in the evening.
   

  

 Organised.
   

  

 Creator campaigns involve a lot of moving parts. You can keep control of them without losing sight of the larger objective.
   

  

 Data\-oriented.
   

  

 You believe influencer marketing can become more measurable and systematic than simply choosing creators based on followers and engagement rates.
   

  

 Collaborative.
   

  

 You will work closely with teams across Wirality and should be comfortable building alongside people with different areas of expertise.
   

  

 Culturally plugged in.
   

  

 You understand Indian internet culture, creators, platforms and how influence is changing.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured by your contribution to the commercial and operational outcomes of the department.
   

  

 Revenue. Margins. Client growth. Repeat business. Creator relationships. Campaign execution.
   

  

 Over time, we expect you to build a meaningful book of business and develop a team capable of servicing it.
   

  

 Your responsibility should grow as the business grows.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Different**
 You aren’t joining an established influencer marketing department.
   

  

 You are joining the team building one.
   

  

 You will have the backing, infrastructure and client ecosystem of Wirality while getting the opportunity to help define how this vertical operates from the beginning.
   

  

 That means more ownership, more responsibility and considerably more exposure to building a business than you would typically get in an established team.
   

  

 For the right person, there is also the possibility of creating meaningful long\-term upside linked to the business they help build.
   

  

 If you’ve spent the last few years learning how the creator economy works and want your next role to be about building something rather than simply managing something, we’d like to talk.
   

  

 Skills: influencer,influencer marketing,partnerships,campaigns

title: VP - Brand (Brand Head)
description:
**About bigbasket**




**bigbasket, a Tata Enterprise,** 
 is one of India’s pioneers in online grocery, transforming the way millions of Indians shop every day. It is at the forefront of transforming quick commerce in India
 



  





 With
 **50,000\+ employees,** 
 presence across
 **60\+ cities and towns** 
 and
 **15 million customer orders per month** 
 , we operate across grocery, fresh retail, quick commerce and B2B. Our ecosystem includes 7 business verticals \-
 **bigbasket, bbnow, bbdaily, bbinstant, Fresho, bbmandi and bbsaathi.** 
 From pioneering online grocery to building next\-generation commerce, we continue to innovate at scale. Backed by the
 **Tata Group** 
 , we combine the trust of a legacy brand with the agility and ambition to build what’s next.
 



  





**Join bigbasket. Build what’s next**

**Reporting To** 
 \- Chief Growth Officer
 



**Location \-** 
 Bangalore (Corporate Office)
 



**Work Model \-** 
 Onsite
 



  





**What would you be doing?**




 The
 **Head of Brand** 
 will be the
 **custodian and architect of the bigbasket brand** 
 , responsible for shaping how the brand is defined, experienced and expressed in a high\-frequency, app\-led, quick commerce environment.
 



  





 This role goes beyond communication to ensure the brand promise is consistently delivered across app experience, delivery interactions, packaging, customer service, and communication. It balances long\-term brand equity with the speed and performance demands of a promotion\-heavy, growth\-led business. The role will establish clear brand architecture, governance, and playbooks that enable decentralized execution across cities, categories, and teams without diluting brand coherence.
 



  





 This leader will work at the intersection of consumer insight, growth, product, category, supply chain, and CX, ensuring the brand consistently shows up as reliable, fast, value\-led, and customer\-obsessed while remaining distinctive in a crowded quick commerce market.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Brand Strategy, Positioning and Framework** 



* Define and evolve
 **bigbasket’s brand strategy** 
 .
* Establish and govern the brand architecture across master brands, sub\-brands and private labels.
* Ensure a
 **clear, consistent brand narrative** 
 across all consumer touchpoints — app experience, delivery experience, packaging, communication, and customer service.
* Balance
 **trust \& reliability** 
 with
 **speed \& convenience** 
 expected from a quick commerce brand.



  





**2\.** 
**Brand Experience \& Expression** 



* Own the end\-to\-end brand experience to ensure the promise is experienced, not just communicated, across:
* App UX and journeys
* Delivery and last mile
* Packaging and physical assets
* Customer support interactions
* Define brand identity, tone of voice, and creative standards.
* Ensure consistency in how the brand shows up across product, operations, and customer interactions.



  





*3* 
**. Integrated Brand Communication** 



* Define overall brand communication and creative framework across:
* Mass media (TV, digital video)
* Performance marketing
* In app journeys
* On\-ground channels
* Own
 **campaign narratives and creative direction** 
 for key business anchors (festivals and events, sales, category pushes, new launches).
* Ensure
 **brand consistency while enabling hyper\-local, city\-specific relevance** 
 .



  





**4\. Consumer Insight \& Brand Health** 



* Build a strong
 **consumer insight and brand research engine**
* Track and improve
 **brand health metrics** 
 : awareness, consideration, trust, NPS, recall, and differentiation.
* Translate insights into
 **actionable brand, experience and communication decisions** 
 .



  





**5\. Private Labels \& Category Branding** 



* Partner closely with category and product teams build
 **strong private label brands** 
 across food \& non\-food
* Create distinctive category\-level propositions aligned with brand narrative
* Shape packaging, naming, pricing cues, and storytelling to drive
 **trial, repeat, and loyalty** 
 .



  





**6\. Market Expansion** 



* Define brand playbooks and launch frameworks for
 **new cities and micro\-markets** 
 .
* Enable regional business teams to execute launches with local relevance within brand guidelines
* Build scalable frameworks that allow
 **speed \+ local relevance** 
 without brand dilution.



  





**7\. Creative, Content \& Brand Expression** 



* Own brand identity, tone of voice, storytelling style, content principles and creative standards across all customer touchpoints.
* Ensuring
 **creative expression of the brand** 
 across campaigns, customer touchpoints and city executions remain contemporary, distinctive and suited to the speed and frequency of quick commerce
* Lead agency ecosystem across creative, media, PR, production to deliver cohesive brand expression at scale.



  





**8\. Growth \& Performance Alignment** 



* Partner with growth, CRM, and performance marketing teams to embed brand thinking into acquisition funnels, engagement journeys and retention programs.
* Ensure alignment between brand investments
 **and measurable business outcomes**
* Balance short\-term performance initiatives with long\-term brand equity.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Act as a
 **thought partner to leadership** 
 , influencing decisions through brand lens on product and tech, customer experience \& support, operations, and expansion.



  





**Who are we looking for?**



* **13–18 years of experience** 
 in large\-scale consumer brand marketing. with exposure to building and anchoring large\-scale consumer brands, spanning brand strategy, communication, and experience.
* Strong grounding in Indian mass marketing (TV, OOH, festivals) combined with deep understanding of digital, app\-led consumer journeys.
* Experience in e\-commerce, quick commerce is strongly preferred.
* Proven leadership of complex agency ecosystems and large teams with a track record of balancing long\-term brand equity and short\-term business pressures



  





**Interested?**




 At bigbasket, you’ll have the opportunity to work at scale, solve meaningful business challenges and help shape the future of commerce in India.
 



  





 Join us and be part of the team building what’s next at bigbasket.
 



  





*Disclaimer: We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where different perspectives, experiences and ideas are valued.*

title: Executive - Online App Merchandising
description:

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
   

  

**Type:**

**WE’RE HIRING \| FOUNDER’S OFFICE ASSOCIATE** 




  





**ROLE DETAILS** 




 Brand: Orchard Gate

**Location: Kasavanahalli, Bangalore**

**Work: 6 days/week, fully in\-office**

 0–1 year / Freshers welcome
 



**Joining:** 
**Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





**ABOUT ORCHARD GATE** 




 Orchard Gate is a specialty coffee sourcing and export business connecting global coffee buyers with Indian coffee origins. nWe work with coffee estates and producers across India, sourcing and developing coffees across different origins, processes and quality profiles, and working with specialty coffee roasters, importers and buyers across India and international markets.
 



 The business operates at the intersection of specialty coffee, agriculture, international trade, sales and brand building.
 



  





**Learn more:** 




**🌐** 
 orchardgatellc.com
 



**💼 Orchard Gate on** 
 LinkedIn
 




  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We’re looking for a
 **smart, curious and highly driven generalist** 
 to work closely with the founder.
 



 This is not a typical “job description” where you do one function every day.
 



 One day you might be:
 



 → Finding 50 potential coffee buyers in a new country
 



 → Figuring out who the right decision\-maker is and writing to them
 



 The next day:
 



 → Researching a new market
 



 → Building a database or analysing a business opportunity
 



 → Working on an Instagram idea around an estate or coffee origin
 



 → Preparing a client presentation
 



 And another day:
 



 → Coordinating samples with a producer
 



 → Following up with an international buyer
 



 → Helping put together a new business proposal
 



 → Figuring out how to solve something that nobody has given you instructions for
 



**You’ll work directly with the founder, and your work will have a visible impact on the business.** 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON** 




  





 BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND GROWTH
 



 A significant part of your role will involve
 **finding and developing new business opportunities.** 




**→ Research domestic and international coffee buyers** 




**→ Identify potential clients and decision\-makers** 




**→ Build prospect databases and lead lists** 




**→ Conduct email, LinkedIn and other outbound outreach** 




**→ Manage follow\-ups and CRM** 




**→ Support sample requests, proposals and commercial discussions** 




**→ Identify new markets, customers and business opportunities** 




  





 RESEARCH AND PROBLEM SOLVING
 



 → Research markets, companies, competitors and industries
 



 → Turn messy information into structured insights
 



 → Build databases and research frameworks
 



 → Answer questions like
 *“Who should we sell to?”* 
 ,
 *“Which market should we explore?”* 
 and
 *“How do we reach them?”* 




  





 MARKETING AND BRAND
 



 → Develop content ideas around coffee, estates, producers and origins
 



 → Work on Instagram and other digital initiatives
 



 → Assist with presentations, proposals and brand material
 



 → Help figure out how Orchard Gate should tell its story
   





 FOUNDERS OFFICE
 


 → Coordinate samples, vendors, clients and shipments
 




 → Support events and partnerships
 



 → Work on new projects and business ideas
 



 → Take projects from
 **idea → execution** 




**→ Jump into whatever important problem needs solving that week** 




  





**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




 We're looking for
 **smart people who are curious about how businesses work.** 




 You might be a great fit if you:
 



 ● Learn quickly and enjoy figuring things out
 



 ● Are naturally curious and ask
 **“why?”** 
 and
 **“what if?”** 




 ● Can research something you've never heard of and make sense of it
 



 ● Are comfortable talking to strangers and reaching out to potential clients
 



 ● Write and communicate clearly
 



 ● Are comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, presentations and digital tools
 



 ● Can take a vague problem and turn it into an actionable plan
 



 ● Don't need someone to tell you what to do at every step
 



 ● Are organised, resourceful and detail\-oriented
 



 ● Actually enjoy startups, business and entrepreneurship
 



**You don't need to know coffee.** 




 You don't need to have done everything listed here.
 



 What matters more is
 **how quickly you learn, how you think and how much ownership you take.** 




  





 A GOOD FIT IF
 



 You see an unfamiliar problem and your first instinct is:
 



**“Okay, let me figure this out.”** 




 You enjoy going down a research rabbit hole and coming back with something useful.
 



 You're comfortable sending the first email, making the first call, finding the missing contact, building the spreadsheet, fixing the presentation or figuring out the process.
 



 And you want to understand
 **how a business actually gets built** 
 , rather than just learn one narrow function.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL GET** 




 You'll work directly with the founder and get exposure to:
 


* Specialty Coffee
* Agriculture \& Coffee Sourcing
* B2B Sales \& Business Development
* International Trade \& Exports
* Market Research \& Business Strategy
* Marketing \& Brand Building
* Entrepreneurship \& Operations



  





 You'll see the entire chain \-
 **from producer and coffee farm to international customer.** 




 And because we're a growing business,
 **good ideas don't stay ideas for long.** 




 If you come up with something that makes sense, you'll likely get the chance to actually build it.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Please email your CV to:
 



 📩
 **trade@mg\-resorts.com** 




 Please include:
 


* College \& degree
* GPA / academic percentage
* Graduation year
* Relevant internships/projects
* A short introduction about yourself and why you’re interested in a Founder’s Office role



  





**Subject: Founder’s Office Associate \- \[Your Name]** 




  





 If you're someone who likes learning fast, figuring things out and being close to the action \- we'd love to hear from you.

title: GTM Operations Manager
description:
**Role Summary** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on Marketing Operations Manager to own the demand generation engine end\-to\-end \- the systems, workflows, campaign execution, and the reporting that tells us what's working. This is an execution\-first role: you will run the marketing automation stack (HubSpot) day\-to\-day, ship campaigns and workflows yourself, and turn funnel data into specific, actionable recommendations. You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, and Inside Sales \- acting as both the builder who gets things live and the advisor who helps these teams do their jobs better through process and data. A strong AI\-first mindset is essential: you should already be using AI/agentic tools to automate operational work and speed up analysis, not just as a stated interest.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 









**Marketing Automation \& MarTech Ownership (HubSpot)** 




 Own HubSpot end\-to\-end: platform administration, licensing/procurement input, integrations (CRM, forms, ad platforms, enrichment tools), and ongoing configuration.
 



 Build and maintain workflows, lead scoring, list segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead routing rules.
 



 Maintain data quality and hygiene across the database (deduplication, enrichment, field standardization, sync integrity with CRM).
 



 Evaluate, procure, and manage adjacent MarTech tools as the stack evolves.
 








**Demand Gen Process \& Campaign Execution** 




 Manage and continuously improve the demand generation process \- from lead capture through MQL/SQL handoff.
 



 Execute multi\-channel campaigns (email, paid, webinar, ABM) in HubSpot, including build, QA, and launch.
 



 Identify friction points in the funnel and drive process fixes in partnership with Field Marketing and Inside Sales.
 








**Analytics \& Reporting** 




 Build and maintain reporting on campaign performance, the demand gen funnel, and channel effectiveness (dashboards, not one\-off decks).
 



 Go beyond reporting: proactively flag where performance is lagging and recommend specific tweaks to accelerate pipeline velocity and outreach effectiveness.
 



 Own attribution reporting and connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
 








**AI\-First Automation** 




 Apply AI/agentic workflows to automate operational tasks (list building, reporting, QA, campaign ops) and to accelerate analysis (anomaly detection, funnel diagnostics, natural\-language reporting).
 



 Continuously look for opportunities to replace manual, repetitive marketing ops work with automated or agent\-driven processes.
 








**Cross\-Functional Partnership** 




 Act as the go\-to executor for PMM, Field Marketing, and Inside Sales on anything requiring HubSpot or campaign operations support.
 



 Advise these teams on marketing operations best practices \- segmentation, nurture design, lead handoff, reporting hygiene \- without owning their strategy.
 








**What We're Looking For** 




 3\-6 years in marketing operations, demand generation operations, or a similar hands\-on execution role.
 



 Deep, current hands\-on HubSpot expertise (admin\-level) \- workflows, lead scoring, reporting, integrations. Certification is a plus.
 



 Strong analytical skills: comfortable in spreadsheets/SQL/BI tools, and able to translate funnel data into a recommendation, not just a chart.
 



 Demonstrated experience using AI tools or agentic workflows to automate marketing operations or analytics work (not just general AI familiarity).
 



 A bias toward shipping \- comfortable owning execution end\-to\-end rather than only planning or strategizing.
 



 Experience working cross\-functionally with sales/inside sales teams and understanding of the demand gen funnel (MQL/SQL/SAL definitions, lead routing, handoff SLAs).
 



 Clear, confident communicator who can advise peer teams on best practice without formal authority over them.
 








**Nice to Have** 




 Experience evaluating or procuring MarTech tools (vendor selection, contracting, rollout).
 



 Exposure to CRM platforms (Salesforce or similar) and lead\-to\-revenue reporting.
 



 Experience in B2B SaaS / enterprise software demand generation.
 








**Success Metrics** 




 Achieve and maintain a minimum 20% MQL\-to\-SQL conversion rate.
 



 Campaign turnaround time of 5 days or less (request to live).
 



 Weekly/bi\-weekly reporting on the marketing funnel and channel performance, with actionable insights.

 📍 Remote — Anywhere in India (IST hours) 💼 Full\-Time 💰 ₹3–5 LPA \+ Performance\-Linked Incentive
 



  





 🏢 ABOUT EXPERTSBIO
 



 ExpertsBIO is a performance marketing agency built exclusively for coaches, consultants, and experts. Since 2017, we've partnered with 100\+ coaching brands and helped drive ₹45–50 crore in client revenue through paid ads, funnels, and high\-converting marketing systems.
 



  





 🔥 THE ROLE
 



 This is a writing role first — about 70% writing, 30% the thinking that makes it land (research, angles, testing, performance analysis).
 



 You'll own the words behind our ads, landing pages, and funnels: understand the audience, find the angle, write the hooks and scripts, watch the numbers, and rewrite based on what the data says.
 



 The goal: stop the scroll, generate qualified leads, lift conversion, cut CPL/CPA, and drive client revenue.
 



  





 🎯 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 


* A strong copywriter above all — ads, hooks, headlines, landing pages, emails, and video scripts
* Experience writing for paid ads (Meta, Instagram, YouTube)
* Able to show real performance data — CPL, conversion rates, ROAS, case studies
* Familiar with coaching, consulting, EdTech, or info\-products
* Sharp on audience psychology — pains, desires, objections, buying triggers
* Comfortable with UGC scripts, VSLs, short\-form video, and nurture sequences
* Uses AI tools well, but knows when human craft matters more
* Fluent written and spoken English
* 1–3 years in performance/digital marketing (strong portfolio can override this)



  





 📊 HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED
 



 CTR, CPL/CPA, lead quality, landing page conversion, ROAS, writing output, winning hooks identified, and client revenue influenced by your copy.
 



 The performance incentive is tied to the ROI your writing generates — when your copy moves the numbers, you share in the upside.
 



  





 💻 REQUIREMENTS
 



 Reliable laptop, stable internet, power backup, IST availability, strong English, and a portfolio with real performance data.
 



  





 🚫 DON'T APPLY IF
 


* You can't show your own writing with real performance data
* You write for engagement, not conversion
* You want to strategize but not write daily — this role writes
* You're uncomfortable being measured on business outcomes



  





 🚀 THE BOTTOM LINE
 



 We're not after pretty sentences. We want a writer who can answer: "What should we say, to whom, why will they care, how do we package it, and how do we know it's working?"
 



 If that's how you think — and you love the writing itself — we want to hear from you.

**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 We are looking for a skilled and passionate Data Visualization Expert to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SQL for data querying, along with strong experience in visualizing complex datasets into intuitive, interactive, and compelling visual representations. The role requires a strong understanding of data trends, patterns, and insights, paired with a creative approach to presenting data for business decision\-making.
   

  

 The AOC is chartered to support automations that drive efficiency and effectiveness through the business, focusing on most impact for our shared interests. We serve the operational needs of GroupM and operating companies through process automation and other technology solutions.
   

  

 You will have daily contact with business stakeholders from WPP Media and operating companies and must be comfortable working with business stakeholders directly. Our primary goal is to drive measurable business outcomes and grow our contribution, and we must earn our right to exist. This is a small, scrappy group. We all‘get our hands in the dirt’ and play multiple roles.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:** 
  

  

* Data Analysis \& Visualization:
+ Design, build, and maintain visually compelling dashboards, reports, and charts using advanced visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, etc.
+ Know how of when and how to design data model for effective Dashboards yielding higher efficiency and lesser loading time
+ Transform raw data into actionable insights by analysing trends and patterns and presenting them through intuitive visualizations.
+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand key metrics and create visual solutions that align with business objectives.


  

  

* SQL Expertise:
+ Use SQL to extract, manipulate, and aggregate data from relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar).
+ Able to write SQL queries to prepare data for visualizations, ensuring the data is clean, accurate, and properly structured for analysis.
+ Optimize SQL queries for performance and efficiency in large datasets.


  

  

* Data Integration \& Transformation:
+ Integrate data from multiple sources, including internal databases, APIs, and external systems, into cohesive visual reporting frameworks.
+ Perform data wrangling, transformation, and cleansing to ensure data quality and consistency.


  

  

* Continuous Improvement:
+ Stay up to date with the latest trends in data visualization, SQL best practices, and data analytics tools.
+ Continuously improve visualizations based on user feedback and emerging business needs.


**What you'll need:**
**Technical Skills:**
* Expertise in SQL for querying and manipulating relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.).
* Strong experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
* Proven Knowledge and Experience with DAX, MDX, etc
* Proficiency in Excel and other data manipulation tools
* Familiarity with ETL processes and data pipelines
* Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics (optional but a plus)


**Problem\-solving** 
 – proven experience dealing with technical blockers.
   

  

**Analytical Skills:**
* Ability to analyse complex data and identify key insights and trends
* Strong attention to detail, ensuring that data visualizations are accurate and insightful
* Understanding of data modelling and normalization principles


**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field
* 7\+ years of experience in Data Visualization, SQL , RDBMS, Large Dataset Modelling, Interactive Dashboards
* Experience working with large datasets and providing insights to drive business decisions –Data Telling a Story


**Mandatory Qualifications/Certifications:**
* Microsoft PL\-300


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure(must))
* Experience with advanced data analytics and machine learning models (a plus)
* Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and technologies
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies


**Who you are:**
**You're open
 *:***
 we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
   

  

**You're optimistic
 *:***
 we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
   

  

**You're extraordinary:** 
 We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
   

  

**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people** 
 – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
   

  

**Scale and opportunity** 
 – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
   

  

**Challenging and stimulating work** 
 – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
   

  

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp\-privacy\-policy\-for\-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

title: Marketing Specialist (B2B SaaS)
description:
**Marketing Specialist (B2B SaaS)** 




**Location: Hyderabad (Onsite)** 




**Experience: 2\-3 Years** 




**Industry: B2B Marketing \| SaaS \| Technology** 




  





**About The Smarketers** 




 The Smarketers is a full\-service B2B marketing agency that helps technology and
 



 industrial businesses accelerate growth through Inbound Marketing, Demand
 



 Generation, Account\-Based Marketing (ABM), RevOps \& MarTech, Website
 



 Development, and AI\-powered marketing solutions.
 



  





 We partner with startups, mid\-market companies, and global enterprises across IT
 



 Services, SaaS, System Integrators, Cybersecurity, Manufacturing, Industrial
 



 Automation, Telecom, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, helping them build a predictable
 



 pipeline, accelerate revenue, and drive measurable business outcomes.
 



  





 At The Smarketers, we believe great marketing combines strategy, creativity, technology,
 



 and data. As AI reshapes the marketing landscape, we're continuously evolving how we
 



 work by combining strong marketing fundamentals with AI, automation, and modern
 



 marketing technologies to deliver better results for our clients.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Marketing Specialist with strong expertise in Inbound Marketing
 



 who can build and scale modern B2B demand generation programs while supporting
 



 strategic Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives.
 



  





 The ideal candidate understands how to attract, engage, nurture, and convert B2B
 



 buyers through content, AEO, GEO, marketing automation, lifecycle marketing, and
 



 data\-driven campaign optimization. While Inbound Marketing and Demand Generation
 



 are the primary focus of this role, you'll also contribute to targeted ABM programs for
 



 strategic accounts.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving problems, working across
 



 multiple client accounts, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and delivering
 



 measurable business impact.
 



 You'll thrive in this role if you're passionate about learning, comfortable working in a
 



 fast\-paced agency environment, confident in leading client conversations, and excited
 



 about using AI and automation to improve quality, efficiency, and results.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Inbound Marketing \& Demand Generation (Primary)
 



 ● Develop and execute inbound marketing strategies that attract, engage, nurture,
 



 and convert qualified B2B buyers.
 



 ● Build and optimize demand generation campaigns across content, AEO, GEO,
 



 email marketing, landing pages, webinars, social media, and organic channels.
 



 ● Create and execute lead nurturing programs, lifecycle marketing campaigns, and
 



 marketing automation workflows.
 



 ● Develop content strategies including blogs, case studies, whitepapers, eBooks,
 



 landing pages, webinars, sales enablement assets, and thought leadership
 



 content.
 



 ● Improve website conversion rates through content optimization, user journey
 



 improvements, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
 



 ● Partner with Sales and RevOps to improve lead quality, MQL\-to\-SQL conversion,
 



 pipeline generation, and revenue contribution.
 



 ● Support SEO\-driven content initiatives and improve visibility across modern
 



 search experiences, AI\-assisted discovery, and relevant industry communities.
 



  





 Account\-Based Marketing
 



 ● Support the planning and execution of targeted ABM campaigns for strategic
 



 accounts.
 



 ● Define Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP), account segmentation, account
 



 prioritization, and personalized engagement strategies.
 



 ● Collaborate with Sales to align account\-based campaigns with revenue goals.
 



 ● Measure account engagement and optimize campaigns based on performance
 



 insights.
 



  





 Marketing Automation \& AI
 



 ● Build and optimize lead nurturing, lead scoring, segmentation, lifecycle
 



 automation, and campaign workflows using HubSpot or similar platforms.
 



 ● Leverage AI and automation to improve research, campaign planning, content
 



 creation, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.
 



 ● Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and build scalable marketing
 



 processes while maintaining quality and accuracy.
 



  





 Analytics \& Optimization
 



 ● Track and optimize key metrics including website traffic, lead generation, MQLs,
 



 SQLs, conversion rates, pipeline influence, campaign performance, account
 



 engagement, and revenue contribution.
 



 ● Build actionable dashboards and provide insights using HubSpot, Looker Studio,
 



 Airtable, DashThis, or similar reporting tools.
 



 ● Continuously improve campaigns through experimentation, A/B testing, analytics,
 



 and business insights.
 



  





 Client \& Project Management
 



 ● Manage multiple global B2B client accounts in a fast\-paced agency environment.
 



 ● Lead client discussions, present recommendations, and build trusted
 



 relationships with stakeholders.
 



 ● Collaborate closely with Sales, RevOps, Content, AEO, GEO, Paid Media,
 



 Design, Development, and Leadership teams to deliver integrated marketing
 



 programs.
 



 ● Drive projects with ownership, accountability, quality, and timely execution.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 We're looking for someone who combines strong marketing expertise with curiosity,
 



 technology, and ownership.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have:
 



 ● 2–3 years of experience in B2B Inbound Marketing and Demand
 



 Generation.
 



 ● Proven expertise in content marketing, AEO, GEO, lead nurturing, lifecycle
 



 marketing, conversion optimization, and marketing automation.
 



 ● Experience planning and executing multi\-channel inbound marketing campaigns
 



 that generate measurable pipeline growth.
 



 ● Experience supporting or executing Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns
 



 is highly preferred.
 



 ● Experience working with SaaS, Technology, IT Services, Cybersecurity,
 



 Healthcare, Manufacturing, Telecom, or other B2B industries.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and marketing automation
 



 platforms.
 



 ● Familiarity with LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, email marketing, analytics, and
 



 performance marketing.
 



 ● Strong understanding of the modern B2B buyer journey and revenue\-focused
 



 marketing strategies.
 



 ● Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, client management, and
 



 stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic agency
 



 environment.
 



  





 AI \& Automation Mindset
 



 We're not looking for marketers who simply use AI tools—we're looking for marketers
 



 who know how to combine deep marketing expertise with AI to produce better outcomes.
 



 You'll stand out if you:
 



 ● Use AI to improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of your work.
 



 ● Build automations that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
 



 ● Apply critical thinking and marketing expertise to validate AI\-generated outputs.
 



 ● Continuously explore new AI tools, workflows, and marketing technologies.
 



 ● Stay updated with evolving industry trends and best practices.
 



 ● Proactively identify better ways of working and contribute to improving internal
 



 processes.
 



  





 Why Join The Smarketers?
 



 ● Work with leading global B2B technology companies across diverse industries.
 



 ● Lead impactful Inbound Marketing and Demand Generation programs that
 



 directly influence business growth.
 



 ● Contribute to strategic Account\-Based Marketing initiatives for enterprise clients.
 



 ● Be part of a collaborative, high\-performance agency where ownership,
 



 innovation, and continuous learning are valued.
 



 ● Work alongside specialists across strategy, RevOps, Content, SEO, Paid Media,
 



 Design, Development, and Marketing Technology.
 



 ● Get the opportunity to experiment with AI, automation, and modern marketing
 



 technologies to shape the future of B2B marketing.
 



 ● Accelerate your professional growth through challenging work, meaningful client
 



 exposure, and continuous upskilling.
 



  





 Our Ideal Team Member
 



 We value people who:
 



 ● Think strategically and execute with excellence.
 



 ● Take ownership and lead with accountability.
 



 ● Communicate confidently with clients and internal teams.
 



 ● Have a strong Inbound Marketing mindset with a passion for generating
 



 measurable business outcomes.
 



 ● Understand how ABM complements inbound strategies to accelerate enterprise
 



 growth.
 



 ● Embrace AI and automation without compromising marketing fundamentals.
 



 ● Continuously learn, share knowledge, and adapt to change.
 



 ● Thrive in a collaborative, fast\-paced agency environment.
 



 ● Are passionate about creating win\-win outcomes for clients, teammates, and The
 



 Smarketers.

title: Specialist Deputy Manager - Brand, Marketing & Communication- Campaign Marketing A&A - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Deputy Manager, Marketing**
 We are seeking a Deputy Manager to manage end\-to\-end marketing campaigns and activations in collaboration with U.S.\-based Strategic Marketers, including national and portfolio marketing leaders, and work closely with business or practice leaders. This role drives strategic alignment, manages content, and optimizes performance using data insights. It includes budget ownership, stakeholder management, and leadership of cross\-functional teams, with a strong focus on influencing campaign strategy and contributing to business outcomes.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Deputy Manager, you will help manage campaign planning by developing content strategies aligned with audience needs and business priorities. You will collaborate with Client Account Teams and Research \& Insights to help shape targeting strategies using behavioral and market data, determining brand messaging consistency across channels, and present strategic recommendations to leadership. You will also manage campaign budgets, create financial forecasts, and demonstrate ROI while coordinating activations to maintain strategic alignment and operational excellence.
   

  

 In execution, you will oversee integrated marketing campaigns across paid advertising, SEO/SEM, social media, and events. This includes managing agency relationships, optimizing media mix, and driving video, audio, and email initiatives through refined segmentation and engagement strategies. You will help manage demand generation efforts, optimize performance using data insights, and manage event strategies for key business units.
   

  

 To measure impact, you will conduct advanced campaign analysis, connect insights to business objectives, and optimize workflows, manage scoring models, and funnel performance. You will also enhance digital experiences by improving conversion paths and recommending user\-driven optimizations, while maintaining dashboards and instrumentation for performance tracking tied to business outcomes.
   

  

**Required Skills And Competencies**
* Quality \& Standards Management — Establishing review processes and maintaining quality standards for complex outputs.
* Technology \& Data\-Driven Innovation — Evaluating emerging technologies, implementing tools to enhance campaign effectiveness, and leveraging insights for strategic decisions.
+ Leverage tools such as Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Power Automate, and other firm\-approved technologies.

* Financial \& Project Management — Managing complex budgets, developing financial models, and helping drive end\-to\-end project execution using data insights.
* Strategic Planning \& Integrated Campaigns — Connecting marketing goals to business outcomes, managing multiple campaigns, and ensuring cross\-functional integration.
+ Own end\-to\-end delivery of leadership reporting, dashboards, KPIs, and operational insights across assigned portfolios.

* Content \& Brand Leadership — Help develop content strategies, manage high\-profile deliverables, and determine brand messaging consistency across campaigns.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Collaboration — Managing stakeholder meetings, managing escalations, and fostering collaboration across teams.
* Problem Solving \& Continuous Improvement — Addressing complex challenges, managing crises, and helping drive process improvements.
* Experience Required in Integrated Marketing Leadership \& Channel Optimization Including:
+ Experience analyzing funnel performance, optimizing campaign workflows, and recommending improvements based on data insights.
+ Ability to curate and repurpose content for new audiences, amplify key messages, and identify content gaps.
+ Demonstrated success evaluating return on investment.
+ Demonstrated ability to qualify leads, track engagement, and support audience segmentation for demand generation efforts.
+ Hands\-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, overseeing agency relationships, and recommending media mix enhancements.
+ Experience leading strategic performance analysis.
+ Ability to lead targeted email campaigns, optimize personalization strategies, and manage stakeholder communications.
+ Experience optimizing SEO/SEM bidding and targeting strategies and managing vendor relationships for performance improvement.
+ Demonstrated success in driving digital experience strategy, optimizing user journeys, and recommending enhancements based on behavioral data.


**The team**
 Our Brand, Marketing and Communications team culture is collaborative and encourages team members to take the initiative and seek on\-the\-job learning opportunities. Our client experience management professionals work with a strong camaraderie toward collective success, and creative brainstorming to deliver value and commitment to excellence. We embody strategic and innovative thinking, new ways of working and constantly strive to deliver personalized digital experiences.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 Deloitte offers a hybrid working environment designed to support flexibility and business requirements. The following schedule applies to this role:
   

  

* In the office: Tuesday and Wednesday are designated work\-from\-office days.
* Work schedule: You can choose to work in a staggered schedule (11:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. and 7:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.) OR 2:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. It's a business expectation that you will be available until 11:00 p.m.


 Please note: Shift timings and work arrangements may be adjusted temporarily based on business needs.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 7–9 years of relevant experience in B2B / Professional Services marketing, with a strong understanding of integrated marketing and communication strategies.
* MBA (preferred) or any Master’s degree.


 \#BM\&C\_G\&P
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills.
