title: Software Eng - Content Management Systems
description:
Marcom is the creatively\-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world\-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.  

Marcom's Interactive Engineering team works on many high\-impact projects that serve various Apple lines of business. We use the latest in open source technologies and continue to evolve and deliver solutions on a worldwide scale. Working with a variety of multi\-functional teams, the Interactive Engineering group brings it all together to deliver the interactive experiences with an excellent group of software engineers while having fun along the way. This team is exciting and fast\-paced; it’s a great place for people with exacting standards who want their work to matter.  

We are looking for a Software Engineer with 3\+ years of experience to design, develop, and enhance modern, distributed, scalable, and high\-performance Content Management Systems (CMS) using Java, open\-source technologies, and modern software engineering practices. This role is critical to the evolution of Apple’s brand as you will be working with the teams taking apple.com to the next phase of its evolution. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building modern CMS platforms, solving complex content management problems at scale, and leveraging AI\-assisted engineering and agentic workflows to improve both CMS capabilities and software development productivity.  

  

**Description**  

This role provides an opportunity to build modern, distributed, and large\-scale Content Management Systems that power apple.com and enable content to be created, managed, governed, and delivered across multiple digital experiences.  

You will work across Java backend services, CMS platforms, content architecture, content modeling, workflows, APIs, integrations, search, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and AI\-powered engineering workflows.  

The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex CMS problems at scale and is excited about the evolution of CMS platforms through headless architectures, open\-source technologies, automation, and AI agents.  

The primary focus of this role is CMS engineering.","responsibilities":"Design, develop, customize, and extend the distributed, large\-scale CMS platforms that power apple.com and other Apple digital experiences, supporting high volumes of content.  

Build and enhance capabilities across the content lifecycle, including content creation, modeling, relationships, metadata, taxonomy, workflows, approvals, versioning, localization, publishing, and delivery.  

Work hands\-on with Java\-based open\-source CMS platforms and frameworks and extend their capabilities to meet evolving product and business requirements.  

Design and develop headless and API\-first CMS solutions enabling content delivery across web, mobile, and other digital channels.  

Develop and integrate REST and GraphQL APIs for content authoring, management, preview, search, and delivery using Java and Spring Boot.  

Build integrations between CMS platforms and search, digital asset management, identity, analytics, CDN, and other enterprise systems.  

Design solutions for scalability, high availability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and efficient content delivery in distributed environments.  

Implement caching, indexing, asynchronous processing, and event\-driven mechanisms for large\-scale CMS workloads.  

Work with databases and data models supporting large content repositories and efficient content retrieval.  

Develop and maintain supporting backend services and microservices in Java, using Spring Boot and related frameworks, based on the CMS architecture.  

Deploy and operate CMS services using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.  

Troubleshoot and resolve CMS, performance, scalability, integration, and production issues, including JVM\-level performance and memory tuning.  

Develop unit, integration, and API tests using JUnit and related Java testing frameworks, and contribute to CI/CD and engineering automation.  

Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of the CMS platform.  

Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.  

Explore and build AI\-powered capabilities and agentic workflows for CMS use cases, where appropriate.  

Collaborate with product managers, architects, frontend engineers, DevOps teams, and content stakeholders.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

Hands\-on experience with Java\-based CMS or content platforms and their extension APIs.  

Experience with DAM or PIM solutions and integrations supporting content\-as\-a\-service at scale.  

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms for deploying JVM services.  

Experience with caching and search technologies such as Redis, Memcached, Elasticsearch, or Solr.  

Experience with event\-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.  

Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React / Vue / Angular) for CMS authoring interfaces.  

Hands\-on experience using AI/ML tools and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, testing, and operational excellence.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

3\+ years of professional software development experience building scalable, highly available backend and web applications in Java.  

Hands\-on experience with Java (Java 11 or later) and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem, including dependency injection, Spring MVC, and Spring Data.  

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with a focus on fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design.  

Experience designing and developing RESTful and/or GraphQL web services in Java.  

Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling for content\-heavy applications.  

Experience with Java build and CI/CD tooling such as Maven or Gradle, Git, and Jenkins.  

Experience writing unit and integration tests with JUnit, Mockito, or similar frameworks.

title: Engineering Manager - Quality
description:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**


For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.


Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.


Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.


Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.

 **What you'll be doing**


Own the Quality Governance capability, defining enterprise quality standards, managing release quality gates, and tracking defect metrics to continuously improve delivery quality across engineering teams.

* Define and own enterprise quality standards and QA methodologies across engineering teams, ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Manage release quality gates, governing entry and exit criteria so releases meet defined quality and business requirements before go\-live.
* Track and analyze defect metrics and quality analytics using tools such as TestRail to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
* Own release management from a quality perspective, ensuring quality sign\-off and release readiness across releases.
* Own UAT readiness, quality sign\-off, and post\-release defect triage for major launches, ensuring business and technical stakeholders have clear entry and exit criteria.
* Lead and develop the QA team, set technical direction, mentoring engineers, and building QA capability.
* Report quality posture, release risk, and defect trends to engineering leadership through concise dashboards and agreed improvement actions.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to embed quality practices early in the SDLC and report on quality posture to leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement of QA processes, incorporating AI\-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to prioritize testing effort.
* Plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end\-to\-end, and regression testing for assigned scope.

**What you’ll need to succeed**


* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in quality engineering and QA, including defining quality standards and managing release quality gates.
* Strong command of QA standards, QA methodologies, release management, and defect analytics, with hands\-on experience using tools such as TestRail.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and driving continuous improvement in delivery quality.
* Understanding quality metrics and reporting to support data\-driven quality decisions.
* Experience supporting quality governance in ecommerce or retail technology environments with complex integrations, releases, and business cutovers
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to enhance testing effectiveness.
* Experience with organizing testing for multiple integrated systems

**What we can offer you**


With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.


We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.


**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**


To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**


It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.


We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 We are looking for a
 **Channel Manager – Middle East \& Africa (MEA)** 
 to build, activate and grow Freshworks’ partner ecosystem across the region.
   

  





 This role is responsible for creating
 **incremental business through the partner ecosystem** 
 — identifying the right partners, enabling them to sell and deliver Freshworks solutions, building joint go\-to\-market motions, generating qualified pipeline and ensuring strong execution across the partner lifecycle.
   

  





 The role requires a strong balance of
 **commercial ownership, partner management, sales alignment and operational discipline** 
 .
   

  





 The Channel Manager will work closely with Sales, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Marketing, Alliances and other cross\-functional teams to make partners a meaningful growth channel for Freshworks.
   

  





**. Partner Strategy \& Business Development**



* Develop and execute the partner strategy for assigned markets and segments across MEA.
* Identify and recruit partners that can provide meaningful customer access, technical capability, industry expertise or geographic coverage.
* Evaluate partners based on their ability to generate pipeline, influence customers, implement solutions and build a sustainable Freshworks practice.
* Develop joint business plans with priority partners, including revenue objectives, target accounts, GTM activities and capability\-building priorities.
* Build relationships with senior stakeholders within the partner organization and establish clear mutual accountability.



**2\. Partner Activation \& Readiness**



* Own the activation of newly recruited partners and move them from onboarding to productive engagement.
* Drive partner readiness across product knowledge, sales capability, solution positioning, certifications and implementation capability.
* Identify capability gaps and create focused enablement plans rather than relying on generic training.
* Establish measurable activation milestones and monitor progress against them.
* Ensure partners have the tools, knowledge and internal champions required to independently position and sell Freshworks.



**3\. Pipeline Generation \& Revenue Growth**



* Own partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline generation for the assigned territory.
* Build joint campaigns, account\-mapping exercises, workshops, roundtables and other pipeline\-generation initiatives with priority partners.
* Identify opportunities where partner access or capability can create incremental Freshworks revenue.
* Work with Sales teams to convert partner\-generated pipeline into qualified opportunities and closed business.
* Track partner contribution across the funnel — from recruitment and activation through pipeline, conversion and revenue.
* Identify gaps early and build corrective action plans with partners and internal stakeholders.



**4\. Joint GTM \& Field Alignment**



* Build strong relationships with Freshworks Account Executives and Sales leadership to align partner activity with territory priorities.
* Facilitate joint account planning between Freshworks and partners.
* Bring partners into relevant enterprise opportunities where they add customer access, technical expertise, implementation capability or commercial leverage.
* Ensure the right level of partner involvement based on the opportunity rather than involving partners purely for attribution.
* Support strategic partner\-led and partner\-assisted opportunities through the sales cycle.



**5\. Partner Governance \& Performance Management**



* Establish regular operating cadences with priority partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews and action tracking.
* Maintain visibility into partner performance, pipeline quality, conversion, activity and readiness.
* Hold partners accountable to agreed commitments and follow through on action items.
* Identify underperforming or inactive partners and develop clear activation, remediation or rationalization plans.
* Maintain accurate partner and opportunity information across Freshworks systems and reporting mechanisms.



**6\. Opportunity \& Deal Support**



* Support partner registration, opportunity alignment, attribution and commercial processes in accordance with Freshworks policies.
* Ensure partner involvement and contribution are clearly documented.
* Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Legal, Operations and other teams where partner\-related issues affect deal execution.
* Escalate partner\-related blockers appropriately and drive them to resolution.
* Protect a consistent customer experience while ensuring the partner receives the appropriate support.



**7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration**




 Work closely with:
   

  




* **Sales / Account Executives:** 
 account planning, opportunity creation and conversion
* **Solution Consulting:** 
 technical readiness, demos and solution positioning
* **Customer Success:** 
 expansion, adoption and partner\-supported customer outcomes
* **Marketing:** 
 campaigns, events, demand generation and partner marketing
* **Partner Enablement:** 
 certifications and capability development
* **Operations / Finance:** 
 commercial processes, attribution and operational execution
* **Leadership:** 
 partner strategy, performance reviews and regional priorities



**Role Boundaries**




 The Channel Manager is accountable for
 **partner growth, activation, engagement and partner\-led pipeline to ensure larger market share.**




**Success Measures**




 Success in this role will be measured through a combination of
 **partner productivity, pipeline creation, revenue contribution and ecosystem health** 
 , including:
   

  




* Partner addition and activation
* Partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline
* Partner\-attributed revenue / ARR
* Partner pipeline conversion
* Revenue/Quality of activated partners
* Partner readiness and certification
* Joint account\-planning coverage
* Partner\-led GTM activity and resulting pipeline
* Strategic partner engagement and business\-plan execution
* Partner productivity and contribution to regional growth
* Accuracy of partner attribution and opportunity governance



 The focus is on
 **productive partners and measurable business outcomes** 
 , not simply the number of partners recruited.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in channel sales, alliances, partner management, indirect sales or B2B technology sales.
* Experience working with partners such as SIs, MSPs, VARs, distributors, cloud partners or technology specialists.
* Experience managing enterprise technology sales cycles and partner\-led opportunities.
* Experience working across multiple countries or markets is strongly preferred.
* Experience in SaaS, ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, cybersecurity, cloud or adjacent enterprise technology categories is an advantage.



**Skills**



* Strong commercial and business\-development mindset.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with both partners and internal sales teams.
* Strong understanding of indirect sales and partner economics.
* Ability to identify where a partner can create genuine incremental value.
* Strong pipeline\-management and forecasting discipline.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving, matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to manage partner performance.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait** 
 .
   

  





 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  





 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  

 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Brand Franchise Manager to ensure successful brand growth for
 **Venusia and the launch of innovative, first time in India market\-driven products** 
 in the category for gathering market insights from Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), developing and executing new product launch plans, conducting effective sales force training, and implementing market research strategies for brand performance enhancement. Collaborating with the SCM team for product availability and maintaining strong relationships with KOLs.
   

  

  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
  

 • You will be responsible for generating new product ideas from Key Opinion Leaders (KOL) interactions, prioritizing these ideas, preparing business cases, analyzing market and competitor data, and handling creative aspects like branding. The aim is to ensure the timely launch of products that address unmet market needs.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for marketing planning by preparing product launch materials, coordinating launch meetings, training the sales force, and tracking initial product performance for the first 12 months to ensure effective product marketing.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for brand performance review by gathering market insights, identifying key issues, and implementing action plans to maintain optimal brand performance, including conducting market research for brand positioning correction.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for interacting with Key Opinion Leader (KOLs), conducting fieldwork to gather insights, updating KOLs on product value, and collating product evidence and clinical reports to build strong relationships and drive growth.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for Supply Chain Management (SCM) by tracking product quantities and supply, sharing new product plan quantities with the SCM team, and promptly addressing product shortages or excess to ensure product availability in the market.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for meeting with Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) to collect feedback, gather campaign feedback, and develop region\-specific strategies to incorporate regional needs into the product plan and improve performance.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification\-** 
 Science/Pharma/Medical Graduate preferably with MBA in Marketing
   

  

  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 
 3\-6 years of experience in Sales \& Marketing

 Technical Skills:**
  

 • Understanding of Pharmaceutical industry; ability to interpret market data; gain marketing insights from various resources
   

  

 • Basic understanding of anatomy and physiology.
   

  

 • Ability to analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs within the generics market.
   

  

 • Strong problem\-solving skills to address regulatory challenges, market access issues, and product\-related obstacles.
   

  

**Behavioral Skills:**
  

 • Strong collaborator and excellent communication.
   

  

 • Good at building and leveraging relationship.
   

  

 • Adaptability and change management skills.
   

  

 • Creative and good Analytical thinker.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**About the Department
   

  

 Global Generics India**
  

 Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.

They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
   

  

  

  

**Our Work Culture**
  

 Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. **Role Description:** 




  





 The Lead – Brand \& Digital Communication is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Hyderabad Area. This role is responsible for developing and executing brand strategy, shaping brand positioning, and ensuring consistent communication across digital and offline channels. The position involves planning and managing digital campaigns, overseeing content creation for social media, website, and marketing collaterals, and maintaining brand guidelines. The Lead will collaborate with sales and business teams to support growth initiatives, create communication assets that drive lead generation and customer engagement, and monitor brand performance metrics. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include coordinating with internal stakeholders and external agencies, analyzing campaign results, refining communication strategies, and ensuring the brand reflects Anytime Diesel’s values of reliability, innovation, and sustainability.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Social Media \& Digital Presence** 




 Own Anytime Diesel's social media strategy and day\-to\-day presence across relevant platforms.
 



 Develop and maintain a structured social media and content calendar.
 



 Create high\-quality content around company milestones, products, customers, technology, people, achievements and industry developments.
 



 Build Anytime Diesel's LinkedIn presence as a strong corporate and leadership communication channel.
 



 Develop content for the Founder/CEO's personal LinkedIn presence in alignment with the company's communication strategy.
 



 Identify opportunities to increase reach, engagement, brand awareness and industry visibility.
 



 Monitor comments, conversations, mentions and relevant industry discussions.
 



 Maintain consistency in brand tone, messaging and visual communication.
 



  





**2\. Brand Communications** 




 Develop and maintain a clear and consistent Anytime Diesel brand narrative.
 



 Convert business achievements and operational milestones into compelling external stories.
 



 Communicate Anytime Diesel's technology, innovation, market presence and business differentiation effectively.
 



 Develop communication themes around fuel delivery, energy logistics, technology, IoT, fleet management, customer experience and industry transformation.
 



 Ensure that all external communication reflects the company's positioning, values and strategic direction.
 



 Build a library of reusable corporate stories, case studies, customer stories, leadership narratives and company milestones.
 



  





**3\. Founder / CEO Communications** 




 Work directly with the Founder/CEO on communication strategy and messaging.
 



 Convert the Founder/CEO's thoughts, ideas and business updates into polished communication.
 



 Prepare LinkedIn posts, speeches, articles, interviews, announcements and other leadership content.
 



 Support the Founder/CEO in developing a consistent public voice and thought\-leadership positioning.
 



 Maintain a forward\-looking content calendar aligned with business priorities and upcoming announcements.
 



 Coordinate approvals and ensure sensitive communication is released only after appropriate authorization.
 



  





**4\. Public Relations \& Media** 




 Build and maintain relationships with journalists, publications, industry media and relevant communication networks.
 



 Identify opportunities for Anytime Diesel to participate in relevant media stories, interviews, podcasts, panels and industry conversations.
 



 Prepare press releases, media briefs, company announcements and media communication.
 



 Coordinate with external PR agencies, media partners and event organizers where required.
 



 Manage inbound media requests and coordinate internal responses.
 



 Track media coverage and maintain a record of Anytime Diesel's media presence.
 



 Identify opportunities to position Anytime Diesel's leadership and expertise in relevant industry conversations.
 



  





**5\. Content \& Storytelling** 




 Transform raw business information into strong, easy\-to\-understand stories.
 



 Develop customer success stories, case studies, product stories and business narratives.
 



 Create content around company milestones, partnerships, technology launches and achievements.
 



 Develop articles, newsletters, blogs, social posts, presentations and corporate communication material as required.
 



 Work with internal teams to source relevant information, photographs, data, customer stories and operational insights.
 



 Maintain a structured content repository for future use.
 



  





**6\. Industry \& Competitive Intelligence** 




 Track developments in fuel delivery, logistics, energy, mobility, technology and related sectors.
 



 Monitor competitor communication, positioning, campaigns and public announcements.
 



 Identify emerging communication opportunities and industry conversations relevant to Anytime Diesel.
 



 Track how customers, competitors and the broader industry perceive the company.
 



 Provide periodic insights to the Founder/CEO on brand and communication trends.
 



  





**7\. Internal Coordination** 




 Work closely with Sales, Operations, Technology, Product, Finance and HR to identify stories and communication opportunities.
 



 Establish a process for collecting business milestones and achievements from different departments.
 



 Ensure factual accuracy of all external communication.
 



 Coordinate photography, videography, design and creative requirements with internal or external resources.
 



 Maintain an organized communication calendar covering upcoming launches, events, announcements and campaigns.
 



  





**8\. Brand Governance \& Confidentiality** 




 Maintain strict confidentiality regarding business plans, financial information, customer information, technology, partnerships, strategic initiatives and pre\-announcement developments.
 



 Clearly distinguish between information that is approved for external communication and information that remains confidential.
 



 Ensure no sensitive information is published without appropriate approval.
 



 Maintain consistency in brand language, messaging and corporate identity across communication channels.
 



 Exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive or potentially reputationally significant communication.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




  




* Strong skills in Brand Strategy and Brand Management to define positioning, messaging, and long\-term brand direction.
* Proficiency in Communication and Branding to create clear, consistent, and compelling narratives across channels.
* Experience collaborating with Sales teams to align brand and communication efforts with revenue and market growth objectives.
* Proven experience in digital marketing, campaign management, and content development for B2B or tech\-enabled services.
* Ability to analyze brand and communication performance metrics and apply insights to optimize strategies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, additional language proficiency is an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional projects, manage agencies, and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; experience in energy, logistics, or SaaS sectors is a plus.

 The Regional Manager is responsible for leading a team of sales professionals focused on achieving business objectives across the Coronary Vascular portfolio. * Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales professionals to achieve regional revenue, market share, and business objectives.
* Execute regional sales strategies aligned with annual operating plan targets and commercial priorities.
* Build and maintain relationships with key healthcare stakeholders, including hospital leadership, interventional cardiologists, and cath lab teams.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**
* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 7\+ years experience

**Preferred:**

* Clinical experience within an interventional suite, hospital environment, emergency medical response setting, or comparable clinical setting.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. title: Head – Brand Marketing
description:
**Company Description**  

AbhiBus is a leading online bus\-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators \- including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3\.5 lakh (350,000\+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.


AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI\-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms \- ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a Head – Brand Marketing to lead and redefine how India books and experiences bus travel through AbhiBus. In this role, you will blend data\-driven performance with emotive storytelling to scale the AbhiBus brand, strengthen market leadership in the online bus ticketing space, and own the end\-to\-end marketing journey for the modern bus traveler. You will be the brand custodian for AbhiBus—ensuring it is not just a transactional booking platform but a trusted companion for every bus journey across India.  



**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**1\. Brand Stewardship \& Narrative**  

* Architect AbhiBus’s brand positioning, visual identity, and voice to resonate across


diverse traveler segments and regional markets.  

* Ensure AbhiBus is perceived not as a commoditized booking tool, but as a premium,


reliable, and traveler\-first brand throughout the booking and travel journey.  

  

**2\. Integrated Multi\-Channel Growth**  

* Orchestrate high\-impact, 360\-degree marketing campaigns spanning Performance,


Social, PR, and Influencer channels tailored to the bus travel audience.  

* Move beyond transactional marketing to build a cohesive brand ecosystem that drives


top\-of\-funnel awareness and converts high\-intent travelers into confirmed bus bookings.  

  

**3\. Data\-Driven Performance \& LTV Optimisation**  

* Own the marketing tech stack and analytical framework to measure real\-time ROI across


all brand and performance channels.  

* Optimise the balance between Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Customer Lifetime


Value (CLV), leveraging first\-party data and CRM tools to predict travel patterns and  

drive repeat bookings in a highly competitive, low\-loyalty category.**4\. GTM \& Product Innovation Strategy**  

* Partner with Product and Engineering to lead Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategies for new


features such as booking technology enhancements, fintech integrations, ancillary  

services, and route\-level innovations.  

* Translate technical product updates into compelling consumer benefits that improve the


user experience and drive app adoption for AbhiBus.**5\. Strategic Partnerships \& Ecosystem Growth**  

* Identify and negotiate high\-leverage partnerships with bus operators, state transport


corporations, payment platforms, travel aggregators, and regional influencers.  

* Build alliances that act as force multipliers for the AbhiBus brand—expanding reach into


new demographics, routes, and markets, and creating exclusive value for our customers.  

  

**6\. Competitive Intelligence \& Trend Forecasting**  

* Serve as the internal expert on the online bus ticketing and broader surface\-transport


landscape, including competitive OTA platforms and emerging mobility players.  

* Synthesise market research and competitor moves to proactively pivot


strategies—anticipating trends such as tier\-2/3 city demand, sustainable bus travel,  

route\-specific dynamic pricing, and AI\-driven trip planning.  

  

**7\. Commercial Leadership \& P\&L Accountability**  

* Lead, mentor, and scale a high\-performing brand marketing team for the Bus business


unit.  

* Maintain P\&L accountability, aligning the marketing budget with AbhiBus’s broader


commercial goals and ensuring every rupee spent is an investment in scalable,  

sustainable growth. **Qualifications*** 10\+ years of marketing experience with 4\+ years in a senior leadership role (Senior


Manager / Head level) within high\-growth B2C travel, consumer tech, or e\-commerce  

companies.  

* Proven track record in FMCG, D2C, travel, hospitality, OTAs, or online marketplaces,


with deep understanding of seasonal demand cycles and regional market dynamics in  

India.  

* Expert\-level command of CAC/LTV modelling, multi\-touch attribution, and modern


MarTech stacks (CDPs, CRMs, GA4, and equivalent tools).  

* Demonstrated ability to marry high\-velocity performance marketing with emotive,


world\-class brand storytelling.  

* Experience recruiting, mentoring, and leading high\-performance, cross\-functional


marketing teams.  

* Strong P\&L management skills with the ability to align marketing output with broader


commercial and leadership\-level goals.  

* Understanding of the Indian bus travel market, regional language nuances, and tier\-2/3


city consumer behaviour is a strong plus. **Additional Information** **Nice\-to\-Have**  

* Experience working in or with online travel aggregators (OTAs) focused on bus or


surface transport.  

* Familiarity with vernacular and regional marketing strategies for Indian audiences.
* Prior exposure to fintech\-integrated or super\-app ecosystems within travel.


  

**Why AbhiBus?**  

* Lead the brand for one of India’s leading online bus ticketing platforms with a massive,


growing user base.  

* Shape how millions of Indians discover, book, and experience bus travel.
* Work at the intersection of technology, data, and consumer storytelling in one of the


country’s most exciting travel categories.  

* Be part of a high\-growth organisation with the ambition to redefine surface transport in


India.

title: Manager Data Engineering
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Manager, Data Engineering – Hyderabad**  

  

**About Warner Bros. Discovery:**

  

Warner Bros. Discovery is a leading global media and entertainment company with one of the world’s most distinctive and comprehensive portfolios of content, brands, and franchises across television, film, streaming, and gaming. The company brings together WarnerMedia’s premium entertainment, sports, and news assets with Discovery’s leading non\-fiction, international entertainment, and sports businesses.

  

For more information, please visit www.wbd.com.

 **Meet Our Team**  

  

The Data \& Audience Platform organization develops and maintains the frameworks, tools, and data products that power WBD’s flagship streaming service, Max, as well as non\-streaming businesses across Films, Sports, News, and the broader WBD ecosystem. Our mission is to enable unified analytics and data\-driven use cases through a robust multi\-tenant platform and semantic layer. We deliver innovative solutions that help teams across the company drive subscriber growth, deepen engagement, and make timely, informed decisions in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

We are seeking a highly motivated Manager, Data Engineering, to help build a state\-of\-the\-art data platform that supports data\-driven use cases across the organization. The platform will host multiple data products, including Subscription, Content, and Product Analytics; Personalization and Recommendations; and Marketing and Ad Sales enablement. In this role, you will manage a team and design and deliver scalable, cloud\-native solutions that address current and future big data initiatives.

  

Role Accountabilities:  

**Technical Leadership \& Strategy**  

Define and drive the technical vision for data platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and scalability requirements.  

Lead architectural decisions to continue enhancing our state\-of\-the\-art data platform

 **Hands\-on Technical Leadership**


Provide technical leadership through active participation in architecture design and code reviews.


Guide teams in troubleshooting complex technical issues while driving code quality, reliability, and engineering best practices.

 **Team Management \& Development**  

Manage and mentor team of engineers to foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.  

Oversee resource planning, performance reviews, and career development for team members.

 **Delivery \& Execution Oversight**  

Ensure timely and high\-quality delivery of engineering projects by establishing best practices, KPIs, and governance processes.  

Collaborate with program management to prioritize initiatives and manage dependencies.

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**  

Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and Data Science teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.  

Represent data in stakeholder discussions and communicate progress effectively.

 **Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**  

Evaluate emerging technologies and tools to enhance platform capabilities and operational efficiency.  

Champion automation, observability, and security best practices across the engineering organization.

 **What To Bring**

* Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or similar discipline
* 10\+ years of experience in data engineering and/or software engineering with at least 3\-5 years in a leadership or managerial role overseeing engineering teams and large\-scale projects.
* + Strong understanding of modern data architecture, cloud\-native platforms (**AWS/GCP/Azure**), and distributed systems. Ability to guide technical decisions.
* Ability to design, build and manage data engineering **and AI/ML engineering** pipelines at **scale** (both streaming and batch)
* Proficient in programming languages like **Python, Java or Scala and SQL**.
* Proficient in working with streaming data platforms (Kafka, Kinesis) and **distributed** data frameworks (Spark, Flink).
* Proficient in working with cloud data warehouses like Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery.
* Proven track record of managing and mentoring engineering teams, driving performance, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
* Experience in defining technical roadmaps, aligning engineering initiatives with business objectives, and managing cross\-functional dependencies.
* Ability to partner effectively with Product, Engineering, Analytics and Data Science teams, influencing stakeholders and communicating technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technologies, champion automation, and implement best practices for scalability, security, and observability.

 **What We Offer:**

* A Great Place to work
* Equal opportunity employer
* Fast track growth opportunities

**How We Get Things Done…**


This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

**Championing Inclusion at WBD**


Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

**Location:** Hyderabad

* Deep expertise in end\-to\-end production (pre\-production, on\-set logistics, post\-production workflows, and vendor contracting).

* Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills with the ability to advise senior leaders on marketing and communication strategies.
* Experience with Agile methodology and Workfront.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. **Job Title: Architect Sales Representative \- Landscape Design Focus**

**Company Overview:**  
We are a leading provider of premium landscaping products, specializing in high\-quality granite materials for outdoor spaces. With a commitment to excellence in design and durability, we strive to elevate outdoor environments and inspire creativity in landscape architecture. As we continue to expand our market presence, we are seeking a skilled Architect Sales Representative with a strong understanding of landscape design and a passion for promoting innovative solutions to top architects and landscape designers.

**Position Overview:**  
The Architect Sales Representative will play a vital role in driving sales and fostering partnerships with top architects and landscape designers. This position requires a deep understanding of landscape design principles, as well as the ability to effectively communicate the value proposition of our granite products in enhancing outdoor spaces. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and results\-driven sales professional with a proven track record of building relationships and driving revenue growth within the architecture and design community.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Business Development:** Identify and pursue new business opportunities with top architects, landscape designers, and design firms to promote our range of granite landscaping products.
* **Relationship Management:** Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key decision\-makers and influencers in the architecture and landscape design community.
* **Product Promotion:** Educate architects and designers on the unique features and benefits of our granite materials and how they can enhance their landscape projects.
* **Consultative Selling:** Understand the needs and preferences of clients and provide tailored solutions that align with their design vision and project requirements.
* **Project Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with architects, landscape designers, and project teams to integrate our products seamlessly into their design plans.

* **Sales Forecasting:** Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts and track performance metrics to evaluate sales effectiveness and inform strategic decision\-making.
* **Trade Shows and Events:** Represent the company at industry trade shows, conferences, and events to showcase our products and network with potential clients.
* **Customer Support:** Provide ongoing support and assistance to clients throughout the sales process, from initial inquiry to project completion and beyond.
* **Collaborative Efforts:** Work closely with internal teams, including marketing, customer service, and operations, to ensure seamless coordination and execution of sales initiatives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, or related field.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical information and product benefits to diverse audiences.
* Proactive and results\-oriented mindset with a demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth and exceed sales targets.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with the ability to establish rapport and credibility with clients and industry professionals.
* Self\-motivated and organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and commission structure.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, retirement plans, and vacation time.
* Opportunity for professional growth and advancement within a growing company.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment with a focus on innovation and creativity.
* Exposure to exciting projects and collaborations with top architects and designers.

If you are a passionate and driven sales professional with a keen understanding of landscape design and a desire to promote premium products to top architects and designers, we want to hear from you! title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**Company** 

 CloudWalker Streaming Technologies (CloudTV)    
 




  





**Department** 

 Marketing — OS Platform, Content \& Ads
 




  





**Reports to** 

 Founder \& CEO, with the Head of Marketing as consulting mentor
 




  





**Works with** 

 Product, BD, Ad Sales, OEM/Partnerships     
 




  





**Location** 

 In\-office, Mumbai
 




  





**Experience** 

 2–4 years (tech / startup / SaaS / AdTech / OTT / media)     
 




  





**Type** 

 Full\-time
 




  





  





**The role in one line** 





 Turn everything CloudTV builds — an operating system, a content ecosystem, an ad platform, a founder's conviction \- into the stories, campaigns, and assets that grow four audiences: OEMs, content partners, advertisers, and viewers.
 




  





  





**Why this role exists** 





 CloudTV is India's first homegrown, AOSP\-based certified Smart TV OS \- live across a large device fleet and 300\+ OEM brands, with its own app store, Voice assistant, Airstream FAST channels, and a full CTV ad stack. We win on a simple idea: a neutral, open platform partners build on, versus closed players who embed their own services and keep the data and ad revenue. That story isn't being told at the speed it deserves. You'll come in early in your career, absorb the business fast, and build the marketing engine from strategy through execution. The ceiling is Head of Product Marketing.
 




  





  





**What makes marketing here different** 





 You market a product that is the audience's screen \- home screen, boot screen, screensaver, mastheads, app store, content rails on millions of TVs, inches from live cricket, festival releases, and the biggest OTT titles. The craft is learning to wield that: time campaigns to content moments, use content partners to sell the platform, use the platform to sell to advertisers.
 




  





  





**What you'll own** 




**B2B \- three ecosystems to grow** 




  





**1\.** 
**OEM \& brand ecosystem.** 

 Keep our TV brands and manufacturers close and selling — every new feature, partnership, milestone, app, content type, and go\-to\-market technology. Always\-on, not one\-off: partner newsletters, Instagram, WhatsApp\-ready forwards, festive greetings, building to the annual CloudTV partner summit, which you help shape end\-to\-end.
 




  





**2\.** 
**Content \& application ecosystem.** 

 Build the narrative and outreach that attracts more apps, FAST channels, and services onto the CloudTV app store and partnership ecosystem — turning every content win into the conversation that pulls the next partner in.
 




  





**3\.** 
**Advertiser ecosystem.** 

 Work as an extension of the CloudTV Ads team. Turn campaign metrics into case studies, data reports, and pitch decks; keep sales decks current with new ad units; translate the ad stack into narratives that win brands and agencies. Genuine curiosity about CTV/OTT/linear advertising, measurement, and audience data is essential.
 




  





**Across all of it** 





 PR, blogs, POV/thought\-leadership on the CTV ecosystem, spokesperson prep, sales\-enablement kits, and collateral for factory lines, retail, and the website — all timed to the product roadmap, partnership milestones, and content moments.
 




  





  





**What we're looking for** 




**•** 

 2–4 years in marketing at a tech startup, SaaS, media/OTT, or AdTech company \- hungry for more than the title implies
 




**•** 

 Product\-marketing instincts: simplify technical, data\-heavy ideas without losing accuracy
 




**•** 

 A storyteller's eye: find the narrative inside a dataset or feature list
 




**•** 

 Range in writing: partner pitch, LinkedIn post, press release, consumer caption
 




**•** 

 AI\-native and self\-sufficient: no designer here \- you use AI tools daily to design, draft, and ship polished, on\-brand assets yourself
 




**•** 

 Comfortable with ambiguity; defines their own briefs and moves
 




**•** 

 Curiosity about where CTV, OTT, linear, and FAST are heading
 




**•** 

 Hands\-on experience running a brand's LinkedIn and Instagram is a strong plus
 




**•** 

 Bachelor's in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related
 




  





  





**Why CloudTV** 



* Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founder on a national story — a homegrown platform taking on the biggest names in tech — with room to build a marketing function from the ground

title: Strategic Alliances - Growth & Martech Platforms
description:
**About BharatNXT** 




  






 Every day,
 
**64 million Indian micro and small businesses** 

 build with grit and audacity, and BharatNXT is building the financial infrastructure to fuel that ambition. We help businesses turn existing credit tools like cards into flexible working capital, while enabling them to
 
**pay vendors, GST and invoices and manage cards, limits and payouts all on one platform.** 




  






 Today, BharatNXT serves
 
**2M\+ users across 450\+ cities** 

 , powered by an in\-house financial infrastructure with
 
**100\+ risk checks** 

 , fraud below
 
**0\.02%** 

 , and a dynamic pricing engine evaluating
 
**20\+ parameters across 10,000\+ daily transactions** 

 . But payments are just the starting point \- we’re building
 
**India’s MSME Financial Operating System** 

 , spanning
 
**Run, Manage and Grow** 

 , with embedded credit, insurance and personalised financial products powered by signals from every transaction, interaction and GST filing.
 





 Our
 
**Predictive Journey Engine** 

 interprets
 
**100\+ data points per user** 

 to continuously personalise pricing, limits, products, reminders and rewards. We’re building towards powering the
 
**next 10 million entrepreneurs** 

 and rebuilding Bharat’s operational and credit rails from the ground up.
 




  





**The role** 





 Own our growth data and tooling layer end to end from the business side. Every growth decision we make runs on data from a stack of connected platforms: our CRM, MMP, engagement platform, website, voice calling stack and the app itself. You will own how those systems get implemented, how they talk to each other, whether the data flowing through them is correct, and whether we are actually getting ongoing value from the growing stack as it evolves.
 




  






 You won't build these integrations yourself. You'll own the outcome defining what's needed, pulling in Tech and Product where required, and driving our external platform partners to deliver. Most of this job is getting things done through other people, on both sides of the company wall. You will define these requirements, work with Tech, Product, Analytics and external partners to get them implemented, QA the output, and ensure they continue to work.
 




  






 You do not need to be an engineer. You do need enough fluency in how these systems work to write a clear requirement, spot a wrong number, and know when a vendor telling you
 
***"that isn't possible"***

 simply means nobody has asked properly.
 




  





**What you'll do** 




  




* **Own data flows across systems** 

 \- define what data should move between CRM, Martech stack, AI calling agent, MMP, website, app/backend and analytics platforms.
* **Manage external partners** 

 \- work with CRM, MMP, calling, engagement and other vendors to get integrations, issues and requirements resolved.
* **Market \& new feature scan** 

 \- track new capabilities and identify relevant opportunities across our tech stack.
* **Commercial optimisation** 

 \- optimise pricing, contracts, usage and ROI across key platforms.
* **Build platform relationships** 

 \- develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders at our technology partners.
* **Industry participation** 

 \- represent BharatNXT at relevant industry events and partner forums.
* **Drive implementations** 

 \- translate business requirements into clear specs, work with Tech/Product/Data and external vendors, and drive integrations through to completion.
* **Own CRM \& engagement data** 

 \- CRM and MoEngage have the right events, properties, fields and user\-level information to support sales, engagement and growth.
* **Connect business workflows** 

 \- map inside\-sales, field\-sales, calling and other operational data into the right systems and journeys.
* **Build the measurement layer** 

 \- identify what needs to be measured and work with Analytics to build the right dashboards, reports and monitoring.
* **QA and maintain data quality** 

 \- validate events, field mappings, integrations and dashboards; identify and fix data gaps or inconsistencies.
* **Own new tool implementations** 

 \- evaluate requirements, define integration needs, coordinate implementation and ensure adoption once a tool goes live.
* **Create structure** 

 \- maintain data dictionaries, tracking plans, integration documentation and clear ownership across systems.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 2\-5 years of
 
**working with large technology product companies** 

 in co\-creating and executing joint strategic roadmaps
* Strong understanding of how data moves across
 
**CRM, engagement, analytics and product systems** 

 .
* Comfortable working with
 
**APIs, webhooks, data mapping and technical documentation** 

 . You don't need to code, but you should be able to understand and debug a data flow.
* Strong ability to convert business requirements into
 
**clear technical requirements and QA checklists** 

 .
* Comfortable working with
 
**Tech, Product, Analytics, Business teams and external vendors** 

 to get things done.
* Strong attention to data quality and an instinct to ask:
 
**"Is the right data reaching the right place, and can we trust it?"**
* Highly organised and able to manage multiple implementations and stakeholders simultaneously.
* **Good to have:** 

 SQL/light scripting, MMP or SaaS experience, telephony/AI calling integrations, CDP experience, fintech/SMB experience or experience managing a major tool migration.



  





**Why take it** 




  






 You'll own the systems that
 
**every growth decision at the company depends on** 

 , with multiple greenfield integrations, new tools and platform relationships ahead of you. If you’re highly ambitious and keen to stay on the
 
**cutting edge of emerging Martech tools and technologies** 

 , this is a role where you’ll have the scope to experiment, build and shape how the company operates.
 




  





**Who should not take it up** 




  




* You’re not deeply driven to
 
**build the next large consumer business for India’s micro \& small businesses** 

 , and would rather optimise for comfort than impact.
* You care more about
 
**perks and flexibility** 

 than the opportunity to build something meaningful and shape it from the ground up.
* You’re looking for a
 
**siloed, low\-collaboration role** 

 . We work closely across Business, Marketing, Product, Tech and other teams \- co\-designing, challenging and building together is a big part of the job.
* You prefer clearly defined boundaries over
 
**taking ownership, figuring things out and getting things done** 

 in an evolving environment.

description:
Job Purpose
   

  

 The primary objective of the role is to roll\-out Cash Management product as part of Mashreq’s expansion in India (both onshore and GIFT city). The role will be required to develop, commercialise and deliver a competitive suite of cash management products to Mashreq’s corporate and FI clients in India. The role will develop capabilities across Account Services, Payments, Collections \& Liquidity Management products.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

 \- Drive Overall Financial Performance – drive the overall financial performance of cash management products by launching new products and driving initiatives for existing products to grow volumes and liabilities whilst establishing strategies to optimize fee pricing, Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and Net Interest Margins (NIMs). Work with Technology and Operations to digitise processes and lower costs
   

 \- Develop the Product Strategy – work with the product management team to develop a comprehensive strategy for all cash management products by clearly defining the market landscape and drivers, core product proposition, target market and client segments, addressable market size, projected share of wallet and associated volumes/revenues, competitor capability assessment, product development roadmap, and commercialization strategy
   

 \- Drive Product Innovation – establish processes and checkpoints to ensure your team identifies opportunities to develop new products and enhance existing products based on market/sales feedback, client needs and/or regulatory changes. Prioritize the development pipeline based on a sound commercial assessment of each opportunity and review the quality of investment plans before the team seeks formal approvals. Constantly review the Minimum Value Proposition (MVP) for the product set against each target segment as well as defining the future roadmap for an Enhanced Value Proposition (EVP) to stay ahead of the market and position Mashreq as the leading innovator in the region
   

 \- Commercialize Product Offerings – ensure the team develop and execute a comprehensive commercialization plan for each key cash management product including revenue/volume targets, client target market and prospect lists, core marketing/sales materials, product training for Sales and Coverage, and client education events. Track and monitor execution of these plans through regular reviews and identify any issues where help is required to remove roadblocks. Ensure the Product Management team are working on the right deals with Sales to maximize revenues
   

 \- Build Product Governance \& Compliance Culture – ensure that the team complete all Product Program Guidelines (PPGs) and/or Country Addenda for cash management products on a regular basis, that these documents reflect a true assessment of the inherent risks associated with these products, and that products are aligned to the legal, regulatory, compliance, tax, credit risk and other relevant frameworks and internal policies within the Bank. Review changes in the market landscape to understand the impact on the product bench, including changes in the regulatory horizon, and ensure the team pro\-actively implement changes to mitigate risks and stay within the risk appetite of the Bank. Set up programs to promote awareness of risk and compliance issues associated with cash management products within GTB and with Sales and Coverage partners
   

  

 Knowledge, Skills and Experience
   

 \- Minimum 10\-12 years cash management product experience including at least 5 years senior management experience covering India market with full P\&L accountability
   

 \- Strong understanding of all cash management products ideally in India/ global or large regional bank
   

 \- Track record developing and successfully commercialising multiple new products
   

 \- Experience in agile product and technology development approaches
   

 \- Strong people management skills
   

 \- Strong analytical and data rationale mindset
   

 \- Strong communication ability and executive impact

**About the Role** 




  





 JOB DESCRIPTION National Sales Manager \- India Capital Equipment, Customised Solutions and Turnkey Projects
 



  





 Position at a Glance
 



  




* Position National Sales Manager \- India

 Position Purpose The National Sales Manager shall develop and execute national sales strategy and achieve order\-intake, revenue, gross\-margin and collection targets across its healthcare, pharmaceutical, laboratory, industrial laundry and industrial kitchen businesses. The role requires hands\-on leadership of the sales team, development of institutional and project business, management of key accounts and channel partners, and close coordination with Engineering, Production, Projects, Service and Finance.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* National Sales Strategy and Performance
* Prepare and execute annual, quarterly and monthly national sales plans aligned with NAT's business objectives.
* Own national targets for order intake, sales revenue, gross margin, pricing discipline and sales\-related receivables.
* Translate national objectives into territory\-wise, segment\-wise and individual targets and review progress regularly.
* Monitor performance and take timely corrective action where targets, pipeline quality or execution are below plan.
* 
* Business Development and Market Expansion
* Develop business across hospitals, CSSDs, TSSUs, ambulatory surgery centres, laboratories, pharmaceutical manufacturers, research institutions, industrial laundries and industrial kitchens.
* Build a qualified pipeline of private, institutional, government and turnkey\-project opportunities.
* Identify growth opportunities, strategic alliances, distributors and priority markets; prepare business cases for, and establish and operationalise, new Regional Sales Offices with company approval.
* Track competitors, customer requirements, tender trends and market developments and recommend appropriate responses.
* 
* Key Accounts, Institutions and Channels
* Build senior\-level relationships with hospital managements, consultants, architects, project\-management consultants, procurement teams, key opinion leaders and other decision\-makers.
* Lead major customer, institutional and tender opportunities from qualification through negotiation and order closure.
* Select, appoint and manage distributors or channel partners under approved company policies and performance standards.
* 
* Hands\-on Field and Team Leadership
* Travel extensively and personally participate in important customer visits, presentations, technical discussions and negotiations.
* Recruit, induct, train, coach and retain a capable national sales team and maintain clear individual accountability.
* Oversee the functioning and performance of six existing Regional Sales Offices across India, including staffing, market coverage, field activity, pipeline, collections and reporting.
* Accompany Sales Executives on strategically important or difficult opportunities and support them in closing orders.
* 
* Solution Selling and Order Quality
* Understand each customer's technical, operational and commercial requirements and develop suitable solutions with the relevant internal teams.
* Ensure that quotations and tender submissions are technically accurate, commercially viable and aligned with approved specifications, costs and delivery capabilities.
* Ensure that no unauthorised commitment is made regarding price, specification, scope, payment terms, delivery, warranty or performance.
* Review project feasibility and risks before major proposals or commitments are submitted to customers.
* 
* Commercial Discipline and Collections
* Maintain pricing and discount discipline and protect approved gross\-margin levels.
* Review customer creditworthiness, advances, payment milestones and other commercial terms in coordination with Finance and the Managing Director.
* Drive timely milestone\-wise billing and collection of sales receivables and intervene in delayed or disputed payments.
* Provide reliable collection forecasts and ensure that commercial exposure remains within approved limits.
* 
* CRM, Forecasting and Management Reporting
* Act as the functional owner for implementation and adoption of CRM and sales\-related FSM processes.
* Ensure timely and accurate recording of leads, visits, opportunities, quotations, probability, expected closure, orders and customer interactions.
* Provide dependable monthly and quarterly forecasts, pipeline analysis and management reports.
* Use data to improve sales productivity, conversion, territory coverage and individual performance.
* 
* Cross\-functional Execution and Customer Satisfaction
* Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Projects, Service and Finance to ensure proper order handover, execution, installation, documentation, invoicing and collection.
* Maintain high standards of customer satisfaction while ensuring that customer expectations remain aligned with the contracted scope.

* 
* Governance and Ethical Conduct
* Ensure compliance with policies, approval matrix, ethical standards and applicable tender and market requirements.
* Maintain accurate records and safeguard confidential customer, pricing, technical and commercial information.



  





  





 Performance Measures Annual targets will be approved by the Managing Director and reviewed monthly and quarterly.
 



  




* Performance Area Weightage

* Gross margin, pricing and commercial discipline 10%
* New business development and qualified pipeline 15%
* Sales receivables and milestone collections 10%
* Sales forecasting and CRM discipline 10%
* Recruitment, coaching and performance of the sales team 15%

**Leadership Capabilities**

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. title: Assistant Brand Manager – Malts
description:

**At Moët Hennessy, We Don't Just Create Exceptional Experiences – We Live Them.**

For generations, our 27 Maisons, including Dom Pérignon, Veuve Clicquot, and Hennessy, have defined luxury. Now, it's your turn. You will act as a guardian and ambassador for the brand at all times, ensuring that all brand marketing activities align with the global brand vision of Moët Hennessy and its single malt brands. We are looking for an organised, creative and passionate brand marketing professional to take on an exciting journey, working closely with business stakeholders to achieve the organisation’s vision. Your contribution will strengthen brand positioning and support the successful execution of marketing initiatives across the business.


\#LinkedIn\-Hybrid

* Achieve brand image, ATL \& BTL objectives and maximize consumer value perception and bring to life key communication strategies through locally driven assets. Measure using key performance tools
* Build a relevant PR and digital (social) plan in line with strategic objectives and target audience in partnership with key agencies
* Conceptualize and execute scalable promotion ideas per brand in on\-trade and off\-trade in domestic channels (hotels, restaurants, MOTs, retail)

* In depth knowledge of brand planning, marketing and ROI across mass and digital media.
* Good exposure to the digital ecosystem with an understanding and appreciation of luxury marketing

* Dynamism and ambition with an outgoing, social nature
* Creative thinker with a great solution orientation
* Being an agile and strategic team player who could work well independently in an autonomous, multicultural and evolving business environment
