title: Territory Manager (Mumbai)
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Territory Manager (Mumbai)
  
Roche India – Diabetes Care
  
  

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  

That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  

As aTerritory Manager \- Mumbai, you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the New Delhi geographic area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life\-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence.
  
  

Your Opportunity
  
  

* Territory Planning\& Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU\-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.
* Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non\-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.
* Sales Promotion\& Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.
* Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.
* Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.
* Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow\-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms.


Who You Are
  
  

* Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy. A post\-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.
* Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2\-3 years of experience with a proven track record in OTC, Surgical Equipment or Pharmaceutical Product.
* Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Goa market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.
* Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.
* Analytical\& Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly sales targets.
* Strong Communicator: You possess excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and motivate external business partners toward a unified goal.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

Product Management·Full\-Time·India\-Navi Mumbai (Hybrid)

**THE ROLE**


At Sovos, we're looking for a Product Marketing Specialist or Senior Specialist for Pricing \& Monetisation to help turn commercial strategy into the data, systems, and processes that make it work at scale. This is a highly execution\-oriented role where you'll work closely with our Vice President for Product Marketing and Go\-To\-Market Strategy and the Principal PMM for Pricing and Monetisation, ensuring our pricing and product information is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the business.


*More specifically, you will:*


* Analyse pricing, packaging, SKU, and product data to identify trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities, and maintain competitive intelligence to support informed decision\-making.
* Build recurring reports and dashboards, and conduct ad hoc analysis to help Product Marketing and leadership understand pricing performance and support strategic pricing decisions.
* Maintain accurate product, SKU, packaging, and pricing information across internal systems, coordinating updates across Product Marketing, Product Management, Finance, and Sales Operations.
* Work closely with Sales Operations to maintain pricing information in Salesforce and make it easier for reps to create custom quotes in the CPQ system, supporting updates to product catalogues and related fields.
* Support the Principal Product Marketing Manager with research, analysis, and preparation for major pricing and packaging initiatives, turning analysis into clear charts, presentations, and insights.
* Support pricing and packaging projects from analysis through implementation, tracking actions and deadlines, coordinating across teams, and monitoring post\-launch results to flag issues or unexpected outcomes.
* Leverage AI tools to improve data analysis, reporting efficiency, and insight generation, continuously looking for ways to make commercial processes simpler, faster, and more scalable.
**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**


* You've built solid experience in product marketing, business analysis, commercial operations, sales operations, product operations, or a related field, ideally 2–4 years.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, excellent attention to detail, and comfort working with large datasets and spreadsheets, with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is strongly preferred, along with the ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations.
* You have strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* You're comfortable working with global teams across multiple time zones and working independently while knowing when to escalate issues, with comfort using AI\-assisted workflows to enhance productivity.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, technology, finance, or pricing is a plus, along with a Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, finance, economics, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**Pre\-Employment Assessment**


Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**Video Interview**


A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.


**4**
**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**


Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day\-to\-day of the role.


**LIFE AT SOVOS**

* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Job Description


**Job Description**


**Role Summary**


The GM, Automotive/ Transportation Experience Design is a senior automotive design leadership role responsible for establishing, governing, and scaling world\-class 360\-degree hardware product experience across products, software interfaces, service journeys, training, support, warranty, repair, upgrades, and customer communications. The role includes hardware experience design(XD) system maturity, XD team building and governance during the product development process, cross\-functional delivery capability, and AI\-enabled automotive experience design transformation.


Senior Automotive Experience Design leadership roles are expected to set product experience vision, build experience design teams, align design with product and engineering roadmaps, embed research and usability into delivery workflows, govern design systems, and report customer impact through measurable qualitative and quantitative metrics.


This role is expected to manage and expand an Automotive Experience Design team comprising transportation designers and hardware product engineers that can work closely with project managers to deliver the entire product design. The GM and all members of this team should have experience in designing and launching consumer facing automotive products, and have had extensive experience working with the other functions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**Cross\-functional Delivery of World\-Class Transportation Experience Design**


* Build, hire, coach, and deploy the right talent to deliver consistent product experience across product, engineering, operations, marketing, customer support, service, and training touchpoints.
* Define XD goals and operating model for cross\-functional teams, including responsibilities, governance forums, review checkpoints, and decision rights.
* Train existing cross\-functional talent on customer\-centric thinking, usability, design system adoption, journey thinking, and experience\-quality standards.
  

  

**Envision and Govern 360\-Degree Customer Experience**


* Define the end\-to\-end customer experience vision across marketing, merchandising, training, end\-use workflows, customer support, warranty, service, repair, and upgrade journeys.
* Establish consistent interaction patterns, visual standards, content conventions, service principles, and customer effort reduction targets across channels.
* Conduct customer journey mapping, workflow analysis, usability testing, voice\-of\-customer research, task\-completion analysis, and friction heatmap reviews.
* Report XD impact and effectiveness to leadership through the right metrics.
  

  

**XD Processes and Product Development Governance**


* Embed XD research as a mandatory part of the product development process and ensure customer evidence informs product and engineering decisions.
* Institutionalize the PRD to XRD to Engineering Requirements workflow, ensuring experience requirements are traceable, testable, and enforced.
* Own XD lifecycle management, including design approval, deviation approval, change approval, experience release readiness, and post\-release feedback loops.
* Create governance artifacts such as XD acceptance criteria, experience risk logs, design review records, usability findings, and design\-system compliance reports.
  

  

**Build Scalable XD Capability and Leadership Pipeline**


* Deploy XD talent into vertical product teams while maintaining central governance, design standards, and shared design system ownership.
* Build career paths, competency frameworks, succession plans, mentoring routines, retention mechanisms, and performance evaluation inputs for UX/XD talent.
* Create a high\-accountability culture that balances customer advocacy, engineering feasibility, product velocity, mission reliability, and business impact.
  

  

**AI\-Powered Customer Experience**


* Assess where AI can augment or replace repetitive XD skills, research synthesis, support triage, prototyping, design review, documentation, and journey analytics.
* Design AI\-enabled XD processes that retain human\-centered principles, safety, explainability, and trust for mission\-critical drone platform contexts.
* Recruit, train, and upskill teams for AI\-assisted research, design operations, prototyping, content generation, analytics, and human\-AI interaction design.
* Implement AI\-enabled XD improvements within the product development process and measure whether they match or exceed current process outcomes.
  

  

**Skills and Competencies**


* Deep Automotive/ Transportation XD experience, design systems, and usability expertise across physical, support, service, and training touchpoints.
* Strong understanding of product management, engineering, operations, customer support, mission workflows, and product development governance.
* Ability to translate customer insights into experience requirements, acceptance criteria, design standards, and measurable product/engineering decisions.
* Agile and Lean methodologies, research operations, design operations, design QA, accessibility, journey mapping, and usability testing.
* Leadership, hiring, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, communication, facilitation, and conflict resolution across product and engineering stakeholders.
* AI literacy for customer experience: human\-AI interaction, AI\-assisted research/design workflows, ethical and trustworthy AI experience principles, prompt/prototype evaluation, and productivity measurement.
  

  

**Education and Experience**


* Bachelor degree in Automotive Design required; Master degree preferred in Automotive Design, Industrial Design, Psychology, Engineering, Innovation Management or related field.
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in Automotive/ Transportation Design, product\-led experience leadership, experience leading design/research teams.
* Demonstrated experience scaling automotive experience design systems, design governance, user research practices, design operations, and cross\-functional experience quality in complex technology environments.
* Experience with mission\-critical, hardware\-software, robotics, UAV, industrial technology, aerospace/defense, or regulated product environments is a plus.
* Portfolio or case studies showing launched automotive design examples with measurable impact on usability, customer effort, adoption, consistency, support reduction, product quality, or customer trust.
  

  

**Working Interfaces**


**Internal:** R\&D, Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Training, Service, Quality, and Delivery teams.


**External:** Key customers and operators, field users, service partners, design/research agencies, training partners, ecosystem experts, and technology vendors.

  

  

**First 6\-12 Month Success Indicators**


* Baseline Transportation XD and design maturity assessment completed across products, support, training, service, and customer\-facing digital touchpoints.
* Transportation Design system roadmap, governance model, and adoption targets agreed with product and engineering leadership.
* PDP XD governance implemented with mandatory XD research, PRD\-XRD\-engineering traceability, and review/approval checkpoints.
* Core customer journeys mapped and prioritized by mission criticality, customer effort, support impact, revenue impact, and product risk.
* AI\-powered XD use cases piloted with measurable process\-quality or cycle\-time improvement.

title: Market Performance Manager
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
   

  

**What We Do...**
 Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000\+ hotels in 150\+ countries, connects to 3,000\+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion\+ in hotel revenue each year.
   

  

 That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
   

  

**About The Market Performance Manager Role…**
 The Market Performance Team Manager leads a high\-performing team of Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists who optimise distribution and revenue strategy for our hotel customers. This role is accountable for building and scaling a centre of excellence in market performance — ensuring hotels maximise bookings and profitable revenue through the intelligent use of SiteMinder’s platform, channel mix, and pricing strategies.
   

  

 Combining strategic leadership, deep commercial acumen and strong people management, the Market Performance Team Manager oversees pipeline and performance across all optimisation initiatives, drives capability development in revenue and distribution management, and partners closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver measurable uplift in customer value, retention and revenue outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
* Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement comprehensive market management strategies that maximise product value and drive customer ROI, with a strong focus on revenue and distribution optimisation.
* Team Development \& Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists. Provide coaching, training and feedback to build deep revenue and distribution optimisation capability across the team.
* Pipeline Management: Own and manage the optimisation and revenue pipeline (initiatives, cases and opportunities), including forecasting, prioritisation and resourcing. Monitor pipeline health, conversion and velocity, and drive continuous improvements in team productivity.
* Performance Reporting: Build and maintain clear performance reporting on optimisation pipeline, revenue impact and team productivity, providing visibility to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to customers.
* Distribution Optimisation: Design and oversee strategies that optimise distribution mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to drive profitable bookings for hotels. Ensure the team can diagnose channel performance issues and execute corrective actions.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales to ensure market performance and optimisation needs inform product development and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Optimisation Program Design: Create and implement scalable optimisation programs that systematically improve customer outcomes and revenue performance across different tiers and segments.
* Performance Management: Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs. Monitor pipeline, revenue and productivity metrics, and coach Team Leads and Specialists to improve conversion, quality and impact.
* Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the business. Represent the market performance function in executive forums and champion customer and revenue outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance optimisation processes, tools and methodologies. Drive innovation in market performance and revenue optimisation delivery to maintain competitive advantage.


**What You Have…**
* Extensive experience in market management at an OTA, customer success, upgrade sales, account management or similar customer\-facing roles, with good experience in a leadership position managing teams (Team Operations).
* Experience leading and developing managers (particularly Team Leads) and frontline specialists, including training and coaching on revenue and distribution optimisation best practices.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing successful market performance and/or optimisation programs that drive measurable revenue and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform strategic decision\-making, manage a pipeline and demonstrate ROI (e.g. RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, channel mix, conversion, productivity).
* Solid grounding in hotel revenue management concepts, including demand forecasting, pricing, inventory and channel management, and competitive set analysis.
* Preferable experience optimising distribution strategy and channel mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to improve profitability and share.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation. Fluent English required; additional languages (Spanish, German, French, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Bahasa, Portuguese or Mandarin) are a plus.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable market performance and revenue optimisation plans.
* Experience in the hotel industry or travel technology sector is highly desirable; background in Market Performance Management from an OTA is highly beneficial.
* Advanced negotiation skills with the ability to train teams in contract negotiation and value\-based selling.
* Proficient in Salesforce and G\-Suite with ability to analyse data across Salesforce reporting, Tableau (as a reader) and Google Sheets.


**Our Perks \& Benefits…**
* Mental health and well\-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in\-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement


 Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
   

  

 When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: GTM Lead - B2B
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Sneakare is a New Delhi\-based, fastest\-growing sneaker care brand, built for people who genuinely love what they are wearing on their feet. We market premium, no\-nonsense products — cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions — designed to help sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear what they love, longer. We started small, made it to Shark Tank India, and haven't slowed down since. Our team is young, fast\-moving, and obsessed with getting things right — whether that's a product formula, a listing copy, or a customer interaction. We care about quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




 We're looking for an experienced GTM Lead to build and own Sneakare's B2B business, largely from scratch. The mandate starts with two known pillars — brand collaborations and corporate gifting — and extends to identifying and standing up whatever other B2B channels make sense for the brand (distribution/wholesale, hospitality, institutional bulk orders, etc.). This is a strategy\-plus\-execution role: you'll define the B2B GTM plan with the Founder, then build and run the pipeline yourself in the early stages.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\.  Corporate Gifting:** 




 • Build a pipeline of corporate clients (HR/admin/procurement teams) for bulk/festive/onboarding gifting orders
 



 • Own pricing, packaging, and proposal templates for corporate orders, including customization options
 



 • Manage the deal cycle from pitch to contract to delivery, coordinating with ops/warehouse on fulfillment timelines
 



 • Build repeat relationships aimed at annual/recurring gifting contracts rather than one\-off orders
 



  





**2\. Brand Collaborations:** 




 • Identify and pitch co\-branded product or campaign opportunities with complementary brands
 



 • Negotiate collaboration terms (commercials, exclusivity, timelines) and manage the partnership through to launch
 



 • Work with marketing/product on execution — packaging, launch content, and joint promotion
 



  





**3\. New B2B Channels (Build\-Out):** 




 • Scope and validate additional B2B revenue channels — e.g. distributor/wholesale partnerships, hotel/airline amenity kits, event and gifting agencies, marketplace B2B — and bring recommendations to the Founder
 



 • Pilot one or two of these channels, defining what a repeatable sales motion looks like before scaling
 



 • Build the playbook (pricing, pitch, process) for each channel you stand up, so it can eventually be handed off or scaled
 



  





**4\. Pipeline, Deal Cycle \& Reporting:** 




 • Own the full deal cycle — prospecting, pitching, negotiation, contracting, and post\-sale account management
 



 • Maintain a live pipeline/CRM view of leads, deal stage, and expected revenue
 



 • Track B2B revenue against targets and report performance regularly to the Founder and leadership
 



  





**5\. Marketing \& Representation:** 




 • Work with marketing to build B2B collateral — decks, case studies, one\-pagers — that support the sales pitch
 



 • Represent Sneakare at industry events, expos, and networking forums to build pipeline and brand visibility in the B2B space
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months):** 




 • A qualified, trackable B2B pipeline exists (not just informal conversations) with clear deal stages and expected value
 



 • Corporate gifting is generating consistent month\-on\-month revenue, with at least a few clients converted to repeat/annual contracts
 



 • At least one brand collaboration has been pitched, negotiated, and launched
 



 • A recommendation (backed by a small pilot) exists for at least one new B2B channel beyond gifting and collabs
 



 • Leadership has a regular, reliable view of B2B revenue and pipeline health
 








**Requirements:** 




 • 6\-8 years of experience in B2B sales, corporate gifting, partnerships, or key account management
 



 • Proven track record of building a pipeline from scratch and closing corporate/B2B deals
 



 • Experience in a D2C, FMCG, or lifestyle brand background preferred
 



 • Strong negotiation, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills
 



 • Excellent communication and presentation skills — comfortable pitching to corporate and institutional buyers
 



 • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building a vertical largely from scratch with limited existing playbook, and turning ambiguity into a structured plan
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment
 



  





**Experience:** 
 6\-8 years
 



**Location:** 
 Kirti Nagar, Delhi (Onsite)
 



**Department:** 
 B2B / Business Development
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**CTC:** 
 Up to 12 LPA

 Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. title: Specialty Sales Manager, Benign GYN
description:
**Company Description**
 It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
 **Intuitive** 
 . As a global leader in
 **robotic\-assisted surgery** 
 and
 **minimally invasive care** 
 , our technologies—like the
 **da Vinci surgical system** 
 and
 **Ion** 
 —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
   

  

 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
   

  

 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
   

  

 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
 **transform the future of healthcare** 
 , you’ll find your purpose here.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
 The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in identifying, developing, and expanding adoption of da Vinci procedures in Benign Gynecology across North \& East India. Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.
   

  

 This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. It combines clinical selling, market development, surgeon pathway execution, customer value creation, and cross\-functional program leadership. The SSM will work through the local commercial organization and directly engage priority customers where specialist expertise is required.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedure Utilization
* Develop and execute the India specialty strategy for Benign Gynecology, aligned with regional priorities and commercial objectives.
* Identify and prioritize procedure growth opportunities, including benign hysterectomy, endometriosis, myomectomy, ovarian cystectomy, and other relevant procedures within the specialty.
* Apply established da Vinci adoption and procedure readiness methodologies in assigned specialties, territories, and target accounts.
* Analyze procedure, surgeon, account, and market trends to prioritize opportunities, address adoption barriers, and guide field execution.
* Partner with local Clinical Sales and Capital Sales teams to develop account\-specific plans that increase utilization of installed systems and create future system opportunities.
* Lead strategic market development activities that build awareness, clinical confidence, and sustainable procedure adoption.
* Convert High\-Volume Laparoscopy Centers into da Vinci Programs
* Identify and prioritize high\-volume laparoscopic centers in Benign Gynecology that have the clinical leadership, procedure volume, infrastructure, and strategic intent to build a robotic surgery program.
* Develop conversion strategies that articulate the clinical, operational, and economic value of da Vinci surgery to surgeons, hospital executives, and other decision\-makers.
* Partner with Capital Sales, Key Accounts, and hospital stakeholders to help qualified high\-volume laparoscopic centers procure a da Vinci system and establish a sustainable program.
* Support the complete program\-building journey, including opportunity assessment, executive alignment, surgeon onboarding, care\-team readiness, initial case\-series support, patient pathway development, and post\-launch growth planning.
* Develop Surgeons, KOLs, and Centers of Excellence
* Identify and develop surgeon champions and Key Opinion Leaders for priority procedures in partnership with Marketing and Professional Education.
* Create development plans for high\-potential surgeons from initial adoption through sustainable utilization, advanced procedure adoption, teaching capability, and peer influence.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to establish suitable case observation sites, mentor sites, training centers, and peer\-learning platforms.
* Coordinate appropriate case observation, on\-site support, simulation or laboratory learning, advanced training, and peer\-to\-peer education in accordance with approved processes.
* Bring relevant clinical and workflow value during the initial surgeon case series and support continuous improvement as experience develops.
* Develop and lead regional specialty education and market development programs that can scale adoption.
* Build Clinical, Operational, and Economic Value
* Work with surgeon champions, care teams, and internal partners to identify and develop credible clinical, operational, and economic value evidence.
* Understand customer success measures within the operating room and across the patient pathway, and translate them into account\-specific value discussions.
* Partner with relevant internal functions to develop value\-focused steering committees, executive reviews, and customer action plans.
* Conduct hospital, department, and practice executive presentations that support informed decision\-making and program expansion.
* Use approved evidence, customer data, and value tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.
* Elevate Specialty Sales Competency
* Coach, counsel, and train Clinical Sales representatives and managers on Benign Gynecology anatomy, procedure pathways, customer needs, clinical value, and consultative selling approaches.
* Provide field feedback that strengthens representatives’ ability to engage Benign Gynecology specialists and position applicable advanced technologies.
* Identify area\-level capability gaps and coordinate competency\-building programs with Clinical Sales Directors and other relevant leaders.
* Create practical field tools, talk tracks, account\-planning guidance, and best\-practice sharing to improve execution consistency.
* Model high\-quality clinical selling and influence through joint field visits, customer engagements, and opportunity reviews.
* Lead Cross\-Functional Initiatives and Market Intelligence
* Serve as the market intelligence liaison for Sales, Marketing, Professional Education, and Training teams by providing timely insights on customers, competitors, procedure trends, adoption barriers, and unmet needs.
* Leverage specialty resources to support scalable launches of new procedures, products, advanced technologies, and customer programs.
* Align with Sales Leadership and Marketing on surgeon training resources, training effectiveness, procedure volume outcomes, and advanced technology adoption.
* Collaborate effectively in a complex matrix organization and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Responsibly manage company resources and budgets to support strategies with the strongest commercial and customer impact.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of plans, activities, opportunities, and outcomes in approved company systems.


**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**
* Minimum 8 years of relevant medical device, surgical, clinical sales, or healthcare market\-development experience.
* Proven track record of individual sales excellence and successful introduction or adoption of new technologies.
* Strong clinical selling capability and the ability to build credibility with surgeons, hospital executives, and highly educated customer groups.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, prioritize opportunities, and deliver results in an environment of change.
* Proven ability to influence peers and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Effective communication and presentation skills across a broad organization and diverse customer audiences.
* Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret market, procedure, surgeon, and account trends.
* Knowledge of the operating room environment and a solid clinical foundation to understand healthcare value.
* Ability and willingness to travel extensively across India, including overnight travel, based on business needs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in one or more Indian languages is advantageous.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification required.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in minimally invasive surgery, robotic\-assisted surgery, benign gynecology, hysterectomy, endometriosis, myomectomy, or surgical capital equipment.
* Experience developing surgeon champions, KOLs, case observation sites, training programs, or centers of excellence.
* Experience building a new clinical market, converting established surgical practices, or launching a hospital program.
* Previous people\-management experience or demonstrated readiness for broader leadership responsibility.
* Experience working with large hospital groups, academic institutions, or complex accounts in India.


 Additional Information

* 743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.


 Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

title: Growth Manager, India
description:
**Growth Manager, India** 

**Location: India (Delhi/Coimbatore/Bangalore)** 





 Are you the person who fixes the process everyone else has learned to live with? Base.com India has grown to a 40\-person team across sales, implementation, support, and marketing, and the way we work has not kept pace with the team. We are looking for a
 
**Growth Manager, India** 

 to run growth experiments across the funnel, run the projects that cut across functions, write the SOPs, and train the team on them. If ownership, hustle, and impact define you, this is your launchpad.
 



**Why Base.com?** 


 We are on a mission to become the global operating system for multichannel commerce. Our platform helps over 30,000 companies worldwide manage orders, inventory, warehouses, listings, and workflows across marketplaces and storefronts, backed by 2000\+ integrations (including Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, Zoho, Tally, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and more). Headquartered in Poland with teams across 17 countries, we are scaling fast, and India is our next big frontier.
 



**What You'll Own \& Drive** 
* **Growth Experiments** 

 : Run experiments across the full funnel: lead generation and pipeline, trial signup to first live order, retention and expansion in the customer base, and marketing and content together with the marketing team. Measure everything, kill what does not move a number, scale what does.
* **Cross\-Functional Projects** 

 : Project\-manage the initiatives that cut across sales, implementation, support, and marketing. Scope, owners, deadlines, follow\-through.
* **Process Improvement \& SOPs** 

 : Find the broken or missing process in each function, fix it, and write the SOP so the function runs it without you.
* **Team Training** 

 : Design and run onboarding for new joiners, product and process refreshers, and training on the tools and AI workflows the team uses every day.
* **Career Development** 

 : Build role ladders, skill maps, and a review cadence with the Country CEO, so every person on the team knows what growth looks like here.
* **Operating Rhythm** 

 : Own the weekly and monthly cadence that keeps every function on its numbers.


**Who You Are** 
* **Builder Mindset** 

 : You would rather design the process from zero than run one somebody else built. There is no growth team, no project office, and no L\&D department here. You are all three.
* **Experienced \& Independent** 

 : 5\-8 years in operations, growth, programme management, consulting, or a founder's office at a startup, SaaS company, or ecommerce business in India. Comfortable leading without direct reports.
* **Process Person With Numbers** 

 : You have written SOPs that people actually followed, and run growth experiments with a number attached: what you tried, what moved, what you killed.
* **Trainer at Heart** 

 : You have taught a team something they did not know, and you enjoyed it.
* **Data Comfortable** 

 : Sheets, dashboards, CRM reports. You find the number before you form the opinion.
* **AI and Tech Savvy** 

 : You use AI tools every day to move faster, and you can teach a team to do the same.
* **Multilingual Communicator** 

 : Fluent in English, and at least one of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati, or Bengali.
* **Doer Culture Fit** 

 : At Base India, everyone executes. The Country CEO does demos. You start as an executor and earn your mandate through results.
* **Bonus Points** 

 : Ecommerce or SaaS domain experience. Hands\-on with HubSpot, ClickUp, or similar CRM and project tools.


**What's In It For You?** 
* **Impact from Day One** 

 : You will shape how the entire India operation runs, across sales, implementation, support, and marketing.
* **Direct Access** 

 : Report to the Country CEO. No layers. You are in the room for every decision that matters.
* **Own the Playbook** 

 : The SOPs, training, and growth loops you build become how Base.com India scales.
* **Long\-Term Growth** 

 : Join during the India build phase and grow into a head\-of\-operations role as the team scales.
* **Competitive Compensation** 

 : We pay well for people who deliver.


**Ready to Build for India's Ecommerce Future?** 


 If you are a hands\-on operator who wants to make a fast\-growing team run better, apply now. In your note, tell us one process you built or one experiment you ran, what you did, and the number it moved.

title: D2C E-Commerce Head [Footwear Industry]
description:
**D2C E\-Commerce Head — Rewritten Job DescriptionAbout The Company**
 Our client is a fast\-growing, conscious footwear brand transforming everyday comfort with innovative engineering and sustainable materials. Featuring high\-performance cushioning and proprietary biodegradable technology, they craft open footwear built for style, function, and minimal environmental impact. They are seeking talented professionals to help scale the future of sustainable fashion across India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented
 **D2C E\-Commerce Head** 
 to lead and scale our direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) business. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving online revenue, improving customer acquisition and retention, optimizing the e\-commerce funnel, and building a profitable and scalable D2C business.
   

  

 The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in
 **Shopify, performance marketing, D2C P\&L management, retention/CRM, conversion optimization, and analytics** 
 — preferably within the
 **footwear, fashion, or lifestyle** 
 industry. This is a
 **D2C\-first role** 
 : the primary focus is the company's own website, not marketplaces.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. D2C Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership
   

  

* Own the D2C website P\&L — revenue, contribution margin, profitability, and growth targets.
* Develop and execute the overall D2C e\-commerce growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Build and execute annual, quarterly, and monthly D2C business plans.
* Identify new growth opportunities across products, channels, campaigns, and customer segments.
* Monitor market trends, customer behavior, competitor activity, and industry developments.
* Present business performance and growth plans to senior management.
* D2C Website Management (Shopify)
* Own the end\-to\-end performance of the company's D2C website on Shopify.
* Improve website conversion rate (CVR), average order value (AOV), customer journey, and overall user experience.
* Manage product listings, collections, merchandising, pricing, promotions, landing pages, and website content.
* Work closely with technology and design teams to improve website functionality and performance.
* Ensure website speed, mobile experience, payment processes, and checkout journey are optimized.
* Performance Marketing \& Customer Acquisition
* Lead performance marketing initiatives across Meta, Google, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms.
* Develop strategies for customer acquisition, retargeting, remarketing, and customer retention.
* Own and optimize key metrics such as ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CVR, AOV, LTV, and contribution margin.
* Work with internal teams and external agencies to improve campaign performance.
* Develop a data\-driven approach to marketing budgets and channel allocation.
* Retention, CRM \& Loyalty
* Own the retention strategy — email, WhatsApp, SMS, push notifications, and CRM automation.
* Build and manage loyalty programs, referral programs, and winback campaigns.
* Track and improve repeat purchase rate, customer retention rate, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and reduce churn.
* Use customer insights to personalize communication and improve lifetime value.
* Brand, Content \& Community
* Lead brand storytelling across D2C — sustainability narrative, product education, and community engagement.
* Build and manage creator/influencer partnerships and affiliate programs.
* Develop content strategy — UGC, blogs, social media, and product\-led content.
* Foster community engagement to build brand loyalty and organic advocacy.
* Revenue \& Conversion Growth
* Drive online sales through effective merchandising, promotions, offers, bundles, and campaigns.
* Analyze the complete e\-commerce funnel and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Conduct A/B testing and implement CRO initiatives.
* Plan and execute major campaigns around festive seasons, launches, sales events, and new product drops.
* Analytics \& Business Intelligence
* Track and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly D2C performance.
* Build and monitor dashboards covering revenue, orders, traffic, conversion, CAC, ROAS, AOV, retention, and profitability.
* Use data and customer insights to make business decisions.
* Identify gaps in performance and implement corrective action plans.
* Product \& Merchandising (Footwear\-Specific)
* Work closely with product and merchandising teams to optimize the online product assortment.
* Identify best\-selling, slow\-moving, and high\-potential products.
* Develop product launch and online merchandising strategies.
* Own inventory planning for footwear — size curves, seasonality, SKU rationalization, and stock\-out reduction — in coordination with supply chain and warehouse teams.
* Reduce stock\-outs, cancellations, and inventory\-related revenue leakage.
* Customer Experience \& Operations
* Improve the overall customer experience across the D2C journey.
* Work with customer service and operations teams to reduce returns, cancellations, complaints, and delivery issues.
* Coordinate with marketing, creative, product, finance, warehouse, logistics, technology, and customer service teams.
* Ensure smooth order processing, fulfillment, delivery, returns, and refunds.
* Ensure D2C processes are scalable as the business grows.
* Team \& Agency Management
* Build, manage, and mentor a 5–10 member D2C/e\-commerce team across performance marketing, CRM, CRO, content, and operations.
* Set clear KRAs and performance targets for team members.
* Manage external agencies, technology partners, freelancers, and other vendors.
* Ensure timely execution of campaigns and business initiatives.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* D2C Revenue Growth
* Contribution Margin (CM2/CM3\)
* Website Conversion Rate (CVR)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* Customer Retention Rate
* New Customer Acquisition
* Website Traffic \& Engagement
* Organic Traffic Share
* Cart Abandonment Rate
* Return \& Cancellation Rate
* Inventory Availability
* Loyalty Program Enrollment
* Brand Search Volume


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, E\-Commerce, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in D2C / E\-commerce, with at least 3–4 years in a leadership role.
* Strong hands\-on experience managing Shopify — this is mandatory.
* Proven experience owning a D2C P\&L of ₹10 Cr\+ — with full ownership of revenue, contribution margin, and profitability.
* Strong understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, CRM, SEO, CRO, and digital marketing.
* Hands\-on experience with retention/CRM — email, WhatsApp, SMS, loyalty programs, and marketing automation.
* Strong commercial and analytical understanding of D2C business models and unit economics.
* Experience managing revenue targets and marketing budgets.
* Strong understanding of e\-commerce metrics and customer acquisition economics.
* Experience building and leading a D2C team (5\+ members).
* Experience in footwear/fashion/lifestyle is strongly preferred.
* Brand storytelling, content, or community experience is a plus.
* Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets and data\-analysis skills.


 What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)TimeframeExpected Outcome
 **0–3 months** 
 Audit D2C website, performance marketing, CRM, and inventory. Build 90\-day growth plan. Establish dashboards and KPIs.
 **3–6 months** 
 Execute quick wins — CRO tests, ad optimization, CRM flows. Improve CVR, AOV, and CAC. Build team structure.
 **6–12 months** 
 Scale D2C revenue profitably. Improve repeat purchase rate and LTV. Build brand storytelling and community. Establish D2C as the primary growth channel.Why This Role?
   

  

* Lead the D2C growth of a conscious, sustainable footwear brand.
* Own the D2C website P\&L — not just a marketing function.
* Build and scale a D2C\-first team in a fast\-growing category.
* Work at the intersection of sustainability, technology, and consumer fashion.
* Competitive compensation: ₹24 LPA (negotiable for the right candidate).


 To Apply
   

  

**Please Share Your Resume With a Brief Note On**
* Your D2C P\&L scale (₹ Cr) and Shopify experience (years).
* Your performance marketing experience (Meta, Google, budgets managed).
* Your retention/CRM experience (email, WhatsApp, loyalty).
* Your team leadership experience (team size, structure).
* Why this conscious footwear brand excites you.

 If you’re looking for an exciting role that combines strategy, execution, and leadership exposure, we’d love to hear from you!

 This role combines strategy and execution, with a focus on ecosystem engagement, community building, and scalable startup programming. You will help strengthen MongoDB’s presence among high\-growth, venture\-backed startups across India by building relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities. In partnership with the broader marketing team, you will design and execute programs, events, and partnerships that increase awareness, adoption, and long\-term affinity for MongoDB.  We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Position Expectations

title: Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR)
description:
We are hiring Entrepreneurs\-in\-Residence (EIRs) to build new businesses from zero inside MedhaviOne. Each EIR reports to the Founders and owns one mandate end to end.
 



  





**Why Now?**




  





 Higher education is being rebuilt, and the people who build it now will shape the sector for decades.
 



 ·      Degrees are giving way to skills.
 



 ·      Classroom\-only learning is giving way to work\-integrated learning.
 



 ·      One\-size\-fits\-all programmes are giving way to new models designed with employers.
 



  





 For years, the strongest graduates from top institutes walked past education. That is changing. The capital, talent and ambition now entering the sector mean it is moving fast.
 



  





 This role is a 2–3 year founder apprenticeship, fully paid. You build a real business, with our partner network and university behind you.
 



  





**(I) EIR, Enterprise Growth**



* **What you build \-** 
 Go\-to\-market, sales motion, and thought leadership for MedhaviOne Enterprise, serving employers and industries that need job\-ready talent
* **Where it can lead \-** 
 Growth Head, then Business Head for the portfolio
* **Best\-fit background \-** 
 B2B marketing or growth in SaaS or AI companies



  





**(II) EIR, New Learning Brand**



* **What you build \-** 
 A curated online marketplace of high\-value, work\-integrated upskilling and reskilling programmes, co\-developed with premier institutes and universities
* **Where it can lead \-** 
 Category Head, then Business Head for the portfolio
* **Best\-fit background \-** 
 Growth, category or programme roles at leading EdTech platforms



  





**What will you do?**




  





 In both mandates, you run the business as its founder.
 



  




* Own everything: proposition, academic framework, industry links, acquisition and outcomes.
* Write the plan, set the targets and own the results.
* Pull in marketing, technology, academic and partnerships teams to get things done.
* Build a lean team as the business proves itself.
* Put plans on a page: numbers first, with the insight beside them.



  





**Who we are looking for?**




  





**Must have** 




  




* A degree from an IIT, IIM or other top\-tier institute, or a track record that speaks just as loudly.
* 2–5 years of work experience.
* Something you built from scratch, and can show.
* A minimum commitment to 2–3 years of hands\-on building with us.
* Clear, sharp writing. Your application is the first test.



  





**Good to have** 




  




* For Enterprise Growth: B2B marketing or growth experience in SaaS or AI.
* For New Learning Brand: EdTech experience or new\-age education businesses.
* For both: Experience running a P\&L, or part of one.



  





**How you work?**




  




* **Hungry.** 
 You want the hard problem, more than the title.
* **Owner.** 
 If it reaches the Founders, you have already checked it.
* **Detail\-driven.** 
 You meet deadlines, and flag early when you cannot.
* **Proud of your work.** 
 You build things and businesses you would put your name on.
* **Thick\-skinned.** 
 The mandate will change as we learn, and you adapt.



  





**What you get**




  




* **A business to build, not a project to support.** 
 You own the outcome from day one.
* **Scale from the start.** 
 You work with 600\+ enterprise partners and a university campus.
* **Direct access.** 
 You work alongside the Founders and the leadership team.
* **A growth path.** 
 EIRs typically move into Growth Head, Category Head / Business Head roles
* **A launchpad.** 
 After 2–3 years, grow with us, or go build your own company in this space.



  





**How to apply**




  





 All applicants are required to complete the application form below. The 150\-word application response will be collected
 



 as part of the form and is mandatory for consideration. Apply Here:
 **MedhaviOne – Candidate Assessment (** 
 https://forms.gle/jisEJHm4AKkWkJsT7
 **)** 




  





**Please note:** 
 The application form and the relevant 150\-word response are mandatory to proceed to the next stage of
 



 the selection process. Please do not email your application separately.
 



  





**About MedhaviOne**




  





 MedhaviOne is building India's education\-to\-employment infrastructure: shared standards for skills and credentials that connect institutions, employers and learners.
 



  





 We are not an early\-stage startup. The Medhavi Group already has:
 



  




* 600\+ enterprise partners across 30\+ sectors, including Hyundai, Mahindra, MRF, Daikin, IHG Hotels and the Indian Navy; 650,000\+ learners reached across India
* Its own skills university, Medhavi Skills University, with close to 2,000 students on campus



  





 The base is built. We now need people to build the next businesses on top of it.
 



 For more information, visit https://www.medhavione.com/
 



  





**About Medhavi Group**




  





 Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill\-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry\-integrated higher education. having trained
 **6\+ lakh learners** 
 with
 **70%\+ employability outcomes** 
 and supporting
 **20,000\+ active students** 
 .
 



  
 


* **WISE (Work Integrated Skill\-based Higher Education)** 
 is Medhavi’s flagship initiative, built on the principle of
 **“Industry on Campus”** 
 , combining academic learning with structured on\-the\-job training.
* Through partnerships with
 **300\+ leading organisations across 26\+ sectors** 
 , including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Marriott, ITC and Tata Electronics, WISE builds industry\-aligned talent pipelines.
* WISE enables students to graduate with
 **real work experience and industry\-ready skills** 
 , enhancing employability, workforce productivity, and bridging the industry skill gap.



  
 



  





 For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise/

title: Founders’ Office
description:
**Founder's Office \| Growth Valley Community** 




 Gurugram (in\-office) \| Full\-time \| 1\-5 years experience \| Reports directly to the Founder
 



  





 Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred or tier one preferred.
 



  





**Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A consistent growth story will be awarded.** 




  





**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.** 




  





**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.** 




  





**About GVC.** 




  





 Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000\+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.
 



  





 Product\-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.
 



  





**The role.** 




  





 You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.
 



  





 This is the highest\-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.
 



  





**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:** 




  




* **Enrollment engine.** 
 Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.



  




* **Admissions product.** 
 We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.



  




* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1\.** 
 A new one\-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.



  




* **Partnerships.** 
 Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.



  




* **The numbers.** 
 Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.



  





**How we will measure you.** 




 Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.
 



  





**Who fits.** 



* Tier\-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1\-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.



  





**Who should not apply.** 




  





 If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.
 



  





**Compensation.** 




  





 fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG\-level.
 



  





**Growth path.** 




  





 This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.
 



  





**How to apply.** 




  





 Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com
 


1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.



 Subject line: FO \| Your Name \| College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

 The Chief of Staff – CEO Office (CPaaS Business) will work directly with the CEO to drive strategic growth, operating performance, and execution across the company's CPaaS business.
 



 This individual will serve as the CEO's execution partner for CPaaS — bridging business strategy, revenue performance, product priorities, enterprise sales, partnerships, technology, operations, and financial performance.
 



 This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role suited to an exceptionally analytical and commercially minded professional who can move seamlessly between strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.

**Role Purpose:** 




 The Chief of Staff – CEO Office, CPaaS Business will work directly with the CEO to drive the strategic growth, operating performance and execution of the company's CPaaS business.
 



 The individual will act as the CEO's execution partner for CPaaS, bringing together business strategy, revenue performance, product priorities, enterprise sales, partnerships, technology, operations and financial performance.
 



 This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role suited to an exceptionally analytical, commercially oriented professional who can move seamlessly between strategic thinking and execution.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. CEO Office \& Strategic Priorities
 


* Work directly with the CEO on CPaaS business priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Convert CEO objectives into clearly defined action plans, owners, milestones and timelines.
* Prepare CEO\-level business reviews, strategic presentations and decision papers.
* Identify critical business issues and independently drive them towards resolution.
* Act as a central point of coordination between the CEO and functional leaders.



 2\. CPaaS Business Growth
 


* Own the strategic agenda for CPaaS growth across SMS, OTP, WhatsApp Business API, RCS, Voice and other communication APIs.
* Track revenue, gross margin, volumes, customer acquisition, retention, and contribution by product/channel.
* Identify new revenue opportunities, customer segments, use cases and geographies.
* Develop business cases for new CPaaS products, partnerships, and commercial opportunities.
* Monitor competitive positioning, pricing and market developments.



 3\. Revenue \& Commercial Strategy
 


* Work closely with Sales and Business Development to build the CPaaS growth plan.
* Track pipeline, conversion, average revenue per customer, churn and revenue concentration.
* Analyse customer profitability and product/channel economics.
* Support pricing strategy and commercial negotiations for key accounts.
* Develop dashboards for daily/weekly/monthly business performance.



 4\. Business Analytics \& MIS
 


* Build a strong CPaaS Business MIS / CEO Dashboard.
* Track key metrics such as:
* Revenue
* Message volumes
* Gross margin
* EBITDA contribution
* Customer acquisition
* Active customers
* Enterprise pipeline
* Conversion rate
* Churn
* ARPU
* DSO/collections
* Delivery rate
* API uptime
* Product\-wise/channel\-wise performance
* Convert data into clear insights and recommendations for the CEO.



 5\. Cross\-functional Execution
 


* Work across Product, Technology, Sales, Finance, Operations, Customer Success and Compliance.
* Ensure strategic projects are delivered on time.
* Establish weekly/monthly operating rhythms.
* Identify bottlenecks and escalate critical issues to the CEO.
* Follow through until closure rather than merely coordinating.



 6\. Market \& Competitive Intelligence
 


* Continuously track competitors, pricing, product launches and partnerships.
* Study developments across CPaaS, conversational commerce, RCS, WhatsApp, AI communications and network APIs.
* Prepare quarterly strategic reviews for the CEO.
* Identify potential partnerships, acquisitions and strategic opportunities.



 7\. Financial \& Business Planning
 


* Support annual operating plans and CPaaS budgets.
* Assist in revenue forecasting and scenario planning.
* Analyse unit economics and profitability.
* Work with Finance to understand business performance and deviations from plan.



 8\. CEO Projects / Special Situations
 


* Take ownership of high\-priority projects assigned by the CEO.
* Prepare business cases and management presentations.
* Support investor/board\-level reporting where required.
* Handle confidential strategic initiatives with maturity and discretion.

title: Manager/Sr Manager - Field Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
**You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.**
 At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we’re supporting our customers’ financial confidence to move ahead, taking commerce to new heights, or encouraging people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what’s possible — and we’re proud to back each other every step of the way. When you join \#TeamAmex, you become part of a diverse community of over 60,000 colleagues, all with a common goal to deliver exceptional customer experience every day. We back our colleagues with the support they need to thrive, professionally and personally. That’s why we have Amex Flex, our enterprise working model that provides greater flexibility to colleagues while ensuring we preserve the important aspects of our unique in\-person culture. Depending on role and business needs, colleagues will either work onsite, in a hybrid model (combination of in\-office and virtual days) or fully virtually.
   

  

**Our Team**
 The Global Merchant \& Network Services (GMNS) organization is responsible for managing relationships with millions of Merchants and Partners around the world that facilitate American Express acceptance and enabling the day\-to\-day operations of our company’s payment network.
   

  

 The U.S. Merchant Marketing, Global Marketing Execution \& Analytics (UMGEA) team is responsible for leveraging marketing and analytics capabilities to drive sustainable growth through customer, partner, and product insights that inform the merchant value proposition, channel strategy, and investment optimization, while leveraging the full range of enterprise assets and partnerships for GMNS customers and ensuring we remain compliant as a network.
   

  

 The GMNS Analytics team within UMGEA is responsible for partnering with global markets to drive profitable growth, accelerating acceptance and amplifying the value of Amex acceptance to Merchants, bank partners and Card Members at scale. We offer powerful data and actionable insights to attract new businesses to engage with Amex, help existing businesses improve performance and capitalize on new opportunities.
   

  

**Description**
 The UMGEA – Global Analytics team is seeking a Manager / Senior Manager, Field Analytics to help lead merchant trigger intelligence and scaled field analytics capabilities. This role will support the continued development and scaling of our flagship analytics\-led merchant trigger program that enables field teams to identify out\-of\-pattern merchant activity, surface actionable leads, and make timely interventions to retain charge volume and improve merchant experience.
   

  

 The individual will partner closely with Field, Marketing, Product, Technology, Compliance, and business stakeholders to translate merchant needs and business opportunities into scalable analytics solutions. The role will be responsible for advancing deterministic and predictive trigger capabilities, strengthening prioritization and arbitration logic, integrating trigger workflows into enterprise platforms, and building measurement frameworks that quantify business impact, including charge volume retained and merchant issues resolved. The role requires strong analytical judgment, stakeholder management, and the ability to move complex pilots into compliant, production\-ready capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Lead the development, delivery, and scaling of analytics\-driven merchant trigger capabilities to support proactive merchant retention, growth, and experience improvement.
* Translate merchant behavior, transaction patterns, and field feedback into actionable trigger logic, prioritization frameworks, and treatment playbooks that enable targeted merchant treatments.
* Partner with Field, Marketing, Product, Technology, Compliance, and business stakeholders to integrate trigger workflows into scalable platforms.
* Support the transition of analytical pilots into compliant, production\-ready capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise governance and risk standards.
* Leverage emerging technologies, including GenAI, to improve intelligence and support field enablement.
* Lead and inspire a high\-performing analytics team, fostering strong ownership, collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 4\+ years of experience in data or analytics functions with a strong business acumen.
* Intellectual curiosity, agility, and quick learning skills to bring structure to shifting priorities, managing multiple demands, and ambiguity.
* The ability to drive insights from data, manage multiple projects, and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong leadership and collaboration skills, able to challenge the status quo and inspire a team.
* Excellent business writing and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively, build relationships, and influence at all levels.
* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Google Bigquery, SQL, R, Python, Lumi, PySpark and Tableau.
* Experience in the merchant business preferred.
* Experience in Machine Learning/ Cloud / Gen AI is a plus.


**Academic Background**
* Bachelors in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/ Engineering/Data Science with relevant experience.
* Post Graduation in Statistics/Mathematics/ Economics/Engineering/Management is a plus.


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities


 American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
   

  

 Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.
