title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning** 



* Strong knowledge on recruitment, must have good English fluent knowledge.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, consultants, and other recruitment channels.
* Coordinate with manpower consultants and recruitment agencies when required.
* Plan manpower requirements based on production, quality, R\&D, sales, warehouse, and support functions.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to onboarding.
* Coordinate interviews and selection with department heads.
* Ensure timely joining and effective employee induction.



**2\. Employee Relations** 



* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, absenteeism, and workplace issues.
* Conduct employee engagement initiatives and address employee concerns.
* Support management in resolving workplace conflicts.








**3\. Payroll \& Attendance** 



* Manage monthly attendance, leave, overtime, and payroll inputs for contractors
* Coordinate with accounts/payroll teams for accurate and timely salary processing.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Monitor attendance, absenteeism, and manpower costs.



**4\. Statutory Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Factory\-related requirements, and other applicable compliances with finance team
* Maintain statutory registers, records, notices, and documentation.
* Coordinate labour inspections, audits, and statutory submissions where required.
* Factory/establishment licence and renewal coordination.
* Contractor and contract labour documentation.
* Maintaining statutory registers and records.
* Supporting labour inspections and statutory audits.
* Monitoring compliance\-related notices and submissions.



**5\. Performance Management** 



* Develop and implement performance appraisal processes.
* Coordinate goal setting, performance reviews, and employee development plans.
* Support managers in performance\-related discussions and corrective actions.
* Track employee performance and HR metrics.



**6\. Training \& Development** 



* Identify training needs across production, quality, R\&D, warehouse, sales, and support teams.
* Prepare annual training calendars with the help of quality team
* Coordinate technical, behavioral, safety, GMP, hygiene, and compliance\-related training.
* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.



**7\. HR Policies \& Processes** 



* Develop, implement, and periodically update HR policies and SOPs.
* Establish effective systems for recruitment, onboarding, confirmation, promotion, transfer, leave, attendance, and separation.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies across departments.



**Admin Activities** 



* Managing office and factory administrative operations.
* Housekeeping, security, canteen, transport, and facility management.
* Monitoring office/factory infrastructure and maintenance requirements.
* Managing stationery, uniforms, ID cards, and other employee requirements.
* Vendor coordination and administration\-related purchase activities.
* Managing company vehicles and transportation arrangements.
* Monitoring security and visitor management.
* Maintaining administrative records, agreements, licenses, and AMC documents.
* Coordinating meetings, events, employee functions, and official programs.
* Supporting safety, emergency preparedness, and workplace discipline.
* Managing employee accommodation, if provided by the company.
* Handling courier, postal, travel, and other general administrative requirements.



  





**Requirements** 




**Preferred Skills** 



* Manufacturing/plant HR experience.
* Recruitment and workforce planning.
* Labour\-law and statutory compliance.
* Payroll and attendance management.
* Employee relations and grievance handling.
* Training and development.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to work with employees at all organizational levels.

title: Solution Architect HR
description:
ROLE SUMMARY
 



  





 What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?
 



  





 The Solution Architect role holds the responsibility of designing and architecting applications that operate on platforms, while adhering to approved designs, security standards, and platform guardrails. Their primary focus is to ensure that solutions meet specifications, deliver optimized performance, and align with agreed run costs. Solution Architects play a crucial role in creating robust and efficient software solutions that drive business success.
 



  





 ACCOUNTABILITIES
 



  





 The HR Solution Architect is accountable for the end\-to\-end technical integrity, governance, and evolution of global HR technology platforms. This role serves as a strategic and technical authority, ensuring that all HR solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. The role drives continuous improvement, oversees global solution design, and ensures seamless integration across systems such as SuccessFactors, Enable, Fieldglass, Concur, and PeopleDoc. Working closely with suppliers, internal teams, and subject\-matter experts, the architect safeguards platform stability while enabling innovation and long\-term strategic value. The incumbent provides expert technical advisory to projects and enterprise architecture functions, ensuring intellectual property, configurations, and solution knowledge are preserved beyond major transformation cycles. • Deliver measurable business value through technology innovation. • Define and influence the strategic roadmap for HR Technology. • Ensure full IDT policy, security, and compliance adherence. • Align solutions with the Global Enterprise Vision and architecture standards. • Approve and validate change initiatives to ensure robustness, compliance, and business alignment. • Drive quality assurance, release governance, and risk/compliance management. • Provide expert configuration and solution design across multiple SuccessFactors modules (e.g., Compensation, Variable Pay, PMGM, LMS, Time Off, Benefits). • Oversee day\-to\-day platform operations, service delivery, and vendor performance against agreed SLAs. • Lead and govern Reward cycles (e.g., ASR, Variable Pay), ensuring accuracy, audit compliance, and operational readiness. • Architect end\-to\-end solutions that leverage appropriate platforms, frameworks, and technologies, ensuring they align with approved designs and security standards. • Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, system administrators, and project managers, to define and refine solution requirements. • Guide HRBPs, Reward CoEs, and leadership teams through technical and functional processes. • Manages risk assessments for operational incidents, change requests, and audit findings; executes risk mitigation and compliance activities. • Translates business requirements into technical specifications and collaborates with internal stakeholders and vendors for effective solution delivery. • Manages escalations, supports incident management organizations, and conducts regular service review meetings. • Ensure smooth service transitions, release management, and operational readiness for new or updated capabilities • Govern access control, ensuring SoX alignment and secure role architecture. • Uphold global GDPR and data\-privacy standards across all HR systems. • Lead budget oversight, resource planning, and capacity management.
 



  





 EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE Job Description
 



  





 ESSENTIAL
 



 Experience Required
 



 • Strong knowledge of data protection principles, information governance, and compliance frameworks. • Proven ability to build strong relationships across global matrix environments. • Minimum 10 years’ experience with SuccessFactors, including implementations and production support. • Full lifecycle delivery experience from design to production. • Experience in large, global organisations using hybrid sourcing models. • Familiarity with regulated environments (e.g., SOX, GDPR) with high data\-protection standards. • Demonstrated self\-driven learning and adaptability. • Experience collaborating across multinational teams and cultures. • Proven technical knowledge/ experience of manage concepts, with focus on Microsoft 365, Azure, and Entra ID (and related cloud/identity platforms).
 



  





 Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required
 



 • Strategic and analytical thinking with a focus on long\-term value. • Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and organisational navigation skills. • Effective communication and presentation skills. • Ability to operate in fast\-paced, complex environments with resilience and agility. • Expertise in solution design, fit\-gap analysis, testing cycles (FUT, SIT, UAT, RT), and data conversion. • Strong negotiation, vendor management, and conflict\-resolution skills. • Project management and financial management capabilities. • Excellent command of English.
 



  





 Education / Qualifications / Certifications Required
 



 • Degree/MBA qualification • SAP SuccessFactors, Fieldglass, SAP ECC HR Module certification \& training courses \& etc • DevSecOps, Agile and ITIL training certification would be beneficial • Knowledge in DevOps, Agile and SaFE processes and how it can be applied in a global enterprise organization. • Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices. Certification in ITIL professional examinations is beneficial • Knowledge in change management processes and implementation cycle/stages • Good understanding of SOX and how it applies within IT

title: People Solutions Associate
description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Visa’s People Shared Services team supports more than 20,000 employees globally across multiple locations and geographies and play a critical role in ensuring a best\-in\-class employee experience. The Associate Analyst role will be primarily responsible for processing employee data changes, program support and execution of task, Verification of Employment request, employee file record management and assisting with other queries related to employee data accuracy.

  

Our team partners closely with our Centers of Excellence teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement while guaranteeing an efficient and consistent approach to the execution of our People Shared Service operational goals.


This role reports to the Manager, People Shared Services.


Key areas of responsibility:

* Will assist in supporting global programs/processes such as Timely Termination Processing, HR Privileged Access Assignments, Team Reporting and Audit controls
* Work to analyze and resolve queries for both simple to medium complexity data processing request as it relates to employee transfers, terminations, personal demographic updates, VOE’s and other inquiries from People Managers, Business Partners, employees, internal COE’s and vendors
* Make appropriate adjustments per the request and communicating progress and outcomes to requestors in a timely and efficient manner, utilizing strong customer service skills
* Employs internal tools such as the case management system (ServiceNow), HRIS (Workday) and vendor tools (Smart Recruiters, ADP, Guardian etc.) effectively to research and assess next steps and accurate resolutions
* Supports cyclical HR events that impact employees (i.e., Annual Review/Promotions)
* Updates and improves the knowledge repository to enable team to take ownership of a higher percentage of inbound inquiries. Actively identifies opportunities for educating team.
* Assist in making recommendation related to training documentation and gaps
* Establish and maintain collaborative and respectful partnerships with our COE’s in HR, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, and others to further our continuous effort to improve operations, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide a high\-quality employee experience
* Be flexible and able to handle unexpected transactions and service requests
* Maintain discretion and adhere to strict confidentiality standards


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

* 3\-6 years of relevant work experience.
* Must have Bachelor's Degree or equivalent. 4\+ years of relevant work experience.
* Experience using enterprise\-scale HRIS tools (like Workday, PeopleSoft, ADP etc.)
* Experience using a HR Case Management system (like ServiceNow)
* General knowledge of HR functional policies and practices within a Global Shared Services model
* Familiar with the utilization and management of enterprise level systems such as Workday and ServiceNow, other comparable software tools acceptable
* Able to work in a fast paced/high volume environment with a focus on QA and meeting established KPIs/SLAs
* Collaborative style and a good team player with a strong customer centered mind\-set that focusses on employee experience and continuous improvement for all processes
* Strong communicator who can deliver easily understandable resolutions to employees and internal teams in common/natural language
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products (PP Presentations, Excel Pivots, VLOOKUP’s, Power BI etc)
* Able to work Monday – Friday and be available for meetings with teams in the US, APAC, CEMEA \& Europe when required

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Customer Support Specialist - Contractor Hub
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the team**

  

The Customer Support Payroll team at Rippling is a dedicated group of professionals committed to ensuring that our customers have a seamless experience with our robust Finance, HR, and IT platform. Our team provides expert guidance and swift resolutions to any technical challenges or inquiries that our customers have. We pride ourselves on our customer\-centric approach, offering support to businesses across various time zones and ensuring help is always available when needed.

  

Our team is composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds and expertise, all united by a shared passion for problem\-solving and continuous learning. We foster a collaborative and supportive environment where team members are encouraged to share insights and innovate solutions to enhance customer satisfaction. Additionally, our team is driven by a commitment to personal and professional growth, with ongoing training and development opportunities to ensure we stay adept with the latest features and updates in our platform.

  

At Rippling, we are actively seeking enthusiastic individuals to join our Customer Support Payroll team. We value candidates who are eager to learn and passionate about growing their skills in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. We believe that fresh perspectives are crucial for continuous improvement and innovation, and we are committed to providing ample opportunities for professional development. If you are motivated, quick to adapt, and excited about contributing to a team that helps businesses operate more efficiently, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique talents to Rippling.

 **What you will do**

  

* US Payroll \- Troubleshoot and resolve payroll\-related issues and guide customers through payroll processing, tax filing, and compliance questions
* Become the go\-to product expert on our Global Payroll and HR capabilities for customers in your designated region.
* Develop and maintain clear, accurate content, documentation, and FAQs to support both customers and internal teams.
* Analyze customer support interactions to identify trends, pain points, and opportunities to improve the support experience.
* Partner with regional Product Managers to provide insights on support volume, customer feedback, and critical compliance concerns.
* Serve as a senior resource and point of escalation for Customer Support Specialists on complex, region\-specific payroll issues.
* Personally own and resolve the most challenging customer cases by leveraging your deep platform and country\-specific payroll expertise.

 **What you will need**

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 1–4 years of experience in customer support or a similar client\-facing role.
* Prior experience working night shifts is mandatory.
* Willingness to work night shifts between 6:30 PM IST and 7:00 AM IST (any 9\-hour shift). Weekly offs will be rotational, consisting of any two consecutive days during the week and may not necessarily fall on weekends.
* Availability to work primarily in US business hours. As a global organization, employees may also be scheduled for APAC or EMEA shifts based on business requirements.
* Proven experience in troubleshooting SaaS products with strong attention to detail and effective problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with experience investigating and resolving complex payroll discrepancies.
* Experience working with a payroll service provider, HR software company, or within a large in\-house payroll function is highly preferred.

 **Additional Information**


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Company Description**  

PhonePe is the leader in UPI based payments in India with a market share of more than 45%. Our goal is to make payments so easy, secure, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. We already are witnessing the mobile revolution, which has changed the way we manage our money on the go. We see ourselves leading this change, through technology and dogged customer centricity. PhonePe went live in 2016 and today, we have 500\+ million registered users \- the first internet Indian company to do this and 35\+ million merchants live on our platform

 **Job Description** **Job Objective:** The role will develop and execute on the HR operations for the business by working closely with stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:**

* To ensure workforce requirements are in sync with annual operating plan and organization's operating structure from a perspective of layers, spans, etc.
* Work with talent acquisition partner to identify different available avenues for sourcing of right talent
* Review profiles, interview candidates and roll out offers with talent acquisition

**Talent Management:**

* To execute the performance management process with regular touch bases and final evaluation as per the decided timelines, for the assigned region
* Facilitate discussions of low performers with their managers and ensure creation of performance improvement plan; Track achievement and take appropriate action in case of no visible increase in performance level
* Drive organization health \& manager connect surveys, as and when conducted, and ensure maximum coverage for the assigned region

**Business Partnering:**

* Maintain strong individual connect and regular touch points with all employees from the assigned business groups
* Solve for front\-line attrition by doing attrition analysis and taking corrective action

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contract role  

  

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment, strong relationship\-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time\-off, payments, and work\-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de\-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third\-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave \& Disability management role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

title: Business Analyst II
description:
**Role Purpose**


The AI Business Analyst will identify, assess, and champion opportunities to apply AI and automation across internal business functions. This role bridges the gap between business needs and AI capability — working closely with stakeholders across departments to understand pain points, map processes, and build the case for where AI/automation can drive efficiency, cost savings, or improved employee experience, then supporting adoption once solutions are approved.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with department leads and teams across the business (Finance, HR, Operations, IT, Customer Service, etc.) to identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient processes that could benefit from AI or automation.
* Conduct process mapping and requirements\-gathering workshops to document current\-state workflows and pain points.
* Assess and prioritize AI/automation opportunities based on feasibility, business impact, cost, and effort, building business cases to support investment decisions.
* Research and evaluate available AI tools, platforms, and use cases (internal and external) relevant to identified opportunities.
* Work with IT/Engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications for AI/automation solutions.
* Support pilot programs and proof\-of\-concepts for new AI use cases, tracking outcomes and measuring impact against defined success metrics.
* Develop training materials, guides, and change management plans to support internal adoption of new AI tools and workflows.
* Track and report on AI/automation adoption metrics across the organization, highlighting wins, blockers, and areas for further investment.
* Stay current on AI/automation trends and best practices, bringing relevant ideas back into the business.
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams throughout the solution lifecycle, from ideation through rollout and adoption.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Process Improvement, or Business Transformation role.
* Demonstrated experience identifying and scoping automation or process improvement initiatives (RPA, workflow automation, AI\-driven tools, or similar).
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with teams across all levels of the business.
* Experience with process mapping and documentation tools/methods (e.g. Lucidchart).
* Analytical mindset with the ability to build business cases, including cost\-benefit and ROI analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain AI/automation concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with IT/technical teams to translate business needs into requirements.
* Familiarity with common AI tools and use cases (e.g., generative AI assistants, RPA platforms, workflow automation tools) and how they apply to business operations.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Direct experience working with generative AI platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) in a business setting.
* Experience with change management frameworks and driving user adoption of new tools/technology.
* Exposure to RPA tools (UiPath, Power Automate, Automation Anywhere) or low\-code/no\-code platforms.

**Qualifications**

title: Regional Manager Operations - Chennai
description:
Sharief Bhai is looking for a Regional Manager to own store\-level P\&L, operations, and people leadership across our Tier\-2 South cluster — including Coimbatore, Palakkad, Manipal, and surrounding markets. This role is central to Sharief Bhai's push to become a Top\-3 brand in its core markets, and offers direct ownership over revenue, cost, quality, and team performance for 6–10 stores.
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 




  
 



 The Regional Manager will be the single point of accountability for a cluster of 6–10 Sharief Bhai stores in Tier\-2 South cities. This is a high\-ownership, on\-ground role combining P\&L management, store operations, people leadership, and quality/compliance oversight. The role reports to the GM – Operations and requires frequent travel across the assigned cluster.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  
 



**P\&L \& Revenue (Primary Focus)** 




 ·        Own store\-level P\&L across the assigned cluster — revenue, food cost, labour cost, and controllable expenses
 



 ·        Drive top\-line growth through online (aggregator) and offline/dine\-in channels; track AOV, order volume, and discounting
 



 ·        Monitor cost levers (food cost %, wastage, utilities, manpower cost) and drive corrective action on deviations
 



 ·        Deliver monthly business reviews with clear performance narratives and action plans for underperforming stores
 



  
 



**Team Management** 




  
 



 Manage and develop a team of Restaurant Managers, and front\-of\-house (FOH) and back\-of\-house (BOH) staff
 



 Drive hiring, training, and performance management across the cluster in line with company SOPs
 



 Build a strong bench of Restaurant Managers and reduce frontline attrition
 



  
 



**Store Operations, Maintenance \& Quality** 




  
 



 Ensure stores are audit\-ready at all times; own corrective action plans for quality/food\-safety audit scores
 



 Coordinate store maintenance (equipment, infrastructure, licensing) with central maintenance and procurement teams
 



 Ensure consistent adherence to SOPs across hygiene, service, and product quality
 



 Travel \& On\-Ground Presence
 



 Conduct regular store visits across the cluster (Coimbatore, Palakkad, Manipal, and other Tier\-2 South markets)
 



 Represent store\-level ground realities in reviews with central ops, QA, and procurement teams
 



  
 



**What We're Looking For** 




  
 



 5–8 years of experience in restaurant/QSR/retail operations, including 2\+ years managing multiple units or teams
 



 Strong P\&L orientation — comfortable owning revenue and cost numbers, not just operational metrics
 



 Proven people\-management experience across store\-level teams (Restaurant Managers, FOH, BOH)
 



 Willingness and ability to travel frequently within the assigned region
 



 Working knowledge of food safety/quality audit processes and store maintenance coordination
 



 Data\-driven approach — comfortable reading store dashboards, audit reports, and P\&L statements
 



 Fluency in English and working proficiency in regional languages relevant to the cluster (Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada) preferred
 








**Success Metrics** 









 Store\-level revenue growth and cost (food \& labour) as % of revenue vs. target
 



 Quality/food\-safety audit scores across cluster stores (target: consistently above 80%)
 



 Team attrition and Restaurant Manager bench strength
 



 Store uptime/serviceability and resolution TAT on maintenance issues

As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 8 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.


* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.


* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

  



**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

  



**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.


* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.


* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.


* Oversees the selection/non\-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection and applicants receive status notifications).

Evernorth Health Services India builds on The Cigna Group’s existing presence in India.

 Evernorth Health Services (Evernorth) is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group \- a Fortune 16 global health company with 75,000 employees, 186 million customers in more than 30 countries and jurisdictions around the world. Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.

Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group.
 



  





  





**HIH \- Program Management Advisor (Workforce Management)** 




**Position Summary:**




 The Program Management Advisor (Workforce Management) will support Hyderabad leadership in driving workforce planning, capacity management, capability development, talent readiness, and workforce insights. The role will partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and functional teams to align talent supply and workforce capabilities with business priorities and growth objectives. The advisor will bring structure, analytics, and governance to workforce decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
 



**Job Description \& Responsibilities:**




**Workforce Planning \& Capacity Management** 




 · Lead workforce management and capacity\-planning processes to align talent supply with current and future business demand.
 



 · Develop workforce forecasts, capacity plans, hiring outlooks, and resource recommendations aligned with business priorities.
 



 · Partner with business leaders and functional teams to translate growth, transition, and transformation priorities into workforce requirements.
 



 · Maintain workforce\-planning assumptions, demand inputs, governance routines, and readiness views.
 



**Capability Management \& Skills Frameworks** 




 · Develop and maintain the enterprise capability taxonomy, skill frameworks, competency models, and role architecture.
 



 · Create and maintain skills inventories and capability maps to improve visibility into workforce strengths and development needs.
 



 · Support role standardization, workforce segmentation, career pathways, and future capability requirements.
 



 · Ensure capability and skill frameworks remain aligned with evolving business priorities.
 



**Workforce Readiness \& Stakeholder Partnership** 




 · Partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and functional teams to identify skill gaps and workforce risks.
 



 · Drive workforce\-readiness initiatives focused on critical skills, emerging capabilities, talent mobility, upskilling, and reskilling.
 



 · Facilitate workforce governance forums and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through on agreed talent actions.
 



 · Influence workforce and capability strategies through structured recommendations and stakeholder alignment.
 



**Workforce Analytics, Insights \& Governance Reporting** 




 · Produce talent insights, workforce analytics, scorecards, and governance reports to support strategic decision\-making.
 



 · Analyze workforce capacity, skill gaps, capability maturity, hiring outlook, and talent\-readiness indicators.
 



 · Translate workforce data into concise executive insights, planning materials, and investment recommendations.
 



 · Maintain consistent definitions, data quality, and reporting discipline across workforce metrics.
 



**Success Measures** 




 · Accurate workforce forecasts and capacity plans that support business priorities and growth objectives.
 



 · Enterprise\-wide adoption and maintenance of capability taxonomy, role architecture, and skills frameworks.
 



 · Improved visibility into workforce capabilities, skill gaps, and talent readiness across functions.
 



 · Delivery of actionable talent insights that enable informed workforce and capability investment decisions.
 



**Qualifications**




**Competencies / Skills:** 




 · Workforce Planning \& Capacity Management
 



 · Capability Taxonomy, Skills Frameworks \& Role Architecture
 



 · Workforce Analytics \& Executive Reporting
 



 · Talent Strategy, Organizational Design \& Workforce Readiness
 



 · Stakeholder Management and Influence Without Authority
 



 · Analytical Thinking, Structured Problem Solving \& Decision Support
 



 · Governance, Facilitation \& Cross\-Functional Program Management
 



**Education:** 




 · Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
 



 · Professional certification in workforce planning, talent management, HR analytics, organizational development, or program management is preferred but not mandatory.
 



**Experience**




**Required:** 




 · 12 \- 15 years of experience in Talent Management, Workforce Planning, HR Analytics, Capability Management, or related disciplines.
 



 · Strong experience in workforce planning, skills inventory, capability mapping, capacity planning, and organizational design.
 



 · Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders and influence talent and workforce strategies.
 



 · Experience leveraging workforce data and analytics to drive talent decisions and business outcomes.
 



 · Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and bring structure to evolving workforce priorities.
 



 · Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with workforce analytics, HR reporting, or visualization tools is preferred.
 



**Desired:** 




 · Experience supporting a large\-scale GCC, shared\-services, technology, healthcare, or enterprise workforce environment.
 



 · Exposure to enterprise capability frameworks, skills\-based workforce practices, workforce transformation, and future\-of\-work initiatives.
 



 · Demonstrated discretion in handling sensitive workforce information and leadership communications.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
***We Are Hiring: Head of Human Resources***




  





**About Elahé** 




 For 30 years, Elahe has been part of Hyderabad's luxury fashion scene, bringing India's finest couture and ready\-to\-wear to discerning clients.
 



 Today, One Elahe LLP brings together seven businesses: Elahe, Elahe Urban, Gallery 476, Oorja, Elahe Online, Amrapali, and Sabyasachi. Its 150\+ strong team spans retail and styling, tailoring and craftsmanship, online, and operations.
 



  





***Location: Hyderabad***




  





**About the Role** 




 As Head of Human Resources, you will be the group's dedicated HR leader. Your first priority is hiring: making sure every business has the right people, at the right time. Alongside that, you will build the HR function from the ground up, including its policies, processes, and eventually its team.
 



 The role calls for a recruiter's instinct and a builder's discipline in equal measure.
 



  





***What you'll do:***




  





***HIRING ACROSS ALL BUSINESSES:***



* Own end\-to\-end hiring for all seven businesses, including sales associates and stylists, store managers, tailors and karigars, the online team, and back\-office roles.
* Work with the founders and business leads to plan headcount and anticipate hiring needs ahead of seasons, launches, and new openings.
* Build reliable sourcing channels, including job portals, fashion and design institutes, referrals, and local networks for skilled craftspeople.
* Run screening, interviews, reference checks, and offers, giving every candidate a fast and polished experience.
* Write and maintain clear job descriptions for every role.



  





***BUILDING THE HR FUNCTION:***



* Set up HR structures, processes, and systems from scratch.
* Build and lead a small HR team as the group's needs grow.
* Create an employee handbook and core policies covering leave, attendance, conduct, dress code, and grievances.
* Introduce an HR system and maintain complete, accurate employee records.



  





***ONBOARDING AND TRAINING:***



* Design a structured induction for new joiners across each business.
* Work with store leads to deliver training in product knowledge and luxury client service.
* Make sure every new hire's first 90 days are well supported.



  





***PAYROLL , COMPLIANCE , AND HR OPERATIONS:***



* Work with the accounts and payroll team to ensure salaries, incentives, and statutory deductions are accurate and on time.
* Own employment contracts, offer letters, and full\-and\-final settlements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, including PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments registrations, and the POSH Act, including setting up the Internal Committee.



  





***PERFORMANCE AND REWARDS:***



* Set up a regular performance review cycle with clear expectations for every role.
* Work with the founders to design fair salary bands and sales incentive structures.



  





***EMPLOYEE RELATIONS AND RETENTION:***



* Be the first point of contact for staff concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters, handling each fairly and discreetly.
* Track attrition, run exit interviews, and act on what they reveal.
* Build a culture of engagement and recognition across stores, workshops, and teams.



  





***Who you are:***




  




* You have 6 to 10 years of HR experience, including time in retail, luxury, hospitality, or another business with large frontline teams.
* You have a strong track record of hiring at volume, for frontline staff, skilled craftspeople, and professionals alike.
* You're familiar with fashion roles such as fashion consultants and merchandisers, and you understand how luxury retail spaces run and what it takes to succeed in them.
* You have hands\-on knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* You have set up HR processes before, ideally as an early HR hire in a growing organization.
* You're organized, discreet, and fair, and you earn the trust of both staff and leadership.
* You communicate clearly in English and Hindi. Telugu is an advantage.
* A postgraduate qualification in HR is a plus.



  





***What the role offers:***




  




* The chance to build an HR function from scratch for an established luxury fashion group.
* Direct access to the founders and real influence over how the group grows.
* Exposure to seven distinct businesses across retail, craft, and online.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.



  





***How to apply:***




  




* **Apply via Linkedin or email:** 
 :
 **elahe@elahe.co.in**
* **In the note, describe an HR function or hiring process you've built, and what you would priorities in your first 90 days at One Elahe LLP.**

title: Senior Manager, Global Mobility Operations
description:
**About Amgen**
 If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Senior Manager, Global Mobility Operations leads the day\-to\-day operational delivery of Amgen's global mobility and immigration programs, ensuring employees are supported through compliant, efficient and consistent relocation and immigration services. This role translates enterprise mobility strategy into operational execution while leading service delivery, vendor engagement, process improvement, compliance and a high\-performing team.
   

  

 The role leads service delivery, vendor engagement, operational performance, process improvement, compliance and a high\-performing Global Mobility Operations team with full people\-management accountability.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor to HR, Talent Acquisition and business leaders, the Senior Manager helps deliver an exceptional employee experience that enables Amgen to attract and move talent in support of its mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead day\-to\-day execution of global mobility programs supporting domestic and international employee movement.
* Translate enterprise mobility strategy, policy direction and business objectives into team priorities, operating plans, service standards, KPIs and measurable operational outcomes.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, automation and standardized ways of working.
* Ensure consistent execution of mobility policies, procedures and operational governance.
* Oversee operational delivery of relocation services supporting new hires, international assignments, transfers and localization activities.
* Lead the processes while partnering with internal Tax, external tax provider, team members and HR leaders, related to cross\-border, non\-traditional movement for remote work and role relocation requests
* Oversee operational processes for trailing equity and trailing bonus for our Mobile population, coordinating with tax vendor and providing guidance to internal payrolls, HR and staff members
* Partner with Tax vendor and provide oversight to global payrolls related to shadow payroll reporting for compensation, relocation and trailing income
* Resolve complex operational issues while balancing employee experience, compliance and business priorities.
* Own operational performance and outcomes across Global Mobility Operations, including service quality, compliance, timeliness, employee experience and continuous improvement.
* Partner with external providers to support timely and effective service delivery.
* Support complex immigration matters in partnership with the Immigration support members on the team to provide guidance, escalation management and issue resolution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Talent Acquisition and business leaders on mobility processes and relocation solutions.
* Partner closely with the Global Mobility COE Strategy Lead to implement enterprise mobility strategy and policy updates.
* Deliver reporting and operational insights that support program effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Partner with the COE on day\-to\-day operational engagement with relocation providers, immigration counsel and other mobility partners.
* Monitor service delivery, operational performance and issue resolution while partnering with Global Mobility COE Lead on vendor governance.
* Manage assigned Global Mobility operational budgets and/or vendor spend, including forecasting, monitoring expenditures and allocating resources within approved parameters.
* Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing Global Mobility Operations team of 3 direct reports, with full accountability for people management, performance and development.
* Set priorities, allocate resources and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Build capability through coaching, feedback, development planning and knowledge sharing.
* Ensure compliance with applicable immigration, employment, payroll, tax and data privacy requirements.
* Maintain operational documentation, audit readiness and governance processes.
* Identify risks and recommend mitigation actions that strengthen service quality and compliance.


**Required Qualifications**
**What We Expect from You**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, International Business, Law or a related field.
* 11\+ years of progressive experience in Global Mobility, Immigration, International Human Resources or a related discipline within a global organization.
* Experience leading operational teams and developing high\-performing talent.
* Strong knowledge of global mobility operations, relocation and immigration processes.
* Experience partnering with external service providers and managing operational delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across a matrixed organization.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced degree or professional certification such as GMS, CRP, SHRM or equivalent.
* Experience supporting scientific, technical or executive populations.
* Experience managing operational budgets and/or significant external vendor spend.
* Experience with mobility technology, reporting tools or process automation.

title: Associate-Resource Management
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Resource Management Advanced Associate**
 As a Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will be part of an industry leading, high performing and agile team of workforce management professionals providing exceptional client service to our stakeholders and helping our employees gain differential experiences that are aligned to their career aspirations.
   

  

 We provide learning and growth opportunities to build your ability to analyze, innovate, think and act globally. You’ll be part of an organization that is focused on optimization, is solution oriented, innovates and provides best in class services to the client serving teams.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and global service delivery network of over 50,000 professionals working across borders, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to EY member firms and EY clients globally. Resource Management plays a vital role in the firm’s Next Wave strategy and it’s purpose of building a better working world.
   

  

 We offer a great place to work for every person joining EY. At GDS, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a truly global environment. You will learn and gain experiences from industry leading WFM professionals and a path breaking leadership team.
   

  

 We invest in your learning and development. We’ll help you develop the technical and soft skills you need. We support your professional development with a combination of learning, networking, experiences, and coaching. As part of a 300\+ member team, supporting 4 unique Service Lines, you will always have opportunities to showcase your skills and contribute to the firm’s strategic initiatives.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As an Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will work as the staffing point of contact for the assigned region/service/competency team and will be responsible to work with the service delivery managers in capturing staffing demand projections, analyze demand intake patterns, demand – supply matching, demand – supply gaps, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.

* Capture demand projections, understand demands heuristics and identify actionable demand.
* Calculate staffing requirements based on demand projections, delivery deadlines and productivity targets.
* Identify suitable staffing options based on matching skills, roles and experiences.
* Create staffing schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.
* Timely update of employee schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
* Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
* Proactive review of resource availability/future project demands.
* Minimize bench pipeline through proactive deployment on projects.
* Minimize open, unfulfilled demand.

* Basic reporting and analysis.

 Graduates with 2\-3 years of relevant workforce management experience. Understanding of business models, operational and financial aspects of service delivery will be preferred. **To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Excellent analytical skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel.
* Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
* Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 **HIH \- Program Management Advisor (Workforce Management)**

**Position Summary:**


The Program Management Advisor (Workforce Management) will support Hyderabad leadership in driving workforce planning, capacity management, capability development, talent readiness, and workforce insights. The role will partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and functional teams to align talent supply and workforce capabilities with business priorities and growth objectives. The advisor will bring structure, analytics, and governance to workforce decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.

**Job Description \& Responsibilities:**

**Workforce Planning \& Capacity Management**

* Lead workforce management and capacity\-planning processes to align talent supply with current and future business demand.
* Develop workforce forecasts, capacity plans, hiring outlooks, and resource recommendations aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with business leaders and functional teams to translate growth, transition, and transformation priorities into workforce requirements.
* Maintain workforce\-planning assumptions, demand inputs, governance routines, and readiness views.

**Capability Management \& Skills Frameworks**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise capability taxonomy, skill frameworks, competency models, and role architecture.
* Create and maintain skills inventories and capability maps to improve visibility into workforce strengths and development needs.
* Support role standardization, workforce segmentation, career pathways, and future capability requirements.
* Ensure capability and skill frameworks remain aligned with evolving business priorities.

**Workforce Readiness \& Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and functional teams to identify skill gaps and workforce risks.
* Drive workforce\-readiness initiatives focused on critical skills, emerging capabilities, talent mobility, upskilling, and reskilling.
* Facilitate workforce governance forums and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through on agreed talent actions.
* Influence workforce and capability strategies through structured recommendations and stakeholder alignment.

**Workforce Analytics, Insights \& Governance Reporting**

* Produce talent insights, workforce analytics, scorecards, and governance reports to support strategic decision\-making.
* Analyze workforce capacity, skill gaps, capability maturity, hiring outlook, and talent\-readiness indicators.
* Translate workforce data into concise executive insights, planning materials, and investment recommendations.
* Maintain consistent definitions, data quality, and reporting discipline across workforce metrics.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate workforce forecasts and capacity plans that support business priorities and growth objectives.
* Enterprise\-wide adoption and maintenance of capability taxonomy, role architecture, and skills frameworks.
* Improved visibility into workforce capabilities, skill gaps, and talent readiness across functions.
* Delivery of actionable talent insights that enable informed workforce and capability investment decisions.

**Qualifications**

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Workforce Planning \& Capacity Management
* Capability Taxonomy, Skills Frameworks \& Role Architecture
* Workforce Analytics \& Executive Reporting
* Talent Strategy, Organizational Design \& Workforce Readiness
* Stakeholder Management and Influence Without Authority
* Analytical Thinking, Structured Problem Solving \& Decision Support
* Governance, Facilitation \& Cross\-Functional Program Management

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Professional certification in workforce planning, talent management, HR analytics, organizational development, or program management is preferred but not mandatory.

**Experience**

**Required:**

* 11 \- 13 years of experience in Talent Management, Workforce Planning, HR Analytics, Capability Management, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience in workforce planning, skills inventory, capability mapping, capacity planning, and organizational design.
* Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders and influence talent and workforce strategies.
* Experience leveraging workforce data and analytics to drive talent decisions and business outcomes.
* Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and bring structure to evolving workforce priorities.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with workforce analytics, HR reporting, or visualization tools is preferred.

**Desired:**

* Experience supporting a large\-scale GCC, shared\-services, technology, healthcare, or enterprise workforce environment.
* Exposure to enterprise capability frameworks, skills\-based workforce practices, workforce transformation, and future\-of\-work initiatives.
* Demonstrated discretion in handling sensitive workforce information and leadership communications.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.

**About Evernorth Health Services**


Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

**About the role:** 




  




* The role serves as a trusted Human Resource and Employee Relations partner, providing strategic guidance on employee relations, workforce change, policy governance, regulatory compliance and employment\-related risk considerations. **HR support:**

**Working Work Environment, Employee Relations and Compliance:** 




  




* Independently lead and manage complex ER matters including disciplinary issues, performance management, grievances, investigations, redundancies, workforce transitions, long\-term illness cases and negotiated exits. Provide guidance to colleagues and managers to achieve balanced and sustainable outcomes.

title: Head – Talent Management, L&D & Performance Management + HR Business Partner
description:
**Purpose** 




  





 This is a blended HR role, combining enterprise Talent Management, Learning \& Development and Performance Management ownership (approximately 60% of the role) with HR Business Partnering \+ Digital Transformation for defined business teams (approximately 40%). The role will drive SPNI's talent strategy, strengthen the leadership pipeline, succession, learning and performance management systems, while staying close to the business through hands\-on HRBP ownership \- bringing enterprise design and on\-ground execution together in one role.
 



 The ideal candidate will have core expertise and track record of driving Talent Management, L\&D and Performance Management, along with hands\-on HRBP experience and will be equally comfortable operating in both spaces. The candidate must be able to have a larger pan\-company perspective to design interventions and influence other BUs, while building deep business acumen and depth for the part of the business they directly partner.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Talent Management, L\&D \& Performance Management** 



1. **Talent Management**



  




* Design the enterprise Talent Management strategy aligned to SPNI's business and growth priorities, by leveraging Build/Buy/Borrow levers.
* Talent 2 Value \- Develop strong business acumen and sector understanding to define high value roles in the company, closely linked to growth priorities. Design and implement a plan of action to ensure top talent is casted into these roles.
* Drive talent reviews, succession planning and identification \+ development of high\-potential talent across the organisation.
* Define the career framework for the wider organization including principles and guidelines for internal talent mobility, both horizontal and vertical career moves.
* Leverage Tech \& AI for new\-age talent management, with transparency, speed and consistency as key pillars.



  





  





  





  




1. **Leadership Development**



  




* Design and execute leadership development interventions across levels, with particular focus on current and future leaders.
* Build differentiated interventions for emerging leaders, high potentials and senior leadership. Partner with external leadership institutions, coaches and development partners where relevant
* Track the effectiveness and business impact of leadership development initiatives.



  




1. **Mission\-Critical Business Capabilities**



  




* Lead the Learning \& Development strategy across SPNI. Identify future\-critical capabilities on content, revenue and digital/technology in partnership with business and HR leaders
* Build learning journeys using a blend of formal learning, experiential learning, coaching, mentoring and digital interventions
* Ensure L\&D investments are aligned to business priorities and measurable outcomes.



  




1. **Assessments \& Talent Diagnostics**



  




* Leverage business insights, leadership feedback and data analytics to identify critical success factors for high performance at SPNI.
* Use this to design assessment methodologies using partnerships with assessment and talent diagnostic providers
* Ensure assessments translate into meaningful decisions on selection, advancement and development interventions for key talent.



  




1. **Performance Management \& Talent Processes**



  




* Own the enterprise Performance Management cycle end\-to\-end \- goal setting, mid\-year and annual reviews, ratings calibration \- in close partnership with HRBPs and business leaders
* Simplify and continuously improve the performance management framework, tools and calibration process
* Continuously evolve talent processes to make them simple, differentiated and business relevant
* Use talent data and insights to identify trends, risks and opportunities.



  





  





  





  




1. **Stakeholder Partnership \& Influence**


* Act as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders on talent and leadership matters Influence senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority
* External orientation and thought leadership – Get the best of knowledge and perspective from Sony Pictures global teams \+ external best practices in India to continuously challenge the status quo and sharpen SPNI’s HR practices and policies.



**B. HR Business Partnering** 



* Act as the HR Business Partner for a defined business group, providing end\-to\-end generalist HR support – strategic advisor, organization design, workforce planning and day\-to\-day people management
* Drive the local execution of performance management, compensation reviews and organisation/role changes for the aligned business
* Be the first point of contact for employee queries, policy interpretation and grievance resolution within the aligned business
* Drive engagement, culture and people initiatives for the business group
* Bring on\-ground business insight back into enterprise Talent Management, L\&D and Performance design, keeping enterprise frameworks grounded in real business needs



 More details on the business team for this candidate to partner will be shared in due course as we run this search.
 



**Key Metrics** 



* Succession coverage and leadership readiness for critical role
* Retention and progression of HiPos and critical talent
* Effectiveness and impact of leadership development and learning interventions
* Internal mobility and stakeholder satisfaction with talent processes.
* Employee relations TAT, resolution quality and query closure for the aligned business
* Engagement scores and attrition trends within the aligned business group



  





  





**Critical Competencies** 



* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen, curiosity and bias for execution
* Strong executive presence and stakeholder management to influence a wide group of senior leaders and rally the HR team on key interventions.
* External orientation \- Keep an eye on M\&E sector transformation, competitive intelligence, scan the world for best people practices and use this to design the SPNI HR innovation roadmap for the near\-term and medium \-term.
* Versatility to operate with equal comfort in enterprise\-level strategic design and in day\-to\-day, on\-ground business partnering



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Talent Management \& Succession Planning
* Leadership Development, Learning \& Capability Building
* Talent Assessments, Psychometrics \& Development Centres
* Talent Reviews, HiPo, Career \& Internal Mobility frameworks.
* HR Business Partnering \- employee relations, engagement and generalist HR execution



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 12–14 years of overall experience, with demonstrated excellence in Human Resources and at least 9–10 years of experience in Learning \& Development and Talent Management.
* At least 5 years of hands\-on HR Business Partnering experience, with strong business acumen and the ability to translate business priorities into people interventions
* Postgraduate qualification from a Tier I or Tier II institution.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with strong executive presence.
* Strong ability to influence and convince leaders and business stakeholders, build alignment and secure buy\-in for talent, learning and people interventions.



 This role is best suited to someone who has deep, demonstrated expertise in driving Talent Management, Learning \& Development and Performance Management at an enterprise level, and who also brings meaningful hands\-on experience of partnering a strategic Business Unit. Candidates who have operated across both spaces \- with their core strength and track record in Talent Management/L\&D/Performance Management \- are ideally placed for this role.

 Talent Management Specialist

 Full\-time

 We are looking for a
 **Performance \& Rewards Specialist** 
 to work as an
 **individual contributor** 
 owning the end\-to\-end performance management cycle (approx. 70% of the role) and supporting compensation \& rewards processes (approx. 30% of the role). This is a hands\-on execution role rather than a people\-management role — the candidate will drive processes directly, working closely with HRBPs, managers, and Finance, without managing a team. The ideal candidate has hands\-on working experience with
 **Keka HRMS** 
 and brings strong process discipline, data accuracy, and stakeholder management skills to drive a fair, transparent, and well\-governed performance and rewards ecosystem.

**Performance Management (≈70%)**

* Working knowledge of compensation fundamentals — salary structuring, benchmarking, variable pay design, and increment/bonus cycles.
* Strong Excel/data analysis skills; comfort building dashboards and reports from HRIS data.
* Excellent stakeholder management — ability to work independently with managers, HRBPs, Finance, and leadership.
* High attention to detail and discretion in handling confidential compensation and performance data.
* Strong process orientation, ownership, and ability to manage multiple cycles/deadlines simultaneously, without relying on a team to execute.


**Good to Have**
* Prior experience in a listed/mid\-size organization with multi\-business\-unit structure.
* Exposure to designing or refining performance policies, competency frameworks, or reward programs.
* Experience preparing leadership/EXCO\-level dashboards and analytics.


**Qualification**
* Postgraduate in HR, Business Administration, or related field (MBA\-HR preferred).


**Awards Won By IRIS**
 Won recognition as Indias best Fintech at the Financial Express Best Banks Awards. an award that was presented to our CEO by Smt Nirmala Sitharaman, Finance Minister, Govt of India.
   

  

 IRIS has been selected as the Best Tax Technology Service Provider 2022 in category National Taxation Awards at the prestigious TIOL Awards.

description:
**Overview**
 CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. For this critical role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Mumbai.
