 We are looking for a passionate HR professional with advanced Excel skills, excellent comprehension and strong analytical depth — ideally with a background in Compensation \& Benefits or a COE analytics role — to join us as Manager, Compensation \& Benefits!
   

  

 As a Manager, Compensation \& Benefits, you will be the custodian of HR data. This is an individual contributor and hands on role. You will own the gathering, cleaning, collating and converting of data into accurate reports and dashboards for leaders and stakeholders within the organization, and go beyond reporting to independently analyse the data and deliver insight leaders can act on. You will play a pivotal role as the reports, dashboards and analysis you own will enable leaders to make informed \& data\-driven decisions that will shape the future of Human Resources at CACTUS! You will report to the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with stakeholders to understand the problem statement or objective, and independently shape the right analytical approach.
* Gather relevant data from various sources, databases, internal systems and combine data from multiple sources into a cohesive dataset using MS Excel.
* Bring compensation \& benefits context to HR analytics — support people cost, salary benchmarking and compensation revision cycle analysis with market and structural context from your COE background.
* Ask the right questions, comprehend and use advanced Excel techniques such as pivots, validation automation, formulas, macros among others to analyze \& interpret the data — going beyond the numbers to explain the 'why' behind the trends.
* Own the creation and continuous improvement of various reports and dashboards such as headcount \& attrition report, people cost reports, hiring \& ad\-hoc data reports etc.
* Independently draw meaningful conclusions from the analysis, summarize key insights \& recommendations, and partner with the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration to present these to leaders and stakeholders.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* Bachelors in any discipline; bachelor's in engineering or mathematics, statistics is preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in using advanced Excel techniques.
* Passionate about data with an affinity for numbers and metrics.
* 5–7 years of experience creating reports from scratch and analyzing HR\-related data, with prior experience in a Compensation \& Benefits function or COE strongly preferred.
* Excellent comprehension skills \& ability to ask the right questions, with a demonstrated track record of turning analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication skills, with experience presenting insights confidently to leadership and stakeholders.


 Application Process
   

  

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, you will have to work on an assessment followed by a virtual interview and lastly an in\-person interview at our Andheri East office.

 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**Accelerating from Anywhere**
 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
   

  

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.

title: Compensation Benefits Manager
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. For this critical role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Mumbai. You may choose to work from home in Mumbai; however, you will be required to frequently travel to our Andheri East office for business requirements, meetings, or company/team events.
We are looking for a passionate HR professional with advanced Excel skills, excellent comprehension and strong analytical depth — ideally with a background in Compensation \& Benefits or a COE analytics role — to join us as Manager, Compensation \& Benefits!
As a Manager, Compensation \& Benefits, you will be the custodian of HR data. This is an individual contributor and hands on role. You will own the gathering, cleaning, collating and converting of data into accurate reports and dashboards for leaders and stakeholders within the organization, and go beyond reporting to independently analyse the data and deliver insight leaders can act on. You will play a pivotal role as the reports, dashboards and analysis you own will enable leaders to make informed \& data\-driven decisions that will shape the future of Human Resources at CACTUS! You will report to the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration.
Job responsibilities:
* Partner with stakeholders to understand the problem statement or objective, and independently shape the right analytical approach.
* Gather relevant data from various sources, databases, internal systems and combine data from multiple sources into a cohesive dataset using MS Excel.
* Bring compensation \& benefits context to HR analytics — support people cost, salary benchmarking and compensation revision cycle analysis with market and structural context from your COE background.
* Ask the right questions, comprehend and use advanced Excel techniques such as pivots, validation automation, formulas, macros among others to analyze \& interpret the data — going beyond the numbers to explain the 'why' behind the trends.
* Own the creation and continuous improvement of various reports and dashboards such as headcount \& attrition report, people cost reports, hiring \& ad\-hoc data reports etc.
* Independently draw meaningful conclusions from the analysis, summarize key insights \& recommendations, and partner with the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration to present these to leaders and stakeholders.


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Bachelors in any discipline; bachelor's in engineering or mathematics, statistics is preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in using advanced Excel techniques.
* Passionate about data with an affinity for numbers and metrics.
* 5–7 years of experience creating reports from scratch and analyzing HR\-related data, with prior experience in a Compensation \& Benefits function or COE strongly preferred.
* Excellent comprehension skills \& ability to ask the right questions, with a demonstrated track record of turning analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication skills, with experience presenting insights confidently to leadership and stakeholders.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, you will have to work on an assessment followed by a virtual interview and lastly an in\-person interview at our Andheri East office.

**Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


About Us:

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment, strong relationship\-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.

* 3\+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field

description:

**About HummingBird** 




 HummingBird, an AI\-powered Total Talent Workforce Platform powered by LanceSoft, helps enterprises transform how they source, engage, manage, and optimize their workforce.
 



 Built for complex enterprise hiring environments, HummingBird brings together AI\-powered talent matching, workforce analytics, recruitment automation, and integrated talent management capabilities to support permanent, contingent, and Statement of Work (SOW) workforce programs.
 



 HummingBird is hiring on behalf of its client, a Fortune 500 company, for an experienced Contingent Workforce Program Manager based in Pune.
 








**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an accomplished Contingent Workforce Program Manager with 8–12 years of experience in managing enterprise contingent workforce programs, vendor ecosystems, workforce operations, and compliance frameworks.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Managed Service Provider (MSP) programs, Vendor Management Systems (VMS), contingent workforce governance, supplier management, workforce analytics, and cost optimization.
 



 This role will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end contingent workforce lifecycle, driving operational excellence, strengthening supplier partnerships, and ensuring workforce programs align with organizational objectives.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Contingent Workforce Strategy \& Program Management** 



* Develop and execute contingent workforce strategies aligned with enterprise workforce objectives.
* Manage end\-to\-end contingent workforce programs covering sourcing, onboarding, engagement, extensions, and offboarding.
* Establish scalable operating models for contingent labor management across business functions.
* Drive standardization of workforce processes, policies, and governance frameworks.
* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce requirements and optimize contingent talent utilization.



**2\. MSP \& VMS Management** 



* Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) relationships and program performance.
* Manage and optimize Vendor Management Systems (VMS) such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or equivalent platforms.
* Ensure effective requisition management, supplier distribution, candidate submissions, approvals, and onboarding workflows.
* Monitor MSP service delivery against established SLAs and KPIs.
* Identify opportunities for process automation and operational improvements.



**3\. Supplier \& Vendor Management** 



* Develop and manage a high\-performing contingent workforce supplier ecosystem.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews and establish measurable scorecards.
* Monitor supplier quality, responsiveness, fulfillment rates, and compliance.
* Support supplier selection, onboarding, contract negotiations, and performance improvement.
* Drive supplier rationalization and strategic vendor partnerships where appropriate.



**4\. Workforce Compliance \& Risk Management** 



* Ensure contingent workforce programs comply with applicable labor laws, contractual obligations, and enterprise policies.
* Establish governance for worker classification, tenure management, onboarding documentation, and offboarding.
* Collaborate with Legal, HR, Procurement, Finance, and Compliance teams to mitigate workforce\-related risks.
* Maintain appropriate audit trails, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support governance for Independent Contractors (IC), temporary workers, and SOW engagements.



**5\. Financial Management \& Cost Optimization** 



* Manage contingent workforce budgets, spend visibility, and cost\-control initiatives.
* Analyze labor rates, supplier markups, workforce utilization, and program expenditures.
* Develop rate\-card governance and support commercial negotiations.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings through supplier optimization, process improvements, and workforce planning.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.



**6\. Workforce Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Establish and monitor key contingent workforce metrics, including:
* Time\-to\-fill and requisition aging
* Supplier fulfillment and submission quality
* Contingent workforce spend
* Cost savings and cost avoidance
* Worker tenure and utilization
* Compliance adherence
* Hiring manager satisfaction
* MSP and supplier SLA performance
* Develop executive dashboards and management reports.
* Leverage workforce analytics to improve decision\-making and program effectiveness.



**7\. Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner with Procurement, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.
* Act as the primary point of contact for contingent workforce program operations.
* Facilitate governance meetings, supplier reviews, and program performance discussions.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on contingent workforce policies and processes.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external workforce partners.



**8\. Program Transformation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to enhance workforce program efficiency through automation, AI, and digital technologies.
* Support MSP/VMS implementation, migration, or optimization initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement across sourcing, onboarding, supplier management, and compliance.
* Contribute to Total Talent Management initiatives integrating permanent and contingent workforce strategies.








**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in Contingent Workforce Management, MSP Program Management, Workforce Operations, or Strategic Procurement.
* Proven experience managing enterprise\-scale contingent workforce programs.
* Strong understanding of MSP operating models and VMS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar workforce management systems.
* Experience managing staffing suppliers and vendor performance.
* Strong knowledge of contingent workforce compliance, worker classification, and contractual governance.
* Experience managing workforce spend, rate cards, supplier commercials, and program budgets.
* Strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.








**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working within a Fortune 500 company, global MNC, or large enterprise environment.
* Experience managing multi\-location or global contingent workforce programs.
* Exposure to Direct Sourcing, Independent Contractor Compliance, and SOW management.
* Experience implementing or transforming MSP/VMS programs.
* Familiarity with Total Talent Management and workforce planning.
* Experience using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
* Understanding of AI\-enabled workforce management and recruitment automation.








**Key Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic workforce planning
* Supplier relationship management
* Strong commercial and financial acumen
* Cross\-functional stakeholder engagement
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Risk management and compliance
* Program governance and operational excellence
* Change management and process transformation








**Why This Opportunity?** 



* Manage a strategic contingent workforce program for a Fortune 500 organization.
* Work with global stakeholders and enterprise workforce management teams.
* Gain exposure to large\-scale MSP, VMS, and Total Talent initiatives.
* Drive workforce transformation through AI, automation, and advanced analytics.
* Contribute to enterprise\-wide workforce efficiency, compliance, and cost optimization.

* Curious mindset, ability to work accurately and at pace with team members and stakeholders.
* Confident and excellent communication skills.
* Strong influencer.
* Reliable, dependable, accountable.
* Strong Team Player.
* Ambitious, intelligent and hard working individual.

 To investigate employee conduct exceptions, provide oversight \& advice and mitigate compliance risks. Help maintain a culture of employee integrity and compliance within the organisation through delivery of appropriate training and execution of controls.
   

  

**Accountabilities**

* Completion of task and exceptions from the following areas Breach Management \& Reward, Global Registrations (including the UK Senior Managers Regime), Conduct Rules, Mandatory Block Leave and Personal Investments \& Affiliations to ensure oversight of relevant Employee Conduct policy and standards.
* Development and implementation of controls related to employee conduct that aligns with regulatory requirements and Barclays’ risk appetite and industry best practices.
* Provision of advice and assistance across Barclays on matters that relating to employee conduct.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We're looking for a Recruitment Manager to take full ownership of day\-to\-day delivery. You'll lead our team leaders and recruiting team, run daily operations, manage client delivery, and make sure mandates convert into closures. This is a hands\-on role. You'll screen, guide and personally close senior mandates, not just supervise.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Team leadership and performance** 



* Lead the team leaders and recruiters: set daily and weekly targets for sourcing, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Track individual and team performance, spot gaps early, and coach, correct or escalate as needed.
* Run daily team operations: mandate allocation, prioritisation, and resolving day\-to\-day queries and blockers.
* Ensure every new mandate gets a first client submission within 48 hours of receipt.



  





**JD understanding and mandate briefing** 



* Break down client JDs into must\-haves, good\-to\-haves and deal\-breakers before sourcing starts.
* Brief the team on each mandate and review early submissions to correct misalignment quickly.



  





**2nd\-level screening and submissions** 



* Conduct or oversee L2 screening, personally handling senior and leadership roles.
* Ensure only quality\-checked profiles reach clients, with accurate candidate summaries and flagged gaps.



  





**Leadership hiring** 



* Personally handle department\-head, manager and senior mandates, including search, assessment, compensation discussions and closure.
* Manage offer negotiation and pre\-joining engagement to reduce dropouts.



  





**Client engagement** 



* Be the delivery point of contact for clients: requirement calls, feedback follow\-ups, interview coordination and escalations.
* Build client trust through fast TAT and relevant submissions.



  





**Reporting** 



* Own daily and weekly client reports and internal MIS: pipeline, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Keep ATS data accurate and current across the team.
* Share a weekly delivery review with the founder.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* 5\+ years in recruitment, with a significant portion at a recruitment agency or consulting firm. Corporate\-only HR/TA backgrounds will not be considered.
* Proven experience leading a team of 5\+ recruiters, or managing team leads, with measurable delivery outcomes.
* Demonstrated closures of leadership or senior roles, with examples you can walk us through.
* Strong JD\-analysis and screening judgement, going beyond keyword matching.
* Hands\-on with Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn sourcing, and at least one ATS.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets for reporting.
* Clear, confident communication with senior candidates and client stakeholders.



  





**REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS** 



* Own laptop, reliable high\-speed internet and power backup.
* Available during business hours \[confirm days/timings], and responsive on calls and team chat.
* Comfortable with daily output tracking and reporting.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Fixed pay plus uncapped closure\-based incentives.
* Full ownership of delivery, working directly with the founder.
* Fully remote role.

title: Workplace Service Delivery Assoc Manager
description:
**Job Description – Workplace Facility Management Associate Manager (CL\-8\)**
**Job Requisition ID** 
 :
   

  

**Job Title** 
 : Workplace Facility Management Associate Manager
   

  

**Management Level** 
 : CL – 8 (Associate Manager)
   

  

**Work Location** 
 : Pune
   

  

**Must have Skills** 
 : Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration
   

  

**Good to have Skills** 
 : Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PMP Certification
   

  

**Experience** 
 : Minimum 10 years of military experience with at least 2 \- 5 years of corporate IFM experience for Veterans/ Min 12 \- 15 years of experience in Facility management and administration for others.
   

  

**Educational Qualification** 
 : Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full time MBA or both would be an added advantage.
   

  

**Department** 
 : Corporate Function
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
**Integrated Facility management**
* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly /quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.


**Engineering and Technical Services**
* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.


**Statutory Compliance and Risks**
* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.


**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**
* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.


**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**
* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.


**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**
* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.


**Cafeteria Management**
* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.


**Team Management**
* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**
* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.


**Projects and Transitions**
* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.


**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word, working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.


**Additional Information:**
* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of Pune offices.

title: Lead - Security Architecture
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

Security Architect role is accountable for driving security initiatives for the organization. Under limited supervisions, you will work with a wide variety of business stakeholders and IT professionals (including different Security functions, Enterprise Architecture, Technology Infrastructure, and Cloud Engineering teams) to ensure organizational security needs/controls are aligned to support business goals and objectives.

  

* Define security functional requirements and non\-functional requirements to meet the business objectives of a solution
* Work with stakeholders in setting the technical direction, selection, and evaluating candidate security solutions
* Work with stakeholders to design and document the conceptual and detailed designs of security solutions
* Lead the development of security standards, reference architectures, patterns, and guidelines
* Assess effectiveness of security controls i.e. data protection, IAM, detective controls, infrastructure/network security, incident response. Work on
* identifying and driving implementation of appropriate controls, processes, and remediation of non\-compliance
* Research and advocate new technologies, architectures, and security products that will support security maturity roadmap
* Act as a subject matter expert for advisory, review and approval of security designs, configurations, baselines, and technical standards
* Create and review threat models using various approaches such as off the shelf tools, whiteboarding etc.
* Good to have hands on Microsoft Threat Model and SD Element or any other open source threat modelling tools
* Interfaces frequently with information security industry groups to stay abreast of emerging security trends
* Helps establish overall enterprise information security architecture (EISA) by aligning business processes, IT software and hardware, local and wide area networks, people, operations, and projects with the organization’s overall security strategy
* Evaluates proposals to determine if proposed security solutions effectively address enterprise requirements, as detailed in solicitation documents
* Interprets and/or approves security requirements relative to the capabilities of new information technologies.
* Good understanding of AI and emerging technologies. Which includes GAI, Deep Learning, Guardrails, etc..

 **Work Experience / Knowledge**:

  

* 10\+ years’ IT experience with 6\+ years focused on security and solution architecture
* 3\+ years’ experience with cloud delivery platforms IaaS/PaaS/SaaS and providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft
* Experience leading enterprise\-wide security initiatives, including architecture and implementation of various security solutions \& processes
* Ability to engage with senior leaders to define requirements and communicate effectively the results and risks
* Expert in 1 or more technology domains – infrastructure, application, network, IAM, data, endpoint
* Experience working with enterprise architecture practice and methodology, with security focus.
* Experience authoring security standards, reference architectures, patterns, and guidelines
* Knowledge of or experience with industry security controls frameworks such as NIST, CSA CCM, CIS Critical Security Controls.
* Hands\-on experience in Cloud (Microsoft Azure/GCP/AWS ) security architecture, security engineering, or equivalent experience with vendor specific cloud certification.

 **Qualifications:**

* BE/Btech degree and relevant work experience is required
* 8\-10 years of experience in software development, information security and architecture design \& controls
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or equivalent
* Preferred \- certified in an enterprise architecture methodology and framework like TOGAF or SABSA
* Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Certified Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK), or preferred vendor certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform
* In\-depth knowledge and understanding of OWASP Top 10 and CWE Top 25 with experience in assessment and providing remediation strategies

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Assistant Director of Human Resources
description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26122494  

**Job Category**Human Resources  

**Location**Golf Course Square, Airport Road, Yerwada, Pune Mahar 411006, India  

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N  

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**


Assists the Director of Human Resources in executing strategies that serve to attract, retain, and develop diverse premiere talent. Position directs and works with human resource employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Department, including recruitment, total compensation, employee relations, and training and development. Executes against objectives outlined in the Human Resources Business Plan and delivers services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success. Ensures compliance with applicable regulations and Standard Operating Procedures.


**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**


**Managing the Staffing and Recruiting Process**


* Ensures open positions are advertised in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Ensures the open position listing is in a visible location for both internal and external candidates.


* Works with Employment Administrator to establish and maintain contact with external recruitment sources (e.g., state job service, local colleges, recruiting agencies, and community based organizations).


* Networks with local organization and peers to source candidates for current or future openings (e.g., Hotel Association).


* Facilitates interdepartmental transfers and promotions and transfers or promotions to other properties within this property brand.


* Oversees the selection and offer processes for hourly employees to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection are documented, applicants receive status notifications).


* Partners with department managers and recruiting professionals to recruit management positions, make hiring decisions and negotiate job offers in accordance with SOPs.


**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures compliance with key policies (e.g., Sexual Harassment, Non\-Harassment, Non\-Discrimination, No Solicitation).


* Ensures interviews are conducted according to recommended guidelines, consistent screening criteria is used, and only job\-related questions are asked.


* Ensures wages are paid in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures and federal and state laws (e.g., employee pay for meeting attendance, wages limited to maximum rate of pay, entry level rates paid to new hires, overtime provisions in place, separation pay).


* Ensures drug screening and background checks are completed in accordance with brand's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Managing Benefits Education and Administration**


* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and costs management.


* Educates employees on benefits package.


* Educates HR team on the various types of benefits available and eligibility requirements.


* Provides an overview of employee benefits to the management team enabling them to educate their employees and answer routine questions.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee benefits.


**Managing and Conducting Staff Development Activities**


* Ensures hourly performance appraisal processes are in place.


* Assists in identifying key drivers of employee satisfaction and supports managers in addressing issues with written plans and actions.


* Coaches managers on progressive discipline process.


* Ensures development plans are in place (e.g., goals documented, progress towards goal achievement is measured).


**Managing Employee Relations and Human Resources Communication**


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to address employee problems or concerns in a timely manner.


* Ensures effective employee communication channels are established and active in.


* Analyzes accident trends and reports these trends to the management team.


* Monitors work environment for signs of union organization.

  


*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non\-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*
At more than 100 award\-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz\-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.  




  

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.
  

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz\-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz\-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. title: Senior Database Administrator, SQL Server
description:
**Overview**The SQL DBA is responsible for providing end\-to\-end production support across the application lifecycle, collaborating with development, infrastructure, testing, and production teams. The role involves managing and maintaining SQL Server database environments across both IaaS and PaaS platforms, ensuring development and testing databases are current and aligned with production standards. Key responsibilities include performance tuning, database optimization, troubleshooting, routine maintenance, health checks, and investigation of production issues. The SQL DBA will also conduct peer reviews, enforce database development and coding standards, and contribute to automation initiatives within a DevOps\-driven environment to support continuous improvement and operational excellence.  

  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**Strategic Focus
* The SQL DBA will provide support and assistance to the wider Data Services team across multiple database technologies, contributing to the effective day\-to\-day operation of business\-as\-usual (BAU) activities.
* The role is responsible for ensuring data integrity, maintaining the availability and reliability of database services, and delivering high\-quality support to business\-critical processes.

Operational Management
  

* Provide operational support and drive continuous improvement across the SQL Server estate, including Development, Test (System, Load, Performance, and UAT), and Production environments.
* Ensure automation, process efficiency, and appropriate tooling (including code/branch management, deployment, and configuration management) are utilised to reduce cycle times and improve the reliability, auditability, and traceability of system deployments across multiple applications.
* Ensure that processes, best practices, and database build standards are consistently applied, maintained, and continuously improved.
* Perform database health checks, manage backups, and implement DBA best practices to maintain database performance, availability, and reliability.
* Define and apply development and code\-merging processes and methodologies to software and systems, minimising risks to Production environments resulting from poor code management practices.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to ensure Development teams have the appropriate environments, tools, and automation required to maximise productivity and remove operational obstacles.
* Protect Production environments through effective governance, best practices, sound design principles, and fit\-for\-purpose environments across the delivery lifecycle, supporting project and change activities.
* Ensure project and change releases are packaged to the required quality standards, are repeatable across environments without modification, and are deployed successfully to target environments, including Production, within agreed timescales.
* Identify and address weaknesses in processes, technology, and service delivery through a culture of continuous improvement, while engaging and collaborating with process managers and key stakeholders.
People Leadership
* Provide training and knowledge transfer to IT support teams on supported tools, technologies, and environments to ensure effective system support and operational continuity.
Governance \& Risk
* Provide strong governance over the management of and access to live data within environments where required (including Client Data Take\-Up activities), ensuring that data obfuscation practices and technologies are implemented and consistently maintained.
* Ensure software, systems, and processes are accurately documented to prevent single points of knowledge, promote knowledge sharing, and distribute skills effectively across the team and wider department.
* Ensure software deliverables and artefacts associated with projects and change initiatives are progressed effectively, providing accurate status reporting and updates to Line Managers, Project Managers, and Change Managers as required.
**Experience \& Personal Attributes*** Demonstrable knowledge of database administration (design, installation \& troubleshooting) of current MS SQL Server and Windows Server Enterprise platforms
* 8\+ years of relevant work experience
* Comprehensive knowledge and experience of Current Microsoft SQL Server versions, IaaS and PaaS
* Proven knowledge and experience of Database Mirroring, Log Shipping, Clustering, Availability Groups, Transactional Replication, ETL
* Database performance and optimisation experience
* Experience working with automation deployment tools.
* Ability to develop and implement data security guidelines while making data available to those authorised to have access
* Ability to ensure the technical integrity of corporate databases by protecting against the loss or misuse of information and designing backup/recovery strategies
* Ability to database design, implementation and performance tune
* Experience in automated testing of all database releases
* Experience in support for all database releases.
* Experience of supporting large scale critical production databases
Personal Attributes
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with global teams and stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with strong technical and programming capabilities.
* Ability to manage and prioritise workloads effectively, working independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively within cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and professional development.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure, balancing competing priorities and delivering timely outcomes.
* Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability to meet changing business and operational requirements.

  
MUFG Pension \& Market Services is a global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly.

description:

 :
**What you'll do:** **Information Protection Analyst** in the **Enterprise** will…  

We are seeking a highly motivated Information Protection Analyst to support the day\-to\-day operations of our Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) programs. The role will focus on managing Zscaler DLP operations, BigID data discovery activities, incident investigations, policy tuning, compliance reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives to protect sensitive enterprise data across endpoints, cloud environments, and SaaS applications.


This position is ideal for candidates with 2 to 5 years of experience in Cybersecurity Operations/ Data Protection /SOC environments / EDR controls who are looking to further their expertise with enterprise\-scale security controls.

 **What you'll do:**

* Contribute to the implementation of new information protection capabilities, security awareness initiatives, and process improvement programs.
* Monitor, investigate, and respond to DLP, Insider Threat, and data security incidents across enterprise environments.
* Analyze alerts, identify true positives and false positives, and investigate potential data exfiltration activities.
* Support the end\-to\-end lifecycle of DLP policies, including testing, tuning, deployment, validation, and exception management.
* Perform data discovery, classification, and risk assessment activities using DSPM platforms such as BigID.
* Onboard and manage data sources across cloud, SaaS, and enterprise platforms including AWS, Azure, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint.
* Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, HR, and business teams to drive incident response and remediation activities.
* Prepare operational dashboards, compliance reports, audit evidence, KPIs, and executive metrics.


**What you’ll bring:*** Relevant certifications such as Security\+, CySA\+, SC\-401, Zscaler Data Security certifications, or BigID certifications are a plus.
* 2\-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity Operations, Data Protection, SOC, Insider Threat, EDR, or Information Security environments.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, incident response, endpoint security, ransomware/breach investigations, and Data Loss Prevention concepts.
* Hands\-on experience or exposure to tools such as Zscaler DLP, Microsoft Purview, BigID, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Sentinel, and ServiceNow.
* Experience with data discovery, classification, security monitoring, cloud security, and compliance\-related activities.
* Ability to analyze security incidents, coordinate cross\-functional investigations, and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience with Microsoft Insider Risk Management, DLP administration, security automation, or workflow tools is highly preferred.
* Fluency in English
* Client\-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem\-solving approach


 :

* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities

With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working.  1–3 years

 Up to ₹4 LPA

 Full\-time \| On\-site

 Minimalist Hotels is a series of design\-forward hybrid hotels that blend community\-style living with hotel\-style amenities for young, urban and creative travellers.
 



 Operating
 **10 hotels across India** 
 in Delhi, Varanasi, Goa and Udaipur, Minimalist has welcomed
 **5,00,000\+ guests from 50\+ countries** 
 since 2017\.

 **Goa and Jaipur** 
 , we are continuing to build a hospitality brand around

 We are looking for a
 **Human Resources Executive**

 **South Delhi**

 This is a
 **hands\-on, people\-facing role** 
 for someone who enjoys working closely with employees, department heads and hotel leadership.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring that we have the right people, the right processes and the right culture in place — from hiring and onboarding to employee engagement, performance, documentation and compliance.
 



 You will work closely with the Hotel General Manager and department heads across
 **Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Sales \& other hotel functions.**

* Support managers in handling employee issues, conflicts and disciplinary matters.

* Identify employee concerns early and escalate critical matters appropriately.


**5\. Performance \& People Development** 
* Support department heads with performance reviews and employee feedback.
* Track probation confirmations and performance improvement plans.
* Coordinate employee training and development initiatives.
* Help build a culture of accountability, ownership and continuous learning.


**6\. Culture \& Employee Engagement** 
* Bring the
 **Minimalist culture** 
 alive at the property.
* Organise employee engagement activities, celebrations and team initiatives.
* Improve employee communication and participation.
* Help create an environment where people feel valued, heard and motivated.


**7\. Compliance** 
* Ensure adherence to applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain required HR documentation and registers.
* Coordinate with external consultants / management wherever required for statutory compliance.
* Ensure hotel HR practices are aligned with company policies.

 , preferably in hotels, hospitality, restaurants, retail or another service\-oriented business.
* Strong understanding of
 **HR operations, recruitment and employee relations** 
 .
* Comfortable working with frontline employees and large operational teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with maturity and confidentiality.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic hospitality environment.
* Good working knowledge of
 **MS Excel, Google Workspace and HR systems** 
 .
* A Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration or a related field is preferred.


**Most importantly…** 

 We are looking for someone who is
 **people\-first, energetic, approachable and hands\-on.** 




 Someone who doesn’t want to sit in an HR office all day, but wants to
 **walk the hotel, know the team, understand what’s happening on the ground and solve problems.** 




 At Minimalist, HR is not just about attendance, payroll and paperwork.
 



**It is about building the team that builds the hotel.** 



**Why Join Minimalist?** 
* Work with one of India’s emerging independent hospitality brands.
* Be part of a young, creative and entrepreneurial environment.
* Exposure to multiple functions across
 **hospitality, F\&B, events, culture and community** 
 .
* Opportunity to grow with a rapidly expanding hotel company.
* Work closely with hotel leadership and department heads.
* Be part of a company where
 **people and culture are central to the business.**



**Location:** 
 South Delhi
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time \| On\-site
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹4 LPA, depending on experience and fit
 


**To Apply** 

 Send your CV along with a brief note on

 .

They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in\-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.
   

  

 A Senior Director possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via in\-person and virtual meetings, sales support visits, Gartner conferences and industry events. This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. This group is dedicated to tracking the transformation of the HR function — evolution of the HR functional structure, HR roles, and HR technology strategy — and advising Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders. Senior Directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must\-have” insights offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) focusing on HR functional transformation, HR strategic planning, and HR technology strategy and use cases.
* Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act.
* Develop in\-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
* Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts
* Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
* Deliver individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs and other senior HR leaders through video\-based presentations and discussions
* Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
* Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
* Provide high quality and timely content peer review
* Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
* Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
* Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
* Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
* Be client\-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions


**What you will need:**

+ Experience successfully designing and leading HR functional transformations.
+ Knowledge of the HR technology landscape, including market dynamics and vendors, particularly with respect to AI, and their impact on HR strategies and workflows.

* Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
* Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
* Strong communicator who is able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
* Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small\-scale speaking engagements
* Strong business and financial acumen
* Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

* Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

title: Senior Consultant - Business Consulting PI - GOV - CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - New Delhi
description:
Requisition Id: 1739968
   

  

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
   

  

**The opportunity** 
 : Senior Consultant\-GOV\-Business Consulting PI\-CNS \- BC \- Transformation Delivery \- New Delhi
   

  

**GOV :**
 Our Global Government \& Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best\-in\-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
   

  

 Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
   

  

 To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re\-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross\-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
   

  

 We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head\-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
   

  

**CNS \- BC \- Transformation Delivery :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large\-scale program and portfolio management.
   

  

 It has multiple fields of play such as:
   

  

 Finance Consulting \- helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
   

  

 Business Transformation \- a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem\-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi\-year, multi\-stakeholder transformation programs.
   

  

 Supply Chain and Operations \- we provide a unique combination of industry\-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* \- Support planning, implementation and monitoring of skill development projects. \- Coordinate with Government departments, training partners, industries and other stakeholders. \- Prepare project reports, concept notes, presentations, policy briefs and review documents. \- Track project progress against targets, timelines and deliverables. \- Support development of skilling strategies, operational guidelines and implementation frameworks. \- Conduct field visits and monitor training centres, institutions and project activities. \- Facilitate industry partnerships, placements, apprenticeships and employer engagement activities. \- Support curriculum development, assessment, certification and quality assurance processes. \- Organize workshops, consultations, training programs and stakeholder meetings. \- Manage MIS, data analysis, dashboards and reporting requirements. \- Support capacity building of government officials, institutions and training providers. \- Identify risks, implementation challenges and recommend corrective actions.


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor of Commerce
* Bachelor of Business Administration
* Master of Commerce
* Master of Business Administration
* Post Graduate Diploma in Management
* PG Diploma in Human Resource Management


**Experience**
* Project Management (6\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
   

  

 EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
   

  

 If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Vice President-Skill Development
description:
About the Role
 
 Valeur Fabtex Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and strategic
 **Vice President – Skill Development** 
 to lead and scale its skill development vertical across India. The role will be responsible for driving business growth, project delivery, government and institutional partnerships, operational excellence, and overall P\&L performance of the Skill Development business.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Business \& Strategic Leadership** 



* Develop and execute the overall strategy for the Skill Development vertical.
* Identify new business opportunities across government, CSR, institutional, and private\-sector projects.
* Drive revenue growth, profitability, and sustainable expansion of the vertical.
* Develop annual operating plans, budgets, business targets, and growth strategies.



**2\. Government \& Institutional Projects** 



* Lead large\-scale government and skill development projects at the national and state levels.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Ministries, Government Departments, State Missions, Sector Skill Councils, NSDC, corporates, and other stakeholders.
* Identify and participate in relevant tenders, RFPs, EOI opportunities, and strategic partnerships.
* Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, and project requirements.



**3\. Operations \& Project Delivery** 



* Provide strategic direction to project and operations teams across multiple states.
* Monitor project performance, manpower deployment, centre operations, training quality, placements, and project milestones.
* Establish strong systems for MIS, dashboards, KPIs, review mechanisms, and performance monitoring.
* Ensure timely delivery and successful closure of projects.



**4\. Team Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor senior leadership and project teams.
* Build a high\-performance culture across the Skill Development vertical.
* Develop organizational structures, KRAs, KPIs, and performance management systems.
* Strengthen leadership capabilities and succession planning within the vertical.



**5\. Partnerships \& Business Development** 



* Develop strategic partnerships with corporates, training organizations, educational institutions, Sector Skill Councils, NGOs, and government bodies.
* Represent the organization in industry forums, conferences, meetings, and stakeholder discussions.
* Strengthen the company's brand and positioning in the Skill Development ecosystem.



**6\. Financial \& P\&L Management** 



* Own the financial performance of the Skill Development vertical.
* Monitor revenue, project margins, operational costs, and profitability.
* Work closely with Finance and senior management on budgeting, forecasting, and financial controls.



**7\. Quality, Compliance \& Governance** 



* Ensure adherence to applicable government guidelines, project SOPs, quality standards, and statutory requirements.
* Establish quality assurance mechanisms across training centres and projects.
* Monitor audits, assessments, certifications, placements, and other project deliverables.

title: Associate - People Success (AI Analyst)
description:
**Job Role: Associate \- People Success (AI Analyst)** 




  





**About the role:** 
 We are throwing out the traditional HR playbook. We don't need administrators; we need builders, system thinkers, and problem solvers.
 



  





 As a People Success Associate (AI Native), you won't be doing routine coordination or organizing meaningless fun activities. You will work directly with the Head of HR on high\-leverage strategic projects, core process automations, and building systems that enable a high\-performing organization. If you view this world as a tech product, this role is for you. Think of it as a Founder's Office/AI Analyst role in the HR function.
 



  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* AI\-Native \& Tech\-First Mindset: You don't just use ChatGPT for writing emails. You know how to build workflows, leverage API tools, or vibe\-code custom internal scripts/apps.
* High Emotional Intelligence (EQ): You understand human dynamics, motivations, and organizational friction deeply.
* Analytical Muscle: You think in logic trees, metrics, and systems, not just gut feelings.
* Relentless Problem\-Solving: You get genuine joy out of fixing broken processes and making teams wildly efficient.



  





**You should not apply if you:** 



* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks
* Are uncomfortable working with data, numbers, or analytical problem\-solving
* Are not willing to collaborate with cross\-functional teams



  





**Skills Required:** 
 AI Native, Product Manager mindset, High EQ
 



  





**What will you do?** 




  




* **Process Automation:** 
 Audit existing HR workflows (onboarding, performance loops, internal communications) and automate them using no\-code, low\-code, or vibe coding tools.
* **People Analytics:** 
 Dive into team metrics, attrition signals, and performance data to extract actionable insights\- not just passive reports.
* **Strategic Projects:** 
 Support the Head of HR in designing incentive structures, organizational design, and talent strategy.
* **AI Integration:** 
 Experiment with, and deploy AI agents/workflows to streamline candidate sourcing, internal query resolution, and policy navigation.
* **HRBP Responsibilities** 
 : Drive people success as HRBP and work on strategic enablement for the workforce
* **Performance Management** 
 : Drive PMS with the Head of HR



  





**Working days:** 
 Monday \- Friday
 



**Location:** 
 Golf Course Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from office)
 



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life’s best work. As a part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that’s revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun, and a place of a unique growth opportunity. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will be feeling appreciated and valued for the work you delivered. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers uptill now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute towards further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





 Nutrabay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, colour, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, political affiliation, race, ethnicity, religion or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.
