* Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value\-realization frameworks.
* Advise boards and C\-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise\-scale change.


**Experience Design**
* Map end\-to\-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
* Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
* Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock\-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
* Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.


**Operating Model \& Process Transformation**
* Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store \& workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
* Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact\-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
* Establish governance frameworks — policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.


**Technology \& AI Transformation**
* Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
* Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
* Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) — intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
* Integrate across order, store and supply\-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS\-enabled field and delivery tracking.
* Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root\-cause analysis capability.


**Human \+ Agentic Operations**
* Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
* Design agents for high\-volume service capabilities — order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
* Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
* Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.


**Enterprise Transformation Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
* Orchestrate multi\-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
* Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.


**Practice Building**
* Develop market\-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
* Coach and mentor consulting teams.
* Support business development and strategic pursuits — collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Song’s Consulting, Technology and Data \& AI teams for delivery.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end\-to\-end value chain — merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in\-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last\-mile fulfilment — and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
* First\-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory\-only) — having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
* Proven track record across service strategy \& advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology \& AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
* Hands\-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery\-exception handling; substitutions, out\-of\-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse\-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi\-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
* Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase\-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score\-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account\-management workflows.
* Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in\-store fulfilment; store\-to\-contact\-centre escalation and case hand\-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
* Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed\-delivery, missed\-slot and delivery\-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns\-to\-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last\-mile SLAs, on\-time performance and partner score\-carding.
* Working knowledge of core retail service processes — order\-to\-delivery, returns \& refunds, complaint \& case management, store\-to\-contact\-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution — with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end\-to\-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
* Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM \& CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge \& case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS\-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root\-cause analytics).
* Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity — reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy \& business rules, approvals \& escalation, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, SLAs \& entitlements, privacy \& consent, security \& access, compliance \& audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics \& bias controls, and data quality \& traceability).
* Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes — customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality \& productivity (first\-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost\-to\-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability \& resilience (in\-stock rate, on\-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
* Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.


**Additional Information**
* Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large\-scale programmes delivered end\-to\-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
* Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.

title: Specialty Sales Manager, Benign General Surgery
description:
**Company Description**
 It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
 **Intuitive** 
 . As a global leader in
 **robotic\-assisted surgery** 
 and
 **minimally invasive care** 
 , our technologies—like the
 **da Vinci surgical system** 
 and
 **Ion** 
 —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
   

  

 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
   

  

 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
   

  

 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
 **transform the future of healthcare** 
 , you’ll find your purpose here.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
 The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in identifying, developing, and expanding adoption of da Vinci procedures in Benign General Surgery across South \+ West India. Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.
   

  

 This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. It combines clinical selling, market development, surgeon pathway execution, customer value creation, and cross\-functional program leadership. The SSM will work through the local commercial organization and directly engage priority customers where specialist expertise is required.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedure Utilization
* Develop and execute the India specialty strategy for Benign General Surgery, aligned with regional priorities and commercial objectives.
* Identify and prioritize procedure growth opportunities, including hernia repair, cholecystectomy, and other relevant benign general surgery procedures within the specialty.
* Apply established da Vinci adoption and procedure readiness methodologies in assigned specialties, territories, and target accounts.
* Analyze procedure, surgeon, account, and market trends to prioritize opportunities, address adoption barriers, and guide field execution.
* Partner with local Clinical Sales and Capital Sales teams to develop account\-specific plans that increase utilization of installed systems and create future system opportunities.
* Lead strategic market development activities that build awareness, clinical confidence, and sustainable procedure adoption.
* Convert High\-Volume Laparoscopy Centers into da Vinci Programs
* Identify and prioritize high\-volume laparoscopic centers in Benign General Surgery that have the clinical leadership, procedure volume, infrastructure, and strategic intent to build a robotic surgery program.
* Develop conversion strategies that articulate the clinical, operational, and economic value of da Vinci surgery to surgeons, hospital executives, and other decision\-makers.
* Partner with Capital Sales, Clinical Sales, Key Accounts, and hospital stakeholders to help qualified high\-volume laparoscopic centers procure a da Vinci system and establish a sustainable program.
* Support the complete program\-building journey, including opportunity assessment, executive alignment, surgeon onboarding, care\-team readiness, initial case\-series support, patient pathway development, and post\-launch growth planning.
* Develop Surgeons, KOLs, and Centers of Excellence
* Identify and develop surgeon champions and Key Opinion Leaders for priority procedures in partnership with Marketing and Professional Education.
* Create development plans for high\-potential surgeons from initial adoption through sustainable utilization, advanced procedure adoption, teaching capability, and peer influence.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to establish suitable case observation sites, proctors, training centers, and peer\-learning platforms.
* Coordinate appropriate case observation, on\-site support, simulation or laboratory learning, advanced training, and peer\-to\-peer education in accordance with approved processes.
* Bring relevant clinical and workflow value during the initial surgeon case series and support continuous improvement as experience develops.
* Develop and lead regional specialty education and market development programs that can scale adoption.
* Build Clinical, Operational, and Economic Value
* Work with surgeon champions, care teams, and internal partners to identify and develop credible clinical, operational, and economic value evidence.
* Understand customer success measures within the operating room and across the patient pathway, and translate them into account\-specific value discussions.
* Partner with relevant internal functions to develop value\-focused steering committees, executive reviews, and customer action plans.
* Conduct hospital, department, and practice executive presentations that support informed decision\-making and program expansion.
* Use approved evidence, customer data, and value tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.
* Elevate Specialty Sales Competency
* Coach, counsel, and train Clinical Sales representatives and managers on Benign General Surgery anatomy, procedure pathways, customer needs, clinical value, and consultative selling approaches.
* Provide field feedback that strengthens representatives’ ability to engage Benign General Surgery specialists and position applicable advanced technologies.
* Identify area\-level capability gaps and coordinate competency\-building programs with Clinical Sales Directors and other relevant leaders.
* Create practical field tools, talk tracks, account\-planning guidance, and best\-practice sharing to improve execution consistency.
* Model high\-quality clinical selling and influence through joint field visits, customer engagements, and opportunity reviews.
* Lead Cross\-Functional Initiatives and Market Intelligence
* Serve as the market intelligence liaison for Sales, Marketing, Professional Education, and Training teams by providing timely insights on customers, competitors, procedure trends, adoption barriers, and unmet needs.
* Leverage specialty resources to support scalable launches of new procedures, products, advanced technologies, and customer programs.
* Align with Sales Leadership and Marketing on surgeon training resources, training effectiveness, procedure volume outcomes, and advanced technology adoption.
* Collaborate effectively in a complex matrix organization and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Responsibly manage company resources and budgets to support strategies with the strongest commercial and customer impact.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of plans, activities, opportunities, and outcomes in approved company systems.


**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**
* Minimum 8 years of relevant medical device, surgical, clinical sales, or healthcare market\-development experience.
* Proven track record of individual sales excellence and successful introduction or adoption of new technologies.
* Strong clinical selling capability and the ability to build credibility with surgeons, hospital executives, and highly educated customer groups.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, prioritize opportunities, and deliver results in an environment of change.
* Proven ability to influence peers and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Effective communication and presentation skills across a broad organization and diverse customer audiences.
* Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret market, procedure, surgeon, and account trends.
* Knowledge of the operating room environment and a solid clinical foundation to understand healthcare value.
* Ability and willingness to travel extensively across India, including overnight travel, based on business needs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in one or more Indian languages is advantageous.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification required.

title: Senior Product Manager (Finance and Account Management)
description:
**About Easyship:** 




  





 Easyship is a leading global shipping software and API platform
 
 trusted by 100,000\+ eCommerce merchants to compare couriers, automate fulfilment, and simplify cross\-border shipping, taxes and duties. A top\-rated Shopify Certified Technology Provider, eBay preferred fulfilment partner, and Amazon preferred multi\-channel integrator, Easyship is the G2 category leader (April 2026\), offering 550\+ courier services worldwide. We believe in accelerating borderless commerce through innovative solutions, and we're proud that brands of all sizes from small business to enterprise trust Easyship for all their shipping needs.
 



  





**Who we’re looking for:** 




  





 Easyship is a shipping technology platform that connects sellers and marketplaces to couriers. Beyond that, we also build and execute customized end\-to\-end shipping solutions for clients worldwide. These Logistics solutions can combine a number of partners and services, from global freight forwarding services to last\-mile delivery.
 



 We’re looking for an experienced Project manager with good knowledge of ecommerce shipping, warehousing \& fulfillment to oversee the delivery of these projects for our clients. Own part of the Easyship product by defining solutions in line with the product vision and strategy, coordinating with the design and engineering teams, in order to constantly create value for our users.
 



  





**What you additionally need to know:** 




  





 This is a full\-time, onsite role based in our Bengaluru (MG Road) office. The role follows UK collaboration hours (11:00AM–8:00PM IST) to support seamless cross\-regional execution.
 



  





**What you would be responsible for:** 




  




* Owning the product strategy and roadmap for two squads:
 *Finance* 
 (payments, billing, invoicing, fees and reconciliation) and
 *Account Management* 
 (account lifecycle, verification, fraud and risk), with every roadmap item tied to a measurable business outcome.
* Reducing the cost of taking payments: shape payment method mix (e.g. Pay by Bank), multi\-currency settlement, payment provider migrations across regions, and systematically root\-cause and reduce payment failures, disputes and chargebacks.
* Growing revenue from the finance surface: fee and pricing structures, processing fees on chargeable items, reconciliation of taxes and duties adjustments, and accurate VAT/GST invoicing across every region we operate in.
* Owning the end\-to\-end account lifecycle, from sign\-up and verification to user roles, team permissions, account settings and closure, so that genuine customers get through with minimal friction and bad actors do not.
* Defining and evolving fraud and risk controls across onboarding and payments, balancing loss prevention against conversion, in close partnership with Finance, Customer Experience and Compliance.
* Partnering with Finance and Accounting, Customer Experience, Sales, Legal and Engineering to deliver scalable solutions, and act as the single product point of contact for anything touching money or accounts.
* Establishing, monitoring and reporting on success metrics such as transaction cost as a percentage of GMV, payment success rate, dispute rate, revenue leakage, fraud losses, onboarding conversion and account\-related support volume.
* Prioritising ruthlessly across two squads: define the MVP, ship quickly, measure success or failure, and iterate.
* Authoring and reviewing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and Opportunity Assessments that clearly document trade\-offs, edge cases, compliance and data considerations before they go to engineering.
* Using AI tools hands\-on in your own product workflow (discovery, analysis, PRD writing, data accuracy checks) and help raise the bar on AI adoption across the product team.
* Acting as a senior voice in the PM team, raising the quality bar on PRDs and mentoring less experienced PMs.



  





**You Might Be a Good Fit If…** 




  




* You have 7\+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years owning payments, billing or fintech products in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or eCommerce.
* You have hands\-on experience with payment service providers (e.g. Stripe, Adyen), local payment methods, multi\-currency settlement, disputes and chargebacks, and payment reconciliation.
* You have knowledge of account and identity products: KYC/KYB, role\-based access control, and fraud detection or risk\-scoring tooling.
* You have an understanding of tax invoicing (VAT/GST) and the basics of revenue accounting, with a track record of working closely with Finance teams.
* You have proven ability to move business metrics such as cost, revenue and loss rates, with examples you can quantify.
* You have experience running more than one engineering squad or roadmap in parallel without losing depth on either.
* You have strong analytical skills; comfortable pulling and interpreting data yourself (SQL or equivalent).
* You have clear, structured written communication and the confidence to push back on engineering, stakeholders and leadership with evidence.
* You have practical, demonstrable use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day product work.
* You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or related field preferred.



  





 If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.
 



  





**What we bring to the table as an employer:** 




  




* Generous remuneration and stock units
* Competitive health coverage
* We reimburse gym and wellness expenses so you can invest in your health
* Zomato digital meal credits and pantry full of wholesome snacks to keep you fueled through the workday
* The freedom to‘Work from Anywhere’ for 4 weeks in a year
* Generous vacation policy, plus duvet days and mental health days to truly recharge



  





**How we value inclusion in our recruitment practices:** 




  





 Easyship is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions—recruiting, hiring, pay, benefits, training, promotion, leave, and separation—based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, veteran or military status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Ariba Guided Buying Specialist (Indirect Procurement)
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/
**Job Description:**

Job Description: **Ariba Guided Buying Specialist (Indirect Procurement)**

  

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

3M Healthcare underwent a corporate spin\-off leading to the creation of a new company named **Solventum** .


At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.


We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.  



  

**Role Overview**

The **Ariba Guided Buying, Commerce Automation, and P2O Specialist** is responsible for enabling, supporting, and continuously improving Solventum’s indirect procurement technology landscape across SAP Ariba Guided Buying, Commerce Automation, SAP Business Network, P2O, SAP S/4HANA, catalog management, and related integrations. This role combines functional process knowledge, system configuration, customization, supplier and catalog enablement, incident management, and hands\-on troubleshooting to deliver a compliant, user\-friendly, and reliable purchasing experience.  



  

**The Impact You’ll Make in This Role**

As an Ariba Guided Buying, Commerce Automation, and P2O Specialist, you will help strengthen Solventum’s Source\-to\-Pay operations by:


* Serving as a functional and technical support specialist for **Ariba Guided Buying** , **Commerce Automation** , **P2O** , and SAP S/4HANA procurement integration processes.
* Supporting end\-to\-end buying processes from guided requisition creation through purchase order transmission, supplier response, confirmation, shipping notice, invoicing, and exception handling.
* Enabling and maintaining **catalogs, punchout sites, supplier content, buying channels, forms, landing pages, tiles, policies, and guided buying rules** to improve usability and compliance.
* Providing configuration, customization, testing, and release support for Guided Buying, Commerce Automation, catalog management, and P2O enhancements.
* Troubleshooting requisition, purchase order, supplier network, catalog, approval, integration, and transaction failures across Ariba, SAP Business Network, middleware, and SAP S/4HANA.
* Partnering with Procurement, Category Managers, Finance, IT, GBS partners, suppliers, and support teams to resolve issues, improve buying channels, and support business continuity.
* Participating in requirements gathering, solution design, UAT, regression testing, deployment, hypercare, and post\-go\-live stabilization for procurement technology changes.
Ensuring procurement processes, configurations, and support activities align with internal controls, compliance expectations, audit readiness, and operational service levels.  
* 

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary support and process specialist for **Ariba Guided Buying** , **Commerce Automation** , **P2O** , SAP Business Network, and related SAP S/4HANA procurement integrations.
* Configure, maintain, and support Guided Buying functionality including landing pages, tiles, forms, policies, buying channels, approval guidance, non\-catalog buying, and user experience improvements.
* Support catalog management activities including hosted catalogs, punchout catalogs, supplier content updates, catalog validation, commodity/category alignment, catalog troubleshooting, and content lifecycle coordination.
* Enable and support Commerce Automation and SAP Business Network transaction flows such as purchase orders, order confirmations, ship notices, receipt\-related processes, invoices, and supplier collaboration exceptions.
* Investigate and resolve P2O and integration issues involving requisitions, purchase orders, approvals, supplier routing, failed messages, master data, catalog content, and transaction status mismatches between Ariba and SAP S/4HANA.
* Partner with Category Managers, Procurement, Finance, IT, integration teams, suppliers, and external support providers to translate business needs into practical system configuration or enhancement solutions.
* Perform root\-cause analysis, document issue resolution steps, maintain support knowledge articles, and identify recurring defects or process gaps for continuous improvement.
* Support customization, enhancement intake, impact assessment, testing, deployment planning, hypercare, and steady\-state support for procurement technology changes.
* Participate in design workshops, requirement reviews, configuration validation, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, and release readiness activities.
Ensure process documentation, configuration decisions, and support actions are traceable, compliant with procurement controls, and suitable for audit or operational review.  
* 

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

To set you up for success from day one, Solventum requires:


* Bachelor’s Degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university; **OR**
* High School Diploma/GED with a minimum of **8–10 years of experience** in procurement operations, procurement technology, ERP support, or related IT/business process roles.
* **5\+ years of experience** in Source\-to\-Pay, P2O, indirect procurement, catalog buying, supplier enablement, procurement operations, or related business process support.
* Hands\-on experience supporting **SAP Ariba Guided Buying** , **Commerce Automation** , **SAP Business Network** , and integration with SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience troubleshooting procurement transactions, catalog issues, supplier network exceptions, approval or routing issues, and master\-data\-related purchasing errors.
* Experience implementing, configuring, customizing, or supporting **SAP Ariba Guided Buying** , **Ariba Buying and Invoicing** , **Commerce Automation** , or **SAP Business Network** .
* Strong understanding of P2O and indirect procurement process flows, including requisitioning, approvals, purchase order creation, supplier transmission, confirmations, goods or service receipt, invoicing, and exception management.
* Knowledge of catalog management practices, including hosted catalogs, punchout catalogs, supplier content validation, category mapping, catalog refresh cycles, and catalog issue resolution.
* Familiarity with Ariba\-to\-SAP S/4HANA integration concepts, supplier network transaction routing, middleware monitoring, message failure analysis, and end\-to\-end transaction traceability.
Experience supporting ERP or Ariba deployments, transformation initiatives, release management, cutover planning, data validation, and post\-go\-live stabilization.  
* 

  

**Additional Qualifications (Preferred)**

* Ability to perform structured troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, defect triage, and knowledge documentation for recurring support issues.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills across functional, technical, business, supplier, and support teams.
Awareness of emerging trends in digital procurement, guided buying, supplier collaboration, automation, and user\-centered buying experiences.  
* 

  

**Work Location**

* **Bangalore (Hybrid)**

**Travel**

* May include up to **10–15% domestic or international travel** , as needed.

title: Software Engineering Professional
description:
Req ID: 62972
Job Function: Software Engineering
Posting Start Date: 22/09/2026
Posting End Date: 24/09/2026
Division: Digital
Job Location: IND\-Bengaluru\-RMZ Ecoworld
Advertised Salary: Competitive
**Recruiter: Sowmya Reddy**

**Hiring Manager: Tanmoy Sen**

**Career Grade: E**

**About the role**
------------------

The Software Engineer Professional is a hands‑on software engineer who delivers high‑quality software as part of a small, outcome‑focused pod of typically 4–5 engineers. The role operates in an AI‑native delivery model, where AI tools and agents are used across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce manual effort.

  

Unlike traditional engineering roles, the Pod Engineer is expected to work with AI as a core delivery partner, using AI tools for requirements understanding, design exploration, code generation, testing, documentation, and optimisation—while remaining accountable for correctness, security, and production readiness.


**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**1\) Hands‑On Software Delivery**

* Design, build, test, and deploy software components as part of a delivery pod.
* Contribute production‑quality code across backend, frontend, APIs, or integration layers, depending on the pod’s scope.
* Own features end‑to‑end—from understanding requirements through to deployment and support.
  

**2\) AI‑Enabled SDLC Execution**

* Use AI tools and assistants across delivery stages to:
* Accelerate understanding of requirements and acceptance criteria
* Generate and refine code safely
* Create and maintain automated tests
* Support documentation and release artefacts
* Apply judgment to validate AI‑generated outputs, ensuring correctness, maintainability, and security.
* Continuously improve personal and pod‑level productivity through effective AI usage.
  

**3\) Engineering Quality \& Standards**

* Write clean, maintainable, well‑tested code aligned to agreed engineering standards.
* Participate actively in code reviews, pair programming, and design discussions.
* Follow secure coding practices and ensure solutions meet performance, reliability, and resilience expectations.
  

**4\) Pod Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Pod Lead Engineer and other Pod Engineers to deliver outcomes as a cohesive unit.
* Contribute to daily planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the pod.
  

**5\) Learning \& Capability Development**

* Continuously develop skills in modern software engineering and AI‑assisted development techniques.
* Adopt and share good practices for prompt design, AI evaluation, and safe AI usage.
* Stay current with emerging tools, frameworks, and patterns relevant to AI‑enabled engineering.
  

**6\) Governance, Risk \& Responsible Engineering**

* Adhere to security, data protection, and governance requirements.
* Flag risks, defects, or concerns early—especially those introduced by AI‑assisted development.
* Ensure delivery artefacts are complete, auditable, and fit for production use.
* What Makes This Role Different from a Traditional Software Engineer
* You work in small, high‑impact pods, not large project teams.
* AI is used by default across the SDLC, not occasionally.
* Success is measured by outcomes, quality, and speed, not just code output.
* You are expected to think critically about AI outputs, not blindly accept them.
**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Strong experience as a software engineer delivering production systems.
* Solid foundations in software engineering fundamentals: data structures, APIs, testing, CI/CD, and debugging.
* Proven expertise in Java, Python along with UI and backend technologies like React, PostgreSQL, Neptune DB.
* Strong credentials in Cloud environments like AWS.
* Experience working in Agile / iterative delivery environments.
* Practical exposure to AI‑assisted development tools (e.g. Copilot, Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, automated testing, AI‑supported documentation).
* Possess B. Tech or B.E. degree in Computer Science or related field.
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience working in small squads or pods with shared ownership of outcomes.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and modern delivery pipelines.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI to improve how software is built.
  

**Success Measures (What Good Looks Like)**

* High‑quality features delivered on time as part of a dev team.
* Effective and responsible use of AI to improve productivity and quality.
* Clean, well‑tested, and maintainable code in production.
* Positive contribution to pod collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Growing proficiency in AI‑native engineering practices.

description:

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Role Title:** R\&D IAC Operations and Communication Manager

**Level:** P2

**Location:** IAC, Bangalore

**Reports to:** R\&D Site Lead

**Role Summary**


This role is a strategic partner and force multiplier to the R\&D Site Lead \& Lead Team, operating at the center of site leadership rather than in support of it. This role is responsible for translating global \& site strategy into tangible action, culture \& communication at Elanco Innovation \& Alliance Center (IAC). This role is responsible for serving as the chief of operations and communications for the local site. The person in this role serves as a trusted extension of the R\&D Lead Team, representing the office in forums where sound judgment, discretion, and credibility are essential. The Site Operations role not only provides administrative and coordination support but also helps advance key site priorities through a focus on leadership effectiveness, strategic alignment, and organizational health advancing global initiatives and translating them at the ground level in consultation with the local R\&D Lead Team.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Partner with the leadership team and enable the site's strategic planning and prioritization efforts by facilitating discussions, tracking key initiatives, and helping ensure leadership attention is directed toward critical priorities

title: Senior Product Support Engineer
description:
**Senior Product Support Engineer**
Development \+ Technical Support**Experience:** 5–7 years**Function:** Product Engineering / Customer Success**Employment type:** Full\-time**Location:** \[Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote]**Reports to:** \[Manager, Technical Support / Head of Engineering]**About the role**
==================


This is a hybrid engineering and support role for someone who is equally comfortable debugging a customer’s production issue and writing the code that stops it happening again.
You will be the senior technical escalation point for our product across heterogeneous customer environments Windows, Linux and Solaris, integrated with enterprise Active Directory, SIEM platforms and a range of network infrastructure. Roughly half your time will be spent on deep troubleshooting and customer\-facing escalation; the other half on building fixes, tooling, integrations and automation that reduce future ticket volume.
We are looking for someone who treats a recurring support ticket as a defect to be engineered away, not a queue to be worked through.**What you will do**
====================

**Troubleshooting and escalation**
----------------------------------

* Own Level 3 escalations end to endreproduce, diagnose root cause, and drive to resolution across OS, network, database and application layers
* Analyse logs, packet captures, stack traces, core dumps and performance counters to isolate faults in complex multi\-vendor environments
* Diagnose issues spanning customer infrastructure boundaries: authentication, directory services, firewalls, proxies, certificates and network policy
* Work directly with customer IT, security and infrastructure teams, including during high\-severity incidents
* Produce clear root cause analysis documents for customer and internal audiences

**Development**
---------------

* Build and ship fixes, patches and product improvements in C\# and Python
* Develop diagnostic tooling, log analysers, health\-check scripts and automated reproduction harnesses
* Write and optimise SQL for investigation, data correction and performance analysis
* Build and maintain customer\-facing integrationsActive Directory, SIEM connectors, APIs and data pipelines
* Contribute to product hardening: instrumentation, logging quality, error handling and observability

**Deployment and integration**
------------------------------

* Support installation, upgrade and configuration of the product across Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Solaris
* Configure and troubleshoot Active Directory / LDAP integration, Kerberos, SSO and certificate\-based authentication
* Integrate product telemetry and event data with customer SIEM platforms
* Support cloud and hybrid deployments, including containerised environments

**Knowledge and enablement**
----------------------------

* Maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides
* Mentor junior support engineers and act as a technical reviewer on complex tickets
* Feed recurring issues and field insight back into the product roadmap

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

**Experience**
--------------

* 5–7 years in a combined engineering and technical support capacity, supporting an enterprise software product deployed in customer environments
* Demonstrable history of resolving complex, cross\-system production issues

**Operating systems**
---------------------

* Strong administration and troubleshooting on Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) systemd, journald, permissions, process and resource analysis, package management
* Windows Server administration — services, Event Viewer, registry, PowerShell, IIS, performance monitoring
* Working knowledge of Solaris or another commercial UNIX in a legacy enterprise context
* Shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell)

**Identity and security**
-------------------------

* Hands\-on Active Directory integration: LDAP/LDAPS, Kerberos, group policy, service accounts, delegation, trusts
* Experience integrating applications with SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent) — log forwarding, syslog, CEF/LEEF, event normalisation
* Practical understanding of TLS/PKI, certificate management and common certificate failure modes

**Networking**
--------------

* Solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, NAT, firewalls, load balancers and proxies
* Ability to read and interpret packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump) to isolate connectivity and latency issues

**Development**
---------------

* Proficient in C\# / .NET
* Proficient in Python for automation, tooling and data processing
* Comfortable with Git, code review and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read unfamiliar production code and trace a fault to its source

**Database**
------------

* Strong SQL against at least one of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL
* Query performance analysis, indexing, execution plans, backup/restore, and basic administration

**Cloud**
---------

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) — compute, networking, identity, storage and managed database services
* Familiarity with containerised deployment (Docker; Kubernetes an advantage)
* Understanding of hybrid architectures where product components span on\-premises and cloud

**Desirable**
=============

* Experience with email infrastructure and protocolsIMAP, SMTP, Exchange/EWS, Microsoft Graph
* Exposure to machine learning or classification systems in a production support context
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and observability tooling (Grafana, ELK, Prometheus)
* Certifications: RHCE/RHCSA, Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Security\+
* Experience supporting regulated customers — financial services, healthcare or public sector
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, problem and change management

**What we look for beyond the checklist**
=========================================

* **Structured diagnostic thinking.** You form hypotheses and test them rather than changing settings until something works.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** Enterprise environments are undocumented and inconsistent; you find your own way in.
* **Customer\-grade communication.** You can explain a Kerberos delegation failure to a CISO and to a junior admin, correctly, in the same afternoon.
* **Composure under pressure.** You are calm and credible on a Severity 1 bridge call.
* **A bias toward permanent fixes.** You are more interested in the third occurrence never happening than in closing the ticket quickly.

description:

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18805 **Date posted** 09/21/2026

* Influence the direction of Synopsys memory characterization and simulation products based on real\-world customer requirements and deployment feedback
* Build long\-term technical relationships with memory design and CAD teams at top\-tier semiconductor companies worldwide
* Expand Synopsys footprint in memory characterization by winning competitive evaluations and driving migrations from alternative toolsets
* Contribute to the development of industry best practices and reference flows that raise the bar for memory characterization quality and efficiency

### **What You'll Need**

* **Characterization Tool Expertise**
Experience with one or more of the following:
	+ PrimeLib ,
	+ Siliconsmart,
	+ LiberateMX,
	+ Solido

Experience with:

	+ CustomSim
	+ Spectre
	+ NanoTime
	+ PrimeTime

* **Advanced Modeling \& Library Views**
Knowledge of:

	+ Variation\-aware characterization methodologies

* **Additional Experience**
	+ Advanced node characterization and validation
	+ Memory compiler qualification and deployment
	+ High\-capacity simulation methodologies

title: Mgr, Solutions Architect
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

The Amazon Web Services (AWS) AI Engineering Team, within the Cloud and AI Innovation Team (CAIT), partners with customers to design and build better products faster using AI and reimagining software development lifecycle. AI Engineers collaborate with AWS Sales and other AWS teams to help address customer business challenges and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.  

  

\*\*\*The Role\*\*\*  

We are seeking a Manager, AI Engineering to lead a team of AI Engineers. In this role, you will hire, develop, and inspire a high\-performing team of customer\-facing developers and architects who help enterprises architect and deploy different systems to production using AI. You will serve as a technically credible executive sponsor to strategic customers, holding AI strategy conversations grounded in real architectural understanding with CAIOs, CTOs, and VPs of Engineering at Fortune 500 companies.  

  

Beyond direct customer engagement, you will drive Thought Leadership in the generative AI and agentic systems space, publishing guidance, frameworks, and best practices that shape how the broader AWS field engages with customers on AI. You will also lead Advancing the Organization initiatives, partnering with AWS engineering and product teams — including Bedrock, Kiro, Quick — to translate customer signals and field feedback into actionable product improvements. You will create and run programs that enable the field to execute at scale, turning lessons learned from individual customer engagements into repeatable patterns and scalable assets.  

  

This role requires a leader who can operate fluidly between deeply technical implementation conversations and executive\-level AI strategy discussions. You must earn the trust of Senior AI Engineers through demonstrated architectural fluency and sound technical judgment, while simultaneously building credibility with service teams, organizational leadership, and customer executives. The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of technical depth, people leadership, and organizational influence — someone who knows which problems matter, which patterns will scale, and how to build a team that delivers outsized impact.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, develop, and retain a world\-class team of Applied AI Architects, fostering a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and continuous learning.
* Set the technical vision and strategic direction for the Applied AI Architecture practice worldwide, ensuring the team's guidance and best practices evolve with the rapidly changing generative AI landscape.
* Serve as a technically credible executive sponsor to strategic customers, engaging directly with C\-level technology leaders on AI strategy, production architecture, and business outcome realization.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with AWS service and product teams, establishing feedback loops that translate field insights into product improvements and roadmap influence.
* Drive Thought Leadership through publications, frameworks, and speaking engagements that position AWS as the leader in production generative AI and agentic systems.
* Create scalable programs, tools, and enablement assets that help the broader AWS field execute generative AI engagements with customers at scale.
* Navigate ambiguity in a fast\-moving technical domain, making directional decisions with incomplete information while building mechanisms to course\-correct.
* Represent the voice of the customer internally, synthesizing patterns across engagements to inform organizational strategy and investment priorities.

  

About the team  

AI Engineering is a global team within the Solutions Architect organization focused on helping customers build and use AI agents. We operate at the frontier of AI, bridging foundation models and production systems through direct customer engagements, open\-source accelerators, and close collaboration with AWS service teams. We split time between hands\-on customer work and creating assets that scale. The role combines engineering, advisory work, and product influence. We maintain high standards while operating with speed, and we stay grounded in customer outcomes. Built for tinkerers who ship production code and thrive in ambiguity.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

* 10\+ years of technical engineering experience
* 5\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 10\+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience

* Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

title: Sr SW Engineer: I5
description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

  

Visa's Corporate IT (CIT) organization is on a transformational journey to redefine how enterprise technology enables global business scale, resilience, and employee productivity. We are moving beyond traditional infrastructure models toward software\-defined, automated, cloud\-integrated platforms that deliver security, reliability, and exceptional user experience at global scale.


As part of this journey, the candidate will join a platform engineering team as a backend and systems\-focused engineer, designing, developing, and implementing cross\-platform client software and large\-scale back\-end microservices. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience building solutions for functionally complex, large\-volume, high\-throughput, data\-centric distributed systems, with strong hands\-on depth in Go and Java.


The successful candidate is expected to be a design, coding, and configuration expert, and will help advance the engineering craft of the team related to architecture, distributed\-systems design, code quality, scalability, resiliency, and CI/CD.


The candidate should enjoy working on diverse technologies and functionally complex, data\-centric distributed applications, should be excited to take initiatives to solve complex systems problems, and get the job done while taking on new challenges. You should thrive in team\-oriented, fast\-paced environments where each team member is vital to the overall success of the projects.

**Key responsibilities**:

**Primary**:

* Design, build, and maintain a cross\-platform agent/plugin in Go (Golang).
* Design and build back\-end microservices and APIs in Java / Spring Boot with a high level of scalability, resiliency, and monitoring.
* Build and operate an Apache Kafka–based streaming pipeline (producers/consumers), including partitioning, consumer groups, and delivery/lag management, across an Active/Active multi–data\-center topology.
* Containerize and deploy services using Docker and Kubernetes, and help define deployment, scaling, and operational patterns.
* Work with data stores — ClickHouse (or an equivalent columnar/analytical store), PostgreSQL, and Redis — including schema/data\-model design and building efficient queries.
* Design and build GenAI\-powered features and integrations — e.g., natural\-language interfaces, LLM\-assisted workflows, and agentic automation — integrating with LLM APIs and tooling.
* Contribute to the React front end as needed (secondary to back\-end/agent work) and collaborate with UI\-focused engineers on API contracts.
* Manage complex, multi\-service dependencies across environments and data centers.
* Work with business partners, TPMs, and Product Managers to drive user\-story grooming, functional/technical specifications, workflow designs, and use cases.
* Contribute to and help shape engineering best practices for the team.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, conduct POCs to prove concepts, and select the best solution approach.
* Work with limited direction within a complex distributed environment to drive delivery of solutions and meet service levels.
* Must be self\-motivated with the ability to work in a fast\-paced agile delivery model, collaborating with effective communication, quality, integrity, and reliable delivery.


This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**:

* 2\+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, OR 5\+ years of relevant work Experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**:

* 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
* 5 or more years of relevant experience in application development (designing, coding, and testing), with strong hands\-on depth in back\-end and systems programming.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or another Engineering discipline.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Go (Golang), building cross\-platform plugins/agents.
* Solid experience in core Java and Spring Boot, building production back\-end services; multithreaded/concurrent and high\-throughput processing experience is important.
* Hands\-on experience with Apache Kafka (producers/consumers, partitioning, consumer groups, offsets/lag, delivery semantics).
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes — building, containerizing, deploying, and operating services.
* Solid experience with microservices architecture and distributed\-systems design — service decomposition, inter\-service communication (REST/messaging), statelessness, fault tolerance, and designing for scalability, high availability, and multi–data\-center (Active/Active) operation.
* Demonstrated knowledge of RDBMS and SQL, with hands\-on PostgreSQL experience; ability to build complex queries from a solid understanding of the data model.
* Experience with ClickHouse or an equivalent columnar / analytical database (or willingness to ramp quickly), and with Redis for caching.
* Experience building GenAI / LLM integrations — working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and/or agent/tool (function\-calling, MCP) integrations — and applying them to real product features.
* Experience configuring CI/CD pipelines using industry\-standard tools such as Git and Jenkins.
* Working knowledge of a modern JavaScript framework (React preferred).
* A fast learner and quick adapter — able to ramp rapidly on new technologies, domains, and unfamiliar codebases, and to be productive with limited direction.
* Enjoy working fast and smart, and able to grasp complex concepts and build algorithms from scratch.
* Proficiency with Agile development techniques.
* Strong interpersonal, facilitation, and communication (written and verbal) skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly.
* Ability to work in a complex organization to determine business and customer needs and provide the best solution.
* Candidate must be able to proficiently multi\-task, with a strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams.

title: Infrastructure SME network automation
description:

You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  

  

What you will do

Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise infrastructure, and emerging technologies while pursuing certifications and advancing toward senior technical leadership roles.  
* 

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.


Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with other  



  

Required skills and experience
  

  

* Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System

  

Preferred skills and experience  

  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: MIS Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. MIS Executive
  
Account Management – Work Dynamics (Country, Region)
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

**Job Overview:**  

We are seeking a skilled and proactive MIS Executive to join our Facility Management team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining information systems that support and enhance our facility management operations. This role requires a unique blend of IT expertise and understanding of facility management processes to ensure seamless integration of technology in our day\-to\-day operations, data\-driven decision making, and improved operational efficiency.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Develop and implement MIS strategies aligned with facility management goals and objectives. Oversee the selection, implementation, and maintenance of facility management information systems, including CAFM (Computer\-Aided Facility Management) and CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software. Ensure the integrity, security, and reliability of facility\-related data and information systems. Collaborate with facility managers and other stakeholders to identify information needs and develop appropriate solutions. Design and implement dashboards and reporting tools to provide real\-time insights into facility performance metrics. Manage the integration of various facility management systems, including BMS (Building Management Systems), access control, and energy management systems. Develop and maintain databases for asset management, maintenance schedules, and space utilization. Provide training and support to facility management staff on the use of MIS tools and systems. Analyze data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement in facility management operations. Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and company policies regarding information security. Coordinate with IT department to ensure alignment of facility management systems with overall IT infrastructure. Manage vendor relationships for facility management software and related IT services. Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends in facility management IT solutions. Develop and manage the budget for facility management IT projects and systems. Provide regular reports to senior management on the performance and impact of facility management information systems.
  
  

**Qualifications:**  

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. An additional degree or certification in Facility Management is a plus. 5\+ years of experience in IT roles, with at least 3 years of experience in facility management or related field. Strong knowledge of facility management software, including CAFM and CMMS systems. Experience with database management, data analysis, and reporting tools. Familiarity with BMS, IoT technologies, and their application in smart buildings. Understanding of facility management processes and best practices. Experience in project management, particularly in IT implementation projects. Knowledge of data security and protection regulations.
  
  

**Key Competencies:**  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal Ability to translate complex technical concepts into layman's terms Strategic thinking and planning abilities Strong leadership and team collaboration skills Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies Attention to detail and accuracy in data management Customer service orientation Time management and ability to prioritize multiple projects
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to have:**  

Proven industry experience
  
Are you a degree holder with three to five years’ experience in facilities management? Do you have a solid background in helpdesk operations and strong working knowledge of occupational safety? Do you have a proven track record in rolling out improvement initiatives? If you said yes to all these, then we encourage you to apply.
  
  

Collaborative mind set
  
At JLL, we believe that collaboration plays a central role in achieving success—that’s why you must demonstrate flexibility in working with a team. Likewise, you must possess a customer\-centric focus and superior organisational skills to manage daily activities effectively. You must also be equipped with excellent communication skills to coordinate effectively with colleagues and clients.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  

Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. title: Advisory Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 The Advisory Account Manager (AAM) is a dual\-mandate, portfolio\-owning role. Unlike a traditional CSM or a pure hunter\-AM, the AAM operates as a trusted advisor across the full customer lifecycle — responsible simultaneously for protecting Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and driving Net Expansion through upsell and cross\-sell. This is a digital\-first, high\-velocity motion that blends proactive advisory engagement with a disciplined, data\-driven approach to identifying both risk and opportunity across the assigned book.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own an assigned portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, accountable for both renewal/retention (GRR) and expansion outcomes across the book.
* Proactively engage customers using the tiered digital engagement model (tech\-touch, low\-touch, and 1:many plays based on segment and risk/opportunity signal).
* Build and execute account\-level Customer Success Plans that identify whitespace for upsell/cross\-sell and flag early indicators of churn or contraction risk.
* Run consultative value conversations with key stakeholders — demonstrating ROI, product adoption gains, and business outcomes tied to the Freshworks suite.
* Drive expansion revenue through upsell (higher tiers, additional seats) and cross\-sell (adjacent Freshworks products) to meet or exceed a blended revenue target.
* Identify at\-risk accounts early using health scores, usage data, and engagement signals; build and execute save plans in partnership with Support, Billing, and Deal Desk.
* Maintain deep product fluency across the Freshworks suite to run demos, map use cases, and recommend the best\-fit solution for a customer's problem.
* Use the customer success platform to track account health, adoption metrics, and pipeline, and to report portfolio status on a defined cadence.
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Renewals, Sales, Support, and Product Marketing to remove friction across the customer journey.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene for both the expansion and renewal book.
* Adhere to Freshworks compliance and information security processes in all customer\-facing activity.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent attainment against a blended quota comprising Net Expansion (upsell/cross\-sell bookings) and Gross Revenue Retention (renewal/anti\-churn).
* Improving product adoption and account health scores across the assigned portfolio.
* A portfolio where expansion is proactively sourced — not just reactive to inbound demand — while renewal risk is caught and mitigated well ahead of the renewal date.


**Qualifications**
* 3–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or SaaS sales, with direct experience carrying both a retention and an expansion/upsell number.
* Demonstrated track record of account growth (upsell/cross\-sell) alongside strong renewal/retention performance — not one at the expense of the other.
* Consultative approach: comfortable building business cases, ROI narratives, and stakeholder\-mapped account plans.
* Experience managing a digital\-first portfolio at scale, using tech\-touch and low\-touch cadences alongside targeted 1:1 engagement.
* Working knowledge of SaaS retention/expansion metrics — GRR, NRR, churn, expansion ARR, adoption.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical/product concepts for varying stakeholder levels (ESSENTIAL).
* Comfort working with CRM and customer success tooling for health scoring, forecasting, and reporting.
* Self\-starter, organized, and able to prioritize across a large book without losing attention to at\-risk or high\-potential accounts.


 Bachelor's degree required; Business or Computer Science background preferred
   

  

**Additional Information**
 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

description:

Our AI\-powered Demand Side Platform (DSP) connects the world's most ambitious marketers with their ideal audiences across the open internet, delivering results that actually move the needle. Since 2006, we've been the industry's trailblazer, launching the first AI\-powered measurement platform for publishers and the first AI\-driven DSP. **About The Role**
 We are hiring an Associate Account Manager to join our Chennai team. In this role, you will own the success of a portfolio of SMB and long\-tail customer accounts while partnering with Field Account Managers to provide operational support to strategic Tier 1 customers.
   

  

 As a client\-facing account manager, you will combine programmatic advertising expertise, operational excellence, analytical thinking, and strong relationship management skills to deliver measurable customer outcomes and build long\-term partnerships.
   

  

 What You'll Do

* Partner with cross\-functional teams throughout the campaign lifecycle, supporting setup, launch and QA while owning client communication, performance reporting, optimization recommendations, troubleshooting and overall campaign success.
* Analyze campaign performance, pacing, targeting, creative and measurement insights to identify optimization opportunities.

 Who You Are
   

  

* 2–4 years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic advertising, account management, customer success, campaign management with demonstrated working experience directly with Clients, Advertisers, Brands, Agencies or external stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of campaign management, optimization, reporting, and digital measurement.
* Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with leading DSPs including DV360, The Trade Desk (TTD), Amazon DSP, StackAdapt, Simpli.fi and other programmatic platforms. Working knowledge of Floodlight tags, tracking pixels, Google Tag Manager (GTM), conversion tracking and GA4 measurement solutions preferred.


 At Quantcast, we craft offers that reflect your unique skills, expertise, and geographic location.
