 Across many parts of India, patients still face significant barriers to accessing innovative therapies, particularly in specialty and rare disease areas. Awareness gaps, fragmented healthcare infrastructure, and affordability challenges often delay access to treatments that could significantly improve outcomes.
 



 At FarmaMondo, our mission is to close this gap by bringing innovative specialty medicines to markets where they are needed most. As we continue to expand in India, we are looking for an entrepreneurial
 **Area Commercial Manager – Tamil Nadu and Kerala** 
 who can help build our presence from the ground up, drive commercial growth, and establish strong partnerships with healthcare stakeholders across the region.
 



  





**About FarmaMondo** 




 FarmaMondo is a fast\-growing Swiss pharmaceutical group focused on improving access to specialty medicines in emerging markets.
 



 Through our unique model combining market access expertise with commercialization capabilities, we work to ensure that both licensed and unlicensed therapies reach patients in countries where treatment options are limited.
 



 India is a key strategic market for our growth, and South India represents an important hub for specialty healthcare institutions and centers of excellence.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Area Commercial Manager –** 
 Tamilnadu and Kerala will be responsible for building and expanding FarmaMondo’s commercial footprint across the region covering states of
 **Tamil Nadu and Kerala.** 
 Based in
 **Chennai** 
 , this role will lead regional Access strategy, develop key hospital partnerships, manage communication with patients \& care givers and facilitate access of FarmaMondo’s specialty portfolio.
 



 This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role within innovative MNC environment, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-growing environment and enjoys building new markets, creating opportunities, and shaping strategy on the ground.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





*Drive Regional Growth* 



* Implement the commercial Access strategy for South India, identifying opportunities to expand FarmaMondo’s specialty portfolio.
* Deliver strong patient access objectives through focused engagement with key hospitals and specialty centers.
* Ensure consistent execution of commercial plans and field activities.



  





*Build Strategic Relationships* 



* Establish trusted partnerships with KOLs, hospital administrators, procurement teams, and specialty physicians.
* Strengthen FarmaMondo’s presence in leading hospitals and centers of excellence across South India.
* Support scientific and commercial engagement initiatives that increase awareness of innovative therapies.



  





*Identify New Opportunities* 



* Analyze market dynamics and patient flows, funding options for access
* Provide insights from the field to support India strategy, market access initiatives, and future portfolio expansion.



  





*Collaborate Across the Organization* 



* Work closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability and successful commercialization.
* Contribute regional insights that help shape FarmaMondo’s India growth strategy.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Around 10 years of specialty pharmaceutical commercial experience in the territory in MNC
* Strong understanding of hospital\-based and specialty medicine markets.
* Proven ability to build markets, grow accounts, and lead teams in dynamic environments.
* Experience engaging with KOLs and major hospital networks.

* Entrepreneurial and comfortable building things from the ground up.

* Passionate about improving patient access to innovative therapies.

 Marklytics builds Digital Product Passport (DPP), product traceability, LCA, and regulatory compliance platforms for global manufacturers.

 You'll manage day\-to\-day delivery of client programmes, from kickoff to go\-live. * PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, or an equivalent certification.

description:

------------------------------------

Valmet´s Pulp, Energy and Circularity business area provides technologies and solutions for pulp and energy production and biomass conversion. * Good project management skill in executing projects globally
* Solid leadership and team management skills
* Good influencing and interpersonal skills with ability to drive change.
* Good expertise and experience in EPC/EPS global projects execution in multinational and matrix organization.
* Financial mindset, contract and claim management skills
* Effective communication and presentation skills in English
Travel according to business needs  
* 

  

**To succeed in this role:**
----------------------------

  

Success in this role requires proven experience leading complex customer delivery projects, balancing technical, commercial, and financial priorities while maintaining strong customer relationships. You bring solid expertise in project execution, contract and claim management, risk mitigation, and leading cross\-functional teams in a global environment. Your ability to drive accountability, influence stakeholders, and deliver results through collaboration will be critical.


We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:


* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value  
* 

  

**We offer**
------------

At Valmet, you will have the opportunity to work in an international and collaborative environment where your expertise directly contributes to customer success and business growth. We offer modern tools, learning opportunities, and challenging projects that support your professional development. You'll work alongside experienced professionals while contributing to projects that help customers improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainability.  



  

**Want to know more?**
----------------------

*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. The Delivery Manager, VSSE\-IT Systems Engineering, is responsible for leading the delivery and operational performance of technology solutions supporting Ford’s vehicle software and systems engineering. The role oversees PLM and Teamcenter capabilities, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, DevOps, application development, and AI/ML\-enabled engineering tools. This role will develop high\-performing teams, establish delivery priorities, manage strategic technology initiatives, and ensure solutions meet organizational standards for security, quality, reliability, scalability, and business value.


* Lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of VSSE\-IT software platforms, modeling ecosystems, and engineering data capabilities.


* Define and execute technology roadmaps supporting systems engineering, digital engineering, product development, traceability, collaboration, and enterprise data integration.


* Provide technical leadership for Siemens Teamcenter customization tools such as VSEM, IVS and PLM integrations, including product structures, bills of materials, requirements management, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, release processes, and configuration management.

* Guide the delivery of secure, scalable, and high\-performance applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript, Angular or React, RESTful APIs, databases, and GCP cloud\-native services.


* Establish and improve DevOps practices, including Kubernetes/OpenShift, containerization, Jenkins or Tekton, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure automation.


* Advance AI/ML\-enabled engineering capabilities through the integration of LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, analytics platforms, AI APIs, and intelligent modeling workflows.


* Partner with Siemens Product Development to address core product issues and coordinate the development and delivery of customer\-specific patches and fixes.


* Collaborate with product owners, systems engineers, architects, PLM teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to prioritize delivery, manage risks, and conduct architecture and production\-readiness reviews.


* Promote engineering excellence through Agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, code reviews, quality practices, performance management, and continuous process improvement.


* Ensure VSSE\-IT solutions meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, data quality, traceability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and user adoption.


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.


* At least 10 years of progressive experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, technology delivery, or a related field.


* At least 5 years of experience with Product Lifecycle Management platforms, including PLM customization, integrations, product structures, bills of materials, requirements, workflows, change management, release processes, and configuration management.


* At least 3 years of experience in people management, engineering management, delivery leadership, or a comparable technical leadership role.


* Demonstrated success leading the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise software products and platforms using Agile, Scrum, or other iterative development methodologies.


* Strong technical experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, Python, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React.


* Experience designing, deploying, and supporting cloud\-native applications using GCP, OpenShift or Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, Tekton or Jenkins, and Terraform.


* Experience leading PLM integrations with engineering, MBSE, ERP, requirements management, or enterprise data systems using REST, SOA, ITK, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or comparable technologies.


* Experience with data platforms, analytics solutions, AI/ML initiatives, or engineering data integration programs. Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and TensorFlow is a plus.


* Proven ability to establish technical direction, manage delivery risks, improve engineering processes, and deliver secure, reliable, production\-ready solutions.


* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, decision\-making, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.


* Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high\-performing teams and partner effectively with engineering, product, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, PLM, and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, Teamcenter X, 3DEXPERIENCE, or comparable PLM platforms.
* Knowledge of PLM data models, product structures, BOMs, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, and configuration management.
* Experience with PLM integrations, migrations, APIs, customization, and enterprise engineering systems.
* Familiarity with MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler, Teamwork Cloud, SysML, Codebeamer, VIATRA, or similar MBSE tools.
* Knowledge of automotive product development, systems engineering, digital engineering, or regulated environments.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, distributed systems, AI/ML applications, LLMs, and analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with GCP, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, CI/CD, containers, observability, and cloud security.
* Experience leading distributed or global engineering teams in a collaborative, inclusive environment.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Tech Zoomers India Private Limited is a technology company that builds intelligent, scalable, and practical digital solutions to help businesses simplify operations, automate processes, and make better decisions. The organization combines AI, automation, cloud technologies, enterprise software, and data intelligence to address real\-world business challenges. Its portfolio includes HR technology, human capital management, payroll, recruitment, fixed asset management, enterprise automation, analytics, AI\-powered solutions, and custom business applications. The Customer Success Manager will track customer health metrics, manage renewals, and work proactively on retention strategies, while serving as a trusted point of contact for product questions and best practices. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting review meetings, addressing issues, coordinating with internal teams to resolve technical or operational concerns, and identifying opportunities for upsell or cross\-sell. The role requires close collaboration with product, sales, and support teams to relay customer feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.

* Strong focus on Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service to ensure a positive end\-to\-end client experience.
* Excellent Relationship Building and Customer Retention abilities to foster long\-term partnerships and support renewals.

* Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in simple, business\-focused language.

* Comfort working on\-site in Gurugram and collaborating across cross\-functional teams (sales, product, support, implementation).

Colleges collaborate with CodeChef to integrate our learning and assessment environment into their Academic Labs.
 



 Are you passionate about coding and want to make a lasting impact by helping students learn effectively? Join us in bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and real\-world application, while staying connected to the latest in tech. This isn't just teaching – it's about building the future of CS education.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Account Manager (AM)** 
 will serve as the primary relationship owner for colleges enrolled in the CodeChef College Program. The AM acts as the strategic bridge between the college and CodeChef’s internal teams, ensuring seamless onboarding, smooth program execution, stakeholder engagement, revenue scale\-up, and long\-term retention.
 



 This is a high\-ownership, high\-accountability role requiring strong coordination skills, stakeholder management, execution rigor, and the ability to drive outcomes both externally and internally.
 


* **Note on Travel:** 
 This role requires being on the move. Expect to spend
 **60\-70% of your time traveling** 
 to college



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Sales Closure \& Onboarding


* Join the final stage meetings led by the BD team to support deal closure.
* Establish relationships with key stakeholders (HODs, faculty members, management).
* Ensure smooth onboarding post\-signature.
* Coordinate with internal content teams once the college syllabus is shared.
* Ensure course creation aligned to the syllabus and delivered within committed timelines.



  





 2\. Program Execution \& Monitoring
 


* Own all client communication (Email \& WhatsApp).
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for the college.
* Ensure weekly reports are sent to the college on time.
* Monitor timely execution of assessments by the support team.
* Track course progress and faculty engagement.
* Identify gaps (e.g., low student completion, inactive faculty monitoring) and take corrective actions.
* Escalate to senior college stakeholders (Owner/Vice Chancellor) when necessary to ensure compliance and progress.



  





 3\. Stakeholder Engagement
 


* Conduct monthly meetings with HODs and faculty .
* Meet the Owner/Vice Chancellor at least once per semester.
* Build strong institutional relationships to ensure program success and expansion.



  





 4\. Revenue Retention, Scale\-Up \& Expansion
 


* If adoption begins at partial capacity (e.g., 25% student enrollment), collaborate with BD to scale to 100% revenue potential.
* Drive internal alignment and external persuasion to ensure maximum program utilization.
* Identify cross\-sell or upsell opportunities where applicable.
* Own renewal and retention of assigned colleges.



  





**Educational Qualifications and Work Experience** 



* Education: B.Tech in Computer Science/IT is mandatory. You must understand the technical nuances of a coding curriculum.
* Experience: 3\-5 years in Enterprise SaaS Ed\-Tech (B2B/Institutional Sales) Account Management

 Experience: 8\+ years
   

  

 Notice Period\- Immediate\-30days
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a senior Oracle NetSuite Functional SME / Implementation Lead to lead a new, end\-to\-end NetSuite implementation.
   

  

 The consultant will serve as the primary functional point of contact and work closely with business users, finance and accounting teams, senior leadership, technical teams, implementation partners and other project stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience implementing and migrating to Oracle NetSuite across Core Financials, Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Project Management and Project Accounting.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on functional role requiring ownership of the implementation lifecycle from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, data migration, production cutover and go\-live.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead discovery workshops with finance, procurement, sales, project management and business stakeholders to understand current processes, requirements, pain points and future\-state objectives.
   

  

 Perform current\-state and future\-state process analysis, fit\-gap assessments and functional solution design.
   

  

 Lead functional implementation across NetSuite Core Financials, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, P2P, O2C, Project Management and Project Accounting.

 Chart of Accounts
   

  

 Accounting Calendars
   

  

 Subsidiaries and Legal Entities
   

  

 Departments and Locations
   

  

 Customers and Vendors
   

  

 Tax Structures
   

  

 Approval Workflows
   

  

 Payment Processes
   

  

 Financial Controls

 Lead O2C configuration covering customer management, quotations, sales orders, billing, collections, receipts, revenue processing and accounting.

 Plan and lead Conference Room Pilots (CRP), System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and end\-user training.
   

  

 Track defects, coordinate resolution and ensure business readiness for go\-live.
   

  

 Develop and manage the production cutover plan and support go\-live and post\-production stabilization.
   

  

 Evaluate NetSuite mobile and tablet capabilities for executives, project managers, site personnel, approvers and other field users.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to streamline and automate financial, procurement, billing, project accounting and operational processes using NetSuite capabilities.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 8\+ years of hands\-on functional experience with Oracle NetSuite ERP.
   

  

 Proven experience leading at least one brand\-new, end\-to\-end NetSuite implementation or major ERP\-to\-NetSuite migration.
   

  

**Strong Functional Expertise Across**
 Core Financials
   

  

 Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)
   

  

 Order\-to\-Cash (O2C)
   

  

 Project Management
   

  

 Project Accounting
   

  

 Hands\-on experience configuring NetSuite financial modules, workflows, approval hierarchies, roles, dashboards, reports and saved searches.
   

  

 Experience conducting discovery sessions, requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, functional configuration, testing, data conversion and production cutover.
   

  

 Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls and month\-end/year\-end closing processes.
   

  

 Experience working with business stakeholders, implementation partners, technical teams and senior leadership.
   

  

 Strong communication, documentation, presentation and project leadership skills.
   

  

 Willingness to work from the Hyderabad Financial District office 3 days per week during the initial implementation phase.

 Oracle NetSuite certifications.

**Knowledge Of Construction\-specific Processes Such As**

 Retention

**Minimum Skills**
 Experienced professional with 8\+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, Customer Success Manager, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
   

  

 Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C\-level.
   

  

 Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.

 Knowledge of Salesforce product suite and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy, including knowledge of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem.
   

  

 Degree or equivalent experience required.  Unleash Your Potential

title: Application Manager
description:
Position Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Application Manager** 
 with a strong technical foundation to manage a portfolio of enterprise and Pharma applications. This role combines Application Management Services (AMS), application lifecycle governance, stakeholder coordination, operational service ownership, and awareness of GxP controls applicable to regulated applications.
 



 The successful candidate will ensure application stability, compliant change execution, service performance, lifecycle planning, and effective coordination across business, quality, technical, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
 



**Ideal Profile:** 
 A technically grounded application professional who can connect service operations, lifecycle decisions, compliance expectations, and business outcomes.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Application Service Ownership
 


* Own end\-to\-end operational management of assigned applications and act as the primary coordination point for service delivery.
* Oversee incidents, service requests, problems, changes, releases, knowledge, and recurring operational activities.
* Monitor service levels, operational health, risks, dependencies, and improvement actions.
* Coordinate major incident response, technical troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and follow\-through on corrective actions.



 2\. Application Lifecycle Management
 


* Manage the application lifecycle from onboarding and transition through BAU support, upgrades, roadmap planning, and retirement.
* Maintain application inventory, ownership, support model, lifecycle status, technical dependencies, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate patching, upgrades, releases, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support with relevant teams.
* Identify technical debt, end\-of\-life risks, support gaps, and opportunities for modernization or simplification.



 3\. GxP and Compliance Awareness
 


* Understand the impact of GxP controls on application support, access, documentation, testing, change, release, and incident processes.
* Ensure changes to regulated applications follow applicable quality, validation, approval, traceability, and evidence requirements.
* Work with Quality, Compliance, Validation, Security, and Business teams to maintain application control readiness.
* Support audit and inspection requests by ensuring records, approvals, evidence, and operational documentation are complete and retrievable.
* Assist with compliance deviations, remediation actions, and risk tracking when required.



 4\. Stakeholder and Vendor Management
 


* Engage application owners, business users, product teams, technical teams, and external vendors to maintain service continuity.
* Lead service reviews and communicate service performance, risks, issues, dependencies, and improvement plans.
* Coordinate vendor deliverables, escalations, support obligations, and technical actions.
* Translate business priorities into clear operational and technical requirements.



 5\. Continuous Improvement and Governance
 


* Drive service improvement, automation, knowledge maturity, monitoring enhancements, and reduction of recurring issues.
* Maintain governance artefacts, operational procedures, support documentation, and management reporting.
* Ensure risks, actions, decisions, and exceptions are documented and tracked to closure.



  





 Required Experience and Skills
 



  





 8\+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial experience in application support, application management, or AMS delivery.
 



 Good understanding of application architecture, interfaces, APIs, databases, middleware, hosting, cloud/SaaS services, security, and production support practices.
 



 Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, release, service request, knowledge, SLA/KPI, and continuous improvement processes.
 



 Experience managing application onboarding, transition, maintenance, upgrades, releases, risk, technical debt, roadmap, and retirement activities.
 



 Awareness of GxP controls and the importance of validated processes, controlled changes, traceability, evidence, access governance, data integrity, and audit readiness for regulated applications.
 



 Ability to work confidently with business, quality, compliance, security, infrastructure, development, support, and vendor stakeholders.
 



 Strong written and verbal communication, governance, prioritization, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

title: Product Manager – KYC & Fraud - IND
description:
### **Description**

  

**Role Summary:**  

  

The KYC \& Fraud Product Manager is responsible for driving the product, tooling and process improvement agenda across the CDD and Fraud functions at DAZN Bet. The role bridges operational requirements and technical delivery, ensuring that the systems, platforms and vendor solutions used by the CDD and Fraud teams are optimised, fit for purpose, and aligned with regulatory and commercial objectives.

The successful candidate will own the product roadmap for CDD and Fraud tooling, working with internal stakeholders and external vendors to scope, prioritise and deliver enhancements that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen DAZN Bet's ability to identify and manage risk. The role also carries responsibility for MI reporting and analytics across both functions, ensuring that leadership has access to accurate, timely data to support decision\-making.

This is a newly created role, established as part of an Operational restructure to promote dedicated product management capacity within the Operations function. The role enables the CDD and Fraud departments to move from a reactive, operationally constrained posture to one focused on continuous improvement, automation and scalability.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Product Roadmap \& Strategy** — Own and maintain the product roadmap for CDD and Fraud tooling, identifying opportunities for enhancement, automation and integration. Prioritise initiatives based on operational impact, regulatory requirement and commercial value, ensuring alignment with the wider Operations and Technology strategy.


* **Vendor \& Platform Management** — Manage relationships with third\-party CDD, KYC, identity verification and fraud prevention vendors. Ensure service levels are met, contracts are appropriate, and that DAZN Bet derives maximum value from its vendor partnerships. Lead procurement and onboarding activity for new tooling as required.


* **Process Improvement \& Automation** — Work closely with the Head of CDD and Ops teams to identify operational bottlenecks, manual processes and inefficiencies. Scope and deliver solutions that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and accelerate throughput — including automation of routine tasks, workflow improvements and system integrations.


* **MI Reporting \& Analytics** — Design, build and maintain MI reporting across CDD and Fraud, providing accurate and timely data on volumes, SLA performance, quality metrics, fraud losses, chargeback rates and risk trends. Ensure leadership has the information required to make informed decisions and demonstrate regulatory compliance.


* **Regulatory \& Compliance Alignment** — Ensure all product and tooling decisions are made with full regard to regulatory requirements across GB, Ireland, EU, Canada and future markets. Work with the Head of CDD, Head of AML and Compliance team to ensure that systems and processes reflect current legislation and licence conditions.


* **Fraud Tooling \& Strategy** — Own the product and tooling strategy for fraud prevention, including chargeback management and bonus abuse detection. Work with the Fraud team (Junior KYC \& Fraud Product Manager, and operational staff within AML and Risk \& Payments) to ensure tooling is configured and optimised to minimise losses.


* **Scalability \& Market Expansion** — Ensure CDD and Fraud tooling is configured and scalable to support new market entry. Contribute to market entry planning by identifying tooling requirements, vendor capabilities and integration needs ahead of launch.


* **Stakeholder Engagement** — Act as the primary point of contact between the CDD/Fraud operations and Technology teams, ensuring requirements are clearly articulated, prioritised and delivered. Represent the function in cross\-functional forums and contribute to wider product and technology governance.
### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

**Technical Skills*** Experience of product management within a regulated environment, ideally in betting and gaming or financial services
* Strong understanding of CDD, KYC, identity verification and fraud prevention tooling and platforms
* Experience of vendor management, procurement and contract negotiation
* Demonstrable experience of MI reporting, data analysis and dashboard design
* Familiarity with automation and workflow tooling, including integration with operational systems
* Understanding of AML legislation and regulatory requirements as they relate to CDD and fraud prevention
* Must be proficient in use of Artificial Intelligence in order to maximise efficiency and accuracy in analytical and product management work

**Soft Skills*** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate operational requirements into clear product specifications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver to deadlines
* High degree of personal integrity and professional discretion

**Leadership Skills*** Experience of managing or mentoring junior staff
* Ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and drive delivery without direct authority
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

**Required Experience*** Previous experience in a product management, product ownership or business analysis role within CDD, KYC, AML or fraud operations.
* Experience of working with third\-party vendors in a regulated environment
* Track record of delivering process improvements and automation initiatives
* Experience of building and maintaining MI reporting.

  

### **About DAZN**


At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game\-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.  

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no\-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. We're using world\-class technology to transform sports and revolutionise the industry and we're not going to stop.

**DAZN VALUES – THE ‘HOW’ IN WHAT WE DO:**

Agility and creativity fuel growth and innovation, to **Make It Happen.**  


Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, **Focusing On Impact.**  


Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to **Win As One.**  


At DAZN, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values equality and diversity, where everyone can contribute and have their voices heard. This means hiring and developing talent across all races, ethnicities, religions, age groups, sexual orientations, gender identities and abilities.  

If you’d like to include a cover letter with your application, please feel free to. Please do not feel you need to apply with a photo or disclose any other information that is not related to your professional experience.

Our aim is to make our hiring processes as accessible for everyone as possible, including providing adjustments for interviews where we can.

We look forward to hearing from you.

This Director of Software Engineering leads the Workplace engineering pillar within CRM\&I. You will own Workplace Service Delivery and its adjacent integrations with CSM and FSM — building the employee and customer facing experiences that handle millions of service interactions across our largest enterprise customers.

  

What makes this role distinct from a traditional engineering director role is the AI\-native mandate. You will not manage teams that use AI as a productivity tool — you will build and lead an organisation that operates as an AI\-native engineering system. Your engineers work more like architects and verifiers than individual contributors typing every line: they decompose problems into agent\-sized tasks, curate the context that makes agent output reliable, and own the verification harnesses that ensure correctness at scale.

  

You will report to the Senior Director, CRM\&I Engineering and work closely with Workplace product management, platform engineering, and senior stakeholders to shape and deliver the Workplace roadmap for the next three to five years.


What you get to do


Lead and develop an AI\-native engineering organisation

* Build and lead two to three engineering managers who coach their teams to operate with AI\-native practices as the default — not the exception.
* Model and scale the shift from implementation\-speed metrics to judgment metrics: specification quality, architectural soundness, and verification rigour.
* Cultivate a culture where engineers own the correctness of output whether a human or an agent produced it, and are accountable for autonomous decision quality in production.


Drive the Workplace product roadmap

* Partner with product management and UX to define, own, and execute the Workplace Service Delivery roadmap — including employee self\-service, request management, and WSD×CSM/FSM integration.
* Translate ambitious product goals and ambiguous problem statements into precise, testable specifications that both engineers and AI agents can act on with high accuracy.
* Make sound architectural and sequencing decisions early, before agent workstreams begin, and course\-correct quickly when output diverges from intent.


Build reliable AI\-native systems

* Design the verification and guardrail harnesses — automated tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and least\-privilege execution environments — that make agent\-generated output trustworthy at scale.
* Oversee context engineering across your teams: instruction files, architectural decision records, golden examples, and agent\-readable documentation that drive reliable results from AI coding agents.
* Own AI reliability in production: monitor for hallucinations, behavioural drift, and safety regressions; maintain agent observability; and implement rollback mechanisms when autonomous behaviour deviates from intent.


Raise the bar on quality, security, and delivery

* Set and hold the standard for enterprise\-grade software quality — accessible, progressive, and responsive web and mobile experiences at the scale our customers demand.
* Champion security\-minded engineering practices specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection defence, secret and data leakage controls, and tool\-access governance.
* Treat the development process itself as a product: trace failures back to missing specs or context gaps, refine evaluation harnesses, and raise team\-wide throughput and reliability.


Develop the next generation of engineering leaders

* Mentor and grow engineering managers and senior engineers, investing in their technical depth, leadership range, and AI\-native fluency.
* Create a talent environment where engineers who are energised by the AI\-native shift can build careers through some of the most advanced systems in enterprise software.

 **Qualifications**  

To be successful in this role


Experience

* 15\+ years of experience designing and shipping scalable enterprise software products, with significant time in technical leadership roles.
* Demonstrated track record of building and leading engineering teams that have delivered real production systems using AI\-native methods — agentic coding tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and autonomous agent architectures.
* Experience in CRM, ITSM, workplace service delivery, or related enterprise domains preferred.


AI\-native engineering fluency

* Agentic AI and autonomous systems. Hands\-on experience designing and operating autonomous agent systems — planning loops, dynamic tool invocation, memory management, execution policies, and multi\-agent collaboration — that select and sequence actions reliably in production.
* Context engineering. Skill in designing what information models receive, when it is retrieved, and how context evolves. Includes assembling instruction files, documentation, examples, and architectural constraints, as well as architecting retrieval systems, vector databases, and long\-term memory frameworks.
* Verification and harness design. Experience building the guardrail systems that make agent output reliable at scale: property\-based and mutation tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and provenance and permission controls.
* Outcome evaluation. Ability to develop measurable frameworks — benchmarks, golden datasets, continuous evaluation pipelines, and drift detection — that hold production AI to the same rigour as deterministically testable software.
* Security and reliability mindset. Working knowledge of risks specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, tool\-access governance, and model abuse, translated into concrete engineering controls.


Leadership and collaboration

* Strong written and verbal communication — able to operate as a credible technical voice with product, platform, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and make clear decisions under uncertainty without waiting for perfect information.
* Conviction to influence product vision and roadmap, paired with the humility to listen, learn, and adapt.


Forward deployed engineering

* Customer\-embedded delivery. Experience leading or participating in forward deployed engineering (FDE) engagements — working on\-site or in close collaboration with strategic customers to accelerate time\-to\-value, co\-develop solutions, and unblock adoption of product capabilities.
* Translating customer context into product decisions. Ability to synthesise what you learn at the customer boundary — pain points, integration constraints, workflow gaps, and adoption blockers — into precise product requirements and engineering priorities that feed back into the core roadmap.
* Executive and technical credibility with customers. Comfortable presenting architecture decisions, roadmap trade\-offs, and delivery progress to both customer engineering leads and C\-suite stakeholders, earning trust through technical depth and clear communication rather than sales framing.
* Rapid scoping and delivery under constraints. Skilled at decomposing ambiguous customer problems into tightly scoped engineering workstreams with clear success criteria, then driving rapid iteration cycles — days to weeks, not quarters — while managing risk and communication on both sides.
* Cross\-functional coordination in a customer environment. Experience coordinating across product, sales, and professional services teams while embedded with a customer — navigating competing priorities, escalation paths, and success handoffs without losing engineering focus.


Technical depth

* Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, and modern software development practices.
* Solid data modelling background — relational and otherwise — with experience building systems where data model quality is a first\-class concern.
* Proficiency with AI/ML fundamentals: model training and evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic failure modes of LLMs, sufficient to reason about and debug model\-driven behaviour in production.


Even better if you have

* Experience with the ServiceNow platform — scoped application architecture, Glide APIs, or platform engineering at scale.
* Hands\-on exposure to multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and the operational realities of shipping to thousands of enterprise customers simultaneously.
* Experience building and operating agentic systems in a regulated or enterprise\-compliance context.
* Prior experience managing distributed engineering organisations across time zones.
* Direct experience leading forward deployed engineering engagements — co\-developing solutions alongside strategic customers, accelerating adoption of complex capabilities, and feeding field learnings back into the product roadmap.


Why ServiceNow


We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a professional environment built on collaboration and inclusion. This is an organisation where people with strong aptitude and conviction grow fast — working on some of the most advanced enterprise technology in the world, with teams that take the craft seriously.

  

If you want to lead engineering at the frontier of what AI\-native product development actually looks like in production — not in a lab, but at enterprise scale — this is the role.

**The Role**


Innovapptive’s Connected Worker Platform is expanding its AI capability from foundational features into a broad portfolio of product\-facing AI agents purpose\-built for industrial field operations. These agents span maintenance planning, work order automation, safety compliance, operator rounds, and knowledge assistance, all grounded in customer\-specific asset data and SOPs.


This role leads the AI Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating that agent portfolio in production. You own the full lifecycle: from architecture and prompt engineering through evaluation, deployment, and reliability. You work closely with Product, Platform, and customer\-facing teams to translate industrial use cases into AI capabilities that enterprise customers trust.

**What You Own**

* AI Engineering team across agent development, LLM infrastructure, and model evaluation.

* RAG and knowledge infrastructure: document ingestion pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding, vector search, and knowledge graph grounding.
* LLM governance: model selection, prompt versioning, bias testing, audit logs, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. All inference within Innovapptive’s AWS VPC — no data to external LLM endpoints.
* Agent quality: evaluation frameworks, accuracy benchmarks, hallucination monitoring, and output labelling pipelines.
* Sprint delivery and production reliability. Weekly quality scorecard.
* Hiring, performance management, and coaching.

**You Must Have**

* 7\+ years in software engineering with 3\+ years managing teams delivering AI/ML or LLM\-powered products in enterprise production.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and multi\-step agentic workflows.
* Strong grasp of RAG architecture: document pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector databases, re\-ranking, and similarity thresholds.
* Experience with managed inference infrastructure: AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent.
* Track record shipping AI product features on schedule in a SaaS context — not just prototypes or internal tools.
* Familiarity with AI observability: prompt tracing, hallucination detection, and output evaluation (Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent).
* Data\-driven: model evaluation scores, accuracy/recall metrics, agent success rates, and DORA metrics for the team.
* Strong engineering standards: prompt discipline, eval\-driven development, responsible AI controls, and production\-grade reliability.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge graph architectures (AWS Neptune, Neo4j) for grounding agent outputs in structured asset data.

* Vision models or multimodal AI: image\-based defect detection, document OCR, or form digitisation.
* MLOps and LLMOps: model versioning, A/B evaluation, and continuous prompt optimisation pipelines.
* Cloud cost optimisation for LLM workloads: token budgets, model tiering, and caching strategies.
* MongoDB and change stream\-based event architectures.

**Tech Stack \& Tools**

**AI / ML**

  

AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, LiteLLM, LangGraph, Milvus (vector DB), AWS Neptune (knowledge graph), Langfuse

Node.js / TypeScript, Python, MongoDB

AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD

Langfuse, Sentry, CloudWatch

 **Tools**

  

GitLab, Jira, SonarQube

 **Compensation \& Growth**


Reports to VP PE\&A. Path to Sr. EM or platform leadership as integration becomes a core horizontal capability.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on AI accuracy and performance.

title: Director of Platform Reliability
description:
Job Description

  

  

**Purpose:**

Lead the Salesforce Level 2 Support function, ensuring the stability, availability, performance, and continuous improvement of the Salesforce platform and its integrated ecosystem. Accountable for incident management, service operations, platform support strategy, vendor management, regulatory compliance, and the delivery of high\-quality support services that enable business operations and customer outcomes.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Service Operations \& Support Leadership**

* Own the end\-to\-end Level 2 support strategy for the Salesforce platform, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, and associated integrations.
* Ensure platform availability, service reliability, and operational excellence through proactive monitoring and support processes.
* Lead major incident management activities, ensuring rapid restoration of service and effective stakeholder communication.
* Establish and govern support SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive root cause analysis and problem management practices to reduce recurring incidents.

**Platform Governance \& Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with enterprise technology standards, security policies, regulatory obligations, and audit requirements.
* Oversee platform release readiness, change management, and production deployment governance.
* Manage operational risks and ensure appropriate controls are embedded across support processes.
* Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities for Salesforce services.

**Stakeholder \& Business Engagement**

* Act as the senior escalation point for business stakeholders, technology teams, and executive leadership.
* Develop strong partnerships with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Vendors.
* Translate business priorities into support and operational plans.
* Provide regular service performance reporting to senior leadership and governance forums.

**Continuous Improvement \& Automation**

* Lead initiatives to improve support efficiency through automation, AI\-driven monitoring, self\-service capabilities, and process optimisation.
* Drive reduction in incident volumes and mean time to resolution (MTTR).
* Sponsor platform reliability, observability, and operational excellence programmes.
* Promote adoption of DevOps, SRE, and Agile operational practices.

**People Leadership**

* Lead and develop a globally distributed team of Salesforce support managers, analysts, and specialists.
* Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build platform expertise and succession capability across the support organisation.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer focus.

**Vendor \& Financial Management**

* Manage relationships with Salesforce and other strategic technology partners.
* Oversee support budgets, contracts, and resource planning.
Ensure optimal utilisation of internal and external resources while maintaining service quality.  
* 

  

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Salesforce platform availability and service health.
* Incident, problem, and change management effectiveness.
* Support SLA achievement and customer satisfaction.
* Operational risk and audit compliance.
* Platform support cost management.
* Team capability and performance.
Continuous service improvement delivery.  
* 

  

**Required Experience:**

* Extensive experience leading enterprise application support organisations.
* Proven leadership of Level 2/Level 3 support teams within a large\-scale Salesforce environment.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Service Management practices.
* Experience managing critical business applications in highly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated success leading global teams and third\-party suppliers.
* Experience driving operational transformation, automation, and AI\-enabled service improvements.
Strong stakeholder management experience at senior and executive levels.  
* 

  

**Skills Required:**

  

* Salesforce Administration and Platform Architecture
* Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud
* Salesforce Integrations (APIs, Middleware, Event\-driven Architecture)
* Release and Environment Management
* ITSM Platforms (ServiceNow preferred)
* Monitoring and Observability Tools
* Agile and DevOps Practices
* Data Security and Compliance
* Incident, Problem and Change Management
Cloud Operations and Platform Reliability  
*

title: Sr Program Manager, ASIN Localization
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About Amazon.com  

  

Amazon.com – a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. We are making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.  

  

The Team: We at Localization are an integral part of creating new listings and enabling customers to shop in a language of preference globally. Our vision is to enable customers in every Store to have access to all of Amazon's WW selection and in a language of their choice. Every year, we help in launching new marketplaces and localize billions of products for Amazon worldwide. The site at Hyderabad manages multiple critical programs for WW Localization team.  

  

The Role: We are looking for an exceptional Program Manager to join Hyd team and drive Operational Excellence in non\-tech domain of project/program management. Operational Excellence is not a set of activities but a philosophy and a mind\-set anchored on problem\-solving and leadership, in order to create sustainable continuous improvement. We expect this leader to enhance both the value of services as well as its delivery to our customers, by deploying (but not restricted to) new processes and implementing consistent small improvements that compound over time to produce big results. We are looking for high\-potential, flexible, innovative, and forward\-thinking professional to join the team. Are you ready to drive high\-visibility and strategic programs as well as lead process improvement initiatives? Are you equally comfortable digging into business requirements as you are driving operational efficiencies? If yes, then come join us!
  

  

What do we expect you to do? This position will be responsible for driving multiple critical programs for WW ASIN Localization, ensuring successful delivery of business goals. You will structure programs to launch new processes, identify defects across existing portfolios and rectify them. The work entails managing multiple portfolios simultaneously and entails coordination with multiple internal teams of Amazon. This is a unique role that offers a great opportunity to build something new, work cross functionally across strategic businesses, and interact with global stakeholders. You will need to balance between big picture thinking and obsessing with the details, identifying risks. The ideal candidate should have exceptional written and verbal skills, and be comfortable presenting to senior leadership and drive alignment amongst stakeholders.  

  

Ideal candidate is expected to:  

* Work with internal teams (Engineering/Product Management etc) to identify opportunities and set up new processes from scratch which can reduce operational load on partner teams.
* Work with product management/Engineering teams to understand program requirements and jointly develop a solution to drive automation as well as deliver on the yearly goals.
* Manage stakeholder (Business/Tech) and collaborate with them effectively to deliver on joint goals
* Identify defects, deep dive root causes and work out short\-term and long\-term solutions. Use industry proven tools such as lean/six sigma to drive operational efficiencies and quality improvement in the operations team under your purview.
* Develop team goals and metrics that allow for accurate measurement and traction towards solving a business problem, achieve buy\-in from stakeholders and actively report progress on the goals.
* Thrive and operate in a variable \& grey environment by addressing situations of low workload forecast, varying customer priorities, changing mix of workload which will impact productivity bar and cross\-skilling of resources for most optimum throughput management.

  

Key job responsibilities  

The Sr Program Manager must serve as a single\-threaded leader capable of managing complex, cross\-functional escalations across multiple stakeholders including RBS, Softlines, and seller teams, transforming fragmented ownership into end\-to\-end resolution. The role requires strategic vision to shift teams from reactive problem\-solving to proactive quality assurance, establishing centralized project plans anchored by measurable P0 metrics across discoverability, variations, returns and detail page defects. This leader must demonstrate excellent SQL skills for making data\-driven decisions, translating business impact into actionable roadmaps with clear success criteria. The position demands stakeholder management excellence, coordinating between technical teams (BIE, Tech, Product) and business partners while establishing standardized SLAs and escalation protocols. Critical capabilities include organizational design, restructuring teams through cross\-training programs and resource optimization without additional headcount, plus technical acumen to understand catalog architectural enhancements and system behaviors. The PM must excel at building mechanisms, creating scalable frameworks for defect identification and reduction, and AI\-powered feedback loops that scale quality improvements. Finally, this role requires leadership influence to secure executive alignment, drive implementation timelines, and foster a culture of continuous improvement that impacts Amazon's worldwide catalog quality.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Client Success & Growth Manager
description:
**⚠️ Please read before applying:** 
 This role pays a maximum of
 **₹8 LPA** 
 . If your expected CTC is above ₹8 LPA, please do not apply — it will not be a fit, and we want to respect everyone's time.
 



  





**Client Success and Growth Manager** 




**Futwork \| Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai (5–6 min walk from the metro)** 




**About Futwork** 




 Futwork runs AI \+ human voice calls for enterprises, handling both inbound and outbound calling. We power 10M\+ conversations a month for top companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Paytm, Lenskart, Shiprocket and BharatPe across logistics, e\-commerce, fintech, education and more.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 You will own a set of B2B client accounts (partners who run their calling operations with us \- Voice AI and Humans). You are responsible for retaining these clients, making sure they hit their goals, and growing each account over time. This is a mix of client ownership, coordination, problem\-solving, and growth.
 



  





**This is not a typical SaaS client success role** 




 If your idea of client success is onboarding, driving adoption, and chasing renewals — this role is different, and probably not for you.
 



  





 At Futwork, you don't just keep the account running.
 **You own how well it performs and how much it grows.** 
 That means:
 


* You are responsible for the client actually hitting their targets and getting real ROI from us — not just being "onboarded."
* You dig into performance data, find why numbers are off, and fix them with our internal teams.
* You drive the growth of the account — more use cases, more volume, more value — not just protect what already exists.
* You work like a mini business owner for your accounts: you understand the client's business, our operations, and the numbers, and you take smart decisions to move things forward.



 This role needs sharp thinking, strong ownership, and comfort with data and problem\-solving. If that excites you, read on.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own 5–7 client accounts and be their main point of contact at Futwork.
* Understand each client's business, their goals, and the return they expect for the money they spend with us.
* Manage Voice AI agents, suggest improvements, and work with the tech and ops team to improve the call quality and results from the voice AI agent.
* Take client requirements and pass them clearly to our internal teams (operations and tech).
* Make sure new processes go live on time, and keep the client updated at every step.
* Track performance against agreed benchmarks. If numbers are not being met, dig into why.
* Do a proper root cause analysis (RCA) when things go off track, find the real gap, and fix it with the internal team.
* Check that our operations team is running the process correctly, and close any gaps you spot.
* Set the right expectations with clients, so there are no surprises.
* Handle discussions between our tech/ops teams and the client's teams.
* When there are limitations at our end, communicate them honestly and in a way that keeps the client's trust.
* Look for ways to grow the account — more use cases, more volume, more value.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–3 years of experience in a relevant role (account management, client relationship management, client success, operations, or similar). Minimum 2 years.
* A track record of owning client relationships and driving results — not just onboarding or support.
* Smart, logical thinkers who can break down a problem and find the real reason behind it.
* Strong common sense and the ability to take good decisions on your own.
* People who can understand both our business and the client's business quickly.
* Good communicators who can keep clients calm, confident and informed.
* Comfortable coordinating across many teams and keeping timelines on track.
* Analytical mindset — you enjoy digging into data and numbers to find answers.



  





**Tools You Should Know** 



* Strong hands\-on skills in Excel and Google Sheets.
* Comfortable with data reporting — building and reading reports to track performance.
* Handy with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Studio, and similar.
* Able to use AI tools to automate processes and repetitive tasks wherever possible, to work faster and smarter.



  





**Details** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 2 years in a client\-facing role. Minimum 1 year in a similar/relevant role
* **Salary:** 
 ₹4\.8–8 LPA
* **Location:** 
 Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai — 5–6\-minute walk from the metro station (on\-site).
* **⚠️ One more time:** 
 This role pays
 **₹4\.8–8 LPA** 
 . If your expected CTC is above ₹8 LPA, please do not apply.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Hudle is India’s largest sports community platform, enabling more than 20 lakh players across 110\+ cities to play regularly, join communities, and make sport part of everyday life. The platform has grown from simplifying venue discovery and booking into a comprehensive ecosystem that powers how India plays, connects, and experiences sport. Hudle partners with thousands of venues across 40\+ sports, and offers community\-led play, events and tournaments, coaching, curated player experiences, and rich sports content. Positioned at the center of India’s growing participation culture—spanning casual games to organized squads—Hudle sees sport as a lifestyle and social ritual, not just fitness. Hudle is a Series A–funded startup backed by leading investors including Sky Impact Capital, Physis Capital, Inflection Point Ventures, and Survam Partners.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 You will own Hudle's business development outcomes for Mumbai. That means hitting the city's partner acquisition and revenue targets, making sure every new venue is onboarded well and starts generating bookings, and building long\-term relationships with the city's most important partners. You'll run the full sales cycle yourself on key deals while coaching a small team to do the same.
 



  





**What You'll Own:\-** 




  





**Mumbai targets and pipeline** 




  





 \- Deliver monthly and quarterly targets for partner acquisition and venue activation for the region
 



 \- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through market mapping, outbound outreach, referrals and on\-ground prospecting
 



 \- Personally lead high\-value and strategic deals, including multi\-venue operators, premium clubs, institutions and real estate developers
 



  





**Onboarding and activation** 




  





 \- Drive end\-to\-end onboarding of new partners: commercials, agreements, listing setup, pricing and inventory, and handover to Partner Growth
 



 \- Make sure onboarded venues go live quickly and start receiving bookings, and fix whatever stands in the way
 



 \- Coordinate with internal teams (Partner Growth, Product, Ops, Hudle Vision) for smooth launches
 



  





**Key relationships** 




  





 \- Own relationships with Mumbai's top partners and decision\-makers, serving as their senior point of contact
 



 \- Find opportunities to deepen partnerships: additional courts or sports, exclusive listings, premium products such as Hudle Vision, and co\-marketing
 



 \- Stay close to the local market: new venues, competitor activity, pricing trends and emerging sports
 



  





**Team leadership** 




  





 \- Coach and manage 1–2 BD Executives, including setting targets, doing joint field visits and running regular pipeline reviews
 



 \- Build repeatable playbooks for prospecting, pitching and closing in the Mumbai market
 



  





**Process and reporting** 




  





 \- Keep Zoho CRM accurate and current for yourself and your team
 



 \- Share weekly and monthly progress reports with leadership, covering pipeline health, closures, activation and forecasts
 



 \- Suggest improvements to sales processes, pitch materials and commercial structures
 



  





**How Success Is Measured** 




 \- New venues and courts onboarded against target
 



 \- Time from signing to first booking, and early booking volume of new partners
 



 \- Team productivity and target achievement
 



 \- CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 \- 4–7 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least 1 year leading or mentoring others.
 



 \- ⁠Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, sports, fitness, hospitality or real estate is a plus.
 



 \- A strong network in Mumbai, or the ability to build one quickly
 



 \- A track record of owning and hitting targets in a field\-sales role
 



 \- Comfort selling to very different people, from tech\-savvy founders and club committees to traditional, first\-time business owners
 



 \- Excellent communication in English and Hindi. Marathi is a strong plus.
 



 \- Confident at running app demos, building presentations and negotiating commercials
 



 \- Organised and data\-driven, comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets and Excel
 



 \- Resilient, self\-driven and at ease in a fast\-moving startup
 



 \- A genuine interest in sports is a bonus
 



  





**Benefits:** 



* Start\-up environment with plenty of learning and growth opportunities
* Great exposure as the candidate will be working closely with the senior management
* Employee\-first culture
* Market Salary
* Potential ESOPs in future

We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.



These institutions make millions of high\-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?



Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.



Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.



Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.



We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back\-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.



We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100\+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder \- Sangram Raje


**About the Role**
------------------



We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who thrives on chaos as much as clarity. Once an account is handed to you by our AI Deployment team after the hyper\-care phase, you own it, whether that means smoothing over rough edges from a still\-settling rollout or building on a genuinely stable one.



Either way, your job is to go deep on that customer's business, become their most trusted point of contact, from day\-to\-day users to C\-suite champions, and turn early usage into a lasting, expanding relationship across Prodigal's full product suite.



You'll do this the way a 2026 CSM should: using AI tools yourself to move fast. That might mean walking a VP of Ops through exactly how much handle time proAgent shaved off last month before they've even asked, or having a clean, data\-backed answer ready the moment a compliance lead wants to know whether proInsight flagged a specific violation, instead of promising to "get back to them" and grinding through a manual pull.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


* **Own the relationship:** a portfolio of accounts post\-handover from Deployment, from day\-to\-day users to CXOs. Set clear expectations, protect trust, and be the internal voice for what your customers actually need
* **Drive value realization:** make sure every account can point to measurable ROI from Prodigal's products, not just usage, and use that proof to defend renewals and justify expansion
* **Drive growth:** adoption, renewals, and expansion are the job; NRR and CSAT are the scorecard. Demo the rest of Prodigal's suite when there's a genuine cross\-sell fit
* **Go deep on the business:** understand each customer's goals and day\-to\-day operations well enough to flag opportunities they haven't thought of yet
* **Run QBRs, and build proof:** turn strong outcomes into testimonials and case studies
* **Partner across the company, and catch trouble early:** work with Deployment, Engineering, Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Support, and flag account risk before it becomes urgent

**Key Competencies**
--------------------


* **Customer Engagement \& Retention:** proactively drive usage, manage cross\-sell/upsell conversations, and maintain a healthy NRR and CSAT
* **Industry \& Product Depth:** genuinely understands the debt collections/consumer finance industry and the day\-to\-day operations of Prodigal's customers
* **Executive Presence:** comfortable running structured, high\-stakes conversations with CXOs and senior stakeholders, not just day\-to\-day users
* **Strategic Thinking \& Project Management:** brings strategic insight to client interactions and expertly manages project timelines, priorities, and customer expectations
* **Problem\-Solving:** navigates ambiguity, diagnoses customer problems, and devises innovative solutions that ensure customer success
* **Business Acumen:** thinks in numbers: ROI, usage data, and account health metrics inform how you prioritize and pitch
* **High Agency:** takes ownership without waiting to be told; comfortable making calls in ambiguous, fast\-moving situations

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 3\-5 years of experience in Customer Success, ideally in a B2B Agentic AI environment
* Experience working with North America\-based customers
* Based out of our Mumbai office, 5 days a week
* Familiar with 01 Customer Success
* Available during US business hours (until 4:30 PM ET)
* Strong customer\-first mindset with excellent verbal and written communication
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment
* High agency individual that pursues excellence. Ready to wear multiple hats.


**Top Tier Benefits**
---------------------



Health insurance for you and your family, meals at office on us, travel reimbursement, unlimited leaves, gym membership, unlimited learning \& development, flexible work schedule and a world\-class team to learn and grow with!

  



From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast\-paced, intellectually\-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.



To learn more about us \- please visit the following:



Our Story \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/our\-story



What shapes our thinking \- https://link.prodigaltech.com/our\-thesis



Our website \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/

description:
