Job Description


**Job Description**


**Role Summary**


The GM, Automotive/ Transportation Experience Design is a senior automotive design leadership role responsible for establishing, governing, and scaling world\-class 360\-degree hardware product experience across products, software interfaces, service journeys, training, support, warranty, repair, upgrades, and customer communications. The role includes hardware experience design(XD) system maturity, XD team building and governance during the product development process, cross\-functional delivery capability, and AI\-enabled automotive experience design transformation.


Senior Automotive Experience Design leadership roles are expected to set product experience vision, build experience design teams, align design with product and engineering roadmaps, embed research and usability into delivery workflows, govern design systems, and report customer impact through measurable qualitative and quantitative metrics.


This role is expected to manage and expand an Automotive Experience Design team comprising transportation designers and hardware product engineers that can work closely with project managers to deliver the entire product design. The GM and all members of this team should have experience in designing and launching consumer facing automotive products, and have had extensive experience working with the other functions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**Cross\-functional Delivery of World\-Class Transportation Experience Design**


* Build, hire, coach, and deploy the right talent to deliver consistent product experience across product, engineering, operations, marketing, customer support, service, and training touchpoints.
* Define XD goals and operating model for cross\-functional teams, including responsibilities, governance forums, review checkpoints, and decision rights.
* Train existing cross\-functional talent on customer\-centric thinking, usability, design system adoption, journey thinking, and experience\-quality standards.
  

  

**Envision and Govern 360\-Degree Customer Experience**


* Define the end\-to\-end customer experience vision across marketing, merchandising, training, end\-use workflows, customer support, warranty, service, repair, and upgrade journeys.
* Establish consistent interaction patterns, visual standards, content conventions, service principles, and customer effort reduction targets across channels.
* Conduct customer journey mapping, workflow analysis, usability testing, voice\-of\-customer research, task\-completion analysis, and friction heatmap reviews.
* Report XD impact and effectiveness to leadership through the right metrics.
  

  

**XD Processes and Product Development Governance**


* Embed XD research as a mandatory part of the product development process and ensure customer evidence informs product and engineering decisions.
* Institutionalize the PRD to XRD to Engineering Requirements workflow, ensuring experience requirements are traceable, testable, and enforced.
* Own XD lifecycle management, including design approval, deviation approval, change approval, experience release readiness, and post\-release feedback loops.
* Create governance artifacts such as XD acceptance criteria, experience risk logs, design review records, usability findings, and design\-system compliance reports.
  

  

**Build Scalable XD Capability and Leadership Pipeline**


* Deploy XD talent into vertical product teams while maintaining central governance, design standards, and shared design system ownership.
* Build career paths, competency frameworks, succession plans, mentoring routines, retention mechanisms, and performance evaluation inputs for UX/XD talent.
* Create a high\-accountability culture that balances customer advocacy, engineering feasibility, product velocity, mission reliability, and business impact.
  

  

**AI\-Powered Customer Experience**


* Assess where AI can augment or replace repetitive XD skills, research synthesis, support triage, prototyping, design review, documentation, and journey analytics.
* Design AI\-enabled XD processes that retain human\-centered principles, safety, explainability, and trust for mission\-critical drone platform contexts.
* Recruit, train, and upskill teams for AI\-assisted research, design operations, prototyping, content generation, analytics, and human\-AI interaction design.
* Implement AI\-enabled XD improvements within the product development process and measure whether they match or exceed current process outcomes.
  

  

**Skills and Competencies**


* Deep Automotive/ Transportation XD experience, design systems, and usability expertise across physical, support, service, and training touchpoints.
* Strong understanding of product management, engineering, operations, customer support, mission workflows, and product development governance.
* Ability to translate customer insights into experience requirements, acceptance criteria, design standards, and measurable product/engineering decisions.
* Agile and Lean methodologies, research operations, design operations, design QA, accessibility, journey mapping, and usability testing.
* Leadership, hiring, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, communication, facilitation, and conflict resolution across product and engineering stakeholders.
* AI literacy for customer experience: human\-AI interaction, AI\-assisted research/design workflows, ethical and trustworthy AI experience principles, prompt/prototype evaluation, and productivity measurement.
  

  

**Education and Experience**


* Bachelor degree in Automotive Design required; Master degree preferred in Automotive Design, Industrial Design, Psychology, Engineering, Innovation Management or related field.
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in Automotive/ Transportation Design, product\-led experience leadership, experience leading design/research teams.
* Demonstrated experience scaling automotive experience design systems, design governance, user research practices, design operations, and cross\-functional experience quality in complex technology environments.
* Experience with mission\-critical, hardware\-software, robotics, UAV, industrial technology, aerospace/defense, or regulated product environments is a plus.
* Portfolio or case studies showing launched automotive design examples with measurable impact on usability, customer effort, adoption, consistency, support reduction, product quality, or customer trust.
  

  

**Working Interfaces**


**Internal:** R\&D, Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Training, Service, Quality, and Delivery teams.


**External:** Key customers and operators, field users, service partners, design/research agencies, training partners, ecosystem experts, and technology vendors.

  

  

**First 6\-12 Month Success Indicators**


* Baseline Transportation XD and design maturity assessment completed across products, support, training, service, and customer\-facing digital touchpoints.
* Transportation Design system roadmap, governance model, and adoption targets agreed with product and engineering leadership.
* PDP XD governance implemented with mandatory XD research, PRD\-XRD\-engineering traceability, and review/approval checkpoints.
* Core customer journeys mapped and prioritized by mission criticality, customer effort, support impact, revenue impact, and product risk.
* AI\-powered XD use cases piloted with measurable process\-quality or cycle\-time improvement.

* Cybersecurity / architecture / compliance awareness

**End\-to\-End Delivery Accountability**

* Coordinate business, internal IT teams, Group teams and external partners to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure critical dependencies, issues and decisions have clear owners and committed closure dates.
* Drive design, build, integration, testing, UAT readiness, cutover and stabilization governance.
* Ensure IT change management, implementation, security and governance controls are defined, validated and complied with for all assigned projects.
* Escalate risks early with clear business impact, options and decisions required.

* Ensure post\-go\-live stabilization is completed before formal project closure.

* Ensure business readiness, UAT ownership, training/adoption needs and go\-live acceptance criteria are established.
* Measure project and service satisfaction and drive corrective actions for material gaps.
* Monitor solution adoption and identify barriers affecting business outcomes.
* Conduct structured post\-go\-live reviews with business and delivery stakeholders.


**Value Realization \& Portfolio Governance**
* Develop business cases jointly with business owners and define measurable expected benefits before investment.
* Establish baseline, target value, benefit owner and realization timeline for strategic initiatives.
* Track value realization after implementation and escalate gaps in adoption or benefit achievement.
* Support portfolio prioritization based on strategic fit, business value, risk and delivery capacity.


**Financial \& Commercial Governance**
* Support IT budget and investment planning for assigned business initiatives.
* Track project budget, committed spend, forecast and Change Request impact.
* Validate vendor estimates and commercial assumptions in coordination with IT Governance / Procurement.
* Ensure ongoing run\-cost and support\-cost implications are visible before go\-live.

title: Distribution Executive - US Hotels
description:
**Location:** 
 Pune, Yerwada (work from office)
 



**Shift:** 
 5 PM – 3 AM IST (Monday to Friday)
 



**CTC:** 
 4\-6 LPA
 



  





**About Atica** 




 Atica is a tech\-first sales and revenue partner for hotels across the United States. We build the technology and run the commercial operation that grows revenue for 200\+ properties — sales, revenue management, distribution and digital — from independents to hotels operating under Marriott, IHG, Hyatt, Choice and Wyndham.
 



  





**Find out more:** 




 https://www.aticaglobal.com https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica\-global
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 Distribution is how Atica's hotels reach global B2B demand — through wholesalers and bed banks (Hotelbeds, WebBeds, Roibos, World2Meet, Travel Funders Network), travel management platforms (Engine, Bnberry) and redistribution partners (Nuitee).
 



  





 We are appointing a Manager to own that function end to end: the partner relationships, the commercial terms behind them, the channel and rate strategy across the portfolio, and the team that runs it.
 



  





 The mandate is to grow distribution's contribution to revenue, open the channels worth opening, close the ones that are not, and build the team and process behind it.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Partner strategy and commercial ownership
* Own every demand partner relationship and the commercial terms behind it: performance reviews, negotiation, escalation, and keeping Atica's hotels prioritised on their platforms.
* Segment the partner portfolio by fit and contribution, and decide where to invest and where to withdraw.
* Open new channels end to end evaluate the opportunity, negotiate terms, contract, and see the first properties live and producing.
* Grow partner penetration and revenue contribution across every active channel.



  





**Channel and rate strategy** 




  




* Decide the channel mix by property and market, and set rate positioning and allotment alongside Revenue Management, who own final pricing.
* Manage redistribution and leakage risk to protect rate integrity across the portfolio.
* Audit content, pricing and offers for accuracy and commercial compliance.



  





**Building the function** 




  




* Hire, develop and lead the Distribution team.
* Turn recurring problems into a standard process, and decide what gets automated.
* Work with Product and Tech on what gets built — workflow gaps, feature requests and internal tooling.



  





**Across the business** 




  




* Partner with Sales and Revenue Management on hotel\-level commercial objectives.
* Engage US hotel stakeholders, Directors of Sales, Revenue Managers directly.



  





**How You'll Be Measured** 



* Revenue contribution from distribution.
* Partner penetration across active channels.
* Strength of the partner ecosystem, including how quickly escalations are resolved.
* Percentage of hotels live on channel within SLA.
* The team's performance and delivery quality.



  





 In your first quarter you will have met every partner, formed a view on which relationships are underperforming, and made the case for where we invest. Within the year, distribution contributes materially more revenue, the channel mix reflects a deliberate strategy, and the team is one you have built.
 



  





**What You Bring** 



* 1\-3 years in hotel distribution, contracting, wholesale, global sales, or a comparable commercial role in hospitality or travel.
* Working knowledge of the wholesale channel: contracting, allotments, rate fencing, markup chains and redistribution. From either side of the table if you have contracted hotels for a bed bank, that translates directly.
* A negotiation track record. You have owned commercial conversations with partners and moved the terms.
* Clear, structured stakeholder communication, and the ability to push back when it matters.
* Evidence of building process operational complexity turned into something documented and repeatable.
* Ownership of an outcome rather than a workflow.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* People management experience.
* TMC or B2B2C channel exposure.
* Familiarity with the US hotel market.
* Please Note Before Applying

Acting as the primary point of contact for learners during onboarding, nesting, and refresher training, the Trainer translates policies, payer rules, and system workflows into engaging, easy\-to\-follow instruction, and closely tracks each trainee's progress toward production readiness. This is a hands\-on, floor\-facing role that blends classroom facilitation, on\-the\-job coaching, and performance feedback to ensure every associate reaches proficiency quickly and sustains it once in production.  



  

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assess learning and performance needs by partnering with business leaders, clients, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to identify knowledge gaps and training requirements.
* Design, develop, and maintain training programs, curricula, learning materials, job aids, and performance support resources that support role effectiveness and business objectives.
* Deliver instructor\-led, virtual, and self\-paced training programs to employees, clients, and end users on products, processes, workflows, services, and organizational initiatives.
* Translate technical, operational, and business concepts into engaging, audience\-appropriate learning experiences that promote understanding and skill development.
* Support implementation, activation, and change initiatives by developing and delivering training that enables successful adoption of new solutions, technologies, processes, and operational practices.
* Facilitate onboarding, knowledge transfer, and readiness activities to accelerate learner proficiency and support successful transitions.
* Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, participant feedback, performance metrics, and stakeholder input, and implement continuous improvements to learning programs.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure training content remains accurate, current, aligned with product enhancements, operational requirements, and organizational priorities.
* Provide coaching, consultation, and ongoing learning support to reinforce knowledge application and improve individual and team performance.
* Maintain training records, learning content repositories, and instructional documentation in accordance with established standards and processes.
* Monitor industry trends, adult learning methodologies, and emerging training technologies to enhance learning effectiveness and user engagement.
Contribute to the development of learning strategies and best practices that support workforce readiness, operational consistency, customer success, and business performance.  
* 

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Healthcare Information Technology, Communications, Organizational Development, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2\-4 years’ experience designing, developing, and delivering training programs, learning solutions, or instructional content.
* Knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and learning facilitation techniques.
* Experience creating training materials, including presentations, job aids, guides, e\-learning content, and performance support resources.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex business, operational, or technical information to diverse audiences.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams, stakeholders, and subject matter experts.
* Ability to assess training needs and develop solutions that address knowledge and performance gaps.
* Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and learning technologies used to develop and deliver training.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.  
* 

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, software, SaaS, revenue cycle management, clinical operations, or related industries.
* Experience supporting software implementations, system deployments, business process changes, or organizational transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of healthcare workflows, regulatory requirements, reimbursement processes, medical coding, or healthcare operations.
* Experience with instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE, SAM, or similar methodologies.
* Experience developing e\-learning content using learning authoring tools.
* Experience with learning management systems (LMS) and learning analytics.
* Experience facilitating virtual instructor\-led training and large\-scale training programs.
* Change management, organizational effectiveness, or user adoption experience.
* Experience consulting directly with clients or customer\-facing stakeholders.
Professional certifications related to training, learning, instructional design, project management, or change management.  
* 

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORKING CONDITIONS**

Primarily works in a standard office environment. Sit/Stand at a desk working consistently on a computer. Frequently talking, hearing, seeing, and heavy use of a keyboard and mouse. May require working after hours.

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a **Senior Conversational AI / Chatbot Developer** to support the development and expansion of an enterprise **Omnichannel customer service platform** across channels such as WhatsApp, web chat, email and other digital touchpoints.

The candidate will work closely with technical leads, business teams, customer service stakeholders and integration teams to take requirements from design through development, testing and production.

* Identify opportunities to improve automation, customer experience and case\-deflection capabilities.


Maintain technical documentation for chatbot flows, integrations and configurations.

* Strong understanding of conversational flows, intents, entities, context management and fallback handling.
* Experience with **REST APIs, JSON and backend integrations**.

* Experience integrating applications with CRM, ERP or other enterprise systems.

* Ability to understand business requirements and independently deliver assigned technical solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with WhatsApp Business or similar messaging\-channel integrations.
* Customer service, contact center or case\-management platform experience.
* Experience integrating with **SAP, CRM or enterprise case\-management systems**.
* Experience with Agentic AI, Generative AI or LLM\-based conversational solutions.
* Knowledge\-base integration and automated answer\-generation experience.
* Experience with multilingual or multi\-country chatbot implementations.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and API management.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Hands\-on development
* Conversational and customer\-experience thinking
* End\-to\-end ownership of assigned use cases
* Strong integration and API skills
* Problem solving and troubleshooting
* Quality and testing mindset

The successful candidate will independently deliver high\-quality **Conversational AI and chatbot solutions**, build reliable integrations with enterprise systems, improve customer self\-service and automation, and contribute to scaling the Omnichannel platform across multiple channels and markets.

title: Client Partner, K12 - Cialfo
description:
What This Role Is
   

  

 Across the Americas \- from US school districts to Latin American international schools, counselors are the single point of contact between a student's ambition and the university system that will decide their future. Most of them are doing this work manually — tracking hundreds of applications in spreadsheets, chasing document deadlines by email, and making recommendations without the data to back them. When that system breaks down, it isn't a productivity problem. It's a missed deadline that closes a door a student spent years working toward.
   

  

 Cialfo exists to close that gap, and how well that gap gets closed depends on two things happening at once: schools already on the platform getting real value out of it, and new schools discovering that this is the platform their counseling team actually needs.
   

  

 That is what this role owns. You are the person a portfolio of high schools across North and South America trusts to make Cialfo work for them, and you are also the person who walks into a school that has never heard of Cialfo and makes the case for why that should change. Saige, our AI layer, is live, and part of what you own is making sure both existing and new schools actually adopt it rather than let it sit unused.
   

  

 You own the renewal and growth of an existing book of schools, and the identification and close of new ones, across two markets that don't behave the same way — US schools and Latin American schools have different buying rhythms, different stakeholders, and often different languages. This role owns the health, retention, and growth of an assigned portfolio of US and LATAM K12 school accounts, operating from India on US hours.
   

  

 What Makes This Role Different
   

  

 Most account management roles in EdTech ask you to defend a territory. Most new\-business roles ask you to build one from nothing. This role asks you to do both at once — which means you never fully switch off the instinct that wins new logos, and you never fully switch off the instinct that keeps existing ones. It also asks you to do it across two distinct markets under one remit, rather than one clean, homogenous territory.
   

  

 It also asks you to do this across one of the widest timezone gaps in the Manifest portfolio. Being based in India while owning an Americas book of business isn't a limitation to work around — it's part of how Cialfo builds a genuinely global support model, and it means the muscle you build here (structured handoffs, tight written communication, deliberate scheduling around narrow overlap windows) is a distinct capability, not a compromise.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem gives you something a standalone vendor doesn't have: when a school's ambitions extend beyond counseling — university outreach or student placement pathways — you can point to Explore or Kaaiser as part of the same infrastructure, rather than referring the school elsewhere. No competitor in this market holds that full arc.
   

  

 The broader overseas education industry is contracting. Cialfo is growing. That gap is the argument for why now is the right time to be inside a school's counseling office, not outside it.
   

  

 What You Own
   

  

**Existing school relationships across the Americas**
* Own the renewal and health of a defined portfolio of high school accounts across both US and Latin American markets
* Build direct relationships with counselors, IT teams, and school leadership — not just your primary point of contact
* Identify and resolve account risk before it becomes churn


**New school acquisition across the Americas**
* Build and work a pipeline of prospective schools across both markets
* Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract
* Translate Cialfo's platform value into terms that land with a counseling team meeting it for the first time, adjusting the pitch to how each market actually buys


**Onboarding and platform adoption**
* Lead onboarding and training tailored to each stakeholder group, from counselors to senior leadership, whether the school is new or renewing
* Drive adoption of Saige and other newer product features against each school's actual counseling workflow
* Ensure every stakeholder group understands the platform well enough to rely on it during peak application season


**Account growth and expansion**
* Build account\-specific growth plans using engagement and outcome data, not general upsell targets
* Identify where a school's needs extend into other parts of the Manifest ecosystem and translate that into commercial opportunity
* Present renewal and expansion proposals with the credibility of someone who has actually used the data


**Client operations**
* Keep account records, interaction history, and pipeline status current in the CRM
* Translate recurring client feedback into structured input for the product team
* Structure your workflow and handoffs around narrow daily overlap windows that shift depending on whether you're working US or Latin American hours


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The markers below reflect where the Cialfo Americas client success and growth function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first three months, you know your existing portfolio well enough to have a point of view on which accounts are healthy in both markets, and you've built a working rhythm that makes the most of narrow live\-overlap windows rather than fighting them — you've started building a real pipeline of prospective schools rather than a list of names.
   

  

 By six months, your existing accounts show visibly higher adoption of features like Saige than when you started, and you've closed or are close to closing your first new schools in at least one of the two markets, without the timezone gap ever becoming the client's problem to manage.
   

  

 By twelve months, you've built a portfolio that runs on trust rather than maintenance across both the US and Latin American book, and a track record of new schools who chose Cialfo because of how you made the case to them. What you built — on both sides of the book, in both markets — outlasts the individual deals.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

 What You Bring
   

  

 You've spent the better part of five years or more in customer success, account management, business development, or client\-facing strategic consulting, ideally with exposure to SaaS, EdTech, or B2B technology sold into schools or comparable institutions. You've done both sides of this job before — closing new business and running an existing book — and you don't think of them as different skill sets, just different conversations.
   

  

 You read data and use it to make decisions about an account before the client asks you to, not after. You track what a portfolio is worth today and what it should be worth, and you build the case to close that gap yourself — whether that gap is a renewal at risk or a school that hasn't signed yet.
   

  

 You're comfortable moving between a counselor who's never used a CRM and a head of school who wants a strategic conversation about outcomes — and you adjust your approach for each without losing credibility with either. You're equally comfortable adjusting your approach between a US school district and a Latin American international school, because you know these aren't the same conversation wearing different accents.
   

  

 You're fluent in English and comfortable working in Spanish or Portuguese, since a meaningful part of this book won't run in English at all.
   

  

 You've built relationships across significant timezone gaps before, or you know exactly how you'd approach it: tight written communication, no reliance on catching people live, and a schedule structured enough that narrow overlap windows are a constraint you plan around, not an excuse.
   

  

 This is a role with a defined book of accounts, an open territory of prospects, and real autonomy in how you manage both. You don't need someone checking in on your renewal strategy or your pipeline weekly.
   

  

 You're coachable. This function is still being refined, and the person who thrives here treats feedback as part of getting better at the job, not as a threat to how they already do it.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what Cialfo is building for schools across the Americas and your first reaction was that you already know exactly which relationships you'd deepen and which doors you'd knock on first — in both markets. That's the person this role is for.
   

  

 Why Manifest
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically, the relationships you build with schools across the Americas — new and existing, in two markets that don't run the same way — are what turn Cialfo from a platform some schools use into the platform counseling teams across the hemisphere choose by default.
   

  

 Cialfo is part of Manifest Global — a multi\-brand group building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.

title: GTM Lead - B2B
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Sneakare is a New Delhi\-based, fastest\-growing sneaker care brand, built for people who genuinely love what they are wearing on their feet. We market premium, no\-nonsense products — cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions — designed to help sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear what they love, longer. We started small, made it to Shark Tank India, and haven't slowed down since. Our team is young, fast\-moving, and obsessed with getting things right — whether that's a product formula, a listing copy, or a customer interaction. We care about quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




 We're looking for an experienced GTM Lead to build and own Sneakare's B2B business, largely from scratch. The mandate starts with two known pillars — brand collaborations and corporate gifting — and extends to identifying and standing up whatever other B2B channels make sense for the brand (distribution/wholesale, hospitality, institutional bulk orders, etc.). This is a strategy\-plus\-execution role: you'll define the B2B GTM plan with the Founder, then build and run the pipeline yourself in the early stages.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\.  Corporate Gifting:** 




 • Build a pipeline of corporate clients (HR/admin/procurement teams) for bulk/festive/onboarding gifting orders
 



 • Own pricing, packaging, and proposal templates for corporate orders, including customization options
 



 • Manage the deal cycle from pitch to contract to delivery, coordinating with ops/warehouse on fulfillment timelines
 



 • Build repeat relationships aimed at annual/recurring gifting contracts rather than one\-off orders
 



  





**2\. Brand Collaborations:** 




 • Identify and pitch co\-branded product or campaign opportunities with complementary brands
 



 • Negotiate collaboration terms (commercials, exclusivity, timelines) and manage the partnership through to launch
 



 • Work with marketing/product on execution — packaging, launch content, and joint promotion
 



  





**3\. New B2B Channels (Build\-Out):** 




 • Scope and validate additional B2B revenue channels — e.g. distributor/wholesale partnerships, hotel/airline amenity kits, event and gifting agencies, marketplace B2B — and bring recommendations to the Founder
 



 • Pilot one or two of these channels, defining what a repeatable sales motion looks like before scaling
 



 • Build the playbook (pricing, pitch, process) for each channel you stand up, so it can eventually be handed off or scaled
 



  





**4\. Pipeline, Deal Cycle \& Reporting:** 




 • Own the full deal cycle — prospecting, pitching, negotiation, contracting, and post\-sale account management
 



 • Maintain a live pipeline/CRM view of leads, deal stage, and expected revenue
 



 • Track B2B revenue against targets and report performance regularly to the Founder and leadership
 



  





**5\. Marketing \& Representation:** 




 • Work with marketing to build B2B collateral — decks, case studies, one\-pagers — that support the sales pitch
 



 • Represent Sneakare at industry events, expos, and networking forums to build pipeline and brand visibility in the B2B space
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months):** 




 • A qualified, trackable B2B pipeline exists (not just informal conversations) with clear deal stages and expected value
 



 • Corporate gifting is generating consistent month\-on\-month revenue, with at least a few clients converted to repeat/annual contracts
 



 • At least one brand collaboration has been pitched, negotiated, and launched
 



 • A recommendation (backed by a small pilot) exists for at least one new B2B channel beyond gifting and collabs
 



 • Leadership has a regular, reliable view of B2B revenue and pipeline health
 








**Requirements:** 




 • 6\-8 years of experience in B2B sales, corporate gifting, partnerships, or key account management
 



 • Proven track record of building a pipeline from scratch and closing corporate/B2B deals
 



 • Experience in a D2C, FMCG, or lifestyle brand background preferred
 



 • Strong negotiation, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills
 



 • Excellent communication and presentation skills — comfortable pitching to corporate and institutional buyers
 



 • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building a vertical largely from scratch with limited existing playbook, and turning ambiguity into a structured plan
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment
 



  





**Experience:** 
 6\-8 years
 



**Location:** 
 Kirti Nagar, Delhi (Onsite)
 



**Department:** 
 B2B / Business Development
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**CTC:**

title: Speciality Sales Manager Benign General Surgery
description:
**Company Description**
 It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
 **Intuitive** 
 . As a global leader in
 **robotic\-assisted surgery** 
 and
 **minimally invasive care** 
 , our technologies—like the
 **da Vinci surgical system** 
 and
 **Ion** 
 —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
   

  

 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
   

  

 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
   

  

 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
 **transform the future of healthcare** 
 , you’ll find your purpose here.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
 The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in identifying, developing, and expanding adoption of da Vinci procedures in Benign General Surgery across North \+ East India. Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.
   

  

 This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. It combines clinical selling, market development, surgeon pathway execution, customer value creation, and cross\-functional program leadership. The SSM will work through the local commercial organization and directly engage priority customers where specialist expertise is required.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedure Utilization
* Develop and execute the India specialty strategy for Benign General Surgery, aligned with regional priorities and commercial objectives.
* Identify and prioritize procedure growth opportunities, including hernia repair, cholecystectomy, and other relevant benign general surgery procedures within the specialty.
* Apply established da Vinci adoption and procedure readiness methodologies in assigned specialties, territories, and target accounts.
* Analyze procedure, surgeon, account, and market trends to prioritize opportunities, address adoption barriers, and guide field execution.
* Partner with local Clinical Sales and Capital Sales teams to develop account\-specific plans that increase utilization of installed systems and create future system opportunities.
* Lead strategic market development activities that build awareness, clinical confidence, and sustainable procedure adoption.
* Convert High\-Volume Laparoscopy Centers into da Vinci Programs
* Identify and prioritize high\-volume laparoscopic centers in Benign General Surgery that have the clinical leadership, procedure volume, infrastructure, and strategic intent to build a robotic surgery program.
* Develop conversion strategies that articulate the clinical, operational, and economic value of da Vinci surgery to surgeons, hospital executives, and other decision\-makers.
* Partner with Capital Sales, Clinical Sales, Key Accounts, and hospital stakeholders to help qualified high\-volume laparoscopic centers procure a da Vinci system and establish a sustainable program.
* Support the complete program\-building journey, including opportunity assessment, executive alignment, surgeon onboarding, care\-team readiness, initial case\-series support, patient pathway development, and post\-launch growth planning.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
At Kapture CX, we are looking for a **Customer Experience Manager** in our Customer experience team.  

Kapture CX is an AI\-native, verticalized SaaS platform helping enterprises automate and execute complex customer and business workflows.
At the core of Kapture is AgentOS — our Agentic Operating System that brings together AI agents, human intelligence, enterprise systems, and operational intelligence to execute work end\-to\-end. AgentOS enables enterprises to build, deploy, orchestrate, monitor, evaluate, and optimize AI\-powered workflows across customer support, sales, collections, claims, and other business operations.  

Today, Kapture is trusted by 1,000\+ enterprises across 18 countries, helping organizations move beyond isolated automation toward intelligent, outcome\-driven operations.### **What is this role all about?**


As a **Customer Experience Manager****,** you become the trusted technical advisor for our clients. You ensure customers successfully onboard, integrate, and scale on Kapture’s platform while proactively solving complex technical challenges and driving long\-term value.### **Sounds interesting?**


Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:  

* You will lead client onboarding and integrations, working hands\-on with APIs, JSON payloads, and tools like Postman and cURL to ensure seamless adoption.
* You will own technical support and escalations, diagnosing issues using logs, Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, and collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to drive fast resolutions.
* You will build strong, trusted client relationships by acting as a technical advisor and advocate, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* You will proactively identify optimization opportunities, conduct platform health checks, and recommend technical strategies to help clients maximize ROI.
* You will document issues, resolutions, and RCAs while sharing feedback and insights to influence product improvements and best practices.

  

This is a **Delhi\-based role**. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.### **What does success look like in this role?**


You consistently deliver smooth client experiences, resolve issues before they escalate, and help customers fully leverage Kapture’s platform to achieve measurable business impact.### **What would make you a good fit for this role?**

**Here are the basic requirements:*** You have strong hands\-on experience with API integrations and system troubleshooting.
* You are comfortable working directly with enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities.
* You can collaborate effectively with engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems in fast\-paced environments.

### **What are the most critical skills for this role?**

* You can debug issues by inspecting logs, tracing errors, and identifying root causes quickly.
* You are proficient with modern tech stacks and monitoring tools like Kafka, Grafana, and Sentry (or similar).
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You take ownership and think proactively about client success and platform optimization.

### **You will have an advantage if you:**

* You have prior experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
* You are comfortable working with SQL/NoSQL databases and understanding data flows.
* You have exposure to chatbot technologies or AI\-driven automation platforms.
* You enjoy creating clear documentation, troubleshooting guides, and RCAs.

### **Why should you be interested?**

**Here’s what you will gain from this role:*** An opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, clients, and business impact.
* Hands\-on exposure to large\-scale CX automation and AI\-powered platforms.
* Collaboration with highly skilled product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Strong growth opportunities in a fast\-scaling global SaaS organization, along with competitive compensation and performance\-linked rewards.

title: Customer Excellence Specialist

**Customer Excellence Specialist**
----------------------------------

* Work model: Hybrid (shift\-based including 1 weekend shift per month, no night shifts)

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------


Deliver seamless, high\-quality customer experiences across APAC region by managing the complete order\-to\-delivery process for ICEYE’s satellite radar data.

  

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you will ensure customers receive timely and accurate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, balancing technical insight, proactive communication, and operational precision. You will work closely with our satellite operations, product, and analytics teams to make sure every delivery meets ICEYE’s world\-class standards and customer expectations.

  

**Who We Are**
--------------

  

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world’s largest SAR constellation, acquiring images of Earth at any time — even through clouds or darkness — to help commercial and government partners make data\-driven decisions.

  

Our satellites and analytics support critical sectors, including maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance. ICEYE’s mission is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

  

Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from offices in five international locations and employs over 600 people from nearly 60 countries, united by our passion for innovation, teamwork, and impact.

  

**Your day\-to\-day responsibilities**
--------------------------------------

**Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities**


Order Management:

* Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.
* Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.


Satellite Resource Planning:

* Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.
* Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.


Customer Interaction:

* Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer\-related issues.
* Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.


Process Improvement:

* Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.
* Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.


Product Knowledge:

* Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.


Governmental and Commercial Contracts:

* Serve as the point of contact for APAC governmental contracts and commercial clients.
* Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.


Relationship Building:

* Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order\-related queries.


Training and Progress Monitoring:

* Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.
* Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues


Reporting:

* Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

  

**Requirements**
----------------

**Must haves:**

* Proven experience in customer excellence or account management roles.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Bachelor's degree or practical experience in geography, remote sensing, or aerospace domains.
* **Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindu/Mandarin/Korean (depending on the location).**

 **Key Competences**

* **Intellectual Firepower:** Quickly grasps complex operational and technical information, translating it into clear customer communication.
* **Passion \& Work Ethic:** Demonstrates consistent motivation, reliability, and ownership in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* **Ownership \& Action:** Takes accountability for order performance and customer satisfaction.
* **Team Player:** Collaborates effectively with global colleagues and cross\-functional teams.
* **Integrity \& Growth Mindset**: Acts transparently, learns from challenges, and seeks continuous improvement.

 **Application Process**

* TA Screen Interview
* HM interview
* Task Stage
* Task\-based interview
* Final Interview

**Working at ICEYE**
--------------------

  

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale\-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

  

**How We Work (Our Values)**
----------------------------

 **Make the impossible possible**: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

* **Be curious**: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
* **See the big picture:** Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
* **Drive effective teamwork:** Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
* **Act as one team:** We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
* **Have fun**: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

  

**Benefits**
------------


Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------------------------


We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.


We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.


Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in operations or business management, and vendor management.
* 7 years of experience using analytics or applying project management tools to address business issues.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience managing or accelerating sales portfolios across regional/international markets within fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Proven track record of orchestrating portfolio turnarounds, exceeding business generation quotas, and inspiring high\-velocity inside sales teams to drive consultative customer value.
* Robust working knowledge of core Google Ads solutions including Search, Performance Max (PMax), and Demand Gen, with a proven ability to map customer\-centric business objectives to the optimal product adoption and maturity journey.
* Ability to synthesize complex, high\-volume performance data into actionable sales playbooks and executive growth roadmaps.
* Strong command of structured sales methodologies, complex pipeline mechanics, lead\-to\-opportunity conversions, and objection handling.


**About The Job**
 As a Vendor Performance Manager (VPM), you are a sales operations leader operating at the frontline of Google’s scaled growth engine. You will own and steer multi\-quarter business delivery across high\-velocity sales programs by partnering with vendor sales leadership, guiding consultative sellers, and driving full\-funnel sales excellence.
   

  

 In this role, you will transition seamlessly between macro\-level sales strategy and tactical pipeline acceleration. You will act as an autonomous business owner—analyzing high\-volume pipeline dynamics, shaping commercial sales motions, unlocking market opportunities, and driving product adoption across Google Ads, YouTube, and automated solutions. Your leadership ensures our extended sales teams deliver high\-touch consultative value, customer return on investment, and consistent, scalable business growth.
   

  

 This role is aligned to the AMER market and will require working non standard hours.
   

  

 The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver against ambitious quarterly business and product adoption goals. Own the end\-to\-end commercial performance of a multi\-million\-dollar portfolio by diagnosing growth drivers, mitigating churn risks, and designing scalable sales strategies.
* Drive rigorous sales pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy. Analyze conversion funnels across customer lifecycle stages to identify bottlenecks, optimize pitch cadence, and maximize business generation per lead.
* Elevate vendor sales leadership and frontline sellers from transactional pitching to high\-impact consultative selling. Coach on advanced sales techniques, objection handling, pitch structure, and the Google Ads product suite (e.g., Performance Max, YouTube, Smart Bidding) to maximize customer ROI.
* Lead high\-stakes weekly/monthly business reviews with senior vendor sales executives. Effectively coach partners to consistently hit quota.
* Translate quantitative data signals, campaign performance data, and market trends into actionable growth pipelines and scalable go\-to\-market plays across the region.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Brand Solutions Manager / Brand Partnerships Manager
description:

**Company:**

 Full\-Time

 1\-2 Years

 On Site
 




  




**About Creators Yug™** 


 Creators Yug™ is an influencer marketing and talent management company helping brands build meaningful connections with audiences through creators across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and other platforms.
 




  




**About the Role**


 We are looking for a
 
**Brand Solutions Manager / Brand Partnerships Manager** 

 who can independently drive business development, build strong brand relationships, understand client requirements and convert them into impactful influencer marketing solutions.
 





 This is not a traditional sales or follow\-up role. We are looking for someone who can
 
**own the entire brand partnership cycle** 

 — from identifying opportunities and pitching to negotiation, closure and relationship management.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities**
* Identify and build relationships with
 
**brand managers, marketing heads, growth teams and agencies** 

 .
* Generate new business opportunities through outbound outreach, networking, referrals and existing relationships.
* Understand brand objectives and create relevant
 
**influencer marketing solutions and campaign strategies** 

 .
* Prepare and present proposals, pitches, creator recommendations and commercials.

 .

 At Creators Yug™, we believe in giving people ownership.
 





 We are looking for someone who can:
 




**See → Understand → Strategize → Pitch → Close → Own.** 





 You should be able to manage your business pipeline independently without requiring the Founder for every conversation or decision.
 





 If a client has a challenge, you should be able to understand the requirement and develop a solution.
 





 If a deal is stuck, you should be able to identify the reason and find a way forward.
 




**Your responsibility is not just to generate leads — it is to build business.**

 .

* New business generated.

* Client relationship quality.

**Brand Partnerships Manager → Senior Manager → Business Development Lead → Head of Brand Partnerships → Business/Revenue Leadership**

 .

**Creators Yug™ — Building a future where creators drive commerce at scale.**

description:
**About the Role** 




 MyOperator is hiring a
 **Manager – Customer Success (Key Accounts)** 
 to lead a specialized pod of Key Account CSMs responsible for our most critical enterprise client portfolio.
 



 In this role, you will be a working manager—responsible for hiring, coaching, and holding your team accountable for Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), while directly steering executive\-level relationships and critical escalations across a concentrated set of 20–30 strategic enterprise accounts. You will design account\-tiering frameworks, build predictable expansion pipelines, and partner with Engineering, Product, and Solutions Architecture to ensure zero preventable churn in key accounts.
 



  





**About MyOperator** 




 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform. Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform. Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino's, Apollo, and Razorpay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \& Observable Work Outputs** 




  





**Team Leadership \& Performance Management** 



* Lead, recruit, and manage a team of 3–6 Enterprise CSMs; conduct weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and performance evaluations against team NRR/GRR targets.



  





**Enterprise Account Portfolio Governance** 



* Direct team oversight for a concentrated portfolio of 20–30 high\-value enterprise accounts, ensure $100% completion of Executive QBRs for Tier\-1 clients.



  





**Revenue Retention \& Expansion Execution** 



* Own team\-level Net Revenue Retention and Gross Revenue Retention; drive structured upselling/cross\-selling motions across CPaaS, Voice/IVR, and Custom AI Bot solutions.



  





**Executive Escalation \& Save Motions** 



* Step in as the primary executive contact for major account escalations, personally leading 30\-day save plans and technical remediation alignment alongside Engineering and Product leadership.



  





**Renewal Pipeline Management** 



* Conduct bi\-weekly renewal forecast reviews for all key account contracts expiring within 120 days; lead complex MSA negotiations, commercial addendum's, and multi\-year contract renewals.



  





**CS Operations \& Play book Standardisation** 



* Build and enforce enterprise CS play books—including executive onboarding flows, health\-scoring parameters, adoption tracking, and risk\-mitigation frameworks—standardised within the CRM.



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Must\-Have Requirements** 



* **Total Experience:** 
 8\+ years total experience in B2B Customer Success, Account Management, or Enterprise Client Delivery within SaaS, CPaaS, or technical software industries.
* **People Management Experience:** 
 Minimum 3 years of direct people management experience formally leading a team of CS Managers or Key Account Managers (not just indirect project coordination).
* **Enterprise Portfolio Scale:** 
 Proven experience overseeing enterprise\-grade key accounts with contract values \- ARR each, focusing on a tight, concentrated account portfolio rather than high\-volume SMB accounts.
* **Quota \& Financial Accountability:** 
 Direct team or individual ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets (NRR/GRR metrics) in previous roles.
* **Technical Product Familiarity:** 
 Experience managing technical enterprise solutions involving APIs, webhooks, workflow engines, cloud telephony, or conversational AI platforms.
* **CS \& CRM Software Depth:** 
 Daily operational proficiency inside enterprise CRM tools (
 **Salesforce** 
 ,
 **Zoho CRM** 
 , or
 **HubSpot** 
 ) and Customer Success management tools (
 **Gainsight** 
 ,
 **Totango** 
 , or
 **ChurnZero** 
 ).
* **Location \& Work Model:** 
 Based in Delhi NCR and able to work from the Noida office.



  





**Good\-to\-Have / Preferred Signals** 



* Direct domain exposure in CPaaS, WhatsApp Business API, Cloud Telephony, or Conversational AI (LLM / Voicebot solutions).
* Consistent track record of team achieving NRR target across enterprise key accounts.
* Experience building or restructuring Enterprise Customer Success play books, health\-score frameworks, or QBR templates.
* Track record of building and scaling enterprise CS teams from 3 to 10\+ team members in a high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.

title: Customer Success Team Lead
description:
**Role Overview** 




 Most Customer Success roles are built to survive churn. This one is built to prevent it — and then grow past it.
 



  





 As Team Leader, Customer Success at MyOperator, you will directly manage a pod of 5–8 Customer Success Representatives across an SMB and Mid\-Market portfolio. Your job is to move the team from reactive firefighting to a structured, proactive commercial motion — with clear playbooks, health score dashboards, and a 30\-day onboarding engine that accelerates Time\-to\-Value for every new customer. You will own your team's Gross Revenue Retention and Net Retention Rate numbers and be accountable for delivering them, quarter after quarter.
 



  





 This is a people\-management role with hard commercial accountability. You are expected to run a tight ship operationally — 1:1s, pipeline reviews, usage monitoring — while also thinking like a revenue owner who can spot expansion opportunities before customers even ask.
 



  





**About MyOperator** 




 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform. Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform. Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino's, Apollo, and Razorpay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas** 




  




* **Team Management:** 
 Directly manage 5–8 Customer Success Representatives. Conduct weekly 1:1s tracking individual account health and pipeline, run monthly upsell pipeline reviews, and hold each CSR accountable to quarterly renewal and expansion targets.
* **Revenue \& Retention Ownership:** 
 Own GRR and NRR for your team's portfolio. Build, maintain, and execute account\-specific intervention playbooks for at\-risk accounts — triggered by usage signals, low call volumes, or stakeholder changes — before accounts reach the point of churn.
* **Onboarding Engine:** 
 Design and enforce a structured 30\-day onboarding journey combining tech\-touch automation and high\-touch check\-ins. Track Time\-to\-Value at the cohort level and identify patterns that delay activation.
* **Health Score Infrastructure:** 
 Build and maintain customer health score dashboards in the CRM. Configure automated alerts for accounts showing early warning signals — dropping usage, low call volumes, missed check\-ins — so your team can intervene before the customer considers churning.
* **Escalation \& Cross\-Functional Input:** 
 Serve as the primary escalation owner for high\-risk accounts in your portfolio. Synthesize product friction data across accounts monthly and deliver structured input to the Product and Engineering teams with account evidence.
* **CSR Skill Development:** 
 Identify performance gaps across your team by reviewing call recordings, customer emails, and CRM notes. Run structured coaching sessions to develop commercial conversation skills, objection handling, and expansion identification.



  





**Requirements — Must Have** 



* **5\+ years** 
 of experience in B2B Customer Success or Account Management at a SaaS or technology company, with direct exposure to SMB or Mid\-Market segments.
* **2\+ years of people management** 
 experience, having directly managed a team of 3 or more CSRs or Account Managers — including running performance reviews, handling underperformance, and conducting hiring.
* **Commercial quota ownership:** 
 Demonstrable track record of carrying and achieving a revenue\-linked quota — Net Retention Rate, Upsell ARR, or Gross Renewal targets — not just customer satisfaction scores.
* **CRM proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on experience configuring dashboards, running reports, and managing pipeline in enterprise CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho CRM) and/or CS platforms (Gainsight, ChurnZero, or Totango).
* **Data independence:** 
 Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs, conditional logic) to independently build and analyze customer usage reports, churn cohort tables, and renewal forecasts without relying on a BI team.



  





**Requirements — Good to Have** 



* Domain experience in Cloud Telephony, UCaaS, CPaaS, or AI\-powered customer communication platforms — familiarity with how call volumes, IVR usage, and agent activity signal account health.
* Demonstrated experience leading a CS team through a motion shift — from reactive support to a commercial upsell and expansion model — including documentation of the before/after process change.
* Experience building or operating automated low\-touch customer engagement sequences: triggered email cadences based on usage thresholds, lifecycle milestones, or health score drops.
* Familiarity with CS analytics and forecasting: ability to build a 90\-day renewal forecast at the team level and present it to senior leadership with variance analysis.



  





**This Profile Is Not For** 



* Candidates whose primary experience is in B2C customer service, retail support, or high\-volume inbound call center operations — even at the team lead level.
* Candidates who have never owned a revenue, renewal, or upsell quota — this role carries hard commercial accountability and requires experience with being measured on a number.
* Individual contributors seeking their first people management opportunity — this role requires prior experience managing, developing, and where necessary, exiting direct reports.

title: Growth Manager - Influencer Marketing
description:
**Growth Manager – Influencer Marketing**




  





***Experience: 2–5 years***




***Compensation: As per experience and expertise, up to ₹6 LPA***




***Preferred: Influencer Marketing / Agency experience***




  





**About Marqueting Ventures** 




 Marqueting Ventures is an influencer marketing and brand\-building company working with leading brands across beauty, fashion, lifestyle, D2C, healthcare, retail and consumer categories.
 



  





 With 6\+ years of industry experience and a growing network of creators across categories, languages, regions and platforms, we work across the entire influencer marketing ecosystem — from strategy and creator discovery to campaign execution, content and performance.
 



  





 As we continue to scale, we are looking for someone who can bring more structure, visibility, and efficiency to how our business operates while actively contributing to its growth.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Growth Manager to own business growth, project management, operational efficiency, and client relationships across our influencer marketing business.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership and accountability\-led role. You will be expected to bring structure to a fast\-moving environment, create and improve processes, maintain visibility across business performance and ensure that opportunities and projects move forward efficiently and profitably.
 



  





 The role requires someone who can look at the business both strategically and operationally — understanding where growth can come from, ensuring existing business is delivered well, identifying potential risks and gaps, and creating systems that allow the team and business to scale effectively.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Business Growth \& Revenue***




 \* Analyse the company's growth, revenue and business performance and identify opportunities for month\-on\-month growth.
 



 \* Identify new business avenues across clients, categories, services and campaign formats.
 



 \* Work closely with the team to ensure new opportunities are evaluated, planned and moved forward efficiently.
 



 \* Maintain visibility on the business pipeline, expected closures and potential revenue gaps.
 



 \* Track existing client business and identify opportunities for retention, expansion and increased revenue.
 



 \* Monitor project\-level and client\-level growth to ensure overall business growth.
 



 \* Work towards maintaining a healthy and predictable monthly revenue pipeline.
 



  





***Project \& Delivery Management***




 \* Ensure new requirements are appropriately planned, assigned and initiated within timelines.
 



 \* Track ongoing projects and ensure timely, high\-quality delivery.
 



 \* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve issues.
 



 \* Ensure projects are commercially and operationally viable before and during execution.
 



 \* Ensure timely project closures, documentation and billing.
 



 \* Work across teams and stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery of client requirements.
 



 \* Step into execution or operational responsibilities whenever required to ensure business continuity and delivery.
 



  





***Process \& Operational Management***




 \* Establish, document and continuously improve processes across the business.
 



 \* Create structures that improve accountability, efficiency and visibility.
 



 \* Ensure trackers, sheets, databases and reporting systems are consistently maintained and accurate.
 



 \* Monitor team bandwidth and ensure work is distributed appropriately based on capacity, capability and priority.
 



 \* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical solutions.
 



 \* Create systems that reduce dependency on individual follow\-ups and improve timely execution.
 



 \* Ensure important information, data and project updates are easily accessible to the relevant stakeholders.
 



  





***Reporting \& Business Intelligence***




 \* Maintain accurate Excel\-based trackers and business reports.
 



 \* Prepare regular reports and updates on business performance and operational progress.
 



 \* Analyse data to identify trends, gaps, risks and growth opportunities.
 



 \* Maintain a clear view of daily priorities as well as the broader monthly business pipeline.
 



 \* Use data and reporting to support business decisions.
 



  





***Client \& Relationship Management***




 \* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and key stakeholders.
 



 \* Ensure client requirements are understood, communicated and delivered effectively.
 



 \* Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential retention or escalation risks.
 



 \* Support relationship expansion and identify opportunities for additional business.
 



 \* Handle escalations and coordinate internally to ensure timely resolution.
 



 \* Ensure the quality and consistency of delivery contribute towards long\-term client relationships.
 



  





***Team \& Stakeholder Management***




 \* Work closely with relevant teams.
 



 \* Ensure priorities, responsibilities and timelines are clearly communicated.
 



 \* Support team members and managers in resolving operational challenges.
 



 \* Ensure accountability is maintained across projects without compromising team efficiency.
 



 \* Identify capacity requirements and potential resource gaps based on business pipeline.
 



 \* Build a culture of structured working, timely communication and ownership.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 \* 2–5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in influencer marketing, digital marketing, agency operations, account management, business management or a related field.
 



 \* Agency experience will be an advantage.
 



 \* Management experience is a strong plus.
 



 \* Strong understanding of influencer marketing and agency workflows.
 



 \* Someone who genuinely values process, structure, documentation and accountability.
 



 \* Ability to create systems and processes rather than simply work within existing ones.
 



 \* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
 



 \* Excellent command of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort working extensively with data, trackers and reports.
 



 \* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, profitability, utilisation, billing and business growth.
 



 \* Excellent formal written and verbal communication skills.
 



 \* Strong client and stakeholder management abilities.
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain visibility in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 \* Proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
 



 \* Willingness to take ownership beyond a defined job description when the business requires it.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 \* Business and revenue show consistent month\-on\-month growth.
 



 \* New opportunities are evaluated and moved forward without unnecessary delays.
 



 \* Existing clients are retained, satisfied and generating repeat business.
 



 \* Projects are delivered on time and to the expected quality.
 



 \* Team bandwidth is optimised and work is distributed effectively.
 



 \* Projects are commercially viable and quality is protected.
 



 \* Billing and project closures happen on time.
 



 \* Clear and reliable visibility on business performance, pipeline and risks.
 



 \* Processes, data and reporting remain accurate and consistently maintained.
 



 \* The organisation becomes more structured and scalable as the business grows.
 



 \* Problems are identified early, ownership is clear and escalations are managed effectively.
 



  





*You should enjoy bringing order to complexity. You should be comfortable looking at a large number of moving parts, identifying what needs attention, creating a structure around it and ensuring that things actually get done.* 




  





***Reach out at aakriti@marquetingventures.com or hr@marquetingventures.com***

This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
   

  

**Job Introduction**
 The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long\-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer\-facing, primarily servicing walk\-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client\-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

* Provide high\-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross\-sales, retention, and growth.

* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.

* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross\-selling opportunities.


**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**
* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**
* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.

* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self\-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.
