title: Active Directory Support Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Active Directory \& Entra Infrastructure Support Engineer** 
 to support and operate our
 **on‑premises and cloud\-based Active Directory environments** 
 , including
 **Azure Entra ID** 
 and associated identity infrastructure.
   

  

 This role is heavily
 **operational in nature** 
 , focused on
 **BAU support, production stability, incident remediation, upgrades, and platform hygiene** 
 , while partnering with security, application, and infrastructure teams.
   

  

 The engineer will play a key role in ensuring
 **availability, security, and performance** 
 of identity services across the enterprise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Active Directory \& Entra Operations**
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for multiple on‑premises and cloud\-based Active Directory environments
* Support and manage Azure Entra ID tenants, hybrid identity setups, and supporting components
* Perform daily operations including user, group, service account, and computer object management
* Implement and manage Delegation Models, Group Policies, and role\-based access controls to meet business requirements
* Support directory integrations with enterprise and third‑party applications


**Infrastructure Maintenance \& Platform Health**
* Own technology currency and upgrades for:
+ AD Domain Controllers
+ Entra / Azure AD components
+ Supporting identity infrastructure

* Perform patching, configuration changes, and infrastructure clean‑up
* Monitor directory health, replication, authentication flows, and system logs
* Conduct regular reviews and audits to ensure stability, compliance, and security posture
* Participate in Disaster Recovery drills, including AD and identity infrastructure restoration


**Incident Management \& Troubleshooting**
* Act as a primary responder for identity‑related production incidents
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues impacting:
+ Authentication
+ Authorization
+ Directory replication
+ Application integrations

* Work closely with application teams, vendors, and platform teams to drive incident resolution
* Support root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective action implementation
* Participate in on‑call rotation, including evenings and weekends, as per operational requirements


**Documentation \& Process Support**
* Create and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides
* Document standard changes, fixes, and known issues
* Support audit requests and internal reviews related to identity platforms
* Continuously improve operational processes and stability


**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of hands‑on experience supporting:
+ Microsoft Active Directory
+ Azure / Entra ID
+ Microsoft server infrastructure

* Experience working in enterprise IAM or infrastructure operations teams
* Microsoft certifications (Active Directory, Azure, Identity) are a strong plus


**Technical Skills**
* Strong hands‑on knowledge of:
+ Active Directory architecture, design, and operations
+ Azure Entra ID \& hybrid identity concepts
+ Domain Controllers, trust relationships, DNS, replication

* Experience with:
+ SSO and MFA integrations
+ IAM concepts and access governance
+ PowerShell scripting for automation and support

* Familiarity with:
+ Cloud platforms (Azure primarily; AWS exposure is a plus)
+ Security standards (NIST, ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS)

* Strong troubleshooting skills using Microsoft diagnostic tools

+ Business teams
+ Security stakeholders
+ Vendors and global teams

* Improve IAM processes and reduce operational inefficiencies
* Track and report:
+ SLA metrics
+ Incident trends
+ Access governance KPIs

* 8\+ years of IAM experience (end\-to\-end IAM exposure mandatory)
* Minimum 2 years of team handling / leadership experience
* Experience working in enterprise IAM / security operations environments


**Technical Skills (Mandatory)**
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
+ SailPoint (IdentityNow / IIQ) or Saviynt (IGA)
+ Okta IAM (SSO, MFA, Federation)

+ Identity lifecycle (JML)

**Job Details**
 InvoiceCloud is seeking an experienced Implementation Manager to analyze, configure, and deploy complex software and biller integrations for external customers. This role is responsible for owning implementation delivery from scope definition through go\-live, ensuring integrations are executed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with payments technology requirements.
   

  

 The Implementation Manager operates as a client\-facing individual contributor, combining project management, configuration expertise, technical analysis, and quality assurance to deliver successful customer implementations. This role requires close coordination with internal teams, external billers, and software partners.
   

  

**Success Profile**

**Ownership**

* Maintains proactive, transparent communication with customers and internal stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Takes responsibility for resolving issues, escalating risks appropriately, and ensuring commitments are met.

* Configures systems within CRM and supporting platforms to meet integration specifications and business needs.
* Develops and executes delivery and project plans to ensure tasks are completed on time and dependencies are managed.
* Coordinates activities across IT, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Training, software partners, and billers to streamline go\-live execution.


**Results Driven**
* Delivers integrations on schedule while meeting quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction expectations.
* Supports customer QA and UAT to validate configurations and resolve issues prior to launch.
* Submits and manages required Jira items, including integration coding and bill presentment requests, to ensure execution continuity.
* Ensures successful client go\-lives through disciplined execution, testing, and stakeholder alignment.


**Innovative**
* Identifies opportunities to improve implementation workflows, documentation, and handoffs based on delivery experience.
* Collaborates with internal teams to refine configuration standards and reduce rework across implementations.
* Leverages automation and AI\-enabled tools to support documentation, validation, and issue tracking during implementations.
* Continuously improves implementation practices to scale delivery as customer volume and integration complexity grow.

* Experience configuring systems to integration specifications and supporting business requirements
* Strong understanding of testing, QA, and UAT processes
* Experience defining and executing delivery and project plans
* Experience working in a SaaS, fintech, or payments environment; insurance industry knowledge preferred
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize and multitask under deadlines

Understanding of Collections and Cash Application processes end\-to\-end, including dunning, dispute management, customer segmentation, payment matching, and deduction management. Knowledge of Reporting and Analytics tools; ability to contribute to KPI frameworks and dashboard validation. Knowledge of ServiceNow for incident and change request management (advantageous). Good capability to work in a global scope collaborating with transversal teams across different geographies. Good communication skills (essential). Ability to contribute to technology roadmaps for Collections and Cash Application capabilities. Ability to manage quality of service KPIs including DSO, overdue, collector adoption, auto\-match rates. Ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders between business teams and technology experts. Ability to support multiple projects with various milestones and deadlines.

title: Senior Administrator, Corporate Systems
description:
**Job Purpose**
 The Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) Corporate Systems Senior Developer will be responsible for the end\-to\-end administration, deployment, and development of the ORMB application built on the Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF). This role combines hands\-on system administration — including fresh installations, environment provisioning, patch management, and release deployments — with Java\-based development of enhancements, integrations, and batch processing solutions.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the Technical Manager, this role requires frequent collaboration with functional business analysts, infrastructure/DBA teams, third\-party vendors, and end users to ensure high availability, compliance, and continuous delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application. The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large\-volume financial systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
*System Administration \& Environment Management*
* Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers
+ Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
+ Manage multi\-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.

* Apply Oracle\-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.
+ Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
+ Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post\-patch environment integrity.

* Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.
+ Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
+ Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post\-deployment validation.

* Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
* Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment\-specific configuration documentation.


*Development \& Enhancements*
* Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
* Build and maintain third\-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e\-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file\-based patterns.
* Develop and optimize batch programs for high\-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM\-level tuning.
* Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.


*Production Support \& Operations*
* Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
* Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
* Perform year\-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
* Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform\-level issues.


*Collaboration \& Governance*
* Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
* Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
* Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel\-run testing and validation activities.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 5\+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC\&B, including hands\-on administration of OUAF\-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 5\+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi\-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high\-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors.


**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**
* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8\.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC\&B / ORMB v2\.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

 Join a hands\-on engineering role focused on building business solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft 365 ecosystem. You will quick adapt and design, develop low\-code applications, automations, and portals that streamline business processes and improve operational efficiency while working closely with stakeholders to translate requirements into practical solutions.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* **Power Platform Development:** 
 Design and build applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model\-Driven), Power Automate, Power Pages, and Dataverse.
* **Workflow Automation:** 
 Develop cloud and desktop flows, approvals, and automated workflows to streamline business operations.
* **Microsoft 365 Integrations:** 
 Integrate solutions with services such as Entra ID, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and external systems using connectors and APIs including Microsoft Graph.
* **Portal Development:** 
 Build external\-facing portals using Power Pages with authentication, forms, and multi\-step processes.
* **AI\-Assisted Features:** 
 Implement AI\-driven capabilities such as document generation, automated notifications, and workflow enhancements using AI Builder or Copilot features.
* **Security \& Governance:** 
 Ensure solutions follow best practices including row\-level security, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity labels, and audit logging.
* **Testing \& Delivery:** 
 Participate in proof\-of\-concept development, testing, documentation, and deployment of solutions.
* **Performance \& Optimization:** 
 Monitor solution performance, capacity, and security while implementing improvements where necessary.
* **Solution Lifecycle Management:** 
 Support solution packaging, deployment, and lifecycle management across development, test, and production environments.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* **Power Platform Experience:** 
 2–5\+ years of experience building solutions with Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Dataverse.
* **Low\-Code Development:** 
 Experience with Canvas Apps, Model\-Driven Apps, Power Fx, automation flows, and portal forms.
* **Microsoft 365 Integration:** 
 Experience integrating with services such as SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, and Microsoft Graph API.
* **Data Modelling:** 
 Understanding of Dataverse data modelling and basic API/connector development.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** 
 Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* **Certifications (Preferred):** 
 Microsoft certifications such as PL\-100, PL\-200, or PL\-400\.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* **Analytics Experience:** 
 Experience with Power BI or Microsoft Fabric for reporting and analytics.
* **Azure Knowledge:** 
 Familiarity with Azure services such as Azure Functions or Logic Apps.
* **Agile Experience:** 
 Experience working in Agile or Scrum\-based environments.
* **Power Platform Governance:** 
 Familiarity with environment management, solution lifecycle management (ALM), and governance best practices.



  





**Equal Employment Opportunity Declaration:** 




 WCT is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Customer Service Executive
description:
**Job Title: Customer Service Executive**
 EC\-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 170 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world\-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide.
   

  

 www.eccouncil.org
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The role involves delivering a high\-quality customer experience by understanding customer needs, resolving queries efficiently, and ensuring issues are handled with accuracy and empathy. The position requires strong verbal and written communication, effective problem\-solving, and the ability to take ownership of customer concerns from initial interaction through resolution.
   

  

 The role also involves handling escalations, collaborating with relevant teams when required, adapting to changing processes, and maintaining close attention to detail. A successful candidate should be a quick learner, customer\-focused, accountable, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver a positive and consistent customer experience across all interactions.
* Maintain strong CSAT and achieve key service metrics, including response time, resolution time, quality, and productivity.
* Handle all types of customers professionally, including difficult situations and escalations.
* Take ownership and accelerate resolution while ensuring accurate and timely responses.
* Develop strong product and process knowledge to provide effective customer support.
* Ensure error\-free execution and adherence to defined processes and policies.
* Identify recurring issues and report process gaps to help improve the overall customer experience.
* Maintain clear, professional, and effective written and verbal communication.
* Work Schedule: 5\-day working week \| Rotational shifts \& rotational week\-offs


**About Our Culture**
 EC\-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. EC\-Council is dedicated to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability that limits your ability to complete any part of the application process and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at ecchr@eccouncil.org and let us know how we can assist. To be eligible for this position, candidates must be able to provide proof that they are either a citizen of the country or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is posted and are currently residing there. EC\-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work. If, as part of the recruitment process, you are required to complete or submit any form of work, project, case study, or assignment, please note that such material will be considered the exclusive property of EC\-Council. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC\-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein.
   

  

 Candidates further waive any intellectual property or moral rights in such submissions, confirm that the work is original and free of third\-party infringement, and acknowledge that it is provided solely for evaluation purposes, with no ownership or other rights retained.
   

  

 Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. This may include information such as your name, contact details, employment history, qualifications, and any other details you provide as part of your application. All data is handled in compliance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.
   

  

 Please review our policy here: EC\-Council Privacy Policy\- User \& company \| Data Protection. Submission of your application will be considered as your acceptance of the terms stated above.

description:
**Job Title:** 
 HRIS Analyst
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location** 
 : Hyderabad
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3 to 4 Years
   

  

**Joining:** 
 Immediate to 30 Days
   

  

**Shift:** 
 US Shift / Night Shift \- 5PM to 2AM IST
   

  

**Work Model:** 
 4 Days Work From Office, 1 Day Work From Home.
   

  

**About NationsBenefits:**
 At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back\-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high\-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on
 **platform modernization** 
 — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud\-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core back\-office functions in the insurance domain.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and service\-driven HRIS Analyst to support the ongoing administration and maintenance of our Human Resource Information System, with primary responsibility for UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) Core HR and Workforce Management systems.
   

  

 This role is responsible for ensuring employee data accuracy, processing system updates, managing HRIS tickets, and providing timely support to employees and managers. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on UKG experience and thrive in a structured, high\-volume, SLA\-driven environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 HRIS Administration
   

  

* Serve as system analyst for UKG (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Workforce Management, Recruitment, Onboarding, Document Manager modules).
* Process employee lifecycle transactions include new hires, terminations, transfers, promotions, compensation updates, and organizational changes.
* Maintain system security roles and user access permissions.
* Ensure data accuracy through routine audits and reconciliation activities.
* Support payroll processing by validating employee data prior to payroll deadlines.
* Maintain documentation of processes and standard operating procedures.


 Ticket Management \& Employee Support
   

  

* Manage and resolve HRIS\-related tickets through the company’s ticketing system in accordance with established SLAs.
* Work with IT and other internal and external teams for issue resolution.
* Provide timely, accurate support to employees and managers regarding:
* Employee data updates
* Timekeeping corrections
* Payroll discrepancies
* Benefits elections and life event changes
* System access inquiries
* Document case resolutions and maintain detailed records.
* Escalate complex issues to HRIS Director and coordinate with HR, Payroll, IT, or UKG Support as appropriate.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.


 Data Integrity \& Compliance
   

  

* Perform regular data audits to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
* Reconcile HRIS data with payroll and benefits providers.
* Support internal and external audit requests.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and data privacy standards.


 Reporting Support
   

  

* Generate standard and ad\-hoc reports from UKG to support HR and business leaders.
* Validate data outputs prior to distribution.


**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5\+ years of hands\-on HRIS experience.
* Demonstrated experience administering UKG (UKG Pro, UKG Ready).
* Experience working in a ticket\-based support environment.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, including employee lifecycle and payroll processes.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data validation).
* Experience supporting multi\-state or multi\-location workforces.
* Experience with data integrations or file feeds.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* High level of accuracy and data integrity
* Customer\-service orientation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline\-driven environment
* Clear written and verbal communication skills

title: TC-CS-IAM-SailPoint-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint IIQ Staff**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 1\-4 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Network Operations Technician
description:
****Overview****
**Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst**
****Overview****
 We are seeking a NOC Analyst to provide 24/7 monitoring and incident response for mission\-critical healthcare SaaS platforms. This role is the first line of defense for production systems, responsible for detecting issues, executing runbooks, and escalating when needed to ensure platform stability and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong technical troubleshooting skills, experience with monitoring and observability tools, and the ability to work effectively in a follow\-the\-sun operations model with global teams.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Monitor production systems 24/7 using observability platforms ( DataDog , Appdynamics \& PagerDuty) to detect anomalies, alerts, and incidents
* Respond to incidents within SLA, perform initial triage, execute runbooks, and engage on\-call engineers when necessary
* Log and manage incidents in ITSM platforms with accurate categorization, priority, and documentation
* Execute documented runbooks for common issues (application restarts, health checks, certificate renewals)
* Familiarity with remote access methods such as SSH, CLI\-based VM management and AWS console, along with support and management of containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes)
* Perform health checks and proactive monitoring to identify degradation before customer impact
* Coordinate with engineering, SRE, and service delivery teams during major incidents and change windows
* Maintain shift handoff documentation and participate in daily operational standup meetings
* Escalate incidents appropriately based on severity, customer impact, and technical complexity
* Document known errors, workarounds, and lessons learned to improve operational knowledge base


****Required Qualifications****
* 1–3\+ years of experience in NOC, IT operations, technical support, or similar monitoring roles
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Appdynamics , ELK , New Relic, or similar)
* Familiarity with incident management and ITSM platforms (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty)
* Moderate understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), APIs, and web services, i.e. AWS SysOps Associate certification / equivalent.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to follow technical runbooks under pressure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for incident updates and handoffs
* Willingness to work rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays (24/7 follow\-the\-sun model)


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience in healthcare or regulated environments (HIPAA, CMS compliance)
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification
* Familiarity with scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash) for basic automation tasks
* Experience supporting SaaS or cloud\-native applications
* Understanding of networking concepts (DNS, load balancers, firewalls, SSL/TLS)


**Key Metrics for Success**
* Incident response time (time to acknowledge and begin triage)
* Escalation accuracy ( appropriate escalations with complete context)
* SLA compliance for incident acknowledgment and initial response
* Quality of incident documentation and handoff notes
* Reduction in repeat alerts through proactive action


**Employment Details**
* Full\-time position with rotating shift coverage (24/7 operations)
* Follow\-the\-sun model with US and global team coordination
* Must be eligible to work on U.S. federal contracts (background check may be required )

 You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. title: Information Technology Administrator
description:
**Job Title:** 

 IT Administrator (Hardware, Systems \& Infrastructure)
 




  





**Department:** 

 Information Technology
 




  





**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-Time
 




  




**Job Overview** 


 We are looking for a hands\-on IT Administrator to oversee our day\-to\-day hardware, software, cross\-platform systems, and physical infrastructure. In this role, you will manage employee workstations (Windows and macOS), maintain networked peripherals (printers/scanners), and administer our office security infrastructure, including CCTV surveillance and biometric access systems.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 

**Cross\-Platform Workstation \& Software Management** 




  




* Manage OS updates, patch deployments, and software installation across all endpoints.



  




* Administer user accounts, security roles, and permissions via Microsoft 365, Active Directory, or Apple Business Manager.



  




* Maintain endpoint protection, antivirus software, and enterprise data security protocols.



  





**Peripherals, Printers \& Office Hardware** 




  




* Install, configure, and troubleshoot network printers, multi\-function copiers, and scanners.



  




* Manage print servers, set up user access profiles, and track usage/toner inventory.



  




* Diagnose and repair hardware failures across desktops, monitors, peripherals, and cable infrastructure.



  





**CCTV \& Physical Security Infrastructure** 




  




* Manage, monitor, and maintain IP/Analog CCTV camera networks, NVRs/DVRs, and storage servers.



  




* Ensure continuous video recording, optimize storage retention policies, and manage video archives.



  




* Conduct routine health checks on cameras, power supplies, switches, and cabling.



  




* Assist in retrieving security footage for authorized auditing and incident reviews.



  





**Network \& General IT Support** 




  




* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi\-Fi, switches, routers, and IP routing issues for endpoints and connected hardware.



  




* Provide fast Tier 1/2 technical support for hardware and software tickets.



  




* Maintain an up\-to\-date IT asset register for all laptops, monitors, CCTV units, and peripheral devices.



  




**Technical Skills \& Qualifications** 
* **Education:** 

 Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Hardware \& Networking, or a related field.



  




* **Experience:** 

 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in IT support, system administration, or desktop engineering.



  




* **OS Expertise:** 

 Advanced proficiency in both
 
**Windows** 

 and
 
**macOS** 

 troubleshooting and deployment.



  




* **Hardware \& Surveillance:** 

 Deep knowledge of printer spooler configurations, TCP/IP printing, CCTV setup, DVR/NVR configuration, and PoE switches.



  




* **Networking:** 

 Solid understanding of Ethernet cabling, IP address allocation (DHCP/Static IP), subnets, and Wi\-Fi networks.

description:
****DESCRIPTION****
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As Data Centre Operations Tech, You Will Be The Primary Point Of Contact For Internal Customers. There Is Never a Dull Moment As Each Day Presents Itself With Different Challenges. Some Of The Key Responsibilities You Will Undertake Are:
   

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.

 As Data Centre Operations Engineer, You Will Be The Primary Point Of Contact For Internal Customers. There Is Never a Dull Moment As Each Day Presents Itself With Different Challenges. Some Of The Key Responsibilities You Will Undertake Are:

 Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Technical Support Professional
description:
TomTom's services run around the clock — and the NOC is the team keeping watch. We monitor every service, spot trouble before customers feel it, drive incidents to resolution and keep everyone informed while we do it.
   

  

 We're now inviting aspiring team members who want to expand their skills and experience to apply for a lateral opportunity within NOC Operations.
   

  

 This is a career progression move into the NOC team. You'll get hands\-on exposure to NOC responsibilities, incident management, service operations and technical problem handling. It's designed for people who want to build real expertise and pursue a longer\-term career path in NOC Operations. Following a successful selection process, you'll go through the onboarding and training needed to support your transition into the role.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Monitor, troubleshoot, document, escalate and continuously improve IT infrastructure and NOC operations to ensure reliable service delivery and rapid incident resolution.
* Monitor TomTom's production services and infrastructure around the clock — working across tools like PagerDuty, Grafana and AlertSite to catch degradations before customers feel them.
* Triage and troubleshoot alerts and incidents as they arrive — establishing impact, forming a first hypothesis and taking the tactical steps that restore service fastest.
* Escalate to the right engineering teams at the right moment — with enough context that they can act immediately, and stay with the incident until it's resolved.
* Own incident communication end to end — keeping engineers, Leadership and Internal/External stakeholders informed while the incident is still unfolding.
* Document what you handle — incident timelines, runbooks and knowledge articles that make the next shift faster than the last.
* Continuously improve NOC operations — tuning noisy alerts, sharpening processes and using automation and AI tools to cut manual effort in reporting, event and knowledge management.


**What You'll Need**
 NOC is looking for strong analytical thinkers who enjoy solving problems and thrive in a high\-pressure environment with shifting priorities. You should be able to assess a situation and determine tactical steps forward.
   

  

 Core skills (0–2 years)
   

  

* A basic understanding of applications, systems and monitoring tools — exposure to PagerDuty, Grafana or AlertSite is a plus, though curiosity matters more to us than the length of your tool list.
* Familiarity with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or Jira — where you'll log incidents, track progress and leave a clean handover for the next shift; training will be provided.
* Good time management and organizational skills — with the ability to triage a new alert, chase an engineering update and prepare a handover within the same hour.
* Basic knowledge of incident management processes — how incidents are detected, prioritized, escalated and closed, and why restoring service quickly and finding the underlying cause are two different jobs.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills — explaining a technical situation clearly and concisely to engineers, leadership and customers, often while it's still unfolding.
* The ability to work in rotational shifts (24x7\) — including nights, weekends and public holidays, on a rotation the team makes work together.
* A highly motivated, self\-starting approach — digging into something unfamiliar, asking good questions and coming back with an answer rather than waiting to be told.
* A team\-player mentality and a customer\-focused mindset — every alert traces back to someone depending on a TomTom service, and keeping that in view shapes how you prioritize and communicate.
* Basic awareness of AI tools and automation — and how they can strengthen event, incident and knowledge management, improve reporting and streamline ServiceNow processes and tooling.


**Nice to have**
* Previous internship or hands\-on experience in IT support or a helpdesk environment.
* Exposure to automation concepts for reporting or incident handling. (edited)

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Product Support Engineer – Cloud Security
description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are seeking a highly motivated Product Support Engineer Cloud Security with expertise in Cloud Security, SASE, Zero Trust, and Enterprise Networking technologies. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical support expert and escalation engineer responsible for resolving complex customer issues involving networking, cloud infrastructure, and modern security platforms. This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, customer engagement capabilities, and hands\-on experience with cloud security technologies such as Netskope, SASE, ZTNA, CASB, and Zero Trust frameworks. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to drive issue resolution, improve platform stability, and enhance customer experience.
 



  




* **Role: Product Support Engineer Cloud Security**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 2 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Act as the primary technical escalation engineer for critical and high\-priority customer issues.
* Troubleshoot advanced networking, cloud security, and infrastructure\-related problems including connectivity, latency, authentication, policy enforcement, and access control issues.
* Communicate directly with customers through video calls, phone calls, emails, and case management systems.
* Provide timely customer updates, resolution plans, and technical guidance throughout the support lifecycle.
* Support and troubleshoot Cloud Security, SASE, Zero Trust, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, and related security platforms.
* Perform detailed analysis of network traffic using tools such as Wireshark, TCPDump, Netmon, and packet capture utilities.
* Diagnose issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, Switching, VPNs, Firewalls, Load Balancers, and Proxy technologies.
* Support cloud\-delivered security solutions including Netskope and similar Secure Service Edge platforms.
* Troubleshoot SSL/TLS decryption, authentication, SSO, policy enforcement, and secure access issues.
* Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams to identify product defects and drive issue resolution.
* Participate in root cause analysis and contribute to platform improvements.
* Support Linux, Unix, Windows, Active Directory, and LDAP environments.
* Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.
* Drive proactive customer success initiatives by identifying potential risks and recommending best practices.
* Manage support cases and collaborate across teams using Salesforce, Jira, Slack, and other operational tools.
* Contribute to continuous service improvement and customer experience enhancement initiatives.
* Stay updated on emerging cloud security threats, technologies, and best practices.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2\-8 years of experience in Product Support, Technical Support, Cloud Security, Network Security, or Infrastructure Support roles.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing \& Switching, VPNs, Firewalls, and Load Balancing.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting enterprise networking and cloud connectivity issues.
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Security architectures and security best practices.
* Experience working with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) platforms and architectures.
* Good understanding of Zero Trust and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts.
* Hands\-on exposure to Netskope or similar cloud security platforms.
* Working knowledge of CASB, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), SSL/TLS Decryption, DLP, and Cloud Security technologies.
* Experience supporting network security solutions including NGFW, SSL VPN, IPSec VPN, Proxy Servers, SSO, and Encryption Gateways.
* Strong experience with Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP, and Identity \& Access Management concepts.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills using Wireshark, TCPDump, Netmon, Ping, Traceroute, and related diagnostic tools.
* Experience handling customer escalations and managing critical support cases.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent customer\-facing communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience collaborating with Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Customer Success teams.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Jira, Slack, and support workflow management platforms.
* Strong documentation and technical writing skills.
* Customer\-first mindset with a proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure support environment.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

title: Sr Associate Support Engineer, Adaptive Planning AI, ML & Platform Operations
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative—our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows.
   

  

 Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data\-driven financial strategies. We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next\-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a customer\-focused
 **Support Engineer** 
 who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this
 **high\-visibility, customer\-facing role** 
 , you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
   

  

 You will drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
   

  

 A key part of this role will also involve hands\-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
   

  

**Location \& Shift**
* Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.
* Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
* Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM \- 5:00 PM IST
* On\-Call: Participation in an on\-call rotation is required to provide after\-hours support when needed.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
* Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands\-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& RCA: Assist in root\-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud \& LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident \& Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high\-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on\-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high\-stakes escalations.
* Database \& Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation \& Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
* Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
* Technical \& Diagnostic Skills:
+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command\-line tools.

* Cloud \& Monitoring Systems:
+ Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

* AI \& LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* Triage \& Operations:
+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
+ Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post\-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer\-facing teams.
* Strong active problem\-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi\-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:
+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
+ Jenkins \& Git
+ Kubernetes and Docker
+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
+ JavaScript

**Background and purpose** 
**of role:**
 BP is driving a central transformation project with an objective to upgrade and standardardise the policies, process, control and technology around balance sheet assurance/ reconciliation and journal entry, to implement an integrated solution via Blackline SaaS solution.
   

  

 The project aims to bring digitization and enhance BP’s balance sheet reconcliation and manual journals operating and assurance capabilities.
   

  

 This role is going to play a pivotal role as a part of project team. Primary objective of this role is to support be proficient in BlackLine maintenance and reporting functionalities. The role requires Blackline admin expertise coupled with finance process and accounting knowledge.
   

  

 The role entails ample opportunities and requires working with senior stakeholders across BP’s GBS teams, liasie with BP\-wide finance and control teams while assisting transformation project team.
   

  

**Key Results / Accountabilities**

* Execute the maintenance and configuration of the BlackLine platform to ensure optimal performance and alignment with business requirements.

* Manage user assignments within the BlackLine platform, including adding new users, updating user profiles, and deactivating accounts as needed.

* Facilitate training sessions for new users to familiarize them with BlackLine functionalities, processes, and best practices and provide ongoing support and assistance to users, answering inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and addressing training needs as they arise.

* Quick to react and adapt to constantly changing business requirements to support rapidly changing business requirements.
* Ability to interact with and influence people at all levels, geographies and time zones within the organisation, building strong relationships quickly.
* Complete understanding of system landscape and infrastructure
* End to end understanding of GBS control monitoring and governance processes.
* Ensuring that BP's control environment remains effective through compliance with internal/ external requirements via the application of controls and systems across all activities in scope of operations.
* Looks for ways to do things better, faster, more efficiently.

**Education and Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in finance, Blackline / SAP ECC / S4 HANA / MS Office Suite.
* Clear, fluent, and confident written and verbal communication skills
* Strong continuous improvement mentality and drive for excellence

**Knowledge And Skills Required**

**Desirable**

title: Global Tech Asset Management - Analyst
description:
We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check to see whether the role you are interested in is posted on our career website.
 



  





**About TMF Group** 




**TMF Group** 
 is a leading provider of administrative services, helping clients invest and operate safely around the world. As we’re a global company with 11,000\+ colleagues based in over 125 offices across 87 jurisdictions, we actively seek out people with the talent and potential to flourish at TMF Group, whatever their background, and offer job opportunities to the broadest spectrum of people. Once on board we nurture and promote talented individuals, making sure that senior positions are open to all.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The ITAM Analyst will support the Software Asset Management (SAM) function by managing software asset data, software license compliance, renewals, vendor relationships, and software lifecycle activities. The role is responsible for maintaining accurate software inventory records, supporting licensing governance, assisting with budget planning, and ensuring effective utilization of Software Asset Management tools and processes.
 



 The analyst will collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Technology, Security, and Vendor Management teams to improve software governance, optimize software spend, and maintain compliance with licensing agreements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




**Software Asset \& License Management** 



* Manage and maintain software asset inventory and license entitlement data within the ITAM/SAM tool.
* Monitor software license compliance and support remediation activities for any identified licensing risks.
* Assist in managing the complete software lifecycle, including software requests, procurement, deployment, maintenance, renewals, and retirement.
* Ensure software asset records remain accurate, complete, and up to date.



**Renewals \& Vendor Management** 



* Support software contract and renewal management activities across various software publishers.
* Maintain software renewal calendars and proactively coordinate renewal activities with stakeholders.
* Assist with software vendor engagement by providing licensing, utilization, and compliance information.
* Support vendor discussions by preparing software entitlement, usage, and commercial data.



**Reporting \& Data Analysis** 



* Develop and maintain Power Bi dashboard ,software asset management reports, dashboards, and compliance metrics.
* Analyze software usage, license consumption, and software ROI to support optimization initiatives.
* Provide periodic reporting on software assets, licensing position, renewals, compliance status, and financial exposure.
* Support audit readiness through accurate documentation and reporting.



**Governance Support** 



* Support purchase order, invoice, and contract reconciliation activities.
* Contribute to commercial governance processes by providing licensing and asset\-related data for sourcing and renewal decisions.
* Ensure compliance with ITAM policies, standards, and governance requirements.



**Tool Administration \& Process Improvement** 



* Support administration of the Software Asset Management platform and related ITAM processes.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve software asset data quality, reporting capabilities, and operational efficiency.
* Participate in process enhancement initiatives related to software lifecycle management and asset governance.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**




**Technical Skills** 



* Understanding of Software Asset Management (SAM) and IT Asset Management (ITAM) principles.
* Knowledge of software licensing concepts, software publishers, maintenance agreements, and renewals.
* Familiarity with asset management tools such as Flexera One, Snow Software, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and reconciliation activities.
* Understanding of software inventory, entitlement management, and compliance processes.



**Professional Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in a global environment.
* Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and licensing models.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* 3 to 5 years of Exposure to Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, Procurement, or Technology Operations.
* Experience working with software licensing, renewals, vendor management, or contract administration.
* Basic knowledge of software licensing models for major vendors such as Microsoft, Adobe, etc

title: OT SOC Analyst L2
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **OT SOC Analyst L2** 
 to join our OT Security Operations Center. The ideal candidate will have 3 \- 6 years of experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity monitoring and incident investigation, with hands\-on exposure to industrial environments such as ICS, SCADA, PLC, RTU, and HMI ecosystems. The analyst will act as the primary escalation point from L1, perform advanced monitoring and triage, support Nozomi and SIEM operations, assist integrations and deployments, and deliver high\-quality customer support and reporting while safeguarding safety\-critical industrial operations.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Security Monitoring and Incident Triage


 Monitor OT and IT security alerts across SIEM and OT visibility platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, FortiSIEM, Elastic, and Nozomi Guardian.
   

  

 Validate suspicious activities, correlate security events, monitor industrial communications, and track abnormal asset behavior in ICS/SCADA environments.
   

  

 Escalate confirmed incidents with complete evidence, business impact, and recommended next actions.
   

  

* Incident Investigation and Analysis


 Investigate OT security alerts, malware indicators, unauthorized changes, policy violations, and suspicious network behavior affecting PLCs, RTUs, HMIs, historians, and engineering workstations.
   

  

 Perform packet analysis using Wireshark, validate indicators of compromise, identify lateral movement, and support containment and recovery activities under defined runbooks.
   

  

**3** 
 .
 **SIEM, Nozomi, and Detection Administration**
 Support SIEM administration activities including log source validation, parser verification, dashboard usage, alert tuning, and false\-positive reduction.
   

  

 Assist in the administration and health monitoring of OT security monitoring platforms such as Nozomi Guardian and related collectors/sensors.
   

  

 Contribute to the creation and maintenance of detection rules and OT use cases aligned to industrial threats and operational realities.
   

  

* Deployment and Integration Support


 Assist OT solution deployments by validating sensor connectivity, syslog forwarding, collector health, API integrations, use\-case testing, and user acceptance activities.
   

  

 Support integration of OT monitoring platforms with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing systems, and reporting workflows.
   

  

* OT Log, Asset, and Protocol Analysis


 Review logs, alarms, and network telemetry from OT and IT sources to identify anomalies and confirm incident context.
   

  

 Demonstrate working knowledge of industrial protocols including Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, IEC 60870\-5\-104, PROFINET, and related industrial Ethernet communications.
   

  

 Support OT asset inventory validation, communication baseline analysis, and visibility improvement activities.
   

  

* Customer Support and Troubleshooting


 Provide remote troubleshooting, incident bridge support, health checks, upgrade support, and ticket resolution for customer OT security environments.
   

  

 Communicate effectively with customers, internal stakeholders, and project teams while maintaining SLA commitments.
   

  

* Reporting and Documentation


 Prepare daily SOC reports, weekly incident summaries, asset visibility reports, security posture updates, and SLA\-driven ticketing updates.
   

  

 Maintain accurate incident records, SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting notes, and knowledge\-base documentation.
   

  

* Collaboration and Escalation


 Work closely with L1 analysts, L3 engineers, implementation teams, customer stakeholders, and cross\-functional security teams to resolve operational issues.
   

  

 Escalate complex OT incidents, persistent integration issues, and monitoring gaps to the appropriate engineering or management teams.
   

  

* Compliance and Best Practices


 Follow established OT security procedures, change controls, and documentation standards while supporting compliance and audit requirements.
   

  

 Operate with awareness of plant safety, production availability, maintenance windows, and the sensitivity of safety\-critical environments.
   

  

* Continuous Improvement


 Recommend improvements to alert quality, reporting accuracy, use cases, SOPs, dashboarding, and OT monitoring coverage.
   

  

 Stay updated on OT cyber threats, industrial attack techniques, and evolving defensive controls relevant to manufacturing, utilities, energy, and other industrial sectors.
   

  

* Report deviations and concerns to the SOC Manager


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, OT SOC, ICS/SCADA monitoring, incident investigation, or industrial network security.

**Job Description**
 As a
 **Staff Engineer – L4** 
 , you’ll be an escalation point for the most complex and critical issues affecting enterprise and hyperscale environments. This hands\-on role is ideal for a deep technical expert who thrives under pressure and has a passion for solving distributed system challenges at scale. This role is part of the Infinia Core engineering team.

 **AI tools** 
 and automation, you’ll reduce time\-to\-resolution, streamline diagnostics, and elevate the support experience for strategic customers.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

* Author and maintain detailed runbooks, performance tuning guides, and RCA documentation.

* Familiarity with observability platforms: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry.
* Knowledge of replication, consistency models, and data integrity mechanisms.
* Exposure to Sovereign AI, LLM model training environments, or autonomous system data architectures.

 Technical Ramp\-Up
   

  

* Complete Infinia training, labs, and architecture deep dives. o Stand up a fully functioning Infinia test system. o Shadow at least 5 complex escalations and participate in 2 customer calls.


 Operational Integration
   

  

* Lead one live incident response and deliver a full RCA within 48 hours. o Propose 3\+ enhancements to internal tools, AI/automation usage, or documentation. o Establish key partnerships with Engineering and Field teams.


 Strategic Insight
   

  

* Deliver a written 30\-day reflection with gaps and high\-impact recommendations. o Begin identifying patterns where AI or automation can reduce MTTR or improve proactive detection.


**Success Metrics – Beyond 30 Days**
* MTTR on high\-severity cases is consistently below internal SLAs.
* Volume and quality of resolved L4 escalations.

* Executive\-ready RCAs that inform product improvement.
