We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low\-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain \& Procurement (ISCaP) organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly\-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!
   

  

 The GenAI Spares Planning Team RMA Program Manager is the single\-threaded owner for ensuring Nvidia GPU material flows correctly through the returns lifecycle across the GenAI accelerator fleet. Nvidia GPUs are among our highest\-value spare parts, and as the fleet scales, spares supportability increasingly depends on the timely recovery and re\-induction of RMA returns. Execution sits with cross\-functional partners (HWEng, Logistics, AIS\-SC, Nvidia); this role monitors that flow end\-to\-end, holds SLA adherence at every handoff, escalates disruptions, and drives owners to recovery — backed by the reporting mechanisms that make the program scalable.
   

  

 If you love being at the forefront of industry growth and development, developing and executing processes in a highly ambiguous environment, identifying information gaps and collaboration needs, and driving business strategy, then this is the spot for you. This is a high impact role offering an opportunity to drive and influence business\-critical decisions impacting the long\-term future of the business.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Owns monitoring SLA adherence across all Nvidia GPU components covered under RMA agreements, at key handoffs and nodes throughout the supply chain cycle.
* Escalates disruptions and drives recovery plans to resolution, coordinating across HWEng, Supporting Logistics Teams, AIS\-SC, Nvidia, and GenAI SPMs.
* Ensures readiness of RMA programs for new Nvidia GPU components ahead of platform launches – including
* Collecting AFRs from HWEng
* Coordinating with SPMs to size initial seed stock pool
* Raising Buffer Stock RMA submissions in Nvidia’s portal
* Monitoring fulfillment of initial seed stock allocations from Nvidia
* Monitors approved failure log coverage and surfaces gaps to HWEng.
* Expands NVTool into a scalable mechanism that supports budget planning for GPU spares, including ongoing monitoring of actual vs. planned spend
* Leads initiatives to streamline and optimize the RMA supply chain, including onboarding Nvidia to the Janus Spares Supply Model.
* Monitors degrade rates post\-launch to identify shortages to required target levels (considering purchased inventory and seed stock), advocating for additional seed stock supply, as needed.
* Monitors and escalates stuck inventory (e.g. replaced GPUs held without logs) requiring state change back to SPARE.


**About The Team**
 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4\+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
* 2\+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years experience in global supply chain management, managing cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced consumer electronics product company


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process experience
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field

title: Head of Agency Lending Operations, Managing Director
description:
**Who are we looking for**

We are looking for an industry leader with hands\-on experience in Agency Lending Operations within a Markets business. You understand what great looks like in a global operations organization and bring deep knowledge of the functions that support Agency Lending across the trade lifecycle. You combine strong operational expertise with executive presence, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to influence, lead through change, and navigate complex challenges.

  

This is a key leadership role responsible for overseeing a global team of approximately 150 professionals across India, Hong Kong, London, and Boston, providing operational support for Agency Lending activities, including settlement, reconciliations, and collateral management. You will lead the organization through the complexity of a large\-scale global operation, ensuring accurate trade processing, effective collateralization, robust risk management, regulatory compliance, and seamless day\-to\-day execution.

  

You will work closely with business, technology, risk, and control partners to drive innovation across processes and systems, enhancing efficiency, scalability, and risk management while ensuring operational solutions remain aligned with State Street's strategic objectives, industry best practices, and evolving market needs.

  

A significant part of your mandate will be the transformation of the function. You will have the opportunity to help shape the future operating model, modernize the technology infrastructure, and drive initiatives that reduce risk, improve efficiency, and accelerate speed to market. Success in this role will require balancing long\-term transformation with an unwavering focus on day\-to\-day execution and client service.

  

The role can be based in Mumbai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad and reports directly to the SVP, Global Head of Financing and Portfolio Solutions Operations.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high\-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data\-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client\-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.

  

As one of the largest and most experienced providers of financing and portfolio solutions in the industry, we provide investors with market\-leading expertise, technology and scale to accelerate decision making, enhance performance and unlock efficiencies across the entire trade lifecycle.

  

We are in the midst of a significant transformation as we modernize our technology architecture and transition from legacy platforms to a more scalable, future\-state environment. The processes and functions that support our Agency Lending business are critical to the success of State Street Markets and operate at significant scale and complexity. This transformation presents a unique opportunity to help redesign and optimize key workflows, driving greater automation, efficiency and resiliency across the business. As one of the largest businesses within Markets, and one of the world's leading agent lenders, we provide the scale, visibility and impact to shape the future of a market\-leading franchise.

  

  

Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

  

**What you will be responsible for**  

As Head of Agency Lending Operations, Managing Director, you will:


* Lead a global organization of 150\+ professionals, driving consistent service delivery, robust governance and controls, operational resilience, and a culture of excellence across regions while setting the strategic direction for one of the industry's leading Agency Lending operations teams.
* Own the end\-to\-end Agency Lending operating platform, overseeing trade capture, confirmations, settlement, clearing, reconciliation, cash movements, data management, and lifecycle events across loan and return activity, as well as bilateral and triparty transactions.
* Provide strategic leadership across the Agency Lending collateral ecosystem, overseeing margin management, bilateral and triparty collateralization, dispute resolution, collateral sufficiency monitoring, and optimization throughout the lending lifecycle, including collateral impacts arising from corporate actions.
* Shape the future of Agency Lending Operations by leading a significant transformation and modernization agenda. Partnering closely with Technology, Business, and Risk teams, you will help deliver scalable, automated future\-state capabilities while optimizing the operating model and cost base to support growth, efficiency, and global consistency.
* Champion a best\-in\-class risk and control environment, proactively identifying and mitigating operational, settlement, and counterparty risks, strengthening controls and operational resilience, and ensuring timely and effective management of incidents, remediation activities, and escalations.
* Ensure the organization remains audit\-ready and regulatory compliant, maintaining adherence to applicable regulations, internal policies, and industry standards while overseeing regulatory reporting, data governance, model risk requirements, and readiness for an evolving regulatory landscape.
* Serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders and key market participants, leading relationships across Front Office, Custody, Risk/ERM, Compliance, Technology, counterparties, borrowers, custodians, clearing agents, and strategic vendors. You will act as a senior escalation point, helping ensure exceptional service delivery, strong cyber\-risk oversight, and swift resolution of complex operational issues.
* Build and inspire a high\-performing global leadership team, attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent while strengthening succession planning, leadership depth, and an inclusive culture that enables individuals and teams to perform at their best.
  

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, or related field is preferred. A postgraduate/professional qualification is advantageous
* 20\+ years of experience in financial services operations, with focus on Agency Lending
* Strong understanding of Agency Lending products and processes (e.g., trade lifecycle management/settlement/collateral, triparty agents, vendors)
* Proven track record of strengthening risk and control environments and managing regulatory and operational risk.
* Experience leading transformation initiatives, including process optimization, automation, and technology modernization.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective partnerships across business, operations, technology, and corporate functions.
* Strategic thinker with a proven change management mindset and experience driving large\-scale initiatives.

**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We're actively seeking teammates who:

* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.

description:
**Job Description: Operations Manager – Modular Furniture ManufacturingRole Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven **Operations Manager** to lead our modular furniture manufacturing operations. You will oversee end\-to\-end factory operations—from raw material planning, CAD/CAM integration, and panel processing (CNC, edge banding, Cutting machine ) to quality assurance, dispatch, and site installation coordination.

The ideal candidate will optimize production efficiency, minimize material wastage, enforce Lean/5S practices, and ensure on\-time project delivery without compromising quality.

**Key Overview \& Responsibilities1\. Production Management \& Scheduling**

* Plan, direct, and coordinate daily shop\-floor manufacturing schedules based on client orders, CAD designs, and delivery timelines.
* Optimize production lines including cutting, edge\-banding, drilling, sanding, spray painting/lamination, and flat\-pack assembly.
* Coordinate with the design/technical team to convert CAD drawings and cut\-lists into error\-free CNC machine programming outputs.
* Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), throughput rate, and turnaround time (TAT).

**2\. Quality Control \& Material Efficiency**

* Enforce strict Quality Control (QC) standards across every stage—raw material inspection (Plywood, MDF, Particle Board, Laminates, Hardware), in\-process machining, and final flat\-pack packing.
* Implement nesting strategies and cutting optimization software to drive down material scrap rates and off\-cut waste.
* Root\-cause quality non\-conformances (dimension errors, edge peeling, missing hardware) and establish preventive action plans.

**3\. Supply Chain, Inventory \& Procurement**

* Oversee raw material inventory, hardware fittings and consumable stock levels using ERP software.
* Coordinate procurement needs with suppliers to ensure steady material flow and prevent production bottlenecks.
* Manage final packaging standards (EPE foam, corner guards, corrugated packaging) to prevent transit damage.

**4\. Plant Maintenance \& Safety**

* Establish preventive maintenance schedules for major machinery (Panel Saws, CNC Routers, Throughfeed Edge Banders, Multi\-Boring Machines).
* Maintain strict safety, ISO, and 5S protocols across the factory floor to ensure a safe, efficient working environment.

**5\. Team Leadership \& Installation Support**

* Lead, mentor, and train plant supervisors, machine operators, carpenters, and helpers.
* Liaise with project managers and site\-installation supervisors to align dispatch schedules with site readiness.
* Installation and handover of site
* Snag list and service order tracking,
* Completion and handover of the project within the prescribed TAT,

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

**Category**

**Requirements**

**Experience**

7–12\+ years in manufacturing operations, with **at least 4\+ years specifically in modular furniture / panel processing**

**Technical Know\-How**

Hands\-on experience with CNC machines, Panel Saws, Edge Banders, Vacuum Press machines, and CAD/CAM software (AutoCAD, Prolance )

**Software**

Hands\-on working knowledge of ERP systems

**Methodologies**

Deep practical knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and Material Yield Optimization

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

 Anandha Inn Convention Centre and Suites is a four\-star luxury hotel located in the central area of Pondicherry, offering guests an elegant setting for relaxation and events. description:

 Across many parts of India, patients still face significant barriers to accessing innovative therapies, particularly in specialty and rare disease areas. Awareness gaps, fragmented healthcare infrastructure, and affordability challenges often delay access to treatments that could significantly improve outcomes.

 FarmaMondo is a fast\-growing Swiss pharmaceutical group focused on improving access to specialty medicines in emerging markets.
 



 Through our unique model combining market access expertise with commercialization capabilities, we work to ensure that both licensed and unlicensed therapies reach patients in countries where treatment options are limited.
 



 India is a key strategic market for our growth, and South India represents an important hub for specialty healthcare institutions and centers of excellence.

 The
 **Area Commercial Manager –**

 This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role within innovative MNC environment, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-growing environment and enjoys building new markets, creating opportunities, and shaping strategy on the ground.

* Implement the commercial Access strategy for South India, identifying opportunities to expand FarmaMondo’s specialty portfolio.

*Identify New Opportunities* 



* Analyze market dynamics and patient flows, funding options for access
* Provide insights from the field to support India strategy, market access initiatives, and future portfolio expansion.



  





*Collaborate Across the Organization* 



* Work closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability and successful commercialization.
* Contribute regional insights that help shape FarmaMondo’s India growth strategy.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Around 10 years of specialty pharmaceutical commercial experience in the territory in MNC

* Experience engaging with KOLs and major hospital networks.

**Who You Are** 



* Entrepreneurial and comfortable building things from the ground up.

description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s Surface Transportation Operations team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Supply Chain Manager to assist in the management of daily freight movements flowing into and out of our NA fulfillment centers and our associated fulfillment network.
   

  

 People Manager role handing about 50\-75 HC in a 24 X 7 shift Operations at HYD office. Role involves managing daily Service Levels, driving KPI’s apart from driving continuous improvement process and cost initiatives in the network.
   

  

 The candidate should have a background in Supply chain/ transportation, loss prevention and excellent program management skills. He/she has the ability to pull and analyze data with ease, drive process improvements, standardize our processes and eliminate the root cause of defects within the current systems. This job will require exceptional communication skills while having the ability to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Continual, tactical communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers ( Finance, Tech, Fulfillment Centers)
* Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
* Develop Key performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
* Lead initiatives to re\-engineer business processes, and identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon’s transportation operations.
* Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
* Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions.
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs.
* Excellent communication, both verbal and written as you will be required to create a narrative outlining your weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
* Propose improvements to our existing process and utilize AI tools for enhancing productivity


 A day in the life
   

  

 You lead a shift cluster of frontline team managers who keep Amazon's middle\-mile trucking moving in real time. Your day runs on three rhythms that blend from the moment you log in: live operations, people, and mechanisms. You open with a handover from the prior shift and walk the queue of active disruptions — drivers stalled in transit, equipment failures, regulated driving\-hour limits, accidents, and safety escalations. When a team manager needs assistance, you will assess the situation the provide the right guidance or escalate further if needed. In between, you coach — 1:1s, floor\-walks, and live feedback on speed, quality, and customer handling. The rest of your day belongs to mechanisms. You measure what matters — service\-level attainment, resolution time, escalation volume — and own the weekly and monthly business reviews for your scope.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Driver Support Services (DSS) is a dedicated ROC unit that keeps Amazon's most strategic mile capacity moving — Amazon Freight Partner (AFP) carriers and TOMY drivers. AFP is Amazon's committed\-carrier program: contracted partners who operate trucking fleets to Amazon's safety, sustainability, and delivery standards, providing capacity that protects the network from rate volatility and scales with our growth. TOMY drivers are Amazon associates within Transportation Operations Management running shorter\- transit legs where DSS acts as their dispatch. We are a white\-glove dispatch and disruption\-resolution team operating 24x7 across three shift bands.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
* 3\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Knowledge of at least one data\-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* 3\+ years in full\-time industry or military work, or experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate

title: Manager II, Program Management, Fee integrity and seller Experience
description:
**Description**
 The Manager II, Program Management role will lead Fee Integrity and Seller Experience Operations within the Seller economics and fees org, responsible for ensuring accurate fee categorization, reducing fee\-related seller contacts, and improving the seller dispute experience across worldwide stores. You will manage a team of product compliance specialists and associates working at the intersection of Fees Product, Science, Tech, Selling Partner Support (SPS), and cross\-functional stakeholder teams to drive execution across key workstreams including fee category override operations, ML model training and evaluation, taxonomy management and seller experience tool readiness.
   

  

 Our environment is fast\-paced and high\-impact: the team processes thousands of fee category override requests monthly, supports ML model training across 20\+ stores, and executes integrity programs protecting tens of millions in annualized fee revenue. This role requires a self\-starter who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and comfortable leading through ambiguity while managing multiple concurrent operational workstreams, cross\-functional dependencies, and senior leadership goals.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Manager who can drive operational excellence through structured team accountability while partnering across Product, Science, Tech, Finance, Legal, and Seller Support teams. You should understand fee integrity and seller experience problems end\-to\-end, have the ability to identify and mitigate fee accuracy risks before they impact sellers, and scale operations through automation and AI\-driven solutions. As the owner of this domain, you should be able to connect operational execution to business outcomes, translate Director\-level goals into team\-level delivery plans, and build repeatable mechanisms that improve quality, productivity, and seller trust at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, product compliance specialists and associates ensuring the team delivers high\-quality results that meet business objectives and service\-level commitments.
* Own end\-to\-end execution of fee category override operations, including ticket processing, quality assurance (QA), accuracy monitoring, and SLA management, directly contributing to Director\-level override accuracy goals
* Drive ML labelling operations in partnership with Fees Science, managing base labelling, QA , inconsistency resolution, and timely delivery of training data to support model retraining cycles across store expansions.
* Design and implement automation and GenAI solutions to improve team productivity, reduce manual effort, and eliminate non\-value\-add work across workflows.
* Build and maintain structured quality frameworks across all operational dimensions (override accuracy, ticket accuracy, ML consistency), using data\-driven error analysis, targeted coaching, and SOP standardization
* Partner with Fees Product, Science, Tech, SPS, and Global Financial Audit teams to resolve cross\-functional dependencies, manage escalations, and align on taxonomy updates
* Manage team performance through goal\-setting, balanced scorecards, talent reviews, coaching plans, and structured ramp\-up programs for new hires
* Define and track operational KPIs; build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide real\-time visibility into team workload, quality trends, and progress against goals
* Support UAT and SP\-Support readiness for seller experience tools across multiple marketplaces


 A day in the life
   

  

 You start your morning reviewing program metrics and preparing for a team standup where you discuss progress, blockers, and shifting priorities. Mid\-morning might find you in a stakeholder alignment meeting, negotiating trade\-offs between timelines and resources. After lunch, you hold a one\-on\-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and review a document they are preparing for leadership. Later, you dive into the details of a risk mitigation plan before wrapping up with a quick sync to ensure your team has what they need to move forward.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Fee Integrity and seller eXperience (FIX) team is Amazon's central program management arm for fee accuracy, seller dispute resolution, and fee\-related seller experience across worldwide marketplaces. Based in Hyderabad, the 25\-member team operates eight interconnected workstreams spanning prevention, detection, correction, and seller education across Amazon's fee ecosystem. FIX partners with Fees Product, Science, Tech, Selling Partner Support, Finance, and Legal teams to drive fee category accuracy, eliminate seller contacts, launch and expand fee integrity products to new marketplaces, and improve how sellers understand and interact with fees.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of team management experience
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

description:
Job Role: Manager / Senior Manager – Patient Access \- Prior Authorization / EVBV
 



  





 Job Description The Patient Access Manager / Senior Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the prior authorization department. This role involves leading a team to ensure all required prior authorizations are obtained accurately and in a timely manner for patient services, medications, and procedures. The manager will develop and implement efficient workflows, monitor key performance indicators, ensure compliance with all payer and regulatory requirements, and serve as a key resource for staff and clinical teams. The ultimate goal is to minimize claim denials, reduce delays in patient care, and optimize the revenue cycle.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 Leadership and Team Management:
 



 • Lead, train, and mentor a team of prior authorization specialists.
 



 • Manage daily workflow, delegate tasks, and ensure productivity goals are met. • Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify opportunities for professional development. Operational Oversight:
 



 • Oversee the end\-to\-end prior authorization process for all requested services.
 



 • Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
 



 • Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as approval rates, turnaround times, and denial trends. Compliance and Quality Assurance:
 



 • Ensure all prior authorization activities adhere to federal, state, and payer\-specific regulations.
 



 • Conduct regular audits of submitted authorizations to maintain a high level of accuracy and quality.
 



 • Stay current with changes in payer policies, medical necessity criteria, and coding guidelines. Communication and Collaboration:
 



 • Serve as the primary point of contact for clinical staff and providers regarding prior authorization requirements.
 



 • Collaborate with the billing, coding, and patient financial services departments to resolve complex issues and prevent future denials.
 



 • Communicate with insurance companies and third\-party payers to appeal denied authorizations. Desired Candidate:
 



 • A minimum of 15 years of experience in prior authorization, medical billing, or revenue cycle management.
 



 • At least 5 years of experience in a leadership or supervisory role.
 



 • Prior Authorization Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of prior authorization processes for a wide range of medical services and specialties.
 



 • Strong understanding of insurance and third\-party payer policies, especially those from major health plans. • Experience with electronic health records (EHR) systems, prior authorization software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
 



 • Familiarity with HIPAA regulations and other healthcare compliance standards.
 



 • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and make informed decisions.
 



 • Proven ability to resolve complex issues and manage competing priorities effectively.

description:

 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations.  At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Local Lab Delivery to lead the operational delivery, oversight, and continuous improvement of local laboratory reference range data management supporting our clinical development portfolio. In this role, you will oversee the end\-to\-end local laboratory data process, ensuring reference ranges, units, conversion factors, analyse mappings, and associated metadata are accurately interpreted, quality controlled, maintained, and configured within laboratory management systems. **Discover Your Role**
* Lead the operational delivery of local laboratory data activities across clinical studies, ensuring timely execution, quality oversight, issue resolution, and effective study support.
* Oversee the intake, interpretation, quality control, maintenance, and delivery of local laboratory reference ranges and metadata, including units, conversion factors, analyse mappings, and study\-specific configurations.
* Ensure accurate and timely configuration, maintenance, and quality oversight of local laboratory information within the EDC Lab Administration system.

* Drive continuous improvement and technology enablement, including opportunities involving automation, AI\-enabled solutions, document extraction, unit harmonization, metadata classification, test synonym mapping, and quality review.
* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Local Lab Delivery Specialists while managing performance objectives, development plans, workload allocation, resource planning, and operational priorities.

* Advanced knowledge of local laboratory reference range management, including analyte interpretation, unit conversions, conversion algorithms, test synonym mapping, reference range evaluation, and metadata management.
* Strong understanding of local laboratory data collection, validation, maintenance, quality control, and delivery processes supporting Clinical Data Management.
* Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, Clinical Data Management principles, EDC systems, laboratory administration systems, and related clinical data technologies.
* Experience managing complex laboratory data issues through root cause analysis, CAPA development, issue resolution, and process remediation.
* Knowledge of applicable regulations, GxP requirements, clinical data quality principles, SOPs, and inspection\-readiness expectations.
* Demonstrated experience with operational metrics, targets, turnaround times, quality indicators, process improvement, and operational excellence.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Exposure to automation, AI\-enabled solutions, workflow optimization, metadata management, or digital transformation within laboratory data management is preferred.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

 Lead the tele\-calling team of 25 Tele callers and supervisors (TL) with focused exclusively on 90\+ DPD accounts, driving resolution and recovery on high\-risk delinquent portfolio through structured calling strategies while ensuring compliance with fair practice norms.

 • Manage daily operations of the tele\-calling team dedicated to 90\+ DPD accounts, driving PTP generation and actual collection/resolution

title: Manager / Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Raw Materials
description:
Raghu Vamsi Aerospace, Hyderabad is part of the Raghu Vamsi Group, a precision aerospace and industrial machining organisation. The Group manufactures complex, close\-tolerance components for global OEMs and Tier\-1 customers across Aerospace, Oil \& Gas and Industrial sectors.
 



**Role Purpose** 




 The Manager / Senior Manager – Supply Chain \& Raw Materials will be responsible for ensuring reliable, cost\-effective and compliant sourcing of raw materials, tools and consumables – with particular criticality around specialty materials used in aerospace\-grade manufacturing – in support of production schedules across the Aerospace, Oil \& Gas and Industrial businesses. The role calls for strong material and market knowledge, sharp negotiation ability and the maturity to operate in a fast\-paced, precision\-manufacturing environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end planning and procurement of raw materials, cutting tools and consumables required for aerospace, oil \& gas and industrial production programs.
* Take particular ownership of specialty and critical materials – ensuring uninterrupted, compliant supply given their long lead times and criticality to production.
* Develop and manage a robust, qualified supplier base across raw materials, tooling and consumables, ensuring adherence to certifications, traceability and industry/customer specifications.
* Partner with Planning, Engineering, Quality and Production teams to translate production schedules into accurate material and tooling requirement plans, avoiding stock\-outs and minimising excess/obsolete inventory.
* Lead sourcing strategy for critical and long\-lead\-time items, including dual\-sourcing, forward buying and risk mitigation for supply volatility (price, availability, market constraints).
* Negotiate pricing, contracts and long\-term supply agreements with mills, distributors, tooling vendors and service centres to secure cost, quality and delivery commitments.
* Ensure all incoming material and tooling is accompanied by correct certification and drive compliance with AS9100 / NADCAP and customer quality requirements.
* Monitor and report on cost trends, lead times, supplier performance (OTIF, quality, responsiveness) and inventory health; drive corrective actions where required.
* Identify and implement cost\-reduction and value\-engineering opportunities in sourcing without compromising quality or delivery.
* Build contingency and business\-continuity plans for critical material and tooling supply, including alternate sources and safety stock strategies.
* Mentor and develop a small team of buyers/planners; instil discipline in forecasting, PO management and supplier governance.



**Candidate Profile** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent; a specific specialisation is not essential – strong, relevant industry experience matters more than the degree stream.
* 12–18 years of experience in raw material / tooling \& consumables sourcing and supply chain management, with a significant portion in aerospace, defence, oil \& gas or other precision/regulated manufacturing environments.
* Strong, demonstrable working knowledge of specialty materials used in aerospace\-grade manufacturing, along with raw materials, cutting tools and consumables more broadly – including sourcing markets, forms and certification requirements.
* Prior exposure to similar industries – aerospace component manufacturing, oil \& gas equipment, or other precision engineering sectors – with an established supplier network.
* Sound understanding of AS9100, NADCAP and customer\-specific material and quality requirements; experience with material traceability and certification management.
* Sharp, proven negotiation skills and experience managing supplier contracts, long\-term agreements and price/lead\-time risk.
* Smart, sharp and commercially astute, with strong analytical and planning capability; comfortable working with ERP/MRP systems and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally with Planning, Engineering, Quality, Production and Finance.
* High personal integrity, ownership and a proactive, hands\-on approach suited to a growing, high\-precision manufacturing environment.



**What the Role Offers** 




 The opportunity to build and shape a critical supply chain function for a fast\-growing aerospace and precision manufacturing group, working closely with senior leadership and gaining exposure across the Aerospace, Oil \& Gas and Industrial businesses.

title: Event Management Specialist
description:
**Position Title:** 
 EMT Lead – Event Management Technology
 **\| Experience Required:** 
 7–8 Years
 



**Function:** 
 IT Operations / Technical Operations Center (TOC)
 **\| Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Event Management Technology (EMT) Lead to own the enterprise event management platform and strategy — correlating, filtering, and prioritizing events generated across monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, SolarWinds, and VeloCloud into meaningful, actionable alerts. This role sits at the intersection of monitoring, automation, and incident response, and is responsible for reducing alert noise, improving signal\-to\-noise ratio, and ensuring the right events reach the right teams at the right time within a 24x7 TOC environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Event Management Platform Ownership** 



* Own the enterprise event management/correlation platform, integrating event feeds from Dynatrace, SolarWinds, VeloCloud, and other monitoring/observability tools.
* Design and maintain event correlation rules, deduplication logic, suppression policies, and event enrichment to reduce alert fatigue and noise.
* Define event severity/priority frameworks aligned with business impact and service criticality.
* Continuously tune event thresholds and correlation logic based on incident trends and false\-positive analysis.



**Team Leadership \& TOC Operations** 



* Lead and mentor a team of event/monitoring engineers operating in a 24x7 TOC, ensuring consistent shift coverage and escalation discipline.
* Own the event\-to\-incident lifecycle — ensuring critical events are correctly triaged, escalated, and routed to the right resolver groups.
* Drive shift handovers, ticket hygiene, and documentation standards across the team.
* Conduct performance reviews, skills assessments, and training for team members on event management tools and processes.



**Integration \& Automation** 



* Integrate the event management platform with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira Service Management) for automated incident/ticket creation.
* Drive auto\-remediation and self\-healing workflows for known, recurring event patterns.
* Partner with monitoring tool owners (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, VeloCloud admins) to ensure clean, well\-structured event data feeds into the platform.
* Support AIOps initiatives — anomaly detection, event clustering, and predictive alerting — to mature the event management capability.



**Incident \& Problem Management** 



* Act as an escalation point during major incidents (P1/P2\), ensuring rapid event\-to\-response handoff to Incident Management.
* Drive RCA for event storms, missed escalations, or correlation failures, and implement preventive improvements.
* Partner with Incident/Problem Management to reduce MTTD (Mean Time to Detect) and MTTA (Mean Time to Acknowledge).



**Reporting \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build dashboards and reports on event volumes, noise reduction metrics, correlation effectiveness, and escalation SLAs.
* Present regular updates to IT leadership on event management maturity, trends, and improvement roadmap.
* Collaborate with Network, Infrastructure, Application, and Security teams to align event priorities with business\-critical services.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 7–8 years of overall IT experience, with at least 3–4 years focused on event management, monitoring, or TOC leadership.
* Strong hands\-on experience with event/alert data from Dynatrace, SolarWinds, and VeloCloud.
* Experience with event management/correlation platforms (e.g., ServiceNow Event Management, BMC TrueSight, Moogsoft, PagerDuty, xMatters, or similar).
* Solid understanding of ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management) and event\-to\-ticket workflows.
* Experience working in a 24x7 TOC/NOC environment, including shift management and major incident escalation.
* Proven ability to design correlation rules, suppression logic, and severity frameworks to reduce alert noise.
* Team leadership experience (managing 5\+ engineers) in an operations environment.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills, with experience presenting to senior IT leadership.



**Good to Have** 



* Exposure to AIOps platforms and machine\-learning\-based event correlation.
* Scripting/automation experience (Python, PowerShell) for event pipeline customization.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native monitoring/event sources (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch).
* Relevant certifications (ITIL Foundation, Dynatrace, ServiceNow Event Management).



**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

title: Manager, Third Party Strategy and Oversight
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Manager, Third Party Strategy and Oversight (TPSO) supports the operational execution of third‑party oversight activities within Patient Safety (PS). This role is responsible for monitoring performance, maintaining oversight metrics, supporting compliance activities, and contributing to continuous improvement of outsourced pharmacovigilance (PV) activities.
   

  

 The role works closely with TPSO leadership and cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure third parties operate in compliance with global PV regulations, GVP requirements, BMS quality standards, and contractual obligations. The role is primarily execution‑focused, providing data, analysis, documentation, and recommendations to support effective governance and decision‑making.
   

  

**Duties/Responsibilities**
 Third‑Party Oversight \& Monitoring
   

  

* Perform day‑to‑day management and oversight activities for assigned third‑party vendors, distributors, or business partners performing PV‑related activities.
* Collect, track, and maintain third‑party performance data, KPIs, and quality metrics in accordance with established oversight processes.
* Review metrics and reports for completeness, accuracy, and trends; flag potential risks or compliance concerns for escalation and proactively recommend mitigation and improvement/corrective actions to PS teams.
* Support investigation and documentation of compliance issues, including deviations, root cause analysis inputs, and CAPA tracking.


 Compliance, Quality \& Inspection Readiness
   

  

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities related to third‑party oversight, including document preparation, evidence collection, and response tracking.
* Assist in the review of safety agreements (e.g., PVAs, SOWs) to ensure oversight requirements are addressed and understood.
* Maintain accurate and inspection‑ready records supporting third‑party oversight activities.


 Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication
   

  

* Work collaboratively with BMS stakeholders to resolve third‑party issues in a timely manner.
* Prepare oversight inputs, summaries, and data for governance forums and management reviews.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with internal stakeholders and external partners within defined role scope.
* Support projects that build strategic third\-party oversight capabilities, processes and standards to ensure delivery of PS objectives.
* Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures and training relating to core responsibilities as needed.


 Culture \& Ways of Working
   

  

* Demonstrate a strong quality mindset and promote a culture of quality and compliance, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute positively to a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
* Support broader SQM initiatives and book of work, as assigned.


 This role reports to: Head of Third\-Party Oversight and Strategy
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Public Health, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Safety Operations, Quality, or a related pharmaceutical function.
* Experience supporting vendor or third‑party oversight activities in a regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of global PV regulations, GxP principles, and quality system expectations.
* Experience working with performance metrics, KPIs, compliance tracking, or quality indicators; ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, project management and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Ability to analyse data, identify issues or trends, and escalate appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in a matrixed environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, sound judgement, and commitment to quality and compliance.

We anticipate how decisions are made, persistently explore and uncover the business needs of our key clients, and understand how our range of product and service offerings can enable their business success.

* Implement blind review protocols and complex multi\-tiered human \+ AI arbitration to prevent Automation Bias.

* Partner with the training team to remediate quality gaps.

title: Chief Operating Officer (PSS08105)
description:
**About The Company**
 A growing NBFC focused on providing accessible and responsible financial solutions across urban, semi\-urban, and rural markets. The company emphasizes Gold Loans alongside lending solutions such as Loan Against Property, Housing Finance, and Micro Enterprise lending. With an expanding branch network across multiple states, it aims to build a scalable, customer\-centric, and well\-governed financial services platform that balances sustainable business growth with strong operational and risk discipline.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **Chief Operating Officer** 
 will lead the company's business and operational performance with a strategic focus on scaling the Gold Loan business. This role oversees business execution across the branch network, strengthens operational processes and controls, drives productivity and customer experience, and ensures sustainable portfolio growth. The COO reports directly to the Managing Director and partners closely with the senior leadership team to translate business strategy into execution and build scalable operating models supporting the company’s next phase of growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the growth and operational performance of the Gold Loan business across the branch network.
* Drive AUM, disbursements, customer acquisition, renewals, and branch productivity.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end Gold Loan lifecycle including sourcing, appraisal, LTV, credit, documentation, disbursement, custody, release, and auction.
* Strengthen processes, controls, turnaround time, and customer experience.
* Lead branch, regional, and field operations across geographies.
* Drive business targets, productivity, operational efficiency, and cost optimisation.
* Monitor branch and regional performance and implement corrective actions.
* Support branch expansion and scalable operating models.
* Oversee portfolio performance, collections, and recovery operations.
* Monitor AUM, delinquency, collection efficiency, and asset quality.
* Strengthen recovery and auction processes ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal requirements.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Legal to strengthen the control environment.
* Ensure adherence to RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Drive process standardisation, automation, and technology\-led improvements to improve turnaround time, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Establish effective MIS and dashboards for business and operational monitoring.
* Lead and mentor senior business, regional, and operations teams, building a strong culture of performance and accountability.
* Partner with the MD/CEO on business strategy, expansion, and organisational priorities.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Credit, Risk, Finance, HR, Technology, Compliance, and Legal teams.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Postgraduate degree in Management, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 15\+ years in NBFCs, banking, or financial services with strong and demonstrable experience in the Gold Loan business.
* Leadership: Proven experience as COO, Business Head, Operations Head, National Operations Head, or equivalent, managing large branch and field operations across multiple geographies.
* Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end Gold Loan lifecycle, secured lending operations, RBI regulations, operational risk, internal controls, and governance.
* Soft Skills: Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and ability to drive growth while maintaining portfolio quality and operational discipline.
* Proficiency in Telugu is mandatory.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead the strategic scaling of a core Gold Loan business within a growing NBFC platform.
* Drive operational excellence and portfolio quality across a multi\-state branch network.
* Shape scalable operating models and technology\-led process improvements.
* Partner directly with the Managing Director and senior leadership on business strategy and expansion.
* Influence risk, compliance, and governance frameworks in a regulated financial services environment.

 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
 



 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
 



**For everyone, everywhere.** 




  





 More about
 **our mission**
 and
 **what we offer**
 .
 



  





**Job Description** 




**About the team (Finance Risk \& Control)** 




 Finance Risk \& Control partners with Finance and the wider business to strengthen the control environment, support SOX compliance, and improve how risks and controls are designed, operated and evidenced. We’re a distributed team across the UK and Estonia, and we’re building a SOX testing hub in Hyderabad to increase consistency, quality and scalability of our testing programme.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing (responsibilities)** 




 Own the SOX business process controls testing programme (end\-to\-end)
 


* Build and run the annual and interim testing plan across all in\-scope business process controls.
* Plan when testing occurs and ensure sequencing reflects process dependencies, change activity, and auditor timelines.
* Deliver both Design Effectiveness and Operating Effectiveness testing to a consistently high standard.



 Methodology, quality, and audit readiness
 


* Own and continuously improve the testing methodology, templates, sampling guidance, and evidence standards.
* Perform QA reviews to ensure testing is complete, well\-documented, and auditor\-ready.
* Ensure consistent conclusions and a strong “why” behind pass/fail outcomes.



 Auditor partnership and external reporting
 


* Be a key interface for the external auditor on business process testing: align approach, share results, coordinate walkthroughs/re\-performance support, and respond to questions efficiently.
* Present testing outcomes clearly in governance packs and formal forums.



 Manage external resources / co\-sourcing
 


* Manage external testing resources: onboarding to Wise methodology, allocation, progress tracking, and quality/performance oversight.
* Ensure external capacity reduces bottlenecks without creating rework or inconsistencies.



 Issue management and remediation governance
 


* Oversee how issues are agreed (severity, impact, root cause) and ensure remediation plans are practical, measurable, and owned.
* Track progress and coordinate re\-testing / closure requirements.



 Minimise burden on the business
 


* Build a low\-friction evidence request process and smart scheduling to reduce disruption for process owners.
* Drive clarity and predictability: stakeholders know what’s needed, when, and why.



 Build the Hyderabad testing capability
 


* This is the first testing hire in Hyderabad; you’ll help build the operating model and then hire/lead a team of 6\+ testers.
* Coach and develop the team; embed standards, consistency, and stakeholder partnership.
* Integrate day\-to\-day delivery with the UK/Estonia Finance Risk \& Control team.



 Innovation: AI/data\-enabled testing in BAU
 


* Identify opportunities to use AI and analytics to improve coverage, speed, and quality (e.g., evidence extraction, population testing, exception flagging).
* Implement in a controlled, explainable way that auditors and internal stakeholders can rely on.



 Themes, insights, and SOX capability\-building
 


* Identify trends across testing results and recommend improvements (control design, execution, monitoring, evidence).
* Help build SOX understanding across the business through guidance, coaching and practical support.



  





**Qualifications** 




**What you’ll bring (requirements)** 




 Essential
 


* Strong SOX/ICFR testing experience across business process controls (DE \+ OE).
* Deep understanding of controls testing methodology, sampling, evidence expectations, and audit standards.
* Proven experience running a testing programme end\-to\-end (planning → fieldwork → QA → issues → reporting).
* Experience managing/coordinating co\-sourced or external testing teams and driving quality.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence remediation outcomes.
* Excellent written documentation skills and governance\-ready communication.



 Nice to have
 


* Experience building/scaling a testing function or controls centre of excellence.
* Fintech/high\-growth/regulated environment experience.
* Experience with continuous controls monitoring, data analytics, or AI\-enabled assurance/testing.
* Experience working across time zones and distributed teams.



 How we work / Level 7 expectations
 


* Sets direction for a programme area and raises the bar for quality and consistency.
* Operates independently, makes sound risk\-based judgments, and escalates early with options.
* Balances rigour with pragmatism—delivers SOX compliance without unnecessary complexity.
* Builds trusted relationships across Finance and the business.



  





 Key stakeholders
 



 Process Owners, Control Owners, Finance teams, Tech/data partners (as needed for automation), External auditors, UK \& Estonia Finance Risk \& Control.
 



  





**Additional Information** 




 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
 



 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
 



 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
 



 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit
 
 Wise.Jobs
 
 .
 



 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on
 
 LinkedIn
 
 and
 
 Instagram
 
 .

title: Smallworld Technical Lead

title: Head of Agency Lending Operations, Managing Director
description:
**Who Are We Looking For**
 We are looking for an industry leader with hands\-on experience in Agency Lending Operations within a Markets business. You understand what great looks like in a global operations organization and bring deep knowledge of the functions that support Agency Lending across the trade lifecycle. You combine strong operational expertise with executive presence, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to influence, lead through change, and navigate complex challenges.
   

  

 This is a key leadership role responsible for overseeing a global team of approximately 150 professionals across India, Hong Kong, London, and Boston, providing operational support for Agency Lending activities, including settlement, reconciliations, and collateral management. You will lead the organization through the complexity of a large\-scale global operation, ensuring accurate trade processing, effective collateralization, robust risk management, regulatory compliance, and seamless day\-to\-day execution.
   

  

 You will work closely with business, technology, risk, and control partners to drive innovation across processes and systems, enhancing efficiency, scalability, and risk management while ensuring operational solutions remain aligned with State Street's strategic objectives, industry best practices, and evolving market needs.
   

  

 A significant part of your mandate will be the transformation of the function. You will have the opportunity to help shape the future operating model, modernize the technology infrastructure, and drive initiatives that reduce risk, improve efficiency, and accelerate speed to market. Success in this role will require balancing long\-term transformation with an unwavering focus on day\-to\-day execution and client service.
   

  

 The role can be based in Mumbai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad and reports directly to the SVP, Global Head of Financing and Portfolio Solutions Operations.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high\-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data\-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client\-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.
   

  

 As one of the largest and most experienced providers of financing and portfolio solutions in the industry, we provide investors with market\-leading expertise, technology and scale to accelerate decision making, enhance performance and unlock efficiencies across the entire trade lifecycle.
   

  

 We are in the midst of a significant transformation as we modernize our technology architecture and transition from legacy platforms to a more scalable, future\-state environment. The processes and functions that support our Agency Lending business are critical to the success of State Street Markets and operate at significant scale and complexity. This transformation presents a unique opportunity to help redesign and optimize key workflows, driving greater automation, efficiency and resiliency across the business. As one of the largest businesses within Markets, and one of the world's leading agent lenders, we provide the scale, visibility and impact to shape the future of a market\-leading franchise.
   

  

 Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 As Head of Agency Lending Operations, Managing Director, you will:
   

  

* Lead a global organization of 150\+ professionals, driving consistent service delivery, robust governance and controls, operational resilience, and a culture of excellence across regions while setting the strategic direction for one of the industry's leading Agency Lending operations teams.
* Own the end\-to\-end Agency Lending operating platform, overseeing trade capture, confirmations, settlement, clearing, reconciliation, cash movements, data management, and lifecycle events across loan and return activity, as well as bilateral and triparty transactions.
* Provide strategic leadership across the Agency Lending collateral ecosystem, overseeing margin management, bilateral and triparty collateralization, dispute resolution, collateral sufficiency monitoring, and optimization throughout the lending lifecycle, including collateral impacts arising from corporate actions.
* Shape the future of Agency Lending Operations by leading a significant transformation and modernization agenda. Partnering closely with Technology, Business, and Risk teams, you will help deliver scalable, automated future\-state capabilities while optimizing the operating model and cost base to support growth, efficiency, and global consistency.
* Champion a best\-in\-class risk and control environment, proactively identifying and mitigating operational, settlement, and counterparty risks, strengthening controls and operational resilience, and ensuring timely and effective management of incidents, remediation activities, and escalations.
* Ensure the organization remains audit\-ready and regulatory compliant, maintaining adherence to applicable regulations, internal policies, and industry standards while overseeing regulatory reporting, data governance, model risk requirements, and readiness for an evolving regulatory landscape.
* Serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders and key market participants, leading relationships across Front Office, Custody, Risk/ERM, Compliance, Technology, counterparties, borrowers, custodians, clearing agents, and strategic vendors. You will act as a senior escalation point, helping ensure exceptional service delivery, strong cyber\-risk oversight, and swift resolution of complex operational issues.
* Build and inspire a high\-performing global leadership team, attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent while strengthening succession planning, leadership depth, and an inclusive culture that enables individuals and teams to perform at their best.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, or related field is preferred. A postgraduate/professional qualification is advantageous
* 20\+ years of experience in financial services operations, with focus on Agency Lending
* Strong understanding of Agency Lending products and processes (e.g., trade lifecycle management/settlement/collateral, triparty agents, vendors)
* Proven track record of strengthening risk and control environments and managing regulatory and operational risk.
* Experience leading transformation initiatives, including process optimization, automation, and technology modernization.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective partnerships across business, operations, technology, and corporate functions.
* Strategic thinker with a proven change management mindset and experience driving large\-scale initiatives.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers
