title: Microsoft-CRM Technical-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Manager Specialized:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Manager to lead large‑scale CRM and Power Platform initiatives, drive technical excellence, and manage high‑performing delivery teams. This role combines strategic oversight, architecture leadership, and people management to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions that enable business transformation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical design, architecture, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery across D365 modules such as Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service, with accountability for quality and outcomes.
* Manage and mentor a team of developers, leads, and technical consultants, providing direction, performance feedback, and career development support.
* Collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Oversee development of custom plugins, workflows, integrations, and extensions using C\#, JavaScript, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Power Platform technologies.
* Establish and enforce development standards through code reviews, design governance, testing strategies, and solution validation.
* Drive solution scalability, security, and performance by overseeing system architecture, integration patterns, and optimization efforts.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, scope, and resource utilization to ensure on‑time and within‑budget delivery.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, integration designs, and deployment standards.
* Act as a senior technical advisor to stakeholders, clearly articulating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong leadership experience managing technical teams in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform delivery environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM customization, extensibility, and solution architecture.
* Solid hands‑on understanding of C\#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and integration patterns (Azure and Power Platform).
* Proven experience delivering complex, enterprise‑scale CRM implementations.
* Strong grasp of Agile delivery models, estimation, planning, and governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive‑level presentation skills.
* Strategic mindset with strong problem‑solving, decision‑making, and prioritization capabilities.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.


**\<\< Ideally, you’ll also\>\>**
**The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:**
* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center


**\<\< What we look for\>\>**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
   

  

 Minimum of 7\+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation, with at least 1 year in a managerial or leadership role.
   

  

 Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, compliance, and enterprise integration patterns.
   

  

 Experience managing budgets, delivery risk, and resource planning for complex programs.
   

  

 Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and retain high‑performing technical teams.
   

  

 What we offer you
   

  

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Payments Platform
description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript).
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's Degree or PhD degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable products and services for external clients.
* Experience with large\-scale backend server infrastructure (e.g., Monarch, Spanner, etc.).
* Proven ability to demonstrate Staff\-level technical judgement and decision\-making for large\-scale backend systems.
* Background in the compliance domain.
* Excellent working proficiency, communication skills, and experience managing cross\-functional stakeholder relationships.


**About The Job**
 Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \-\- and as a manager, you guide the way.
   

  

 With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
   

  

 Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead, manage, and develop a team of Software Engineers. Perform talent reviews, ensure growth opportunities exist for top talent, and build a healthy team culture.
* Exercise the technical judgment and decision\-making expected of Staff\-level engineers to guide system architecture and design. Ensure technical decisions are made promptly and risks are proactively managed to unblock engineers.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional stakeholders from Product, Program, Payments Compliance and Export Legal teams to develop new capabilities, publish multi\-year roadmaps, and improve the quality and reliability of existing solutions.
* Manage the infrastructure for Sanctions platform, ensuring robustness, scalability, and reliability while actively addressing technical debt.
* Partner with the Product Manager to understand the legal and compliance requirements for sanctions screening, proposing scalable, common, or customized solutions.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 *be your best*

title: EHS Manager
description:
The Lead – EHS – Site is responsible for end\-to\-end Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) implementation at a specific project site. title: Application Manager
description:
Position Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Application Manager** 
 with a strong technical foundation to manage a portfolio of enterprise and Pharma applications. This role combines Application Management Services (AMS), application lifecycle governance, stakeholder coordination, operational service ownership, and awareness of GxP controls applicable to regulated applications.
 



 The successful candidate will ensure application stability, compliant change execution, service performance, lifecycle planning, and effective coordination across business, quality, technical, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
 



**Ideal Profile:** 
 A technically grounded application professional who can connect service operations, lifecycle decisions, compliance expectations, and business outcomes.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Application Service Ownership
 


* Own end\-to\-end operational management of assigned applications and act as the primary coordination point for service delivery.
* Oversee incidents, service requests, problems, changes, releases, knowledge, and recurring operational activities.
* Monitor service levels, operational health, risks, dependencies, and improvement actions.
* Coordinate major incident response, technical troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and follow\-through on corrective actions.



 2\. Application Lifecycle Management
 


* Manage the application lifecycle from onboarding and transition through BAU support, upgrades, roadmap planning, and retirement.
* Maintain application inventory, ownership, support model, lifecycle status, technical dependencies, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate patching, upgrades, releases, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support with relevant teams.
* Identify technical debt, end\-of\-life risks, support gaps, and opportunities for modernization or simplification.



 3\. GxP and Compliance Awareness
 


* Understand the impact of GxP controls on application support, access, documentation, testing, change, release, and incident processes.
* Ensure changes to regulated applications follow applicable quality, validation, approval, traceability, and evidence requirements.
* Work with Quality, Compliance, Validation, Security, and Business teams to maintain application control readiness.
* Support audit and inspection requests by ensuring records, approvals, evidence, and operational documentation are complete and retrievable.
* Assist with compliance deviations, remediation actions, and risk tracking when required.



 4\. Stakeholder and Vendor Management
 


* Engage application owners, business users, product teams, technical teams, and external vendors to maintain service continuity.
* Lead service reviews and communicate service performance, risks, issues, dependencies, and improvement plans.
* Coordinate vendor deliverables, escalations, support obligations, and technical actions.
* Translate business priorities into clear operational and technical requirements.



 5\. Continuous Improvement and Governance
 


* Drive service improvement, automation, knowledge maturity, monitoring enhancements, and reduction of recurring issues.
* Maintain governance artefacts, operational procedures, support documentation, and management reporting.
* Ensure risks, actions, decisions, and exceptions are documented and tracked to closure.



  





 Required Experience and Skills
 



  





 8\+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial experience in application support, application management, or AMS delivery.
 



 Good understanding of application architecture, interfaces, APIs, databases, middleware, hosting, cloud/SaaS services, security, and production support practices.
 



 Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, release, service request, knowledge, SLA/KPI, and continuous improvement processes.
 



 Experience managing application onboarding, transition, maintenance, upgrades, releases, risk, technical debt, roadmap, and retirement activities.
 



 Awareness of GxP controls and the importance of validated processes, controlled changes, traceability, evidence, access governance, data integrity, and audit readiness for regulated applications.
 



 Ability to work confidently with business, quality, compliance, security, infrastructure, development, support, and vendor stakeholders.
 



 Strong written and verbal communication, governance, prioritization, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

Verantwortung für Lieferantenergebnisse, Verbesserungen mithilfe von Lieferanten\-Scorecards. Beeinträchtigt die Fähigkeit des Teams, Service, Qualität und Aktualität der Ziele zu erreichen.Die Arbeit unterliegt Zielen der Funktionsrichtlinie.Verantwortlich für die regelmäßige Beratung des Managements im Fachbereich und/oder im Geschäft.Hat eine unterstützende Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu wichtigen Themen.Um die gewünschten Ergebnisse zu erzielen, ist ein hohes Maß an bewertendem Urteilsvermögen erforderlich.

Umfasst Lieferantenqualifikationen, Aktionspläne, Audits, Leistungsüberwachung und die Unterstützung wichtiger Lieferanten beim Erreichen industrieller Qualitätsstandards. SQEs unterscheiden sich auf verschiedenen Ebenen, die sich auf das technische Verständnis von Konstruktionszeichnungen und die Fähigkeit zur Verwaltung von Anbietern beziehen.
* Erfordert eine spezielle Tiefe und/oder Breite des Fachwissens innerhalb der eigenen Disziplin.Möglicherweise ist ein starkes wirtschaftliches Bewusstsein erforderlich, und es wird erwartet, dass die Entwicklung der Strategie im eigenen Bereich, einschließlich der Kontrolle der Ressourcen, sowie die Richtlinienformulierung beeinflusst wird.Leitet ein kleines bis mittelgroßes Team von erfahrenen Fachleuten.
* Wertet einfache interne und externe geschäftliche Herausforderungen aus und empfiehlt Best Practices zur Verbesserung von Produkten, Prozessen oder Dienstleistungen.Bleibt über Branchentrends informiert, die die Arbeit beeinflussen können.
* Verwendet ein hohes Maß an Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen und komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme zu lösen, die sich auf die Funktion auswirken.Hat die Fähigkeit, die Qualität der bereitgestellten Informationen zu beurteilen und Stakeholdern relevante Fragen zu stellen.Kann neue Lösungen für Probleme anbieten, die außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter liegen, und ist in der Lage, Empfehlungen zu erstellen und abzugeben.Verwendet mehrere interne und einige externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um eine Entscheidung zu treffen.

**Grundqualifikationen**

Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

title: Associate Network Ops Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Associate Operations Manager – REO**
**Department:** 
 Reliability, Engineering \& Operations (REO) — Operations
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Director/Senior Director, Operations
   

  

**Location:** 
 \[Location] \| \[Remote/Hybrid]
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Associate Operations Manager is a hands\-on people leader responsible for the day\-to\-day health and performance of the Network Operations Center (NOC). This role directly supervises resources, ensuring the successful outcome of the day and keeping REO leadership directly aware of challenges of any sort.
   

  

 The Associate Operations Manager is expected to get hands\-on alongside the team — personally investigating alerts, coordinating in real time with REO Incident Management to support active incident bridges, and stepping into triage when capacity or complexity demands it . Additionally, this role ensures the NOC team has what it needs to be successful, and that runbooks are followed consistently, knowledge is captured and maintained , and leadership has clear visibility into critical production issues.
   

  

 Beyond reactive response, they drive a culture of proactive vigilance: monitoring service health, identifying degradation patterns before they escalate, and acting on weak signals before they become incidents. The Associate Operations Manager is a force multiplier: coaching their team to perform, removing obstacles in their path, and stepping in as a stabilizing presence during high\-severity incidents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Directly manage NOC Analysts, providing regular coaching, feedback, and performance guidance . Schedule resources to efficiently meet the demands of the day in a follow\-the\-sun shift structure.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and psychological safety within the team.
* Support career development planning for team members, including skills growth and role progression pathways (e.g., NOC\-to\-IM career tracks).
* Identify training gaps and drive cross\-training initiatives to increase team versatility and resilience.
* Provide scheduled reporting as well as real time feedback as needed for any performance related concerns of staff to HealthEdge REO leadership.


**Alert Response \& NOC Oversight**
* Ensure NOC Analysts respond to monitoring alerts within defined SLA thresholds and escalate appropriately.
* Champion runbook adherence — ensuring documented procedures are followed accurately and consistently, and that deviations are flagged and reviewed.
* Monitor alert volume trends and response quality, using metrics to identify systemic issues or coaching opportunities.
* Partner with Engineering and Platform teams to reduce alert noise, close coverage gaps, and continuously improve alert fidelity.
* Support Incident Managers during SEV1 and SEV2 incidents , and guide NOC resources to assist with on\-call engagement, incident scribing and other duties as required .


**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**
* Drive a culture of documentation — ensuring runbooks, playbooks, escalation paths, and operational procedures are created, reviewed, and kept current.
* Identify knowledge gaps surfaced through incidents or training and assign ownership for resolution.
* Maintain a structured knowledge base that is accessible, accurate , and usable by both NOC Analysts and Incident Managers.
* Ensure that lessons learned from incidents and near\-misses are captured and translated into updated procedures or training materials.


**Operational Performance \& Reporting**
* Track and report on key operational metrics including MTTA, MTTR, alert volume, incident frequency, runbook compliance, and SLA performance.
* Provide regular operational summaries to leadership, highlighting trends, risks, and improvement initiatives.
* Participate in and contribute to ITSM maturity improvement efforts, including process standardization, tooling optimization, and cross\-functional alignment.
* Support Problem Management efforts by ensuring patterns identified from recurring incidents are escalated and tracked to resolution.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 5\+ years of experience in IT Operations, NOC, or Incident Management, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team lead capacity.
* Demonstrated experience managing or supporting 24x7 operational environments.
* Strong understanding of incident response practices, escalation frameworks, and ITSM principles (ITIL Foundation or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to communicate clearly and calmly with both technical teams and non\-technical leadership during high\-pressure situations.
* Experience with monitoring/alerting platforms (e.g., PagerDuty, Datadog, Splunk, or similar) and ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
* Strong documentation skills — ability to write and maintain runbooks, procedures, and executive summaries.


**Preferred**
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher.
* Experience in a SaaS or healthcare technology environment.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Experience supporting or building cross\-functional operational teams following an organizational merger or acquisition.


**Competencies**
**Competency**
**Description**
**Composure Under Pressure**
 Remains steady and decisive during high\-severity incidents; models calm clarity for the team.
   

  

**Team Enablement**
 Prioritizes removing friction for the team; invests in their growth and success.
   

  

**Operational Rigor**
 Holds high standards for process adherence, documentation quality, and follow\-through.
   

  

**Communication**
 Translates technical situations into clear leadership\-facing narratives without delay.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Actively surfaces and acts on patterns — turning incidents into better processes.

title: Manager, Fund Accounting
description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ\-EQ**
 We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end\-to\-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 6,500\+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top\-15 private equity firms.
   

  

 Our services are underpinned by a Group\-wide commitment to ESG and best\-in\-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in\-house experts.
   

  

 Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.
   

  

 We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Introduction**
 As a Manager in Client Services, you will lead high\-performing teams responsible for private equity fund accounting, financial reporting, and client service delivery. This role focuses on driving business growth, developing talent, ensuring operational excellence, maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, and delivering accurate, timely, and compliant services while supporting complex client requirements and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* You'll lead, coach, and develop Client Services teams, monitoring performance, managing workloads, providing feedback, and driving continuous improvement to achieve quality, productivity, and timeliness targets.
* You'll oversee the review and delivery of complex private equity fund accounting activities, including NAV calculations, financial statements, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, journal entries, and other client reporting requirements.
* You'll build and maintain strong relationships with clients, cluster counterparts, and internal stakeholders, managing escalations, resolving issues, facilitating performance discussions, and ensuring service levels and client expectations are met.
* You'll ensure compliance with internal policies, procedures, SSAE requirements, and risk management standards by reviewing deliverables, monitoring controls, approving compliance reports, and driving corrective and preventive actions when needed.
* You'll support operational and strategic projects by facilitating fund onboarding and system migrations to Investran/Paxus, managing workflow planning and resource allocation, serving as a subject matter expert, and acting as an alternate to the Head of Delivery when required.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health \& Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances \& Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.


**Qualifications**
**About You**
* You have a degree in Accounting or a business\-related discipline, 8\+ years of relevant accounting experience, and at least 4 years of people management or supervisory experience in a service delivery environment.
* You possess strong technical expertise in fund accounting, private equity operations, and the preparation and review of working papers, financial statements, disclosures, and financial reports, with sound knowledge of Ind AS, IFRS, and multi\-jurisdictional GAAP standards.
* You have proven experience managing client deliverables, leading teams, conducting performance reviews, and building strong stakeholder relationships while ensuring high\-quality service delivery.
* You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, advanced Excel functions (including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and IF formulas), and accounting platforms such as Investran and/or Paxus, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and an additional foreign language.
* You demonstrate a commitment to professional growth and bring added value through qualifications such as CPA or ACCA, experience in multinational financial services or shared services environments, and a willingness to travel or undertake international secondment opportunities.


**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Together, we are building the next\-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting\-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.

title: Sr. Operations manager
description:
**Company Description:** 
 TrueNorth DMC is a destination management company specializing in comprehensive ground handling and destination services across the United States, Canada, and North America.
 



 We work with international tour operators, travel agencies, corporate groups, and travel partners to deliver seamless FIT, Group, MICE, and customized travel experiences. Our services include hotels, transportation, sightseeing, attractions, restaurants, guides, airport transfers, group movements, and complete destination management.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Operations Manager** 
 to lead and strengthen our U.S. operations team.
 


**Position Overview** 

 The Senior Operations Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end execution of group tours, FIT bookings, MICE movements, and customized travel programs throughout the United States.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring strong destination knowledge, supplier relationships, operational planning, problem\-solving abilities, and the ability to manage multiple groups simultaneously.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience working with a
 **DMC, receptive tour operator, inbound tour operator, or travel company handling U.S. ground operations** 
 .
 


**Key Responsibilities** 
 Tour \& Group Operations
 * Manage complete ground operations for leisure groups, FIT travelers, MICE groups, and customized programs across the United States.
* Review finalized itineraries and ensure all operational components are booked and reconfirmed.
* Coordinate hotels, transportation, restaurants, attractions, guides, airport transfers, activities, and other ground services.
* Prepare detailed operational files, movement sheets, vouchers, rooming lists, manifests, and supplier confirmations.
* Monitor groups from arrival through departure and ensure smooth execution throughout the tour.
* Manage multiple departures and operational files simultaneously.
* Ensure all services are delivered according to the confirmed itinerary, quality standards, and client expectations.


 Supplier \& Vendor Management
 * Develop and maintain strong relationships with hotels, transportation companies, restaurants, attractions, guides, and local suppliers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, terms, cancellation policies, and operational conditions.
* Source new suppliers and alternatives in major U.S. destinations.
* Maintain an updated supplier database and preferred vendor network.
* Monitor supplier performance and resolve service\-related issues.
* Ensure suppliers receive accurate passenger counts, timings, manifests, and service requirements.


 Transportation \& Logistics
 * Coordinate coaches, minibuses, Sprinter vans, SUVs, airport transfers, and other transportation requirements.
* Manage driver schedules, DOT\-related operational considerations, routing, parking, permits, and group movement logistics.
* Coordinate airport arrivals and departures, including meet\-and\-greet services.
* Plan complex multi\-city movements while maintaining realistic travel times and operational efficiency.
* Handle last\-minute transportation changes, delays, breakdowns, and other operational issues.


 Hotel \& Accommodation Operations
 * Coordinate hotel reservations, rooming lists, group allocations, special requests, and payment deadlines.
* Work directly with hotel sales and operations teams for group arrivals and departures.
* Monitor attrition, cancellation deadlines, deposits, and final payment schedules.
* Reconfirm group arrangements before arrival and ensure smooth check\-in and check\-out procedures.


 Client \& Partner Coordination
 * Communicate with international tour operators, travel agencies, and B2B partners regarding operational requirements.
* Review itineraries before operation and identify potential logistical challenges.
* Provide timely operational updates to clients and internal teams.
* Coordinate special requirements including dietary preferences, accessibility needs, VIP travelers, senior travelers, and special occasions.
* Build long\-term relationships with B2B partners through reliable execution and proactive communication.


 Team Leadership
 * Lead, train, and supervise the operations team.
* Allocate files and responsibilities based on workload and destination expertise.
* Establish operational processes, checklists, and quality\-control procedures.
* Conduct pre\-departure reviews for major groups.
* Monitor team performance, response times, accuracy, and service standards.
* Support team members during high\-volume periods and complex operations.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, and exceptional customer service.


 On\-Tour Support \& Problem Resolution
 * Serve as a senior escalation point for operational issues.
* Handle last\-minute changes, flight disruptions, supplier cancellations, passenger emergencies, and service recovery.
* Coordinate solutions quickly while minimizing financial and operational impact.
* Maintain communication with tour managers, drivers, suppliers, and clients during active departures.
* Participate in after\-hours operational support when required for active groups.


 Cost Control \& Operational Profitability
 * Review supplier costs and ensure services remain within approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and margins without compromising service quality.
* Verify supplier invoices against confirmed services and contracted rates.
* Work closely with the contracting, sales, and finance teams regarding costing and supplier payments.
* Monitor operational expenses and prevent avoidable additional charges.


 Preferred Experience
 * 5\+ years of experience in travel operations, preferably within a
 **U.S. DMC, receptive operator, inbound tour operator, group tour operator, or destination management company** 
 .
* 2\+ years of experience managing or supervising an operations team preferred.
* Strong knowledge of major U.S. destinations and tourism circuits.
* Experience managing multi\-city group tours within the United States.
* Strong understanding of hotels, motorcoach operations, attractions, restaurants, guides, and group logistics.
* Experience handling international travelers and overseas B2B travel partners.
* Experience with MICE, corporate groups, incentive travel, and large leisure groups is an advantage.


 Key Skills
 * Excellent operational planning and organizational skills
* Strong leadership and team\-management abilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong negotiation and vendor\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple groups and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to remain calm and solution\-oriented during operational disruptions
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, CRM, and travel operations systems
* Understanding of tour costing and operational margins
* Strong geographic knowledge of the United States


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who thinks beyond simply making reservations.
 



 The right candidate understands the complete journey of a group, anticipates operational challenges before they happen, maintains strong supplier relationships, takes ownership of every file, and ensures that our clients receive consistently reliable service.
 



 You should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where multiple groups may be traveling across different U.S. destinations at the same time.
 


 Why Join TrueNorth DMC?
 
 At TrueNorth DMC, you will have the opportunity to play a key leadership role in building and expanding a growing North American destination management company.
 


* You will work directly with international travel partners, develop supplier networks across major destinations, lead operational teams, and help establish the systems and service standards required to scale our U.S. and North American operations.

title: Centre Head- Andheri, Mumbai
description:

**Company:**

**Location:**

 Full\-Time
 


 About FlexifyMe
 
 FlexifyMe is a growing physiotherapy and pain\-management company focused on helping patients recover from chronic pain, injuries, and movement\-related conditions through evidence\-based physiotherapy and advanced rehabilitation techniques.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Centre Head** 
 who can take complete ownership of the day\-to\-day functioning, clinical environment, patient experience, team performance, and growth of a FlexifyMe centre.
 


 Role Overview
 
 The Centre Head will be responsible for managing the centre as a whole, ensuring high\-quality patient care while driving operational efficiency, team productivity, patient retention, and centre growth.
 



 The ideal candidate should be a strong people leader with excellent communication and organisational skills, a patient\-first mindset, and the ability to balance
 **clinical quality, operations, and business performance** 
 .
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Centre Operations
 * Take ownership of the overall day\-to\-day operations of the centre.
* Ensure smooth functioning of appointments, consultations, treatment sessions, follow\-ups, and patient flow.
* Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, safety, and centre presentation.
* Ensure all operational processes and SOPs are followed consistently.
* Coordinate with management and support teams to resolve operational issues.
* Monitor centre infrastructure, equipment, supplies, and maintenance requirements.


 2\. Team Management \& Leadership
 * Lead, manage, and motivate physiotherapists and centre staff.
* Plan staff schedules, therapist allocation, leaves, and daily responsibilities.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
* Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and development of team members.
* Monitor individual and team productivity.
* Build a positive, accountable, and collaborative centre culture.
* Identify performance gaps and work with team members to improve them.


 3\. Clinical Quality \& Patient Care
 * Ensure patients receive high\-quality, ethical, and evidence\-based physiotherapy care.
* Monitor adherence to clinical protocols and treatment standards.
* Work closely with physiotherapists to improve assessment, treatment planning, documentation, and patient outcomes.
* Review patient feedback and identify opportunities to improve the patient experience.
* Escalate and appropriately manage complex patient concerns.
* Ensure patient records, treatment plans, progress reports, and other documentation are maintained accurately.


 4\. Patient Experience \& Retention
 * Ensure every patient receives a professional, welcoming, and personalised experience.
* Monitor patient satisfaction and feedback.
* Track treatment adherence, follow\-ups, and missed appointments.
* Work with the clinical team to improve treatment\-plan adherence and patient engagement.
* Build strong relationships with patients and address concerns promptly.
* Support long\-term patient retention through quality care and effective communication.


 5\. Centre Growth \& Business Performance
 * Take ownership of centre\-level performance and growth targets.
* Monitor key metrics such as:
* New patient enquiries
* Assessments/consultations
* Conversion to treatment plans
* Treatment\-plan adherence
* Patient retention
* Follow\-up rates
* Therapist utilisation
* Revenue and collections
* Patient satisfaction
* Identify opportunities to increase centre utilisation and patient footfall.
* Work with the central marketing/business team on local growth initiatives.
* Develop relationships with doctors, hospitals, corporates, gyms, sports organisations, and other relevant referral partners where appropriate.
* Monitor centre performance against agreed targets and prepare regular reports for management.


 6\. Sales \& Consultation Support
 * Ensure prospective patients receive accurate information about FlexifyMe's services and treatment approach.
* Support the team in converting appropriate consultations into structured treatment plans without compromising clinical ethics.
* Help therapists communicate treatment plans, expected timelines, follow\-ups, and patient responsibilities effectively.
* Track and address reasons for treatment drop\-offs.


 7\. Reporting \& Performance Management
 * Maintain accurate daily, weekly, and monthly centre reports.
* Analyse centre performance and identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct regular reviews of operational and business KPIs.
* Share insights and action plans with the management team.
* Ensure timely completion of administrative and compliance\-related activities.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 
 The Centre Head will be evaluated on a combination of
 **patient care, people, operations, and business performance** 
 , including:
 


* Centre revenue and achievement of agreed targets
* New patient acquisition
* Consultation\-to\-treatment conversion
* Patient retention and treatment\-plan adherence
* Patient satisfaction and feedback
* Therapist utilisation and productivity
* Team attendance and performance
* Operational efficiency
* Clinical documentation and protocol adherence
* Centre hygiene, safety, and compliance
* Staff engagement and retention


 Required Qualifications \& Experience
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physiotherapy, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, or a related field.
* **2–4\+ years of professional experience** 
 , preferably including experience in a physiotherapy clinic, rehabilitation centre, hospital, healthcare organisation, or similar setting.
* Prior experience managing a team or healthcare centre is preferred.
* Strong understanding of physiotherapy/rehabilitation services is an advantage.
* Experience with MSK, orthopaedic, sports, or chronic pain rehabilitation is desirable.


 Required Skills
 * Strong leadership and people\-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong patient\-handling and relationship\-management abilities.
* Good organisational and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Commercial and business awareness.
* Data\-driven approach to performance management.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to coach and motivate clinical teams.
* Professional, empathetic, and patient\-first approach.
* Comfortable working with targets, KPIs, and performance metrics.


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who can think like an
 **owner of the centre** 
 — someone who can ensure that:
 



**Patients receive excellent care → therapists perform at their best → operations run smoothly → patients stay engaged with their treatment → the centre grows sustainably.** 




 The Centre Head should be capable of being the
 **primary point of ownership for the centre** 
 , while working closely with the clinical, operations, marketing, and management teams.
 


 Why Join FlexifyMe?
 * Opportunity to take leadership ownership of a growing physiotherapy centre.
* Work with a multidisciplinary and performance\-oriented healthcare team.
* Opportunity to contribute to clinical and operational excellence.
* Professional growth and leadership development opportunities.
* Exposure to both healthcare delivery and centre management.
* Opportunity to be part of a growing physiotherapy and pain\-management organisation.

**Lead \- Civil Construction**
**Technical Management**

 Analyze civil engineering issues and formulate effective solutions to ensure compliance with project requirements.
   

  

 Conduct structural analysis and design for buildings across various sectors, ensuring technical quality and compliance with project objectives, safety, and quality standards.

 Undertake periodic site visits to ensure civil/structural works are executed per design intent.

We're expanding our team to include Mechanical Service Engineers who will be responsible for critical infrastructure maintenance and operations. This position will serve as the primary technical resource for mechanical and HVAC systems maintenance within AWS data centers in India. The role requires hands\-on management of mechanical infrastructure, including preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and emergency response. The position will require 24x7 on\-call support and rotational shifts (need basis general shift).
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Operations And Maintenance**
* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post\-mortems, root cause analysis and follow\-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site\-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.

* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best\-in\-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
* Providing hands on facility support where required


**Incident And Emergency Response**

* Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
* Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.
* Ensure 24\*7 shift operations in safe, secure manner without availability impact.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Troubleshoot facility and rack\-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility MEP management.
* Provide operational readings and key performance indicators
* Responsible for the on\-site management of contractors, sub\-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures \& local legislation.

* Ensure smooth order fulfilment across B2C, marketplace, darkstore, and other ecommerce channels, wherever applicable.



**2\. SLA \& Performance Management** 



* Track and improve key operational metrics, including order processing TAT, dispatch TAT, pick\-pack accuracy, inventory accuracy, manpower productivity, and order breach percentage.
* Review site performance daily through dashboards, MIS, exception reports, and pending trackers.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive corrective actions.
* Prepare daily / weekly performance updates for leadership review.
* Highlight operational risks proactively with root cause and action plan.



**3\. Inventory Accuracy \& Stock Governance** 



* Ensure accurate stock storage, bin mapping, SKU hygiene, batch tracking, expiry tracking, FEFO / FIFO adherence, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly cycle counts as per audit plan.
* Verify physical stock against system stock at SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, and bin level.
* Identify stock mismatches, short/excess quantities, wrong bin placements, missing labels, unscannable barcodes, and location errors.
* Monitor shrinkage, damaged stock, expired stock, dead stock, slow\-moving stock, and high\-value inventory.
* Ensure expired, damaged, leaked, or unsellable stock is quarantined and marked correctly.
* Maintain strict controls for high\-value, fast\-moving, fragile, and expiry\-sensitive SKUs.



**4\. Inbound Audit \& GRN Control** 



* Audit incoming stock against PO, invoice, ASN, delivery challan, and system records.
* Verify SKU name, SKU code, quantity, batch number, expiry date, MRP, barcode, and packaging condition.
* Ensure received stock matches system expectations before GRN closure.
* Identify shortages, excess quantity, wrong SKUs, duplicate items, damaged products, near\-expiry stock, expired stock, leakage, tampering, or invoice mismatch.
* Validate GRN entries for accuracy and ensure all discrepancies are recorded before stock acceptance.
* Prevent unauthorized inwarding of stock without a PO or required approval.
* Ensure only audited and approved stock moves to putaway.



**5\. Vendor, Transporter \& Discrepancy Management** 



* Report vendor\-side and transporter\-side issues such as wrong dispatch, short supply, excess supply, damaged goods, expiry mismatch, MRP mismatch, or invoice mismatch.
* Capture proper evidence through photos, quantity records, signed discrepancy notes, and audit reports.
* Maintain inbound discrepancy logs, rejection reports, vendor issue reports, damage reports, and GRN correction records.
* Coordinate with procurement, planning, finance, and warehouse teams for discrepancy closure.
* Track vendor discrepancy closure and ensure repeated issues are escalated with data.



**6\. Putaway, Storage \& Bin Discipline** 



* Ensure stock is moved from the receiving area to the correct storage/bin location within the defined TAT.
* Validate correct labeling, barcode scanning, batch tagging, expiry marking, and SKU placement before storage.
* Prevent wrong putaway of unaudited or rejected stock.
* Ensure bin accuracy across racks, storage zones, pick faces, and bulk locations.
* Identify mixed SKUs, wrong bin mapping, wrong batch placement, and missing labels.
* Coordinate correction of bin\-level discrepancies with the warehouse team.



**7\. Team \& Manpower Management** 



* Monitor whether warehouse staff, supervisors, pickers, packers, auditors, and third\-party manpower are following brand\-defined SOPs.
* Plan manpower as per order load, sale days, campaigns, and business peaks.
* Conduct daily briefings to align teams on order priorities, pending workload, SLA risks, and process discipline.
* Track manpower productivity and identify areas of underutilization or bottlenecks.
* Ensure clear shift\-wise ownership for inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and audits.



**8\. Process Compliance \& Site Audit** 



* Ensure SOP adherence across inbound, storage, putaway, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, and stock adjustment processes.
* Perform site audits in accordance with brand guidelines.
* Maintain documentation for audits, stock movements, damages, GRN, dispatches, returns, rejected stock, and stock adjustments.
* Ensure all stock adjustments are properly documented and approved as per the process.
* Support internal and external audits with required data and records.
* Ensure safety, hygiene, security, and compliance standards are followed at the site.



**9\. Returns \& Reverse Inventory Control** 



* Ensure returned stock is received, audited, QC\-checked, and moved to the correct inventory status.
* Validate return discrepancies such as wrong item received, missing item, damaged item, used product, or non\-sellable return.
* Track return\-to\-sellable %, return QC TAT, and rejected return stock.
* Coordinate with customer support, logistics, and finance teams for return closure and refund\-related dependencies.



**10\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation** 



* Act as the first escalation point for site\-level operational and inventory\-related issues.
* Resolve issues related to stock mismatch, GRN errors, order delays, manpower shortage, courier handover delays, return discrepancies, system discrepancies, and damaged stock.
* Prepare RCA for repeated inventory mismatches, inbound discrepancies, dispatch delays, and SOP deviations.
* Escalate critical risks proactively with data, business impact, and a corrective action plan.

 in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, inventory control, inbound operations, stock audit, darkstore operations, retail fulfillment, supply chain operations, FMCG, supplement, pharma\-like product handling, or logistics operations.
 



 Experience in a

manpower \& other resource plan · Plan, allocate, and manage work assignments and shift coverage, ensuring continuous skill development and team capability enhancement. · Lead, guide, and develop production teams including supervisors and crew leaders to ensure effective shop\-floor execution. · Ensure continuous skill development through structured training on OJT, GMP, SOPs, safety, and process discipline. · Manage shift deployment, manpower planning, attendance control, and provide performance and appraisal inputs in coordination with HR. · Develop, update, and maintain the and statutory EHS audits, ensuring timely closure of observations and compliance actions. · Promote and sustain a zero\-accident culture through safety discipline, training, and proactive risk title: Head of Prime Services Operations, Managing Director
description:
**Who are we looking for**

We are looking for an industry leader with hands\-on experience in Prime Operations within a Markets business. You understand what great looks like in a global operations organization and have deep knowledge of the functions that support Prime Services across the trade lifecycle. You combine strong operational expertise with executive presence, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to influence, lead through change and resolve complex challenges.

  

  

This is a key leadership role responsible for overseeing a global team of approximately 50 professionals across India, Hong Kong, London, and Boston, providing operational support for Prime Services borrowing and lending activities, including settlement, collateral management, reconciliations, billing, and corporate action processing. You will lead the organization through the complexity of a large\-scale global operation, ensuring accurate trade processing, effective collateralization, robust risk management, regulatory compliance, and seamless day\-to\-day execution.

  

You will work closely with business, technology, risk, and control partners to drive innovation across processes and systems, enhancing efficiency, scalability, and risk management while ensuring operational solutions remain aligned with State Street's strategic objectives, industry best practices, and evolving market needs.

  

A significant part of your mandate will be the transformation of the function. You will have the opportunity to help shape the future operating model, modernize the technology infrastructure, and drive initiatives that reduce risk, improve efficiency, and accelerate speed to market. Success in this role will require balancing long\-term transformation with an unwavering focus on day\-to\-day execution and client service.

  

The role can be based in Mumbai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad and reports directly to the SVP, Global Head of Financing and Portfolio Solutions Operations.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high\-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data\-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client\-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.

  

As one of the largest and most experienced providers of financing and portfolio solutions in the industry, we provide investors with market\-leading expertise, technology and scale to accelerate decision making, enhance performance and unlock efficiencies across the entire trade lifecycle.

  

We are in the midst of a significant transformation as we modernize our technology architecture and transition from legacy platforms to a more scalable, future\-state environment. The processes and functions that support our Prime Services business are critical to the success of State Street Markets and operate at significant scale and complexity. This transformation presents a unique opportunity to help redesign and optimize key workflows, driving greater automation, efficiency and resiliency across the business. As one of the largest businesses within Markets, and one of the world's leading agent lenders, we provide the scale, visibility and impact to shape the future of a market\-leading franchise.

  

Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

As Head of Prime Services Operations, Managing Director, you will:


* Lead a global organization of 50\+ professionals across Prime Services Operations, driving consistent service delivery, strong governance, operational resilience, and a culture of excellence across regions, while attracting, developing, and retaining top talent and building a strong leadership pipeline for the future.
* Own the end\-to\-end Prime Services operating platform, overseeing loan and return transactions, trade capture, confirmations, settlement, clearing, reconciliation, cash movements, and the full trade lifecycle, including cash dividends, corporate actions, and monthly billing.
* Provide strategic leadership across Prime Services collateral operations, overseeing financing and collateralization frameworks, margin management, collateral optimization, dispute resolution, and intraday and end\-of\-day sufficiency monitoring, while driving efficient use of collateral across funding, risk, and trading activities.
* Shape the future of Prime Services Operations by leading a significant transformation and modernization agenda. Working closely with Technology, Business, and Risk partners, you will help design and deliver scalable, automated future\-state capabilities while optimizing the operating model and cost base to support growth, efficiency, and global consistency.
* Champion a best\-in\-class risk and control environment, proactively identifying and mitigating operational, settlement, and counterparty risks, strengthening controls and operational resilience, and ensuring timely and effective management of incidents, remediation activities, and escalations.
* Ensure the organization remains audit\-ready and regulatory compliant, maintaining adherence to applicable regulations, internal policies, and industry standards while supporting regulatory reporting, Data Governance, Model Risk initiatives, and evolving market and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Front Office, Custody, Risk/ERM, Compliance, and Technology, acting as a key escalation point and helping align operational priorities with business growth, client needs, and risk management objectives.
* Manage critical external relationships with counterparties, custodians, clearing agents, vendors, and technology partners, ensuring high\-quality service delivery, strong commercial outcomes, effective oversight of third\-party providers, and appropriate management of cyber and operational risks.

  

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, or related field is preferred. A postgraduate/professional qualification is advantageous
* 20\+ years of experience in financial services operations, with focus on Prime Services and principal trading
* Strong understanding of Prime Services products and processes (e.g., trade lifecycle management/settlement/collateral, corporate actions, vendors)
* Proven track record of strengthening risk and control environments and managing regulatory and operational risk.
* Experience leading transformation initiatives, including process optimization, automation, and technology modernization.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective partnerships across business, operations, technology, and corporate functions.
* Strategic thinker with a proven change management mindset and experience driving large\-scale initiatives.

**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Call Center Manager

The company offers diverse products including vehicle finance, home loans, SME loans, home equity loans, loans against property, and consumer durable loans. Guided by integrity and responsibility, Chola focuses on sustainable growth and empowerment for customers, employees, shareholders, and communities.

 This is a full\-time, on\-site Call Center Manager role based in the Pune Division. The Call Center Manager will oversee day\-to\-day operations of the call center, including workforce planning, shift scheduling, and performance monitoring to ensure service levels are met. Responsibilities include managing and coaching a team of agents, conducting regular reviews, providing feedback, and organizing training to enhance customer service quality. The role involves analyzing call center metrics and customer feedback, implementing process improvements, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and operational issues. The Call Center Manager will also ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines, promote a customer\-centric culture, and contribute to initiatives that drive customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

* Candidates should possess strong Contact Center Management and Team Management skills, with experience leading customer service or call center operations.

* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, with the ability to interact clearly and professionally with customers, team members, and leadership.

* Relevant experience in financial services or BFSI sector is beneficial, especially in managing high\-volume customer interactions.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, management, or a related field is preferred, along with proficiency in call center technologies and reporting tools.
* Demonstrated ability to work ethically, handle sensitive information responsibly, and adhere to organizational policies and regulatory requirements.

title: Contingent Workforce Manager
description:
Location: Pune, India
 



 Experience: 8–12 Years
 



 Industry: Global Enterprise / Fortune 500
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Level: Manager / Senior Manager
 








**About HummingBird** 




 HummingBird, an AI\-powered Total Talent Workforce Platform powered by LanceSoft, helps enterprises transform how they source, engage, manage, and optimize their workforce.
 



 Built for complex enterprise hiring environments, HummingBird brings together AI\-powered talent matching, workforce analytics, recruitment automation, and integrated talent management capabilities to support permanent, contingent, and Statement of Work (SOW) workforce programs.
 



 HummingBird is hiring on behalf of its client, a Fortune 500 company, for an experienced Contingent Workforce Program Manager based in Pune.
 








**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an accomplished Contingent Workforce Program Manager with 8–12 years of experience in managing enterprise contingent workforce programs, vendor ecosystems, workforce operations, and compliance frameworks.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Managed Service Provider (MSP) programs, Vendor Management Systems (VMS), contingent workforce governance, supplier management, workforce analytics, and cost optimization.
 



 This role will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end contingent workforce lifecycle, driving operational excellence, strengthening supplier partnerships, and ensuring workforce programs align with organizational objectives.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Contingent Workforce Strategy \& Program Management** 



* Develop and execute contingent workforce strategies aligned with enterprise workforce objectives.
* Manage end\-to\-end contingent workforce programs covering sourcing, onboarding, engagement, extensions, and offboarding.
* Establish scalable operating models for contingent labor management across business functions.
* Drive standardization of workforce processes, policies, and governance frameworks.
* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce requirements and optimize contingent talent utilization.



**2\. MSP \& VMS Management** 



* Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) relationships and program performance.
* Manage and optimize Vendor Management Systems (VMS) such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or equivalent platforms.
* Ensure effective requisition management, supplier distribution, candidate submissions, approvals, and onboarding workflows.
* Monitor MSP service delivery against established SLAs and KPIs.
* Identify opportunities for process automation and operational improvements.



**3\. Supplier \& Vendor Management** 



* Develop and manage a high\-performing contingent workforce supplier ecosystem.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews and establish measurable scorecards.
* Monitor supplier quality, responsiveness, fulfillment rates, and compliance.
* Support supplier selection, onboarding, contract negotiations, and performance improvement.
* Drive supplier rationalization and strategic vendor partnerships where appropriate.



**4\. Workforce Compliance \& Risk Management** 



* Ensure contingent workforce programs comply with applicable labor laws, contractual obligations, and enterprise policies.
* Establish governance for worker classification, tenure management, onboarding documentation, and offboarding.
* Collaborate with Legal, HR, Procurement, Finance, and Compliance teams to mitigate workforce\-related risks.
* Maintain appropriate audit trails, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support governance for Independent Contractors (IC), temporary workers, and SOW engagements.



**5\. Financial Management \& Cost Optimization** 



* Manage contingent workforce budgets, spend visibility, and cost\-control initiatives.
* Analyze labor rates, supplier markups, workforce utilization, and program expenditures.
* Develop rate\-card governance and support commercial negotiations.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings through supplier optimization, process improvements, and workforce planning.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.



**6\. Workforce Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Establish and monitor key contingent workforce metrics, including:
* Time\-to\-fill and requisition aging
* Supplier fulfillment and submission quality
* Contingent workforce spend
* Cost savings and cost avoidance
* Worker tenure and utilization
* Compliance adherence
* Hiring manager satisfaction
* MSP and supplier SLA performance
* Develop executive dashboards and management reports.
* Leverage workforce analytics to improve decision\-making and program effectiveness.



**7\. Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner with Procurement, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.
* Act as the primary point of contact for contingent workforce program operations.
* Facilitate governance meetings, supplier reviews, and program performance discussions.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on contingent workforce policies and processes.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external workforce partners.



**8\. Program Transformation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to enhance workforce program efficiency through automation, AI, and digital technologies.
* Support MSP/VMS implementation, migration, or optimization initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement across sourcing, onboarding, supplier management, and compliance.
* Contribute to Total Talent Management initiatives integrating permanent and contingent workforce strategies.








**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in Contingent Workforce Management, MSP Program Management, Workforce Operations, or Strategic Procurement.
* Proven experience managing enterprise\-scale contingent workforce programs.
* Strong understanding of MSP operating models and VMS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar workforce management systems.
* Experience managing staffing suppliers and vendor performance.
* Strong knowledge of contingent workforce compliance, worker classification, and contractual governance.
* Experience managing workforce spend, rate cards, supplier commercials, and program budgets.
* Strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.








**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working within a Fortune 500 company, global MNC, or large enterprise environment.
* Experience managing multi\-location or global contingent workforce programs.
* Exposure to Direct Sourcing, Independent Contractor Compliance, and SOW management.
* Experience implementing or transforming MSP/VMS programs.
* Familiarity with Total Talent Management and workforce planning.
* Experience using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
* Understanding of AI\-enabled workforce management and recruitment automation.








**Key Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic workforce planning
* Supplier relationship management
* Strong commercial and financial acumen
* Cross\-functional stakeholder engagement
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Risk management and compliance
* Program governance and operational excellence
* Change management and process transformation








**Why This Opportunity?** 



* Manage a strategic contingent workforce program for a Fortune 500 organization.
* Work with global stakeholders and enterprise workforce management teams.
* Gain exposure to large\-scale MSP, VMS, and Total Talent initiatives.
* Drive workforce transformation through AI, automation, and advanced analytics.
* Contribute to enterprise\-wide workforce efficiency, compliance, and cost optimization.
