 1
   

  

**Qualification :** 
 Graduate / Post\-Graduate in Engineering, Technology, Management or equivalent
   

  

**Experience :** 
 10\+ Years
   

  

**Location :** 
 Pune
   

  

**Reporting to :** 
 Head \- Enterprise IT
   

  

**Purpose Of The Position**
 The Lead – Enterprise IT Business Relationship \& Delivery acts as the IT partner for assigned business functions and initiatives, from demand intake and solutioning through delivery, go\-live, stabilization and business value realization. The role works with business, internal IT, Group/local architecture teams and vendors to convert business priorities into practical technology initiatives and drives internal IT, Group teams and external vendors to ensure committed delivery outcomes and vendor obligations are met. After implementation and hyper care, the role ensures structured handover to the AMS team, owns IT assessment and governance of new change requests for assigned applications, and reviews support\-ticket trends with AMS to reduce repeat issues and improve service quality.
   

  

**Authority**
* Accept, return or challenge business demand based on completeness, ownership, expected outcome and readiness for IT assessment.
* Recommend prioritization of initiatives based on business value, risk, urgency, dependencies and available capacity.
* Require clear delivery plans, accountable owners and committed milestones from internal teams and external vendors.
* Escalate material delivery, architecture, vendor, cost, quality and service risks to the appropriate governance forum.
* Recommend go\-live hold where critical defects, architecture, security, support or operational\-readiness requirements are incomplete.
* Require corrective\-action plans for repeated vendor or service\-performance failures.
* Recommend Change Request disposition based on business value, delivery impact, architecture and commercial implications.
* Recommend vendor performance / commercial actions to Head – Enterprise IT and relevant governance.


**Skills Required**
* Business Relationship Management / Stakeholder Management
* End\-to\-End IT Delivery / Program Management
* Vendor Management \& Delivery
* Demand management and portfolio prioritization
* Business process analysis / digital transformation
* Business case / ROI / value realization
* Group / local architecture coordination and fit\-gap
* Enterprise applications – ERP, CRM, DMS and digital platforms
* Integration / API / data\-flow concepts
* Testing / UAT / cutover / stabilization governance
* ITSM – Incident, Problem, Change and Service Management
* Vendor commercial / contract awareness
* Cybersecurity / architecture / compliance awareness
* Executive communication, influencing and conflict management
* Internal Customer orientation / CSAT improvement


**Key Responsibilities \& Tasks**
**Business Partnership \& Demand Management**
* Act as primary IT relationship owner for assigned business functions and maintain a clear understanding of strategy, KPIs, priorities and pain points.
* Own structured demand intake and ensure each initiative has a named business owner, clear outcome, priority and value proposition.
* Translate business requirements into structured IT work packages and coordinate feasibility with relevant IT teams.
* Maintain a transparent demand backlog and 12–24 month business\-IT roadmap.


**End\-to\-End Delivery Accountability**
* Own overall IT delivery outcome from approved demand through implementation, go\-live and stabilization.
* Maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and readiness.
* Coordinate business, internal IT teams, Group teams and external partners to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure critical dependencies, issues and decisions have clear owners and committed closure dates.
* Drive design, build, integration, testing, UAT readiness, cutover and stabilization governance.
* Ensure IT change management, implementation, security and governance controls are defined, validated and complied with for all assigned projects.
* Escalate risks early with clear business impact, options and decisions required.


**Vendor \& Group / Local Architecture Governance**
* Govern external vendors against agreed scope, milestones, quality, support commitments and contractual obligations.
* Drive vendor corrective actions for delays, defects, recurring issues or delivery gaps.
* Coordinate with Group and local architecture / application teams to ensure solution alignment and timely technical decisions.
* Ensure solution design, integration and platform choices conform to approved architecture, security and governance standards.
* Track vendor and Group dependencies through closure and recommend escalation or commercial action where required.


**Service, Support \& Sustenance Ownership**
* Ensure projects transition into a stable and sustainable support model with clear service/application ownership.
* Ensure L1/L2/L3 responsibilities, SLA/OLA, support contracts, monitoring, SOPs, knowledge transfer and lifecycle ownership are established.
* Review service performance, major incidents, recurring defects, backlog and vendor support performance for assigned applications.
* Drive Problem Management and continual improvement for recurring business\-impacting issues.
* Ensure post\-go\-live stabilization is completed before formal project closure.


**Business Readiness, Adoption \& CSAT**
* Ensure business readiness, UAT ownership, training/adoption needs and go\-live acceptance criteria are established.
* Measure project and service satisfaction and drive corrective actions for material gaps.
* Monitor solution adoption and identify barriers affecting business outcomes.
* Conduct structured post\-go\-live reviews with business and delivery stakeholders.


**Value Realization \& Portfolio Governance**
* Develop business cases jointly with business owners and define measurable expected benefits before investment.
* Establish baseline, target value, benefit owner and realization timeline for strategic initiatives.
* Track value realization after implementation and escalate gaps in adoption or benefit achievement.
* Support portfolio prioritization based on strategic fit, business value, risk and delivery capacity.


**Financial \& Commercial Governance**
* Support IT budget and investment planning for assigned business initiatives.
* Track project budget, committed spend, forecast and Change Request impact.
* Validate vendor estimates and commercial assumptions in coordination with IT Governance / Procurement.
* Ensure ongoing run\-cost and support\-cost implications are visible before go\-live.

title: Team Lead - MV
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**About Rockwell Automation**
 Rockwell Automation is the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation. We connect the imaginations of people with the potential of technology to expand what is humanly possible, making the world more productive and more sustainable. Our Global Engineering \& Business Services (GEBS) group in India partners with Rockwell Automation offices worldwide to deliver world\-class engineering.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Team Lead – Medium Voltage** 
 you will be responsible to lead a team of application/electrical engineers engaged in the engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) Motor Control Center (MCCs), Switchgear and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), customizing as per customer requirement utilizing the AutoCAD tools, while providing engineering support to the manufacturing plants of RA. This role reports to the Engineering Manager and is part of Global Engineering \& Business Services group in India, catering to regional Rockwell Automation offices across the globe. It's a hybrid work environment working in 12:00pm to 9:00 pm shift located in Pune/Noida \- India.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor and develop a team of MV application/electrical engineers – allocating and prioritizing work, managing workload and ensuring on\-time delivery, high quality engineering and customer satisfaction
* Manage day\-to\-day execution of CTO/ETO projects within defined timelines, ensuring high quality engineering while leveraging standard and reusable engineering practices
* Serve as the technical escalation point and subject\-matter expert for MV products (MV MCCs, MV Switchgear, MV Drives), providing robust technical solutions, addressing queries and resolving technical deficiencies
* Work closely with internal and external customers, and collaborate with global stakeholders across regions and time zones, to review requirements and deliver customized technical solutions that comply with electrical standards and Rockwell Automation's engineering practices
* Coordinate overall system integration activities, maintaining accurate documentation and fostering effective collaboration across teams and functions
* Drive capability development, continuous improvement and knowledge\-sharing within the team – coaching engineers, building technical depth and supporting other initiatives
* Monitor team performance, quality metrics, resource utilization and project KPIs, reporting progress and risks to the Execution Manager
* Ensure strict adherence to international engineering standards (NEC, UL, CSA, IEC) by consistently applying them throughout order execution activities


**The Essentials – You Will Have**
* Bachelor's in Electrical / Electronics
* Relevant Experience of more than 8\-10 years in Hardware Designing for Medium Voltage MCC / Switchgear, Electrical knowledge and Automation Engineering
* Minimum 3 years of experience in leading and managing an engineering team
* Exposure of working in a global setup – collaborating with global stakeholders, customers and cross\-functional teams across regions and time zones
* Strong domain expertise in Medium Voltage Drives, PLC \& MCC System Designing
* Expertise of AutoCAD\-Electrical software
* Thorough knowledge of DOL \& S/D Starters, VFDs, Soft\-Starters, Intelligent Motor Control, Safety Product's System Designing
* Knowledge of Electrical Components Selection, Busbar Calculation, Heat and Load Calculation
* In depth knowledge of International Standards used for Design and Manufacturing


**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**
* Field Installation \& Commissioning experience on MV VFDs, MV Switchgear, PCC's, MCC's, PLC's \& Instruments is preferrable
* Gone through complete project life cycle from design phase to commissioning
* Proven people\-leadership skills – team building, mentoring, performance management and workload planning
* Good Command on SAP Documentation and Part Management
* Industry and application Knowledge, training skills, and familiar with Lean Six Sigma and EHS (Environment, Health \& Safety) Principles.
* Experience with Creo software
* Experience on Panel Testing, I/O Testing and FAT
* Experience of managing or coordinating deliverables across a global / distributed engineering team is preferrable


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


**Equal Opportunity \& Inclusion**
 At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.
   

  

 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Planning Manager
description:
**About the role** 




  





 The Planning Manager will be responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules across all interior design\-and\-build projects. The role requires close coordination with design, procurement, project execution, vendors, and client stakeholders to ensure project milestones are achieved efficiently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Project Planning \& Scheduling** 




  




* Own and publish comprehensive baseline project schedules for all active design\-and\-build projects, covering design, procurement, execution, and handover phases.
* Develop detailed, activity\-level schedules that clearly identify critical path, dependencies, and float.
* Build master schedules and rolling look\-ahead plans that surface risks and constraints weeks in advance, enabling proactive recovery.
* Maintain and update all schedules as actuals roll in, keeping them alive and credible as the project's source of truth.



  





**2\. Schedule Monitoring \& Control** 




  




* Track actual progress against planned schedules on a weekly basis; flag delays, acceleration, and deviations immediately.
* Conduct detailed variance analysis, dig into the why behind every slip: is it design approval, procurement, execution, or resource constraints?
* Produce weekly project status reports and monthly scheduling reviews for management; articulate impact on project delivery dates and cost implications.
* Ensure zero misses on timelines, hold the line on milestones and escalate deviations that threaten delivery.



  





**3\. Risk \& Recovery Management** 




  




* Proactively identify schedule\-related risks, design delays, vendor lead times, resource constraints, site conditions, and develop clear mitigation strategies.
* Monitor inter\-dependencies between projects and functions to flag conflicts and resource contention early.



  





**4\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 




  




* Partner closely with Design, Procurement, Execution, and Site teams to understand realistic timelines, identify bottlenecks, and drive schedule alignment.
* Facilitate monthly planning review meetings and weekly progress tracking calls; be the voice for timeline realism and early warning.
* Work with vendors, subcontractors, and suppliers to understand delivery windows and manage external dependencies.
* Support client communication on project timelines, change impact, and schedule recovery plans.



  





**5\. Planning Tools \& Analytics** 




  




* Maintain accurate project records, schedule baselines, change logs, ensuring data integrity and traceability.
* Spot trends and anomalies: unusual delays, recurring bottlenecks, missed forecasts, and bring structured recommendations to close them.



  





**Academic \& Professional Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Project Planning certifications are a strong advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience in project planning, scheduling, and project controls, not just project support.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously in design\-and\-build, commercial interiors or workplace fit\-outs.
* Prior exposure to investor\-facing or stakeholder reporting roles is valued.



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Deep, confident command of MS Project.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, dashboards, pivot analysis, data visualization, and dynamic reporting.
* Experience building project dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
* Familiarity with construction methodologies, interior fit\-out processes, and project lifecycle management.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We're looking for a Recruitment Manager to take full ownership of day\-to\-day delivery. You'll lead our team leaders and recruiting team, run daily operations, manage client delivery, and make sure mandates convert into closures. This is a hands\-on role. You'll screen, guide and personally close senior mandates, not just supervise.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Team leadership and performance** 



* Lead the team leaders and recruiters: set daily and weekly targets for sourcing, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Track individual and team performance, spot gaps early, and coach, correct or escalate as needed.
* Run daily team operations: mandate allocation, prioritisation, and resolving day\-to\-day queries and blockers.
* Ensure every new mandate gets a first client submission within 48 hours of receipt.



  





**JD understanding and mandate briefing** 



* Break down client JDs into must\-haves, good\-to\-haves and deal\-breakers before sourcing starts.
* Brief the team on each mandate and review early submissions to correct misalignment quickly.

* Conduct or oversee L2 screening, personally handling senior and leadership roles.

**Leadership hiring** 



* Personally handle department\-head, manager and senior mandates, including search, assessment, compensation discussions and closure.
* Manage offer negotiation and pre\-joining engagement to reduce dropouts.



  





**Client engagement** 



* Be the delivery point of contact for clients: requirement calls, feedback follow\-ups, interview coordination and escalations.
* Build client trust through fast TAT and relevant submissions.



  





**Reporting** 



* Own daily and weekly client reports and internal MIS: pipeline, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Keep ATS data accurate and current across the team.
* Share a weekly delivery review with the founder.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* 5\+ years in recruitment, with a significant portion at a recruitment agency or consulting firm. Corporate\-only HR/TA backgrounds will not be considered.
* Proven experience leading a team of 5\+ recruiters, or managing team leads, with measurable delivery outcomes.
* Demonstrated closures of leadership or senior roles, with examples you can walk us through.
* Strong JD\-analysis and screening judgement, going beyond keyword matching.
* Hands\-on with Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn sourcing, and at least one ATS.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets for reporting.
* Clear, confident communication with senior candidates and client stakeholders.



  





**REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS** 



* Own laptop, reliable high\-speed internet and power backup.
* Available during business hours \[confirm days/timings], and responsive on calls and team chat.
* Comfortable with daily output tracking and reporting.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Fixed pay plus uncapped closure\-based incentives.
* Full ownership of delivery, working directly with the founder.
* Fully remote role.

title: Director, APAC CISO
description:
The Director provides regional coverage for Asia and Middle East located businesses across three high level functions: (i) Business Support; (ii) Local Governance; (iii) Regulatory Controls. Justification for the backfill focuses on Business Support and Local Governance, as coverage for Regulatory Controls will be delivered from Cyber Posture and Assurance.
   

  

**Business Support**
* The Director role is required to provide a senior touch point for regional business stakeholders and regional technology leadership to discuss Cyber Security Issues and Strategy.
* The role acts as the principal in time\-zone escalation point for operational matters requiring prompt advice and guidance, including providing coverage on Incidents (including 3rd Party).
* The Director role also takes the lead on all regionally driven NAPA engagements across both Asia and Middle East, working directly with the business project teams to understand plans, and guide on Cyber relevant matters. This often requires facilitation with other parts of the CISO organisation to help land on appropriate strategy and outcomes that deliver pragmatic outcomes for the regional business.
* The Director role assists the regional franchise with local internal audits that have Cyber scope, as well as external audits (typically branch level statutory audits).
* The Director provides oversight of regionally relevant and specific risks and issues, owning management and governance of the issues.
* The Director owns coverage of any local control requirements (country specific and localized).
* The Director owns the execution of colleague engagement activities in the region, ensuring reach of key messages and execution of in person events across the multiple regional business sites. This includes attending non\-cyber departmental meetings to present on Cyber themes and topics.


**Local Governance**
* The CISO function is required to provide and present materials representing Cyber risk and Cyber strategy at the many country level governance meetings that operate across APAC and Middle East. The Director is accountable for ensuring these materials provide an accurate and context appropriate view for each of the individual entities that operate. This requires analysis and preparation of materials, derived from globally supplied information and metrics.
* The CISO function are also required to support local governance activities to demonstrate appropriate in branch accountability of operations and decisions. For example Outsourcing – the regional Director is accountable for reviewing all outsourcing decisions from a Cyber Security perspective (goes beyond TPSecM coverage).


**Locations Covered:** 
*Australia, Beijing, Hong Kong, India (BBPLC \& 3 PBWM entities), Israel, Japan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Shanghai, Singapore, South Africa, Taiwan, Turkey, United Arab Emirates.*
**Purpose of the role**
 To provide a primary liaison service between the business, technology, and security functions. In order to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information, and support the mitigation of security risk.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Collaboration with stakeholders to understand their security requirements in business processes and IT projects, to enhance overall risk management.
* Execution of risk assessments to identify and prioritise potential cybersecurity threats that could impact the banks operations and data and guide the implementation of mitigation strategies and communicate findings to relevant findings to relevant senior stakeholders.
* Collaboration with business units to develop and implement security policies and procedures for the banks operations aligned to the risk management framework.
* Management of the implementation, testing and monitoring of security controls across the banks IT systems to ensure the effectiveness of controls and mitigation of risk.
* Execution of training content and sessions to educate employees, enhance cybersecurity awareness and provide guidance on safe online practices.
* Management of complex cybersecurity incidents by collaborating with IT teams and response experts to effectively resolve cases through analysis, expertise support and project supervision.
* Identification of emerging cybersecurity trends, threats, and new technologies to address potential risks by advocating the adoption of new security solutions.


**Director Expectations**
* To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
* They manage the direction of a large team or sub\-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
* Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub\-function.
* Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.
* Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up\-to\-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.
* Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.
* Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.
* Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.
* Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.
* Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.


 All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Assistant Planning Manager
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
 With 19\.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben \& Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
   

  

 We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
   

  

**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
 We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
   

  

 We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
   

  

 The role The Assistant Manager\- Planning is responsible for the day\-to\-day operational excellence and delivery of the Forecast\-to\-Plan (F2P) lifecycle across the multiple regions. This role acts as the critical bridge between global process standards and regional execution, ensuring that the Third\-Party Service Provider (3PSP) performs planning activities at the keystroke level with precision, speed, and alignment to business goals. The Operations Lead focuses on "running the engine"—managing the vendor relationship, troubleshooting regional supply chain bottlenecks, and ensuring that demand forecasting, supply planning, and S\&OP cycles are executed accurately What you'll be responsible for 1\. Operational Oversight \& Vendor Management 3PSP Coordination: Act as the primary point of escalation and coordination for the 3PSP vendor; ensuring their delivery of demand forecasting, supply planning, and inventory management meets all contractual requirements. Keystroke\-Level Governance: Monitor the quality of the vendor’s execution within planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Kinaxis), ensuring data entry and process steps align with the Global Process Owner’s (GPO) standards. Service Delivery: Oversee the timely completion of regional planning cycles, including the weekly/monthly drumbeat for Demand and Supply reviews. 2\. Regional Performance \& Execution KPI Accountability: Own the regional delivery of F2P metrics for EU, specifically: Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, Inventory Health (DIO), and On\-Time In\-Full (OTIF) service levels. Operational Reviews: Lead weekly and monthly operational performance reviews with the 3PSP and regional stakeholders to address variances and drive corrective actions. Exception Management: Proactively identify and resolve regional supply\-demand imbalances, coordinating between the vendor and local markets to mitigate stock\-outs or excess inventory. 3\. Process Localization \& Compliance Standardization Adherence: Ensure the operations remain 100% aligned with the global F2P framework designed by the GPO, minimizing "local\-only" deviations unless business\-critical. Documentation \& Knowledge: Maintain regional operational playbooks and ensure the 3PSP keeps all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Desktop Procedures (DTPs) updated and accurate. Audit \& Controls: Ensure all planning activities in the region comply with internal controls, SOX requirements, and data privacy standards. 4\. Technology \& Tactical Enablement System Utilization: Ensure the 3PSP is fully utilizing the capabilities of SAP S/4HANA and planning platforms; identifying technical training gaps or system glitches that hinder regional performance. User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Lead regional UAT for any new system deployments or upgrades, ensuring that EU\-specific market nuances are captured before "Go\-Live." Data Integrity: Oversee the hygiene of master data (lead times, safety stocks, MOQs) managed by the vendor to ensure planning outputs are reliable. 5\. Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Alignment Regional Bridge: Act as the operational liaison between Commercial teams, Regional Finance, and the Global GPO team. S\&OP Integration: Facilitate the regional S\&OP/IBP forums, ensuring the vendor provides the necessary data transparency and scenario modeling to support executive decision\-making. Conflict Resolution: Resolve operational trade\-offs between commercial demand and supply constraints. We're looking for someone who Experiences \& Qualifications University degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain operations, with a heavy focus on Demand and Supply Planning. Significant track record managing 3PSPs or BPO partners in a high\-volume, keystroke\-level environment. High "Super\-User" comfort level with SAP S/4HANA and advanced planning tools (e.g., SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or OMP). Ability to dissect complex datasets to identify the root cause of forecast bias or inventory stock\-outs. Experience navigating the diverse market landscape of multiple markets and managing stakeholders across different time zones and languages. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market\-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
   

  

**Why join us?**
 This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed \- both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end\-to\-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
   

  

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
   

  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.


 Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
 If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
Production Manager – uPVC Windows \& Doors

Department: Production / Manufacturing

Designation: Production Manager

Industry: uPVC Windows \& Doors

Location: Maharashtra

Reporting To: Plant Head / General Manager / Management

Role Purpose

To manage and control the complete production operations of the uPVC windows and doors manufacturing unit, ensuring timely production, consistent quality, optimum manpower utilization, minimum material wastage, and adherence to project/site delivery schedules.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Production Planning \& Execution

\- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production plans based on project requirements and dispatch schedules.

\- Monitor production from cutting → reinforcement → welding → cleaning → hardware → glazing → final inspection → packing → dispatch.

\- Ensure production targets are achieved within defined timelines.

\- Coordinate with sales, project/site and dispatch teams for priority requirements.

2\. Manpower Management

\- Plan and allocate manpower across different production activities.

\- Manage skilled and semi\-skilled workers and ensure optimum utilization.

\- Monitor attendance, productivity and performance.

\- Identify manpower requirements and coordinate with management for recruitment/training.

3\. Quality Control

\- Ensure production is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.

\- Monitor critical parameters such as dimensions, welding quality, sash/frame alignment, reinforcement, hardware installation, glass fitment and drainage provisions.

\- Implement inspection procedures at various stages of production.

\- Identify recurring defects and take corrective/preventive action.

4\. Material \& Inventory Control

\- Coordinate with stores and purchase teams for timely availability of profiles, reinforcement, hardware, glass, gaskets, accessories and consumables.

\- Minimize material wastage and optimize profile cutting.

\- Monitor production scrap and material consumption.

\- Ensure proper storage and handling of profiles, glass and finished products.

5\. Machine \& Factory Management

\- Ensure proper operation and maintenance of welding, corner cleaning, cutting, routing, drilling, glazing and other production equipment.

\- Coordinate preventive maintenance to minimize machine downtime.

\- Maintain a safe, organized and efficient production floor.

6\. Project \& Delivery Coordination

\- Review project\-wise production requirements and pending quantities.

\- Coordinate with the project/site team regarding measurements, revisions, priorities and dispatch requirements.

\- Ensure production is aligned with committed delivery schedules.

\- Provide regular production status and pending reports to management.

7\. Process Improvement

\- Identify bottlenecks in the production process and implement improvements.

\- Improve productivity, reduce rejection/rework and control wastage.

\- Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).

\- Introduce production tracking and performance monitoring systems.

8\. Documentation \& Reporting

\- Maintain daily production reports, rejection/rework reports and manpower reports.

\- Track project\-wise production status.

\- Monitor material consumption and wastage.

\- Submit MIS and production performance reports to management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\- Production target achievement

\- On\-time completion and dispatch

\- Production rejection/rework percentage

\- Material wastage

\- Labour productivity

\- Machine utilization

\- Production cost control

\- Quality compliance

\- Safety and housekeeping standards

Required Experience \& Skills

\- 5–10 years of experience in uPVC window/door manufacturing or a closely related fenestration industry.

\- Strong knowledge of uPVC window and door fabrication processes.

\- Experience with profile cutting, reinforcement, welding, corner cleaning, hardware, glazing and quality inspection.

\- Strong manpower and production\-floor management skills.

\- Ability to read technical drawings and understand window/door configurations.

\- Good knowledge of production planning, inventory coordination and quality control.

\- Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.

\- Working knowledge of MS Excel and production reporting systems.

Preferred

\- Experience handling project\-based as well as retail production.

\- Experience with multiple uPVC profile systems/series.

\- Exposure to aluminium/system\-aluminium production will be an advantage.

\- Experience in setting up or streamlining a uPVC production facility will be an added advantage.

Personal Attributes

\- Leadership and team\-management skills

\- Strong sense of ownership

\- Process\-oriented approach

\- Good communication and coordination

\- Ability to work under production deadlines

\- Focus on quality, productivity and cost control

Overall Responsibility:

The Production Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the factory operates efficiently and that the required quantity and quality of uPVC windows and doors are manufactured and made ready for dispatch as per the planned schedule.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Internal and client stakeholders.
  
Direct reports
  
  

Role Purpose
  
The Site Lead holds single\-point accountability for the overall performance of the lab facility in Bangalore, spanning safety, technical integrity, operational delivery, financial performance and multi\-party stakeholder governance. This is a senior leadership role requiring a genuine technical background sufficient to engage credibly with process, mechanical, electrical and instrumentation matters, while leading a cross\-functional site team and managing complex interfaces across BP, JLL (as facilities/managing agent), the landlord/lessor, and specialist engineering partners.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Site Leadership \& Governance
  
Act as the single point of accountability for HSSE, technical and operational performance of the Bangalore lab facility.
  
Own and maintain the site's operational accountability model across Upstream, Downstream, clarifying ownership and reporting lines.
  
Chair and lead cross\-functional site governance forums, including risk, incident review and operational performance reviews.
  
Represent the site to senior BP and JLL stakeholders, and act as primary escalation point for site\-level issues.
  
Technical Oversight
  
Maintain sufficient technical understanding of process, mechanical, electrical and I\&C systems, and lab\-specific infrastructure (compressed air, fume hoods, gas systems, oil sinks, gas detection) to challenge specialist partners and approve technical decisions.
  
Own the boundary definitions between JLL/facilities\-delivered scope, lab\-operations scope, and specialist third\-party scope, ensuring these remain current as the site matures.
  
Sponsor engineering design review and sign\-off processes for significant process, mechanical, electrical and I\&C changes.
  
Stakeholder \& Contract Management
  
Manage the JLL managing\-agent relationship, including oversight of facilities service delivery against agreed service levels.
  
Oversee the landlord/lessor CAM (Common Area Maintenance) interface, including validation of service delivery and invoice review.
  
Oversee contracts and performance of specialist engineering and technical partners engaged for scope outside core FM competency.
  
Own escalation and resolution of service\-level shortfalls across all delivery partners.
  
Risk, Safety \& Compliance Leadership
  
Hold executive\-level ownership of the site risk register, ensuring appropriate mitigation plans are in place and reviewed.
  
Chair incident review for significant events and ensure root\-cause corrective actions are tracked to closure.
  
Ensure Management of Change (MOC) and Control of Work governance is followed consistently across lab and workplace teams.
  
Ensure statutory and regulatory compliance obligations for the site are met, engaging local regulatory expertise as required.
  
Financial \& Commercial Management
  
Own the site operating budget, including CAM charge validation and specialist/vendor contract spend approval.
  
Review and approve major capital and operational expenditure proposals for the site.
  
Ensure cost\-effective delivery of services across all outsourced and managing\-agent arrangements.
  
People Leadership
  
Lead the site leadership team, including the Technical Manager, HSSE Manager and sub\-regional/function leads.
  
Manage team performance, capability development and succession planning.
  
Foster a strong safety and performance culture across all site personnel and delivery partners.
  
Qualification \& Education
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or related technical discipline) — essential.
  
Master's degree or MBA in Engineering Management, Operations Management or Business Administration — preferred.
  
Certification \& Licenses
  
* NEBOSH International General Certificate or Diploma (or equivalent HSE qualification) — desirable.
* PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project/programme management certification — desirable.
* Relevant process safety management (PSM) training.
* Working familiarity with India statutory compliance frameworks (Factories Act, PESO) — desirable.


Experience Required
  
* 15\+ years' experience in facilities, operations or site management within chemical, oil \& gas, pharmaceutical or industrial laboratory environments.
* 5\+ years in a senior site leadership role with full P\&L or budget accountability.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-stakeholder outsourced service delivery models, including managing\-agent and landlord/CAM interfaces.
* Experience with facility or process\-site commissioning, transition or start\-up programmes.
* Track record of leading cross\-functional teams through organisational or operational change


Technical Competencies
  
* Working knowledge of process safety management and high\-hazard operations.
* Understanding of engineering design review and technical sign\-off processes across multiple disciplines.
* Familiarity with CMMS platforms, Management of Change (MOC) systems and Control of Work / permit\-to\-work systems.
* Understanding of statutory and regulatory compliance frameworks relevant to industrial/laboratory facilities in India.


Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies
  
* Strategic thinking with the ability to translate site\-level objectives into operational execution.
* Executive\-level stakeholder management and influencing skills across BP, JLL, landlord and specialist\-partner boundaries.
* Strong decision\-making under ambiguity, particularly during transition and go\-live phases.
* Ability to hold technical and safety accountability while appropriately delegating execution to specialist leads.
* Skilled negotiator and conflict resolver across complex, multi\-party commercial relationships.
* Change leadership capability to guide the site through transition into steady\-state operations.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen


If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

* Someone who can independently manage teams, contractors, and multiple project sites.

title: Regional Clinical Trial Manager – (Unblinded Lead and Start-up Specialist)
description:
**Job Title: Regional Clinical Trial Manager – (Unblinded Lead and Start\-up Specialist)** 




**Location: Gurugram, India** 




**Reports to: Associate Director, Clinical Trial Management** 




  





*Help IAVI translate science into global health impact as a Regional Clinical Trial Manager!* 




*IAVI is seeking a Regional CTM, India, who will be responsible for the day\-to\-day operational activities enabling the conduct of clinical trials according to ICH/GCP guidelines. The role will work closely with the Global CTMs, cross\-functional study teams, clinical research sites and CROs to support unblinded activities, study start\-up and other operational coordination where applicable.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Unblinded CTM:** 




 Serve as the unblinded lead for assigned blinded studies ensuring appropriate handling and documentation of unblinded information and maintaining the integrity of the study blind. The responsibilities may include but not be limited to:
 


* Reviewing unblinded monitoring visit reports (MVRs) and working with the CRA to finalize reports within the deadline set in the study Monitoring Plan
* Cross\-checking information in the unblinded MVR with the randomization list for each study
* Leading or supporting investigations into deviations that involve unblinded data
* Filing unblinded documents in the TMF and performing reconciliations of unblinded documents in each study TMF as required by the Document Management Plan
* Reviewing laboratory test results or other study information that may be unblinding
* As required, liaising with the IAVI Manufacturing and clinical research sites to enable adequate and timely IP supplies at sites








**Study Start\-up:** 



* Perform study start\-up activities as assigned by the Clinical Trial Manager or Director, Clinical Operations. These may include but not be limited to:
* Coordinating site feasibility questionnaires and collating responses
* Liaising with selected sites to collect required documents for regulatory and ethics submissions
* Review site\-specific informed consent documents to ensure all essential elements are included and study\-specific information is accurately covered as per the Master Informed Consent Document
* Reviewing site SOPs to ensure they adequately cover GCP requirements and are fit for purpose for the trial
* Reviewing site source documents and tools to be used in the study
* Coordinating and supporting identification and resolution of site start\-up issues. Escalate any risks and document decisions.
* Developing and maintaining study start\-up trackers and site\-activation timelines
* Maintaining oversight of assigned study start\-up documentation and ensuring timely filing in the Trial Master File (TMF)
* Contribute to internal IAVI study plans (e.g., Monitoring Plan, Risk Management Plan)
* Assist CTM in establishing study timelines for clinical aspects of trials
* Provide study status updates to project team and management as needed.



  





**Other duties:** 



* May be assigned one or more sites to monitor (either blinded or unblinded)
* May participate in Clinical Operations departmental activities as assigned, including drafting or reviewing operational procedures, tools and templates
* Participate in departmental and cross\-functional meetings as appropriate
* Share relevant operational knowledge and lessons learned across Clinical Operations team



  





**Education and Work Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or related field is required.
* Minimum 5 years of clinical trials experience including clinical monitoring is required.
* Clinical team lead experience is preferred.
* Experience supporting multinational or global clinical trials, preferably in sponsor, CRO, or public health settings, is highly desirable.








**Qualifications and Skills:** 



* Excellent knowledge of ICH GCP and FDA CFR guidelines as well as the Declaration of Helsinki and relevant country specific regulations are required.
* Interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a cooperative and collaborative manner with all levels, and across functional teams both internally and externally is required.
* Ability to work on problems of moderate complexity and diverse scope using good judgment within defined procedures and policies to determine appropriate action is required.
* Excellent project planning, organization and implementation skills in a cross\-disciplinary and multi\-cultural environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
* Proven ability to coordinate and lead multi\-disciplinary project teams is required.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently in a global, matrixed environment.
* A professional demeanor, as well as a pleasant manner and positive “can\-do” attitude.
* Flexible and adaptable to accommodate changing deadlines to meet organizational needs is required.
* Experience working with electronic TMFs and Clinical Trial Management Systems is required.
* Excellent computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel is required.

* Familiarity with HIV, TB, emerging infectious diseases..
* Ability and willingness to collaborate effectively across time zones and geographic locations is required.
* Ability to travel internationally as required for study activities.



  





**Organizational Overview:** 




  





 IAVI is a nonprofit scientific research organization dedicated to addressing urgent, unmet global health challenges including HIV and tuberculosis. Our mission is to translate scientific discoveries into affordable, globally accessible public health solutions. Through scientific and clinical research in Africa, India, Europe, and the U.S., IAVI is pioneering the development of biomedical innovations designed for broad global access. We develop vaccines and antibodies in and for the developing world and seek to accelerate their introduction in low\-income countries. IAVI programs and partnerships are grounded in the regions of the world where the disease burden is the greatest, and our approach emphasizes sustainability. Our network of clinical research center partners in Africa and India helps strengthen in\-country research capacity and supports the training and education of the next generation of scientists. The global impact of our science includes fundamental contributions to understanding the biology of HIV infection, which IAVI and others are applying toward advancing vaccine science and immunology. IAVI accelerates scientific discovery and development by fostering unique collaborations among academia, industry, local communities, governments, and funders to explore new and better ways to address public health threats that disproportionately affect people living in poverty. Our global reach, including a clinical research network in five countries in sub\-Saharan Africa and in India, has allowed us to make fundamental contributions to understanding the epidemiology, transmission, virology, and immunology of HIV. This work played a key role in facilitating the design of promising HIV vaccine candidates, as well as the discovery of broadly neutralizing antibodies that are now being advanced as promising approaches for HIV prevention. Our integrated capabilities in vaccine and antibody discovery, development, and clinical research take advantage of bio\-pharmaceutical industry expertise to accelerate the development and testing of prevention methods for HIV and other diseases. Through the Product Development Center, we support external researchers with technical and scientific expertise to accelerate the development of their own products.

* Integrity: We uphold strong moral principles to maintain our credibility as a nonprofit scientific research organization
* Collaboration: We work as one IAVI team and partner with others to deliver globally accessible, urgently needed, public health solutions

 Leadership Profile:
   

  

 Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.
   

  

 Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.
   

  

**Learn \& Grow**
 Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an advantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.
   

  

**Foster a Culture of Care**
 Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.
   

  

**Adapt and Thrive with Change**
 Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.
   

  

**Achieve Results**
 Leaders are action\-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer\-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer\-term view of results that count.

title: Manager Impact, India and Southeast Asia
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
 Direct Reports:
   

  

**Matrix/Dual Reports**
 Chief Impact Officer
   

  

 None
   

  

 VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non\-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Stepping into a start\-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long\-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
   

  

**Accountabilities** 
  

  

* 
+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected\-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility\-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
+ Evaluation: Sourcing and managing independent evaluation partners working closely with the Director of Evaluation. Establishing the pulse on what needs evaluation and when by closely working with the India and Southeast Asia and Grids of the Future teams in sourcing evaluation questions. Selecting fit for purpose evaluation approaches and tools and sense checking their design and functionality.
+ Learning: Support the team in designing and managing ongoing reflection, sense\-making, and learning from the work to inform potential shifts in strategy when necessary, using data and evidence to rationalize change.
+ Capacity building: Onboarding, training and operationalizing Impact functions in country teams, solution teams and hiring monitoring evaluation and learning consultants. Ensuring that all requirements per the Impact framework are met in the investment cycle for all India and Southeast Asia programs.
+ Systems integration: Ensuring the internal Global Energy Alliance systems tracking progress on program implementation, financial execution and impact measuring are integrating, working in close collaboration with the IT systems manager, the management teams for country programs and scalable solutions and the Investment team.
+ Advisory function: Advising global Impact colleagues and external technical providers by ground truthing India and Southeast Asia portfolio realities.


**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**
* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self\-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start\-Up Philosophy.’


**Required Experience**
* 10\-15 years of experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning.
* Advanced degree in relevant subjects such as economics, public policy, or similar areas with strong training in evaluation, monitoring and learning.
* Experience in developing best\-in\-class monitoring, evaluation and learning approaches including designing and establishing these systems from scratch. Ideal experience gained in a complex organizational environment.
* Substantial experience of monitoring, evaluation and learning in the context of climate and energy programs, and/or programs driving systems change. Experience with contribution analysis will be a plus.
* Experience measuring the impact of grid infrastructure, utility performance or battery energy storage programs, including modelling expected impacts and validating them against realized results.
* Experience working in India and Southeast Asia, with familiarity with the region’s energy sector, utilities and government programs.
* Experience working independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with contractors, consultants to ensure value for money and quality actionable outcomes.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong writing skills.
* Expertise in STATA, R or similar software packages, and MS Excel.
* Experience with Power BI or other dashboard tools, data engineering and applied use of AI tools for analysis will be a plus.


 Please submit your application on or before
 **2 October COB.** 
 The Global Energy Alliance reserves the right to close the job advert early if we receive a high number of suitable applications.
   

  

*We operate from a strong commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in everything we do. It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.* 
  

  

*Global Energy Alliance is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity and compliance with all federal, state, and local laws concerning employment discrimination, including the Americans with Disabilities Act. To this end, the organization ensures equal opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, lawful alien status, physical, mental, and medical disability, veteran status, or liability for service in the United States Armed Forces.*

**Job Purpose**

 The role exists to ensure
 **high\-quality implementation of Cambridge programmes and qualifications** 
 , strengthen long\-term partnerships with schools, empower teachers and leaders, improve student outcomes, and drive sustainable growth through retention, expansion, and enhanced adoption of Cambridge offerings across South Asia.
   

  

 This role will act as the
 **regional academic authority** 
 , partnering closely with Sales, Professional Development, Marketing, and Product teams, while leading and developing a high\-performing team of Academic Advisors.

* Regional Academic Leadership \& Strategy
* Provide strategic leadership and oversight for Academic Advisory across South Asia.
* Define and execute a regional academic advisory strategy aligned to business and educational goals.

* Monitor school performance trends and recommend region\-wide interventions to improve outcomes, entries, and syllabus adoption.

* Governance, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement

* Regional academic strategies to grow entries and adoption of new syllabi.
* Prioritisation of school visits, advisory interventions, and academic focus areas.
* Deployment and utilisation of Academic Advisors across territories.

* Identification of high\-potential new school targets.
* Academic inputs into regional marketing and growth strategies.
* Recommendations for mentor/mentee school networks.
* Identification of gaps in professional development offerings and proposed solutions.

**Non\-Financial Impact**

 **academic quality, customer satisfaction, and brand credibility**

**Key Job Challenges**
* Deep understanding of diverse school contexts and effective Cambridge implementation models across South Asia.
* Managing extensive regional travel and multi\-country stakeholder engagement.
* Leading through change in a growing and evolving South Asia market.
* Collaborating effectively in a hybrid (physical and remote) working environment across business streams.


**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Experience and Skills**
* Master's Degree
* Teaching qualification (mandatory)


**Skills**
* Expert knowledge of Cambridge programmes and qualifications (Primary, Lower Secondary, IGCSE, AS \& A Level)
* Strong understanding of Cambridge assessments and exam cycles
* Exceptional presentation and facilitation skills for senior academic stakeholders
* Strategic thinking, leadership, and influencing skills


**Experience**
* Mandatory: Cambridge teaching experience
* Preferred: Cambridge School Leader / Cambridge Coordinator / Exams Officer experience
* Minimum 10–12 years' experience in Cambridge International schools or equivalent academic leadership roles
* Prior experience leading teams or regional academic functions is highly desirable


**Behaviours**
* Confident and credible academic leader
* Strategic, reflective, and customer\-focused
* Self\-starter with strong ownership mindset
* Collaborative and inclusive team leader
* Excellent written and verbal communicator


**Working Pattern**
* Periods of higher workload during spring, early summer, autumn, and early winter
* Relatively slower periods during school holidays and exam cycles

* Flexible working, with home\-based work when not travelling


*Cambridge University Press \& Assessment is committed to being a place where anyone can enjoy a successful career, where it's safe to speak up, and where we learn continuously to improve together. *We believe that diversity of thought, background, and approach create better outcomes. More importantly, fostering an inclusive culture is the right thing to do, and it's part of how we achieve our purpose: to contribute to society through the pursuit of education, learning and research at the highest international levels of excellence. Ensuring that anyone, no matter who they are, feels they belong here is an essential part of who we are and the contribution we make to society, and to our planet.*
*To enable an environment which our people can thrive in, our customers benefit from, and where work complements life, we empower everyone to manage their time and capacity, and to prioritise their wellbeing. That's why from day one everyone at Cambridge University Press \& Assessment can discuss flexible working options to find the best solution for them and their role.*

**Reports To:** 
 Head of IT Operations
 



**Location** 
 : Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



  





**POSITION OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking an exceptional Support Manager to lead end\-user support and retail operations excellence across Forest Essentials' expanding store and factory network. This role connects technology and business operations, ensuring smooth POS systems, uninterrupted retail technology, and proactive end\-user support across \~200\+ locations.
 



  





 As Support Manager, you will drive operational excellence through direct support delivery, team coordination, vendor management, and continuous improvement initiatives. You'll be instrumental in supporting our retail expansion, ensuring business continuity, and building scalable support infrastructure for future growth.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. POS \& Retail Application Support (Weightage: 25%)
 



 • Ensure uninterrupted POS operations across all retail locations nationwide
 



 • Troubleshoot and resolve billing\-related issues with minimal downtime
 



 • Provide user training and first\-line support for POS systems and retail applications
 



 • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new POS versions and features
 



 • Liaise with POS vendors for incident resolution, escalations, and product updates
 



 • Support new store launches, configurations, and POS rollouts
 



 • Maintain POS ticket queue and achieve SLA targets
 



  





 2\. System \& End\-User Support (Weightage: 20%)
 



 • Provision, deploy, and configure desktop and laptop equipment for end\-users
 



 • Perform OS installations, updates, and troubleshooting
 



 • Deploy software applications and manage license installations
 



 • Provide technical support for printers, peripherals, and connectivity issues
 



 • Address day\-to\-day user IT requirements and technical support tickets
 



 • Achieve SLA compliance for ticket closure and issue resolution
 



 • Maintain asset tracking and documentation for all equipment
 



  





 3\. CCTV \& Surveillance Management (Weightage: 15%)
 



 • Monitor CCTV system health and recording availability across locations
 



 • Conduct periodic health checks and preventive maintenance
 



 • Troubleshoot CCTV failures and coordinate technical resolution
 



 • Manage relationships with CCTV vendors and service providers
 



 • Ensure SLA compliance for CCTV incident resolution
 



 • Document CCTV infrastructure and audit trails
 



 • Support CCTV setup for new store locations
 



  





 4\. Backup Monitoring \& Recovery Support (Weightage: 10%)
 



 • Monitor and verify scheduled backups on a daily basis
 



 • Review backup logs and alert on failures or anomalies
 



 • Support and conduct quarterly restoration testing
 



 • Escalate backup failures to relevant teams within defined timelines
 



 • Maintain backup documentation and recovery procedures
 



 • Report backup status and metrics to management
 



  





 5\. Automation \& Process Improvement (Weightage: 10%)
 



 • Develop and implement automation scripts for repetitive IT tasks
 



 • Identify opportunities to reduce manual efforts and improve efficiency
 



 • Create automated reporting tools and dashboards
 



 • Implement process improvements for ticket management and user support
 



 • Develop self\-service knowledge base and automation tools for end\-users
 



 • Document and share best practices across the team
 



  





 6\. IT Asset \& Inventory Management (Weightage: 10%)
 



 • Maintain accurate IT asset inventory and tracking systems
 



 • Manage hardware lifecycle, procurement, and disposal
 



 • Monitor stock levels and coordinate with procurement teams
 



 • Execute scrap policy and ensure proper asset retirement
 



 • Prepare audit\-ready asset documentation and compliance reports
 



 • Plan and manage hardware requirements for new locations
 



 • Support software license management and renewal coordination
 



  





 7\. Documentation \& Compliance (Weightage: 10%)
 



 • Update and maintain IT Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
 



 • Document incidents, resolutions, and lessons learned
 



 • Support internal and external audit processes
 



 • Maintain and expand knowledge base for common issues
 



 • Ensure adherence to IT policies and security protocols
 



 • Create documentation for new locations and configurations
 



 • Prepare compliance reports and audit evidence
 



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




 Education \& Experience:
 



 • 3\-7 years of experience in IT support, retail IT operations, or technical support management
 



 • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
 



 • Proven experience supporting POS systems or retail technology environments
 



 • Demonstrated experience managing multiple IT support responsibilities simultaneously Technical
 



 Expertise:
 



 • Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems and OS troubleshooting
 



 • Hands\-on experience with POS systems and retail applications
 



 • Working knowledge of CCTV systems, DVR/NVR technology, and surveillance infrastructure
 



 • Experience with backup systems, monitoring tools, and recovery procedures
 



 • Proficiency with desktop support tools and asset management systems
 



 • Basic networking knowledge (troubleshooting connectivity, printer setup)
 



 • Familiarity with IT ticketing systems and asset tracking tools
 



 • Basic scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, batch scripts, or similar)
