title: Workplace Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description – Manager (CL\-7\)**
**Job Title** 
 : Workplace Service Delivery Manager (CL\-7\)
   

  

**Management Level** 
 : CL – 7
   

  

**Work Location** 
 : Noida
   

  

**Must have Skills** 
 : Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration
   

  

**Good to have Skills** 
 : Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PMP Certification
   

  

**Department** 
 : Accenture Workplace Solutions, Corporate Function
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 15\-20 years of experience in Facility management and administration with IT/ITES Sectors.
   

  

**Educational Qualification** 
 : Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full\-time MBA or both would be an added advantage.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
**Integrated Facility management**
* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly/ quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.


**Engineering and Technical Services**
* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety. Leverage tools to improve quality of services, including office meters, sensors and SLA tracking.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.


**Statutory Compliance and Risks**
* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.


**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**
* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.


**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**
* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.


**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**
* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.


**Cafeteria Management**
* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.


**Team Management**
* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**
* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.


**Projects and Transitions**
* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word), working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.


**Additional Information:**
* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of NCR offices.

description:

 Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one\-of\-a\-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting\-edge solutions to solve real\-world energy problems.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Planning lead, reporting directly to HOD to join our Construction team based in Noida.

 Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality.
   

  

 Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000\+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last.

* Provide overall project cost, schedule, estimating, progress measurement, and change management leadership

As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T.EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, and from the support of your manager through check\-in moments like the Mid\-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development

We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application.

title: FinCrime Senior Manager
description:

 Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
   

  

 We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
   

  

 Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade\-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
   

  

 Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018\. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you'll own FinCrime Operations end to end — keeping Aspire compliant with regulatory requirements while mitigating financial crime risk. You'll lead a team of analysts, provide strategic insight to senior management, and drive the process improvements that make our financial crime risk management framework sharper and more efficient as we grow.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our FinCrime team protects Aspire and our customers from money laundering, sanctions exposure, offboarding risk, and other financial crime. Working closely with Compliance, KYC, and Fraud, FinCrime Ops builds and runs the monitoring controls that keep Aspire compliant and safe as we scale across markets.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (KYC, Fraud, Compliance) to improve data collection, risk assessment, and reporting
* Collaborate with external partners to continuously improve how we work together
* Ensure FinCrime Ops processes align with industry best practices and global regulatory standards (AML, CFT, KYC)
* Identify trends and emerging risks in financial crime, surfacing insights to senior management for proactive risk management
* Develop and implement AI and automation strategies within FinCrime Ops to improve efficiency and accuracy
* Train and mentor your analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development


**What You Need To Be Successful**
* 7\+ years of experience and 4\+ years of leadership experience in financial crime compliance, AML, KYC, risk management, or related fields within financial services or fintech
* Strong knowledge of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime typologies, and risk assessment methodologies
* Proven leadership skills, with experience managing operational teams and driving performance
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with strong attention to detail
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations clearly
* Proficiency in compliance\-related tools, transaction monitoring systems, and data analytics
* Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti\-Money Laundering Specialist) or equivalent

* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving regulatory landscapes
* Has a strong grasp of artificial intelligence concepts and the ability to apply AI tools (e.g. Claude, n8n, etc.) and frameworks to solve real\-world problems at Aspire.

 GlobalLogic is looking for an experienced and proactive Assistant Manager – Project \& Product Operations with 9\+ years of relevant experience to manage multiple projects and work closely with Product Managers/Project Owners. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in SOP creation, workflow management, process improvement, team management, and performance monitoring.
   

  

 The role requires a product\-oriented professional with strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, organizational, and decision\-making skills. The candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day project operations, developing and maintaining SOPs, collaborating with product stakeholders, addressing product\-related queries, and driving team performance.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 9\+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in Project Management, Product Operations, Technical Project Management, or IT Operations.
* Proven experience working in the IT/technology sector.
* Strong product\-oriented mindset with experience working closely with Product Managers or Product Owners.
* Hands\-on experience in SOP creation, workflow management, process documentation, and process improvement.
* Proven experience in team leadership, people management, or supervisory roles.
* Strong understanding of performance metrics, KPIs, and team performance management.
* Excellent analytical, logical reasoning, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a diverse, collaborative, and cross\-functional environment.
* Proactive approach with the ability to identify process gaps, trends, and opportunities for innovation.
* Strong decision\-making and multitasking abilities.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Educational background in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently as well as collaboratively.


 Job responsibilities
   

  

  

* Manage multiple projects and day\-to\-day operations in close collaboration with Product Managers and Project Owners.
* Create, maintain, and continuously improve SOPs, workflows, and process documentation for projects.
* Identify process gaps and proactively recommend solutions and process improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.
* Respond to and resolve product\-related queries and operational issues.
* Create an open and collaborative team environment with clear communication and defined goals.
* Delegate tasks, establish priorities, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Monitor day\-to\-day team operations and ensure adherence to defined processes and workflows.
* Track team performance and prepare/report key performance metrics and KPIs.
* Identify training and development needs and provide coaching and guidance to team members.
* Support performance management and drive continuous improvement within the team.
* Encourage innovation and proactively identify trends, user issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Organize team engagement and team\-building activities.

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

**Professional Development:**

title: AM LTE (f/m/d)
description:
Railways for the world of tomorrow.
   

  

 DB RRTS is a part of the DB group, a world\-leading global railway company with an extensive organization in Germany and projects around the world. Our company offers a technically sophisticated and customized infrastructure, mobility, and transport solutions. We acquire, initiate, and manage rail operations and maintenance projects outside Europe. We are looking for transport and mobility enthusiasts and entrepreneurs with long\-standing experience in railway operations and projects in India or worldwide.
   

  

 We are currently seeking you to build up and manage the operation and maintenance of a Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) and Mass Rapid Transport System (MRTS) business in Delhi, India. This 82km long Delhi\-Meerut line will consist of 25 RRTS and 9 MRTS stations. This will include developing a local O\&M company from scratch to full operations, developing and leading a passionate and performance driven team, steering quality, performance, and customer satisfaction as well as ensuring economic success in India.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Plan, execute, and supervise scheduled Preventive Maintenance activities for LTE, TETRA, MCX, and DAS systems in accordance with approved SOPs.
* Ensure PM completion within defined maintenance windows with full SOP/EOP compliance.
* Prepare and submit PM reports, checklists, and maintenance logs in required formats.
* Monitor system health parameters, KPIs, and performance trends post\-PM execution.
* Lead fault isolation, troubleshooting, and system restoration for LTE and associated telecom systems within SLA timelines.
* Independently diagnose hardware, software, and network\-level failures using NMS/NetAct and field diagnostics.
* Escalate complex failures to OEM with detailed fault analysis and coordinate resolution.
* Maintain fault registers, incident logs, and downtime records with accurate technical entries.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all major/recurring failures and submit structured RCA reports.
* Define and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions to eliminate recurrence.
* Participate in incident review meetings and present technical findings.
* Prepare and maintain PM reports, CM reports, failure analyses, RCA documents, FAT/SAT/PAT records, and interface documents.
* Maintain up\-to\-date system configuration records, As\-Built drawings, and SOP registers.
* Ensure all maintenance activities are conducted in strict compliance with safety procedures, permit\-to\-work systems, and operational safety rules.
* Conduct toolbox talks and safety briefings for field teams prior to maintenance activities.
* Supervise and guide junior engineers and field technicians during maintenance activities.
* Support training and competency development of team members on LTE system operations.
* Evaluate field team performance and provide technical guidance during operational failures.


**Qualifications:**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication / Telecommunications / Electrical \& Electronics Engineering.
* 5–10 years of hands\-on experience in Telecom / LTE / TETRA / DAS system maintenance in a field environment.
* Proven fault isolation and troubleshooting capability on LTE RAN / EPC / NMS systems.
* Prior experience in Metro Rail, Airport, or other mission\-critical communication infrastructure.
* Exposure to LTE level 1 and 2 maintenance environment.
* RF planning experience with tools.
* Familiarity with MCPTT / MCX / DMR network design and integration.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Homeie is building the consumer company for where you live.** 




  





 The first product is the smartest way to rent a home in India. You tell Homeie what matters once, and our AI understands your taste, searches and coordinates across a fragmented offline market, helps you see only the homes actually worth considering, and gets the transaction done, including ₹0 security deposit upfront. What takes weeks today should eventually feel like one really good afternoon.
 



  





 Over time, Homeie should help you rent a home, understand your housing history, know what matters around where you live, make every move easier than the last, and eventually help you buy your first home.
 



  






 We’ve raised 
 
**$750k** 

  from a stealth fund, whose backers include Abstract Ventures, Bain Capital and Long Journey. We are still a very small team, which means the people joining now will have an absurd amount of influence over what Homeie becomes.
 




  





**What will you do:** 



* Own how we get our first few hundred renters. Reddit, offices, partnerships, going on the ground, weird hacks nobody has tried. Whatever works.
* Figure out where the best supply actually comes from, how we work with those people, what incentives make sense, and how we consistently get great homes when a renter shows up.
* Visit broker offices in person, onboard brokers to Homeie and build trust with them over time. Do creative stuff here \- like hosting broker events to bring them together.
* Spending time on the ground with renters, brokers and partners instead of forming opinions from a spreadsheet.
* Work with engineering and product to turn things we repeatedly do manually into software.



  





**Who we're looking for:** 



* Strong spoken Hindi and English. You talk to brokers, owners, society guards and renters all day, and each needs a different version of you.
* You want to be on the ground, not at a desk
* You can make decisions on your own when a plan falls apart



  





**We're hiring two kinds of people:** 




 1\. Freshers: 2025 and 2026 pass\-outs
 


* Startup internship experience strongly preferred. If you have interned somewhere early and know what it feels like when the process doesn't exist yet and you have to build it, this role will make sense to you.



 2\. People with 1\-3 years of field, ops or service experience
 


* KAMs, City Ops, Fleet Ops or Field Ops at quick commerce, mobility, hyperlocal or home services companies.



  





**This role is not for you if:** 



* You want a fixed desk and predictable 10\-to\-6 hours
* You'd rather escalate a problem than solve it on the spot
* You need a clear process before you can start
* You don't enjoy spending your day in broker offices, societies and other people's homes

title: UTM Supervisor
description:
The UTM Supervisor shall report to the General Manager / UTM Operation Manager and shall be responsible for the planning, supervision, verification, and reporting of assigned projects. **ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
* Lead the UTM team on ship\-board assignments
* Review survey requirements, measurement scope, and project specifications
* Prepare measurement plans and coordinate project execution
* Liaise with attending surveyors, vessel representatives, and other stakeholders
* Brief the UTM Operator on measurement requirements, work scope, and safety precautions
* Supervise and verify onboard measurement activities
* Confirm that measurement locations, extent, and coverage meet survey requirements
* Assess significant wastage, corrosion, pitting, deformation, or other abnormal conditions
* Prepare, review, and compile the UTM report
* Ensure all project records are complete and properly retained


**Requirements**
**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**
**Technical Skills \-**
* Ship structural Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement (UTM) and marine inspection
* Interpretation of Class, IACS and survey requirements for thickness measurement
* Preparation of UTM measurement plans, scope, locations and coverage
* Review and validation of UTM readings, measurement records and prepare final reports
* Understanding of ship structural arrangements and common deterioration mechanisms
* Application of measurement quality, calibration and traceability requirements
* Knowledge of relevant Ship\-board safety procedures


**Professional Skills**
* Proficiency in AutoCAD for reading and marking\-up ship structural drawings, measurement locations and UTM sketches
* Proficient in MS Office and digital reporting systems
* Plan and supervise UTM projects from preparation to reporting
* Lead and brief UTM Operators on scope, methods and safety
* Coordinate effectively with Class Surveyors, vessel personnel and clients
* Exercise judgement to accept, reject or require re\-measurement of readings
* Willingness and readiness for international travel, with valid passport and national CDC


**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**
**Professional Experience**
* Minimum 5 years relevant experience in Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement and marine inspection
* Practical experience conducting and/or supervising UTM for special surveys on ships
* Experience with Class/IACS requirements preferred


**Education \& Qualifications**
* Graduate (any stream) or
* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical engineering or Naval Architecture
* ASNT Level II in Ultrasonic Testing (UT) or equivalent

title: Head - Finance & Accounting Quality
description:
**Head Finance and Accounting (F\&A) Quality** 




**Location: India (Open)** 




  





**Role Purpose** 




 Lead the design, deployment, governance, and continuous improvement of an independent Finance \& Accounting Quality function across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Record to\-Report (RTR), FP\&A, Master Data, and other F\&A towers.
 



 The role is responsible for establishing a centralized quality operating model that drives transaction accuracy, control compliance, defect prevention, customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and delivery risk reduction across all F\&A engagements.
 



 This leader will build and institutionalize a scalable quality governance framework covering quality methodology, sampling strategy, control validation, calibration, RCA, training, certification, reporting, and continuous improvement.
 



 The role will also own governance of process\-related training across F\&A, ensuring that teams are trained, assessed, and certified on approved processes, SOPs, desktop procedures, job aids, controls, and client\-specific requirements before performing activities independently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Quality Function Establishment \& Governance
 


* Design and institutionalize an enterprise\-wide F\&A Quality Management Framework.
* Establish independent QC operations across all F\&A towers.
* Define quality governance structure, operating cadence, escalation mechanisms, and review forums.
* Standardize defect taxonomy, scoring methodology, quality criteria, and control requirements.
* Create quality policies, SOPs, and governance standards.



**2\. Deployment of Dedicated QC Organization** 



* Build and scale centralized and account\-level QC teams.
* Define QC staffing models, spans, and coverage ratios.
* Drive deployment of QC Leads, Analysts, Calibration Specialists, and Quality Managers.
* Establish quality operating rhythms across all accounts.
* Ensure independence of quality teams from transaction processing teams.



**3\. Quality Control Framework** 



* Define risk\-based sampling methodology across PTP, OTC, RTR, FP\&A, and Master Data.
* Establish process\-specific quality checklists and evaluation parameters.
* Implement layered quality reviews, control validation, and QA audit mechanisms.
* Drive quality coverage enhancement for high\-risk and judgment\-intensive activities.



**4\. RCA and Defect Prevention** 



* Establish structured defect prevention programs.
* Lead root cause analysis governance for all critical quality failures.
* Drive corrective and preventive action programs.
* Create enterprise defect repositories and knowledge\-sharing mechanisms.
* Ensure closure tracking and effectiveness validation of improvement actions.



**5\. Process Training Governance, Calibration \& Capability Assurance** 



* Establish periodic calibration programs across all F\&A towers.
* Drive certification and accreditation programs for Operations and QC teams.
* Create quality knowledge repositories and training curriculum.
* Lead bottom\-quartile improvement initiatives.
* Institutionalize process\-specific competency assessments.
* Own governance of process training across PTP, OTC, RTR, FP\&A, Master Data, and other F\&A processes.
* Ensure all employees complete role\-based training on approved SOPs, desktop procedures, job aids, controls, policies, and client\-specific requirements.
* Implement training\-needs analysis linked to quality defects, process changes, audit findings, customer feedback, and control failures.
* Establish training calendars, trainer qualification standards, attendance and completion tracking, knowledge assessments, certification criteria, and refresher\-training triggers.
* Ensure new hires and employees moving to new activities are certified before independent processing or system access, in line with applicable operational requirements.
* Govern SOP and training\-content currency through version control, periodic reviews, approval workflows, and timely updates following process or policy changes.
* Monitor training effectiveness through post\-training quality performance, assessment results, error recurrence, control adherence, and action closure.
* Provide leadership visibility through training\-compliance dashboards, overdue actions, certification status, capability risks, and improvement plans.



**6\. Metrics, Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Build enterprise quality dashboards and scorecards.
* Track accuracy, defect density, customer defects, audit findings, control failures, RCA closure, sampling coverage, and training effectiveness.
* Present quality performance reviews to leadership and clients.
* Drive predictive quality analytics and trend identification.



**7\. Client Governance** 



* Act as quality SME during client reviews and governance meetings.
* Lead customer defect management and remediation programs.
* Provide executive updates on quality health, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Support quality commitments during transitions and new deal mobilization.



**8\. Continuous Improvement** 



* Partner with Transformation, Operational Excellence, Lean Six Sigma, and Automation teams.
* Identify systemic quality improvement opportunities.
* Drive process standardization across accounts.
* Improve first\-time\-right performance and reduce recurring errors.
* Build a prevention\-focused quality culture.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Educational Qualification** 



* CA / CMA / CPA / MBA Finance / M.Com or equivalent.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt mandatory.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt preferred.



**Experience** 



* 15\-20 years of overall F\&A/BPS operations experience.
* Minimum 8\-10 years in Quality, Audit, Controls, Compliance, Operational Excellence, or Governance roles.
* Proven experience setting up dedicated Quality/QA/QC functions for large\-scale F\&A operations.
* Experience managing multi\-tower F\&A environments covering PTP, OTC, RTR, FP\&A, Master Data, and preferably Treasury / Tax.



**Mandatory Experience** 



* Creating centralized QA/QC organizations.
* Designing sampling and quality frameworks.
* Quality scorecard design and deployment.

**Job Description – Manager Finance \& Accounts** 




**Designation:** 
 Manager – Finance \& Accounts
 



**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head\-F \& A
 



**Location:** 
 Hospital\- Delhi (Shalimar Bagh)
 



 Maharishi Ayurveda hospital

 4\-5 years.
 



**Qualification:** 
 B.Com /M.Com
 



  





  





**1\. Job Purpose** 




 To manage and control the day\-to\-day Finance \& Accounts operations of the hospital, ensuring accurate accounting, timely financial reporting, effective cash\-flow management, statutory compliance, billing controls, bank reconciliation, internal controls, and adherence to financial policies and IFC requirements.
 



**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Hospital Billing \& Revenue Control** 



* Monitor daily
 **IPD, OPD, Pharmacy, Diagnostics, OT, Consultation and other hospital billing** 
 .
* Ensure billing is complete, accurate and properly supported by relevant documents.
* Review cancellations, discounts, refunds, credit notes and adjustments.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and coordinate with concerned departments for timely recovery.
* Ensure proper reconciliation between hospital billing software, collection records and bank receipts.
* Identify revenue leakage and implement appropriate controls.



**B. Daily Finance \& Accounting Operations** 



* Supervise day\-to\-day accounting activities and ensure transactions are recorded accurately and timely.
* Review
 **receipts, payments, journals, purchase entries and other accounting vouchers** 
 .
* Ensure all vouchers are properly supported and approved as per the organization's delegation of authority/IFC.
* Monitor cash and bank transactions.
* Maintain proper accounting records and documentation.



**C. Bank Reconciliation \& Cash Management** 



* Ensure
 **daily bank reconciliation** 
 of all hospital bank accounts.
* Reconcile hospital billing/collection data with bank statements.
* Investigate and resolve unreconciled transactions and differences on a timely basis.
* Monitor daily cash position and coordinate fund requirements.
* Ensure proper control over cash collections and deposits.



**D. Accounts Payable \& Vendor Management** 



* Review vendor invoices, purchase bills and supporting documents.
* Ensure proper verification and approval before processing payments.
* Monitor vendor outstanding balances and ageing.
* Coordinate with Purchase/Stores/Administration for discrepancies in vendor invoices.
* Ensure timely and accurate vendor payments as per approved terms.



**E. Accounts Receivable** 



* Monitor patient, corporate, TPA and other receivables.
* Prepare and review ageing reports.
* Follow up with concerned departments for collection of outstanding amounts.
* Ensure timely reconciliation of patient/TPA/corporate accounts.
* Highlight long\-pending and disputed balances to management.



**F. MIS \& Management Reporting** 



* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly financial MIS as required by management.
* Prepare revenue, collection, expenditure and profitability reports.
* Provide management with analysis of:
* IPD/OPD revenue
* Collection
* Receivables
* Expenses
* Cash flow
* Department\-wise performance
* Budget vs. actual
* Highlight significant variances and provide explanations/action points.



**I. Internal Control \& IFC** 



* Ensure compliance with the organization's
 **Internal Financial Controls (IFC)** 
 .
* Review financial processes and identify control gaps.
* Ensure segregation of duties and appropriate authorization levels.
* Conduct periodic checks of billing, receipts, payments, bank reconciliation and accounting records.
* Report irregularities, control weaknesses and suspected financial leakage to management.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions.



**J. Audit** 



* Coordinate with internal, statutory and external auditors.
* Provide required schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents.
* Ensure audit observations are addressed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain proper audit trails and documentation.
* Follow up on pending audit observations.



**K. Inventory \& Pharmacy Finance Controls** 



* Coordinate with Stores/Pharmacy for financial controls over inventory.
* Review stock\-related accounting and reconciliation.
* Monitor stock adjustments, shortages, expiry and write\-offs.
* Ensure appropriate authorization for inventory adjustments.
* Train staff on accounting procedures, hospital billing controls and financial policies.
* Ensure timely completion of month\-end and year\-end closing activities.



**4\. Month\-End Responsibilities** 



* Complete monthly books of accounts within the defined timeline.
* Ensure all income and expenses are properly accounted for.
* Complete bank, vendor, patient, TPA and other reconciliations.
* Review provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses and outstanding liabilities.
* Prepare monthly MIS and financial analysis along with preparation of Financials.
* Coordinate with auditors and management for month\-end review.
* Ensure zero/acceptable unexplained reconciliation differences.

description:
**Purpose of Position:**

The SAP Project \& Operations Lead serves as the primary functional focal point across Project System (PS), Plant Maintenance (PM), Production Planning (PP), and Quality Management (QM) within the Group\-wide SAP S/4HANA environment

The role ensures stable operational processes, supports continuous improvement, leads solution design, and enables best\-practice process adoption across all operating companies.

This position serves as the primary functional authority for operations\-related modules and works closely with business stakeholders, SAP partners, and internal CoE teams to ensure efficient and reliable SAP\-enabled business processes.

**Minimum Work Experience:**

2\. Proven experience leading solution design, configuration oversight, testing, and deployment in at least two full\-cycle SAP implementations or major rollout projects (S/4HANA preferred).

3\. Strong track record in stabilizing operations, resolving cross\-module issues, and improving system performance.

4\. Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders and managing functional expectations.

5\. Prior experience guiding junior consultants or support analysts is strongly preferred.

6\. Exposure to SAP BTP integrations, Fiori apps, digital maintenance, and manufacturing execution systems is a plus.

**Skills \& Competencies Required:**

2\. Strong understanding of cross\-functional processes (MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, and SCM).

4\. Strong documentation, process mapping, and presentation skills.

6\. High level of accountability and ownership of module performance.

8\. Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break down complex SAP issues.

**Job title:**  

**Service Network \& Technical Operations Manager**

  

**Your role:**  

* **Consumer Care \& Service Network Management:** Manage and strengthen the consumer care and authorized service network to ensure high\-quality and timely service support.
* **New Product Introduction (NPI) Training:** Plan and conduct technical training for service centre teams on new product launches, product features, repair procedures, and troubleshooting.
* **Spare Parts Management:** Ensure availability and proper management of spare parts across service centres, including forecasting, inventory monitoring, and resolution of critical shortages.
* **Safety Case Management:** Identify, monitor, investigate, and coordinate closure of product/service\-related safety cases in accordance with company safety standards and escalation procedures.
* **Technical Product Knowledge:** Develop and maintain strong technical knowledge of products, including functionality, installation, troubleshooting, repair, and common failure modes.
* **Service Centre Claim Management:** Manage service centre claims related to warranty repairs, spare parts, labour, and other service activities. Ensure claims are accurately validated, processed, and resolved within defined timelines.
* **Service Quality Improvement:** Monitor service performance and identify recurring technical issues, driving corrective and preventive actions with relevant teams.
* **Cross\-functional Coordination:** Coordinate with Product Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, and Customer Care teams to resolve technical and service\-related issues.
* **Performance Monitoring:** Track key service network KPIs such as turnaround time, first\-time fix rate, repeat complaints, claim closure, spare\-parts availability, and customer satisfaction.
* **Service Network Capability Development:** Assess service centre capability and implement improvement plans through technical training, process standardization, and regular performance reviews.

  

**You're the right fit if:**

  

* Strong experience in **service network management, technical operations, partner/vendor governance, and consumer service excellence** .
  

Proven capability in **NPI readiness, technical training, RCA, process improvement, NPS, TAT and service quality management** .
  

Excellent **leadership, stakeholder management, analytical and problem\-solving skills** , with a strong focus on operational efficiency and cost optimization.
* Strategic thinking, decision\-making, problem solving, influencing, communication, and team leadership
* Preferably **10–15\+ years** in service operations, technical service, after\-sales/service network or consumer care, preferably with experience managing a sizeable service ecosystem
* **Ideally a bachelor's degree in engineering** (Electrical/Electronics/Mechanical preferred). MBA/PGDM in Operations, Service Management or Business Administration would be an added advantage

  

  

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.  



  

**About Philips**  

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Assistant Teaching Operations Manager
description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.


Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.


**We connect. We inspire.**  



**Pay Band:** 5
**Country/Location:** Noida, India
**Department:** GSS English \& Exams (English Operations)
**Contract Type:** Fixed term contract
**Contract Duration:** 1 year
**Closing Date:** 5 October 2026, 11:59 PM (IST)  

**Work Schedule:** This is a 24/7 on\-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift\-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position and it requires working onsite five days a week.  

**Role Description \& Purpose**The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager will support the effective delivery of English Online’s Teaching Operations by monitoring student booking trends and assisting in timetable optimisation. The role will contribute to planning and deploying teacher resources to meet demand while supporting cost\-effective operations across English Online’s offerings, as well as supporting data reporting and ensuring adherence to service level agreements through collaboration with the Teaching Operations Manager. Working closely with internal stakeholders, such as Partnerships, Sales and Customer Service, the Assistant Teaching Operations Manager will help plan and deliver various projects and contribute to initiatives focused on timetabling improvements and resource management efficiencies. The role will also support the recruitment, onboarding and scheduling of new teachers, ensuring adherence to British Council policies and contributing to English Online’s growth and service quality.  

**Role Accountabilities**The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager implements standard operating procedures and contributes to meeting performance targets under the guidance of the Teaching Operations Manager. The role assists in managing resourcing, timetabling, and capacity adjustments to support smooth and consistent service delivery. It ensures adherence to SLA standards with internal and external customers and suppliers by following established processes and providing timely support for issues that arise. The role also collaborates with the Teaching Operations Manager to monitor demand trends and makes preliminary adjustments to forecasts and resources as needed.
The role builds and maintains strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across English Online, supporting communication between Teaching Operations and teams such as Sales, Customer Service and Tech/Product. It provides teachers with operational updates and addresses routine queries related to timetabling and non\-academic support areas, escalating complex queries as necessary.  

The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager supports data collection and analysis efforts to inform business process improvements, generating routine reports and offering initial recommendations to the Teaching Operations Manager. The role assists in monitoring OKRs and KPIs, preparing data as needed to track performance and support reporting requirements.  

The role maintains accuracy in timetabling and booking data, monitors student booking patterns and supports forecasting adjustments in collaboration with the Teaching Operations Manager. It also assists in uploading classes and seeks approval ahead of doing so.  

The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager follows agreed corporate risk management processes and procedures when delivering services, including child protection, security policies, financial protocols and anti\-fraud measures, to protect the interests of British Council and its customers at all times.  

**Qualifications \& Experience****Essential*** Bachelors degree or equivalent.
* Experience of working in an operations/service delivery role.
* Experience of monitoring costs.
* Experience of contributing to the delivery of process improvements in a commercial context.
  

**Desirable*** Microsoft Office Specialist certification in Excel – Expert level or higher, or equivalent courses (e.g. through Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, edX).
* Courses/certifications in data visualisation and/or AI/machine learning.
* Courses/certificates in Microsoft Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience using timetabling software or scheduling systems (e.g. in the education or travel industries).
* Experience working with a relational database.
* Experience working with hourly\-paid staff and/or non\-permanent workers.
* Experience working within the education industry.
  

**Further Information**Right to Work: Locally recruited
Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work.  

Applications are also welcomed from candidates currently based in other British Council country offices. However, please note candidates must have a natural right to work in the country, on a permanent basis, as immigration clearance and/or on\-going visa support is not provided by the British Council for this role. Relocation support is also not provided.  

**India (OCI)**Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in  

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.  



**Safeguarding Statement**

The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989\. description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Manager Operations \- Fund Accounting.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* The traditional Accounting \& Valuations team has daily, monthly and weekly Net Asset Value valuations with stringent timelines. The team is responsible for performing capital activity bookings, accruals, amortization, yields leading to final generation and validation of Net Asset Value through diagnostic checks, Financial Mainframe Report and post Net Asset Value activities. The team also performs other Monthly \& Reporting activities which includes Fee Reviews. Ex‑Dividend Distribution, Trustee Packs and Queries, Regulatory \& Client Reporting. The Accounting \& Valuations team is responsible functionally across multiple jurisdictions (where applicable) serviced out of Markets and Securities Services Kolkata.
* The role will require technical excellence to achieve target deliverables combined with the ability to get work done from administrators and / or Subject Matter Expert to achieve target Key Performance Indicator. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering excellent client service within the standard Net Asset Value model of promoting continuous improvement of Net Asset Value processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies.
* Responsible for identifying and reducing manual processes for enhanced operational control. Undertake relevant measures to extend support and implementation of technology upgradation. Lead and oversee User Acceptance Testing for the business (as and when required) initiatives.
* Lead Projects for both business partners and Markets and Securities Services Kolkata (based on business objectives, targets and requirements). To acquire a comprehensive and broad understanding of the Traditional Net Asset Value processes and to keep abreast of the latest developments in the assigned markets on the rules and regulations by the regulators, stock exchange and etc. that may have implication to the daily Net Asset Value processes.
* This role includes the responsibility to ensure that business data requirements are completed accurately and efficiently, additionally make sure that supporting statistics/reports/returns are presented to business/management within agreed timescales. Drive the plan for standardization of processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim of enhancing cost effectiveness and efficiency.
* To ensure control measures/checkpoints are established to scrutinize exceptions/errors to prevent any operational losses and reviews on these measures are constantly performed. Procedural changes/new initiatives are reviewed, fully communicated to and implemented.
* Review Contingency requirements on a periodic basis and invoke relevant business recovery measures as necessary. Carry out effective Operational Risk Assessment by monitoring and implementing risk mitigating plans. Maintains HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
* Ensure Gross Asset Value / Net Asset Value operating procedure is followed with management of risks (if any). Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures. Ensure governance on all daily/weekly tracker updated by team. Update all management MI by the stipulated deadlines. Additional review of Job\-Aid Matrix, Standard Operating Procedure, process notes, checklists and other internal process related documents periodically.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or qualifications in the accounting/finance industry. Strong working knowledge on Microsoft Office.
* Overall 5\+ Years of experience and 3\-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent knowledge of Capital Markets and Financial instruments. Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge in Net Asset Value Calculation process with clear understanding of the End\-to\-End Fund Accounting Model.
* Ability to monitor and meet operational goals. Should have an eye for detail and a strong analytical mind. Ability to update, manage and analyze Management Information related activities. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements and recognize areas for development.
* Complete understanding of Trade Life Cycle. Understanding of Gross Asset Value \- Net Asset Value Activities. Previous experience in performing \& reviewing funds in Accounting \& Valuations. Knowledge in investment accounting, investment valuations, fund industry. Working knowledge on IMS, Multifonds, ICON, Bloomberg, etc. Knowledge in the use of Bloomberg and/or Reuters.
* Ability to speak and understand English fluently, writes business letters and reports, good conversational / telephone skills. Ability to learn quickly, transfers knowledge appropriately, understand and interpret numeric data. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements.
* Initiate cost control measures by achieving resource efficiency and managing overheads. Evidence of very good prioritizing, planning and organizing skills. Ability to effectively communicate and implement group policies and procedures
* Ability to comprehend and minimize operational risks including wide understanding of audit controls and compliance requirements. Ability to maintain control, direction and motivation of staff in an ever\-changing environment. Proven experience in change and problem\-solving management.
* Strong Accounting Concepts with a clear understanding of financial statements. Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 EDCONS EXPORTS PVT. LTD. combines Italian design expertise with over 30 years of Indian craftsmanship to produce premium leather goods and fashion accessories. From its headquarters in Kolkata and a Milan\-based design studio, the company serves leading global brands with handbags, wallets, and small leather goods. A 200,000 sq. ft factory manages cutting, stitching, finishing, quality control, and packaging entirely in\-house, supporting both large\-scale production and custom, small\-batch orders. Recognized as a Government of India Star Export House and certified by BSCI, Sedex, and ISO 14001, EDCONS is committed to ethical labor, safe workplaces, and environmentally responsible manufacturing. The company exports to clients across Europe, the United States, and Asia, offering dependable quality, sustainability, and traceability in leather goods.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Production Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area, responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end production operations for leather goods and fashion accessories. This role includes planning and scheduling production, managing shop\-floor activities, monitoring output against targets, and coordinating cutting, stitching, finishing, and packaging functions. The Production Manager will lead and guide production teams, ensure adherence to quality standards and compliance requirements, and maintain workplace safety and efficiency. Daily activities involve collaborating with design, sourcing, and quality assurance teams, optimizing resource utilization, solving production bottlenecks, and maintaining accurate documentation and reports. The role also requires continuous improvement of processes to support on\-time delivery, cost control, and scalability for both bulk and custom orders.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong production planning, workflow management, and capacity planning skills, with experience in high\-volume manufacturing environments.
* Hands\-on experience in leather goods, apparel, or accessories production processes, including cutting, stitching, finishing, and packaging.
* Proficiency in quality control methods, process standardization, and compliance with social and environmental standards.
* Leadership and team management skills, including training, performance monitoring, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Ability to analyze production data, use basic ERP or manufacturing software, and prepare clear reports and dashboards.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and time management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Production Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations, or a related field; relevant experience in export\-oriented manufacturing is preferred.
* Familiarity with safety regulations, ethical labor practices, and sustainability\-oriented manufacturing will be beneficial.

title: Workplace Service Delivery Assoc Manager
description:
**Job Description – Workplace Facility Management Specialist (CL\-9\)**
**Job Requisition ID** 
 :
   

  

**Job Title** 
 : Workplace Facility Mgmt Specialist
   

  

**Management Level** 
 : CL – 9 (Specialist)
   

  

**Work Location** 
 : Kolkata
   

  

**Must have Skills** 
 : Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration
   

  

**Good to have Skills** 
 : Microsoft office, Power BI
   

  

**Experience** 
 : Min 8 \- 10 years of experience in Facility management and administration with IT/ITES Sectors.
   

  

**Educational Qualification** 
 : Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full time MBA or both would be an added advantage.
   

  

**Department** 
 : Accenture Workplace Solutions, Corporate Functions
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
**Integrated Facility management**
* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly /quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.


**Engineering and Technical Services**
* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.


**Statutory Compliance and Risks**
* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.


**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**
* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads, CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.


**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**
* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.


**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**
* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.
* Good knowledge of ISO standards like ISO45K, ISO27001, ISO14K, ISO22301\.


**Cafeteria Management**
* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor.
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.


**Team Management**
* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**
* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.


**Projects and Transitions**
* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.


**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.

**Required Experience \& Skills** 



* Strong professional experience in

 .

* Experience preparing and reviewing:
* 3D steel models
* General Arrangement drawings
* Shop/fabrication drawings
* Erection drawings
* Assembly and single\-part drawings
* Material/Bolt lists and BOMs
* Strong understanding of structural drawings, architectural drawings, design documents, and project specifications.
* Ability to identify clashes, missing information, detailing errors, and fabrication issues.
* Strong QA/QC and drawing\-checking capability.
* Experience leading, mentoring, or supervising steel detailing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Knowledge of relevant steel detailing and fabrication standards such as AISC, OSHA, AWS, or applicable project standards.
* Experience working with commercial, industrial, warehouse, infrastructure, or miscellaneous steel projects.
* Experience managing projects from initial model setup through final fabrication/erection drawing delivery.



  





**Leadership Expectations** 




 The successful candidate will be expected to act as the technical and delivery leader for the detailing team.

* Take ownership of project quality and delivery.
* Guide team members rather than simply distribute work.
* Develop junior detailers into independent and reliable team members.

 Practice: Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network \| Area of Work: Technology M\&A \| Level: Manager \| Location: Bangalore/Gurgaon/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata \| Years of Experience: 8–15 years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you enjoy solving complex business and technology challenges? Are you passionate about helping clients create value through successful integrations and separations? Do you thrive in fast\-paced transaction environments and enjoy working with senior executives to drive critical business outcomes?
   

  

 Then this is the right place for you.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 The Technology M\&A team helps clients navigate the technology implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, joint ventures, and business transformations. We work across the transaction lifecycle, with a strong focus on post\-deal signing activities including sign\-to\-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy and exit planning, and execution through Integration Management Offices (IMO) and Separation Management Offices (SMO).
   

  

 Our professionals help clients identify and realize transaction value while managing technology risks, operational dependencies, and transformation opportunities. We work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to design and execute integration and separation strategies that enable successful transaction outcomes.

* Lead technology workstreams across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, and separation engagements.

* Develop Day 1 readiness strategies and support Day 1 execution planning.
* Drive technology integration and separation planning across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity, data, and operating models.
* Support Integration Management Office (IMO) and Separation Management Office (SMO) governance, planning, execution tracking, and stakeholder management.
* Develop TSA strategies, transition plans, service schedules, and TSA exit roadmaps.
* Assess technology costs, risks, synergies, and implementation dependencies associated with transactions.
* Facilitate decision\-making with senior client stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* Lead teams in delivering technology M\&A programs and manage project financials, staffing, and delivery quality.
* Develop executive\-level presentations, steering committee materials, business cases, and transaction\-related recommendations.

* Ability to connect transaction objectives with technology execution plans and value realization opportunities.
* Experience managing technology workstreams within complex transaction environments and coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop practical, actionable recommendations.
* Experience leading teams and managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.

* IT Infrastructure \& Cloud
* Infrastructure integration and separation planning.
* Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.
* Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end\-user computing environments.
* Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.
* ERP

* ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve\-out activities.
* Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.
* Enterprise Architecture \& IT Operating Model Transformation
* Enterprise architecture assessments and target\-state design.
* Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.
* IT operating model design and transformation.
* Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.


 Deep SME\-level technical expertise is not required; however, candidates should possess sufficient hands\-on experience to assess transaction impacts, identify dependencies and risks, and support planning and execution activities within their chosen technology domain.
   

  

**What’s in it for You?**
* Opportunity to work on high\-profile global M\&A transactions and transformative business programs.
* Exposure to senior client executives and strategic decision\-making processes.
* Collaboration with leading practitioners across Technology Strategy, M\&A, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Industry groups.

title: DGM - Production Pilot line
description:
Purpose of the Role
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end process management of the entire Pilot Line, including planning and execution of chemistry changeovers (e.g., LFP to NMC, or any other emerging chemistry) to support R\&D trials and new product qualification. Organize and control Pilot Line operations across all process areas E/A/B zones to support process qualification, DOE trials, and yield/quality improvement targets across chemistries.
   

  

 Key Responsibility Areas
   

  

 Manpower, Line \& Shop\-floor Management
   

  

* Plan and manage manpower deployment across the Pilot Line including shift/line management, attendance, multi\-skilling, and readiness for changeover\-driven workload swings.
* Own overall shop\-floor management of the Pilot Line, day\-to\-day activities across process areas, work allocation, housekeeping (5S), and coordination across electrode, cutting/stacking, cell assembly, welding, formation \& aging, and inspection stations.
* Manage non\-standard procurement and consumables required for pilot builds (trial materials, spares, tooling, jigs/fixtures, chemistry\-specific PPE), coordinating with Procurement/Stores to avoid trial downtime.


 Knowledge Generic
   

  

 Process Ownership \& Chemistry Changeover Management
   

  

* Own the Pilot Line process end\-to\-end across all process areas, including planning, sequencing, and executing changeovers between chemistries (e.g., LFP to NMC or other future chemistries) with minimal downtime.
* Define and maintain changeover procedures, process parameters, and equipment settings/fixtures required for each chemistry, ensuring the line can be reconfigured quickly and repeatably for new trials.


 Job Context
   

  

 Functional
   

  

* Organize and implement Pilot Line process/changeover strategies and action plans across all process areas to attain process\-validation and productivity targets across chemistries.
* Capture, analyze, and report trial data (process capability, NG rates, root\-cause analysis) to support go/no\-go decisions on process and equipment readiness for mass production.
* Initiate plans and processes which minimize Pilot Line costs through effective utilization of manpower, equipment, facilities, materials, energy, and trial\-cell capital across changeovers.


 Job Context Specific
   

  

 Coordination with R\&D, Commercial \& Quality
   

  

* Coordinate with the R\&D team to align pilot\-line trial plans and changeover schedules with new chemistry/product development roadmaps, translating technical requirements into achievable pilot\-line builds.
* Coordinate with the Commercial team to understand customer and sample requirements, prioritize pilot\-line build sequencing accordingly, and ensure timely delivery of trial cells/samples against commitments.


 Knowledge Specific
   

  

 B.E in (Mechanical/Electrical /Chemical), Six Sigma Certified / 10–15\+ years leading manufacturing/pilot\-line operations in Li\-ion cell, EV battery pack, or solar cell manufacturing, with NPI, process validation, or multi\-chemistry changeover exposure. Strong process knowledge across electrode/mixing\-coating, cutting/stacking, cell assembly, welding, formation \& aging, and vision inspection, including how process parameters shift across chemistries. Skilled in exception handling, NG/CAPA management, and problem\-solving tools (8D, Six Sigma, 7 QC, 5\-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, DOE). Working knowledge of IATF 16949, SAP/ERP, and MES for shop\-floor data and compliance. Proven cross\-functional coordination with R\&D, Commercial, and Quality to translate production needs into a pilot\-line plan
