title: Revenue Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Anandha Inn Convention Centre and Suites is a four\-star luxury hotel located in the central area of Pondicherry, offering guests an elegant setting for relaxation and events. Established in 1994, the property blends traditional architectural elements with modern design and amenities. The hotel is surrounded by heritage sites, war memorials, Bharathi Park with its Greco\-Roman arches, and renowned local temples.  The Revenue Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai, responsible for driving revenue performance across rooms, events, and ancillary services. The Revenue Manager will prepare regular revenue reports, support budgeting and forecasting, and ensure accurate revenue recognition in coordination with the finance and accounting teams. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating with sales and marketing to develop promotions, evaluating distribution channels and online travel agency performance, and recommending strategy changes based on market trends and competitor analysis. The role also entails maintaining rate integrity, overseeing revenue\-related systems and tools, and supporting senior leadership with data\-driven insights for commercial decisions.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data\-driven recommendations.
* Proficiency in revenue management, including demand forecasting, pricing strategies, and inventory control.
* Solid understanding of finance and accounting principles, including accurate revenue recognition practices.
* Experience using hotel revenue management systems, PMS, and reporting tools; advanced Excel skills are an advantage.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with sales, marketing, and operations teams.

**Required Qualifications**
* 4–7 years as a Business/Systems Analyst, including 2\+ years hands\-on with Power BI.

* Proficient SQL (joins, CTEs, window functions) and data profiling.
* Experience with BI lifecycle in Agile/Scrum environments (Jira/Azure DevOps/Confluence).
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Certifications: Microsoft PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), PSM/CSPO, IIBA CCBA/CBAP.

**Success Metrics (KPIs)**
- Report adoption and satisfaction (usage growth, NPS).

- Cycle time from request to deployment; backlog throughput.

- Data quality and refresh reliability; reduction in manual reporting hours.

 Performance benchmarks (e.g., \<3s median visual/DAX query time).

**Education**

title: Manager - Scheduler
description:
We are looking for a
 **business\-oriented Scheduling \& Project Controls Manager** 
 to lead planning, scheduling, project controls, and integrated project management for the Water \& Effluent Treatment business. A person who is passionate about execution, takes ownership beyond his/her defined responsibilities and has the drive and ability to bring people and functions together to deliver results.
   

  

 The role will have strong
 **scheduling expertise** 
 as its core, while also being responsible for integrating schedule, cost, resources, risks, progress, and project performance across multiple projects. The individual will work closely with Business Heads, Project Managers, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Finance, Commercial, and other functions to drive effective project execution.
   

  

 The role will also lead a team and drive implementation of an Integrated Project Management / Project Controls system across the business.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop, integrate, and maintain master project schedules using Primavera P6, including critical path, baselines, milestones, progress measurement, forecasting, and recovery plans.
* Drive integrated project controls by linking schedule, cost, resources, procurement, engineering, construction, risks, and commercial performance.
* Implement and monitor Earned Value Management (EVM) and key KPIs such as SPI, CPI, EV, EAC, ETC, and schedule/cost variances.
* Monitor project performance, identify trends, risks, delays, and cost/schedule deviations, and drive appropriate corrective actions.
* Provide portfolio\-level dashboards, forecasts, and management insights to Business Heads and senior leadership.
* Coordinate across all functions to ensure alignment of project priorities, deliverables, resources, and execution plans.
* Work closely with Business Management teams on project performance, forecasting, resource planning, and business reviews.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of project controls/planning professionals.
* Drive standardization and continuous improvement of project management and project controls processes across the business.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* BE/B.Tech in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical Engineering; PG in Construction/Project Management is an advantage.
* 15\+ years of experience in project planning, scheduling, project controls, or project management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong expertise in Primavera P6, MSP and EPC project scheduling.
* Strong understanding of EVM, Cost management, Forecasting, SPI/CPI, and project performance management.
* Experience in Water \& Wastewater / Effluent Treatment / EPC projects will be highly preferred.
* PMP / PMI\-SP / equivalent certification is an advantage.

 A
 **strong scheduler who has evolved into a project controls and business leader**

 **better execution, cost control, and business decisions** 
 .

Every year, our platform helps optimize hundreds of millions of customer journeys, ensuring businesses can confidently deliver exceptional experiences at scale.

+ Prepare variance analyses and drive root\-cause explanations \& solutions

**Expense Management \& Procurement**

* Lead the development and maintenance of an expense management framework, including vendor spend categorization, cost center accountability, and spend\-against\-budget tracking
* Identify and drive cost\-saving and cost\-avoidance initiatives across major spend categories (SaaS/software, professional services, facilities, travel \& entertainment, etc.)
* Establish and monitor spend approval workflows and policies in partnership with Procurement and Accounting to strengthen budgetary controls
* Track vendor consolidation opportunities, contract and usage compliance, and spend concentration risk, reporting findings to functional and finance leadership


**Reporting / Analytics**
* Contribute toward monthly Board (MBR) and ELT reporting materials, with a dedicated section on expense trends and procurement initiatives
* Lead the creation of monthly Budget vs. Actual (BvA) reports for functional leaders, including detailed summaries of key spend areas, vendor commitments, and upcoming initiatives

* Act as a thought partner to business and functional leaders in developing budgets and forecasts, with particular ownership of vendor spend categories
* Meet with Procurement to understand various spend needs, evaluate requests, and provide financial guidance
* Independently manage ad hoc analysis requests from leadership and the finance team, translating findings into clear recommendations
* Drive ongoing improvements to FP\&A processes, tools, and documentation related to expense management and procurement workflows

* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence non\-financial stakeholders and drive adoption of spend controls and processes
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial planning software; hands\-on experience with ERP systems required (NetSuite preferred)
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred
* 5\+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, with demonstrated experience in expense management, procurement, or vendor spend analysis
* Experience within a PE\-backed SaaS organization is strongly preferred
* Advanced proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, including experience building spend/vendor management frameworks

title: FinOps Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Redwood is scaling public cloud infrastructure and AI features across multiple product lines, and we need a FinOps Lead to bring rigor, visibility, and accountability to that spend. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with the authority to drive cross\-functional cost governance directly. This role owns the translation of raw cloud cost data and AI spent into the models, forecasts, and governance mechanisms that let engineering, product, and executive leadership make informed decisions. This is not a bill\-monitoring role. You will build the cost attribution infrastructure that ties cloud/AI spend to specific product lines and, ultimately, to ROI involving architecture and engineering teams to make the right trade offs and decisions in line with the strategic roadmap.
 



 The role will report to the Senior Director, Product Engineering Operations, and work closely with Cloud Engineering, the CPO's org, and engineering leadership to create cost visibility and defensibility informing leadership on efficiency strategies. Your ability to be an effective communicator, collaborative team player, and analytical thinker will be keys to success in this role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Cost Visibility, Attribution \& Optimization** 



* Own and continuously improve cost models that attribute AWS (and other public cloud) spend by product line, team, and environment
* Drive tagging governance and hygiene, define standards, audit compliance, and close attribution gaps that prevent accurate cost\-per\-product reporting
* Build shared cost allocation models to drive transparency into per\-team cost drivers where there are prevalent savings plans, reserved instances and network charges
* Build toward feature\-level cost attribution that connects infrastructure spend to product ROI, not just aggregate bill totals
* Create and manage optimization programs with achievable savings targets, including working across engineering and finance to rightsize, clean up and modernize infrastructure



**Forecasting \& Reporting** 



* Forecast cloud and AI/LLM API spend against budget; monitor forecast drivers and maintain accuracy over time
* Develop and maintain predictive cost models for AI/LLM services, factoring in variable consumption patterns (token usage, model selection) to improve long\-term forecast accuracy
* Own recurring cost reporting cadences (monthly/quarterly) for engineering leadership and executive materials
* Track and report on discount utilization (Reserved Instances, Savings Plans) and flag roll\-off risk before it hits the P\&L



**Governance \& Partnership** 



* Partner with Cloud Engineering to design and drive public cloud spend management programs, including guardrails on provisioning and spend approval thresholds
* Participate in architecture and design reviews where infrastructure decisions carry meaningful cost implications by bringing cost tradeoffs into the conversation before decisions ship
* Identify and drive optimization opportunities (rightsizing, waste elimination, commitment planning) in partnership with engineering owners



**Analysis \& Ad Hoc Support** 



* Prepare ad hoc financial and cost analysis to support planning cycles, budget reviews, and executive asks
* Perform unit\-economic analysis on new AI features to project cost\-at\-scale, enabling data\-driven conversations with Product and Engineering teams regarding ROI and feature viability.



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Must\-have** 



* 5\-7\+ years in FinOps, cloud cost management, or a closely related financial/technical analyst role
* Has built a cost attribution model from scratch not just maintained or updated one built by someone else
* Understanding of AI/LLM cost drivers: Deep familiarity with token\-based pricing, model selection,, and the architectural levers that impact spend; ability to translate technical AI usage metrics into financial forecasts. Ability to
* AI\-Enabled Automation: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., custom GPTs, Claude, or agentic workflows) to automate repetitive data analysis, reporting tasks, or internal workflows
* Track record of influencing engineering/architecture decisions on cost grounds
* Hands\-on experience with cloud cost tools (AWS Cost Explorer required; CUDOS dashboards, CloudHealth, Cloudability, Vantage, or similar)
* AWS Compute Optimizer: Knowledge of how to use this service to identify right\-sizing opportunities for EC2, Lambda, and EBS based on utilization metrics.
* AWS Budgets \& Cost Anomaly Detection: Experience in setting up automated alerts and responding to usage spikes before they hit the monthly bill.
* Working SQL proficiency able to independently query and reconcile cost data, not just consume pre\-built dashboards
* Experience pulling data via APIs from cloud/cost platforms
* High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling; comfort building executive\-ready decks (PowerPoint/Slides)
* Demonstrated experience presenting cost/technical findings to non\-technical executives or leadership, translating technical detail into business narrative
* Excellent organization, time management, and communication (written and verbal) skills



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* Experience building financial models for variable\-cost services (e.g., cloud API usage, token\-based pricing) and translating technical usage patterns into business\-level spend forecasts.
* Savings Plans and Reserved Instance cost attribution, so underlying resource usage changes are properly allocated to the teams that own the resources
* Basic infrastructure literacy and understanding what drives cost in compute, storage, networking, and containerized/K8s environments well enough to ask informed questions in architecture discussions
* Experience working in a multi\-product or multi\-business\-unit environment where cost attribution across units was a core challenge
* Exposure to PE\-backed or investor\-scrutinized environments where financial defensibility of technical spend mattered
* Familiarity with AI/LLM API cost structures (token\-based pricing, usage tiers) as this becomes a growing spend category

**GlobalData is a productivity and intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.** 
 By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose\-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organizations see what's coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.
 



  





 Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organizations across the world's largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

 Proprietary coverage of 95% of global GDP, synthesized in real time from internal and external sources, aligned under a single business taxonomy \- giving you earlier insight, unified context, and decisions you can trust.
 



**Experts who turn insight into impact** 




 Human insights that AI alone can't replicate, from industry specialists and strategic advisors, embedded in your workflows to decode complexity and guide high\-value action.
 



**AI that moves smarter \& faster** 




 AI that doesn't just think, but acts \- forecasting market moves, surfacing answers in seconds, and freeing your teams to focus on execution when timing matters most.
 



**Workflow solutions** 




 Together, our six solutions turn intelligence into action, helping every team make smarter, faster decisions. Each solution focuses on the decisions that matter most, driving measurable impact.
 



  





 What we are looking for:
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field; relevant professional qualification preferred.
* **10\+ years of experience** 
 in strategic pricing, revenue management, or a similar role, with a strong track record of success in pricing execution.
* Direct experience working with software licensing models (e.g., SaaS, subscriptions) and pricing strategies for AI\-driven products.
* **Proven, hands\-on experience in pricing execution, governance, and commercial reporting within a mid\-to\-large scale business.**
* Strong expertise in financial modelling, data analytics, and pricing software.
 **Experience using Salesforce (CRM/CPQ) is a strong advantage.**
* Proven track record of partnering effectively with sales leaders and participating directly in key client meetings.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to present complex pricing strategies and data to leadership and cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to handle work under pressure, prioritize effectively, and deliver high\-quality results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of market dynamics, competitor pricing, and advanced pricing methodologies.
* Ability to contribute to and execute a strategic pricing vision that aligns with corporate strategy.
* Demonstrated success in guiding cross\-functional collaboration on pricing initiatives as a highly effective individual contributor.
* Experience with innovative pricing models and the ability to drive continuous improvements.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 The Pricing Senior Manager is a key
 **individual contributor** 
 responsible for the execution, governance, and reporting of the company’s pricing function across markets and product lines. This role ensures that pricing strategies are implemented smoothly, adhere to business objectives, maximize profitability, and enhance competitive positioning. You will execute daily pricing activities, enforce governance frameworks, work closely with leadership and sales teams, and serve as a critical hands\-on operator for long\-term pricing initiatives. This position has a heavy emphasis on driving pricing excellence through execution, data\-driven reporting, and maintaining pricing discipline across the organisation.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for a driven professional to play a high\-impact, hands\-on role in a strategic function, pushing it towards excellence and innovation. You will join us at a pivotal point in our transformation and enjoy a high\-profile role working to deliver an essential pillar of our growth plan.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing…** 




**Strategic Pricing Execution:** 




  




* Execute the implementation of advanced pricing models that align with both short\-term and long\-term business goals, with a specific focus on software and AI products.
* Ensure pricing strategies are operationalized effectively to contribute to revenue growth, margin improvement, and market competitiveness.



  





**Governance, Compliance \& Reporting:** 




  




* Enforce pricing governance frameworks, ensuring that pricing guidelines and discount matrices are strictly adhered to across regions, business units, and customer segments.
* Regularly review and audit pricing performance across the organization to ensure compliance with strategy, executing corrective actions where needed.
* Track and execute robust reporting on the financial performance of pricing strategies, analyzing their impact on revenue, profitability, and market positioning.
* Identify trends, opportunities, and risks within pricing data and present actionable insights to leadership.
* Leverage CRM and pricing platforms (including Salesforce) to maintain pricing discipline, process approvals, and ensure data hygiene.



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Sales Enablement:** 




  




* Partner closely with sales leaders to drive sales enablement, providing teams with the tools, training, and commercial narratives needed to execute pricing strategies confidently.
* Participate in key client meetings alongside the sales team to negotiate complex deals, explain pricing value propositions, and resolve commercial challenges.
* Collaborate with senior leadership and key stakeholders to align pricing execution with broader business goals (e.g., profitability targets, market share expansion).
* Act as a pricing subject matter expert during tactical and strategic discussions, including product launches and market expansion.



  





**Pricing Innovation and Optimization:** 




  




* Drive hands\-on initiatives to refine operational pricing models, including value\-based pricing, dynamic pricing, and discounting strategies.
* Ensure the pricing function leverages advanced analytics, market research, and competitive intelligence to make data\-driven pricing decisions. Support the execution of machine learning approaches within the pricing architecture.
* Champion the adoption and daily utilization of pricing tools, systems, and software that enhance pricing accuracy, efficiency, predictability, and transparency.
* Ensure that processes for the delivery of pricing tools are efficient and well\-understood by end\-users.

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.

Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our IT\&D Vendor \& Commercial team, where you’ll play a critical role in strengthening how IT\&D manages its commercial and financial operations at scale. * Strong experience managing IT vendors, contract lifecycle management, supplier onboarding, and procurement operations.
* Proven ability to work with cross\-functional teams including Procurement, Finance, Legal, Information Security, and Business stakeholders.

* Proficiency with procurement and reporting tools such as SAP, ServiceNow, and Power BI, with strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to partner effectively with Finance, Procurement, Legal, and IT stakeholders
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear, actionable processes
* Comfortable operating with autonomy and accountability in a senior individual‑contributor role


 The skills for success
   

  

 Purchase Order Management, PO Lifecycle Management, Vendor Governance, Commercial Governance, Procurement Operations, IT Commercial Operations, Financial Controls, Financial Governance, Compliance, Vendor Management, Vendor Compliance

For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality

Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Sr Associate, Credits, Incentives and Methods
description:

We invite skilled Engineers, Technologists, Scientists, and technically adept professionals to join our exceptional Scientific Research and Experimental Development (SR\&ED) team. We have cultivated an inclusive environment of teamwork, accountability, and ongoing education.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 We are looking for a Senior Associate to join our SR\&ED team:
 


* Working with the SR\&ED Technical Lead, collaborate on files to understand the SR\&ED opportunities and client expectations to meet, and exceed, our commitment to clients.
* Prepare SR\&ED submissions, the technical reports and identifying eligible expenses, with an unerring commitment to the SR\&ED criteria and RSM standards. Impress the RSM SR\&ED Technical Lead by collaborating on files with your insight and ability to distill complex and challenging technical projects from available documentation and discussions into succinct and clear descriptions of technological advancements and experimental work for their review. Identify and deliver on opportunities to ensure all eligible aspects and expenses of the work is identified and captured, supporting the development of logical rationales to claim those expenses.

Prepare the defense to be clear, concise, and organized, proactively addressing any CRA questions and instilling confidence in our clients with our expertise and professionalism.
* Stay abreast of changes to SR\&ED federal and provincial programs and other relevant tax incentives. Research scenarios as asked, reviewing the Income Tax Act, CRA policies, and relevant case law to identify opportunities to strengthen and expand SR\&ED opportunities or defense and review your findings with the Technical Lead.

**Required Qualifications**

* Several years’ experience in your field of expertise with demonstrated strengths in performance and achievements.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities, with the aptitude to convey complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.
* Exhibit exemplary teamwork, marked by effective communication, empathy, and solution\-oriented approaches.
* Ability to flourish in both autonomous and team\-based environments, contributing to collective goals and milestones.
* Be self\-motivated, with an unwavering commitment to delivering quality work that echoes professionalism and excellence.
* Possess the capabilities to excel and adapt within a dynamic, fast\-paced workplace while navigating complex tasks to deliver highest quality work to clients.

**About CleanHarbors**

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
* With the launch of multiple products, the movement of goods has become a challenging task in the Unit, more\-so in the context of higher no. of SKUs. The challenge gets multiplied with the dynamics and uncertainties of competitive market conditions wherein, the logistics \& dispatch plans are not static in a given period.
* The uncertainties arising out of external factors (like change in fuel prices, local logistical advantages of competitors in specific markets, troughs \& crests in monthly off\-take of Stockists linked to ongoing market\-demand, road transporters strike, impact of seasonality on availability of adequate means of transportation etc.) lead to daily fine\-tuning of dispatch plan and coordination with various internal customers/ external agencies so that the Monthly/ Quarterly/ Yearly Sales target are met.
* Also, the coordination task with relevant All\-India offices of CONCOR (tasks like rake\-planning \& transhipment planning, control of financial liabilities arising out of damages/ ground\-rents/ penalties/ demurrages, maintaining cordial relations with key\-decision\-makers and staff in CONCOR \& Indian Railways etc.), demands dedicated focus and highly effective coordination \& interpersonal skills.Key Challenges
* Uncertain market conditions impacting the variables of transportation/ movement of goods.
* To coordinate with All\-India marketing team and ensure maintenance of Optimum Stock Level in all the Depots, to avoid a stock\-out position, even in the most uncertain situations.
* Manage On\-Time, In\-Full delivery of all the SKU (Stock\-keeping Units) with a constant review \& control of \- dispatch plan, transit\-time in shipment of goods, damages, withheld material at Container Yards etc.
* Effective coordination with all the internal/ external touch\-points so as to maintain high level of customer satisfaction, especially on the parameter of OTIF Delivery.
* To streamline daily dispatch plan in a manner that it doesnt affect the monthly/ quarterly/ yearly sales target of Marketing\-function.
* To assist Marketing Head in preparing near\-accurate monthly sales budget of the entire product\-mix so that the production\-planning \& logistics\-planning are well aligned and deviations are minimized.


**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 Accountability: ASSISTANCE IN SALES PLANNING 1\. Study the historic trends of Sales (Month\-wise, Product\-wise, Sales Area\-wise, State\-wise, Zone\-wise \& All\-India for BW as well as competitors).
   

  

* Design formats to obtain the Sales Figure from Regional


 teams, during Planning \& Budgeting exercise.
   

  

* Coordinate with Regional teams to obtain their respective


 plans and compile the same to obtain All\-India picture.
   

  

* Assist Marketing Strategy Cell and Functional Head\-Marketing to streamline the forecasted Sales Plan, during Planning \& Budgeting exercise, (in accordance with the Revenue Driver Tree), so that the same can be converted into a systematic Dispatch \& Production schedule for a given FY.


 KRA2 COORDINATION FOR DISPATCH PLANNING 1\. Coordinate with regional teams to review, monitor and control the Dispatch Plan (on daily\> weekly\>monthly basis).
   

  

* Update the Sales\-Area/ State/ Region\-wise dispatch plan and submit the same through structured reports, to Functional Head\-Marketing. In other words, assist Functional Head (Marketing) in Reviewing and Controlling the Targets on a daily basis, set for a given FY.
* Based on the daily review with FH (Mktg.), prepare a status report, as per the amendments finalized in discussion with FH.
* Provide timely information about the amendments \& status reports to all concerned Regional/ State/ Sales Area Heads, to ensure that the Dispatch Planning is in tandem with the decisions.


 KRA3 CUSTOMER SATISFACTION CUSTOMER SATISFACTION
   

  

* Ensure timely dispatch of material, as per Customers plan, through daily follow\-up \& coordination with Logistics (Kharia)
* In pro\-active coordination with the concerned sales team, ensure that the Optimum Stock Level in the Depots (Godowns) is maintained so that the Customer at these locations doesnt face a stock\-out position.
* To interact with dis\-satisfied Customers (Stockists \& Industrial buyers), in the event of delays in delivery of material. Accordingly, handle their grudges/ complaints in a manner that such situation crisis does not have a bearing on their relationship with the Organistaion.
* Serve as an important central link between Logistics (Kharia) and Regional teams to facilitate the OTIF (On\-time, In\-Full) delivery of goods.


 KRA4 COORDINATION WITH CONTAINER CORPORATION OF INDIA (CONCOR) 1\. Coordinate with all relevant offices of CONCOR, on All\-India basis, for timely rake planning and trans\-shipment planning on daily basis.
   

  

* Maintain cordial relationship with key\-decision\-makers and staff in CONCOR to control financial liabilities arising out of damages, ground\-rents, penalties/ demurrages, withheld containers etc.
* Facilitate the negotiations between Logistics (Kharia) and CONCOR, thus contributing in cost\-effective transportation of goods.
* Ensure timely placement of rakes at Works\-Kharia.


 KRA5 INTERFACE BETWEEN CMO \& LOGISTICS (KHARIA) INTERFACE BETWEEN CMO \& LOGISTICS (KHARIA)
   

  

* Prepare and submit All\-India ¿Order transmission plan¿ to Logistics (Kharia) on daily/ weekly basis.
* Based on competitor¿s dispatch information received from Logistic (Kharia) and relevant State Heads, prepare reports related to State\-wise dispatches of all Brands of White Cement, on monthly basis. These reports are used by all Departments for analysis of Industry Growth, BW Growth and Market\-share of all the brands.
* Facilitate meetings and execution of specific tasks with CONCOR, based on directions/ requirements of Logistics (Kharia).
* Facilitate information\-based interaction between FH\-Marketing and Logistics (Kharia), through various informative reports (generated as per the requirements of FH\-marketing). Such reports provide a basis for taking decisions related to Sales/ dispatches/ logistics related affairs and also serve as an informative base for various analytical tasks carried\-out by marketing Strategy Cell (during Planning \& Budgeting Exercise and Quarterly reviews).

title: Finance & Accounts Manager
description:
**About The Company**
 Our client is a fast\-growing, conscious footwear brand transforming everyday comfort with innovative engineering and sustainable materials. Featuring high\-performance cushioning and proprietary biodegradable technology, they craft open footwear built for style, function, and minimal environmental impact. They are seeking talented professionals to help scale the future of sustainable fashion across India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Finance \& Accounts professional to manage end\-to\-end finance operations, statutory compliances, management reporting, and business finance activities. The ideal candidate should possess strong accounting knowledge, analytical skills, and the ability to work closely with management, auditors, investors, vendors, and customers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Financial Reporting \& MIS:
+ Prepare monthly MIS including Profit \& Loss Account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and variance analysis.
+ Monitor key business KPIs and provide actionable insights to management.
+ Prepare budget vs actual reports and departmental performance analysis.
+ Support annual budgeting and forecasting exercises.

* Investor \& Management Reporting:
+ Prepare periodic investor reports and management presentations.
+ Assist in financial modelling, fundraising, due diligence, and data room management.
+ Support Board and management reporting requirements.

* Accounting \& Financial Control:
+ Ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts.
+ Manage month\-end and year\-end closing activities.
+ Review journal entries, provisions, accruals, and reconciliations.
+ Implement and strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs.

* GST, TDS \& Statutory Compliance:
+ Ensure timely filing of GST returns (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, Annual Returns, Reconciliations).
+ Manage TDS deductions, payments, return filings, and reconciliations.
+ Coordinate with consultants and authorities for tax assessments and notices.
+ Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory regulations.

* Vendor \& Customer Reconciliations:
+ Perform periodic vendor and customer account reconciliations.
+ Resolve discrepancies and ensure accurate accounting records.
+ Monitor receivables and payables aging.
+ Coordinate with business teams for timely collections and payments.

* Banking \& Treasury:
+ Manage banking operations, fund flow, and cash flow planning.
+ Prepare cash flow forecasts and working capital reports.
+ Coordinate with banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions for funding requirements.

* Audit \& Compliance:
+ Coordinate with statutory, internal, GST, and tax auditors.
+ Prepare schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents for audits.
+ Ensure timely closure of audit observations and compliance matters.

* ERP \& Process Improvement:
+ Work on ERP systems and ensure data integrity.
+ Drive automation initiatives and process improvements.
+ Develop reports and dashboards to improve decision\-making.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* MBA (Finance), M.Com, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification.
* 5–10 years of experience in Finance \& Accounts.
* Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting standards, and financial reporting.
* Experience with ERP systems and advanced Excel.
* Exposure to investor reporting and fundraising activities will be an added advantage.


**Required Skills**
* Financial Analysis \& MIS Reporting
* Accounting \& Finalization of Accounts
* GST \& TDS Compliance
* Budgeting \& Forecasting
* Cash Flow Management
* Vendor \& Customer Reconciliations
* Audit Coordination
* Advanced Excel \& ERP Systems
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Timely closure of monthly accounts and MIS.
* Accuracy of financial reports and reconciliations.
* Zero major compliance delays or penalties.
* Improvement in receivable collections and working capital.
* Timely submission of investor and management reports.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and controls.

 Apollo is a high\-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk\-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth.  A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.

 Outperform expectations
   

  

 Challenge Convention

**Our Benefits**
 Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Apollo is looking for candidates to join its Credit Underwriting team in the Credit Research team which is split across multiple sectors. As part of the team, the candidate will work alongside respective sector leads and Portfolio Managers to maximize the return potential of investments while also collaborating with the larger Credit Research team. The role is a blend of Team Lead and Individual Contributor the candidate will be responsible for leading a team of analysts on the credit analysis as well as maintaining / initiating coverage on a portfolio of issuers. The candidate, together with the larger Analyst team, will be responsible for evaluating the credit quality of issuers and support lead analyst on primary and secondary deals while monitoring existing exposures. The candidate should have a good understanding of one or many fixed income asset classes, such as Investment Grade, High Yield Bonds or Leveraged Loans. The candidate should have prior experience in delivering end\-to\-end Credit Research solutions, having worked on developing extensive financial models with scenario analysis and preparing Investment Memos. The candidate must possess strong written and verbal communication skills, effectively manage client/stakeholder requirements and ensure their timely execution, while consistently delivering high\-quality and impactful research. The candidate should demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and be capable of conducting thorough quality checks (QC)
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Managing Credit Research engagements where the Analyst Team is involved in initiating / monitoring single name corporate credit situations in US/EU/APAC markets as part of the engagement, the team performs investment research, including:
   

  

* Building detailed financial models with KPI driven Revenue projections, Cost drivers, Working capital analysis, Capex schedule, Capital Structure analysis, Covenant analysis, Default \& Recovery workouts and IRR sensitivities and valuations.
* Creating a finalized product: Preparing Investment Memos including identification of investment catalysts and provide recommendations IG instruments. This is a fundamental analysis role.
* Presenting the primary/secondary deals to the investment committee and clearly articulating your opinion. Take full ownership of the investment view and continuously monitor key developments affecting the issuers credit quality.
* Maintain portfolio coverage including regular model updates and earning summary write\-ups.
* Checking the work of and training younger analysts, as required.
* Driving Systemic Quality mindset across teams, implement and maintain best research delivery practices.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MBA or equivalent in Finance /CFA/CA
* Experience: 7\-12 Years
* Industry experience: PE / Investment Banking / Credit Research with high modelling skills
* Experience supporting equity research and/or FIG(M\&A) at banks or PE firms. Ideally modelling writing reports.
* Excellent corporate credit analysis skills from a fundamental perspective.
* Proficiency in building detailed financial models and preparing investment memos besides having excellent analytical skills
* Generalist with sector exposure in any of TMT, IT, Healthcare, Autos, Manufacturing, Oil \& Gas, Chemical sectors, Utilities or corporate finance background in a sell side firm. Thorough understanding of accounting.
* Proficiency in using Databases \& Portfolio Asset Management Systems \- Bloomberg, CapIQ.
* Ability to work under pressure and deliver high\-quality research.
* Prior record of having worked on competitive Pilots will be an added advantage

The above criteria are intended to be used as a guide only – candidates who do not meet all the above criteria may still be considered if they are deemed to have relevant experience/ equivalent levels of skill or knowledge to fulfil the requirements of the role. title: Associate Consultant/Consultant (Strategy)
description:
**Blue Matter Consulting** 
 is a strategy consulting firm focused exclusively on the life sciences industry. We partner with biotech startups and multinational pharmaceutical corporations to help them achieve commercial success across the lifecycle of their products, portfolios, and organizations. Our work spans new product planning, launch strategy, brand and lifecycle planning, and corporate and portfolio strategy across specialty therapeutic areas. We operate globally, with offices in the US (San Francisco, New York, Boston), Europe (London, Zurich, Netherlands), and India (Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune).
 



  





**The Role** 




 As an Associate Consultant or Consultant in our India office, you will work as an integrated member of US\- and Europe\-based project teams — directly engaging global clients, contributing to live strategy engagements, and building deliverables that shape commercial and corporate decisions.
 



 This is not a support or back\-office role. You will own meaningful workstreams, present to clients, and operate with the same expectations as your US/Europe counterparts. The role involves working partial overlap hours with US or European time zones a few days each week; work timing flexibility is provided.
 



  





**Primary Resonsibilities** 



* Onboard rapidly to new engagements — internalize objectives, scope, and timelines, and integrate with the US/Europe project team from day one

* Create and utilize analytical tools to support strategic decision\-making
* Develop slides or memos effectively communicating results of analyses
* Prepare material for project meetings, workshops, and client presentations
* Proactively communicate progress, flag risks, and seek guidance from senior team members
* Demonstrate accountability for completion and high\-quality delivery of all assigned responsibilities

 We look for consultants who can hit the ground running in a project team, are scientifically trained (by experience or academic background), and demonstrate strength across four core competencies:
 


* **Critical Thinker** 
 — Able to approach a problem, understand its context and implications, and work with ambiguous information to develop creative and pragmatic solutions
* **Collaborative** 
 — Able to plan your own work, deliver on commitments to your project team, and operate effectively across time zones and cultures
* **Communicative** 
 — Able to interact transparently and concisely with internal and external stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
* **Proactive** 
 — Able to take initiative, eager to learn, receptive to feedback, and willing to take failure in stride



  





**Desired Experience and Skills** 



* Understanding of clinical trial phases and their impact on strategic decision\-making
* Demonstrated ability to integrate scientific, business, and industry knowledge in developing creative solutions for clients
* Strong analytical skills and structured, hypothesis\-driven problem\-solving
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines
* Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment
* Proactive and entrepreneurial in spirit
* Willingness and ability to read complex scientific material and distill key insights
* Proficiency in MS PowerPoint and Excel
* Experience using proprietary pharma databases
* Experience with pharma marketing analytics, valuation, or forecasting/modeling is a plus
* Prior demonstrated success working across time zones with international teams is a plus



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Advanced degree(s) in the biology domain — PhD, MBBS, MD, BDS, MS, BPharm/MPharm, PharmD, or MPH
* 2–3 years of prior consulting experience, OR at least 2–3 years of biopharma industry experience in roles such as portfolio planning, corporate strategy, or business development
* US/Europe life sciences industry knowledge and exposure is a plus



  





**What We Can Offer You** 



* Diverse, intellectually stimulating projects across our clients' products, portfolios, and organizations — from biotech startups to multinational pharmaceutical corporations
* Direct engagement with global clients and US/Europe project teams from day one

 pipelines by tracking and reconciling courier partner collections and aging reports.

 between storefront applications (e.g., Shopify), internal ERP systems, and bank transactions.

 issued by credit card networks or payment processors to minimize fraud losses.

 •
 **Track the Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)** 
 metrics and create real\-time collection dashboards for leadership.
 



 •
 **Enforce internal financial control SOPs** 
 for physical point\-of\-sale (POS) retail locations if Omni\-channel structures apply.
 



 •
 **Manage corporate client lines if the D2C** 
 brand sells via bulk corporate gifting or wholesale distribution agreements.

 are maintained across varying promotional models, discount structures, and gift card redemptions.
 



 •
 **Format outward supply data** 
 to cleanly align with multi\-state tax frameworks (like Indian GST or state\-level sales taxes).
 



 •
 **Support month\-end closing timelines** 
 and deliver ledger transparency for upcoming statutory and internal audits.
 



  





**5\- Team Leadership \& Process Automation** 




 •
 **Direct and mentor** 
 a dedicated team of junior AR analysts and billing coordinators.
 



 •
 **Drive systems engineering to automate** 
 manual data pulling or heavy Excel\-based reconciliation loops.
 



  





**Skills \& Qualifications**




  





**Education \& Experience** 




 • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
 



 • Industry Experience: 6 to 7\+ years of dedicated revenue tracking or AR experience specifically within an e\-commerce, D2C, retail, or FMCG brand.
 



 • Leadership Experience: Minimum 1–2 years supervising financial or accounting workflows.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 • Advanced data manipulation capabilities in Microsoft Excel (e.g., Power Query, Pivot Tables, massive data\-array matching).
 



 • Deep functional hands\-on experience using modern ERP software
 



 • Familiarity with the backend financial portals of storefront ecosystems like Shopify or Amazon Seller Central.
 



  





**Soft Skills** 




 • Exceptionally sharp analytical and forensic data investigation skills.
 



 • Comfortable interfacing across multi\-disciplinary functions (logistics, marketing, and web tech teams) to isolate payment errors.
 



  





**Immediate joiners or candidates serving their notice period are preferred.**

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. **Role**
 Based in the first line of defense with in the Enterprise COO function, we are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Reporting Specialist to support the ongoing implementation of the Reporting Standards across Northern Trust. This will involve supporting 1st and 2nd line of defense stakeholders standardizing controls and issues reporting across the governance forums, to ensure consistency through development of reporting standards, data metrics, data dictionaries, reports, and data quality, while establishing communities of practice for ongoing oversight and learning.
   

  

 This individual will become deeply familiar with data sourcing, data standards and be responsible for answering questions that arise from partners as Issues and Controls metrics are reported in the governance committees. In addition, this individual will also work closely with various stakeholders to ensure ongoing escalation of implementation and compliance concerns. The ideal candidate will have a risk and compliance background, experience working across the three lines of defense, experience with data mapping, business analysis and Power BI (or similar solutions).
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
* Reporting Standards and Alignment: Define standard set of tactical and strategic reports needed and align stakeholders on data sources and data maps to be used for board, scorecard, and other metrics within the 1LOD and 2LOD. This includes creation and maintenance of the data map, establishing data dictionary, and aligning standards across 1LOD and 2LOD
* Health of Control Environment and Issue Management: Create standard set of reports, including report trends, and "central" data extracts. Produce any ad\-hoc reports needed by the CCO teams
* Control and Issue standards adherence: create and run data quality reports, work with the team to resolve exceptions, and produce metrics to identifying trends
* Enterprise Thematic Analysis: Understand the overall health of the internal control environment (including issues), identify trends, weaknesses, and determination of required mitigation actions.
* Review and Challenge: Respond to the 2LOD review and challenge requests
* Identify and escalate situations that include complex challenges and articulate actionable plans to drive results, while demonstrating exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail

title: Procurement Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 Collects information, inputs, data from various sources and conducts analysis/simulations to support or report sourcing work. Analyzes sourcing information and presents findings for process improvement and cost reduction while maintaining high quality product and/or service delivery. Supports sourcing processs and or may source assigned items and executes buying strategies in accordance with agreed sourcing strategy at the optimum cost. Supports and or leads some "special" projects within the team category scope. Super User/Subject Matter Experts (SME) for systems and tools to support the team
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Procures inventory, supplies, and capital goods; places purchase orders with vendors. Analyzes sourcing and procurement initiatives and processes in support of the delivery of cost effective and high quality goods and services. Supports providing the Value Capture Summaries at month and quarter ends. Prepares and presents recommendations of improvement opportunities and alternative courses of action to senior procurement/sourcing leaders. Consistently applies sourcing policies, procedures and processes. Supports procurement/sourcing management in activities such as price benchmarking, vendor management, process analysis, market and industry research, and model building. Conducts minor contract negotiations. Gathers information and provides input on larger contracts. Manages loading and retrieving of legal and compliance documents into applicable storage systems to support regulatory, audit and research activities. Assists in the process of interviewing and evaluating sales representatives and vendors. Supports Six Sigma projects through active team membership or provision of data and market intelligence. Interacts with suppliers with regard to payments and order fulfillment. Procures services and goods, inventory, supplies, and capital goods (CIP) Compiling and managing Ariba IAC's (Invoice against Contracts) \- (CIP) Low complexity /risk sourcing work and contract development under supervision
   

  

**Competencies**
 Action oriented \- Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
   

  

 Balances stakeholders \- Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
   

  

 Business insight \- Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
   

  

 Data Analytics \- Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
   

  

 Confidential Disclosure \- Protects Cummins confidential information by using the appropriate channel of communication and ensures that Confidential Disclosure Agreements are in place with all suppliers that Cummins interacts with to protect Cummins Confidential Information and to ensure that the suppliers confidential information is not misused or disclosed in any manner.
   

  

 Cost and Value Management \- Establishes and controls product and service costs using functional tools to deliver and track product and services at competitive prices. Ensures competitiveness of Cummins products in our markets while preserving desired margins. Utilizes Total Cost Opportunity (TCO) model methodology.
   

  

 Procurement Ethics \- Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.
   

  

 Procurement Policies, Procedures, Tools \- Understands all of the relevant Procurement policies and procedures and complies with them in daily work; Masters all tools required to conduct procurement work. Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.
   

  

 Procurement Systems \- Recognizes linkage to multiple systems such as purchasing order, payment, engineering release, and quality systems; troubleshoots and corrects issues resulting from data issues; writes ad\-hoc reports using tools within each application; identifies and documents work flows and system testing; actively participates in implementation process of new purchasing systems including requirements gathering, design, communication, and training.
   

  

 Source to Pay Principles \- Leverages key principles of the Source to Pay process to smoothly execute sourcing decisions, order placement, material/service acquisition and on\-time payment of Suppliers.
   

  

 Sourcing \- Utilizes the purchasing functional system to support the Request For Quote process and establish a Total Cost of Ownership comparison of suppliers based on the category strategy and define the supplier that is most likely to meet Cummins and customer's needs.
   

  

 Supply Base Risk Management \- Minimize supplier risk to Cummins by proactively mitigating risks through use of risk analysis tools and risk mitigation playbook to manage three key risk: 1\) Continuity of Supply, 2\) Reputational Risk, and 3\) Risk to our Margins of parts. By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

**1\. Project Planning \& Scheduling** 




  




* Own and publish comprehensive baseline project schedules for all active design\-and\-build projects, covering design, procurement, execution, and handover phases.
* Develop detailed, activity\-level schedules that clearly identify critical path, dependencies, and float.
* Build master schedules and rolling look\-ahead plans that surface risks and constraints weeks in advance, enabling proactive recovery.
* Maintain and update all schedules as actuals roll in, keeping them alive and credible as the project's source of truth.



  





**2\. Schedule Monitoring \& Control** 




  




* Track actual progress against planned schedules on a weekly basis; flag delays, acceleration, and deviations immediately.
* Conduct detailed variance analysis, dig into the why behind every slip: is it design approval, procurement, execution, or resource constraints?
* Produce weekly project status reports and monthly scheduling reviews for management; articulate impact on project delivery dates and cost implications.
* Ensure zero misses on timelines, hold the line on milestones and escalate deviations that threaten delivery.



  





**3\. Risk \& Recovery Management** 




  




* Proactively identify schedule\-related risks, design delays, vendor lead times, resource constraints, site conditions, and develop clear mitigation strategies.
* Monitor inter\-dependencies between projects and functions to flag conflicts and resource contention early.



  





**4\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 




  




* Partner closely with Design, Procurement, Execution, and Site teams to understand realistic timelines, identify bottlenecks, and drive schedule alignment.
* Facilitate monthly planning review meetings and weekly progress tracking calls; be the voice for timeline realism and early warning.
* Work with vendors, subcontractors, and suppliers to understand delivery windows and manage external dependencies.
* Support client communication on project timelines, change impact, and schedule recovery plans.



  





**5\. Planning Tools \& Analytics** 




  




* Maintain accurate project records, schedule baselines, change logs, ensuring data integrity and traceability.
* Spot trends and anomalies: unusual delays, recurring bottlenecks, missed forecasts, and bring structured recommendations to close them.



  





**Academic \& Professional Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Project Planning certifications are a strong advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience in project planning, scheduling, and project controls, not just project support.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously in design\-and\-build, commercial interiors or workplace fit\-outs.
* Prior exposure to investor\-facing or stakeholder reporting roles is valued.



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Deep, confident command of MS Project.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, dashboards, pivot analysis, data visualization, and dynamic reporting.
* Experience building project dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
* Familiarity with construction methodologies, interior fit\-out processes, and project lifecycle management.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
 With 19\.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben \& Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
   

  

 We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
   

  

**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
 We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
   

  

 We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Finance Junior Manager gives support to the (alternatively) Materials / Factory / Logistics / Supply Chain Overheads and Business Waste respective teams by performing various day to day operational activities for them, discussing, and sharing relevant information and assumptions behind these activities so that European finance teams and countries can concentrate on their core business partnering tasks.
   

  

 What you'll be responsible for
   

  

 Ensure Knowledge transfer is OTIF from old SCFS Teams in Unilever ahead of the end of the TSA (Temporary Service Agreement) by end 2026\.
   

  

 Act as first point of contact for the respective Cost Bucket Owners in Europe and all its countries and factories covering localization process of Opus Design (New SAP) representing EU processes,
   

  

 Being the linking pin between the internal Cost Buckets Owners and the team members in charge of transfer pricing and intercompany flows
   

  

 Coordinate the Business Plan \& Quarterly TP update processes between GBS team and 3rd party subcontractors where applicable
   

  

 Facilitate the Transfer Price corrections and strengthen the controls process identifying together with Unilever SCFS the root causes
   

  

 Deliver understanding \& transparency of Supply Chain cost developments (Actuals vs. Forecast) for the Cost Bucket in scope
   

  

 Maintain and develop various TP reporting using relevant tools (Power BI, Power Query etc.)
   

  

 Lead projects for further development of the analytical support provided to the external stakeholders
   

  

 Lead projects for continuous improvement in team processes
   

  

 We're looking for someone who
   

  

 University degree in Finance (minimum Bachelor)
   

  

 Minimum of 4 years of finance working experience preferably in finance business partnering
   

  

 Excellent MS Excel Skills. Power BI/ Power Query is required.
   

  

 Effective Communication: Fluent in English, oral and written.
   

  

 Analytical thinking, problem solving attitude.
   

  

 Financial Accounting and Reporting knowledge
   

  

 Effective Prioritization and Problem\-solving attitude
   

  

 Forward looking approach and ability to provide “what if” analysis
   

  

 Multiple Stakeholders Management
   

  

 IT skills – excellent level of computer literacy (incl excel \& SAP)
   

  

 Motivation to build up own agenda
   

  

 Team working – demonstrate commitment to the team in helping to achieve goals; proactively share best practice, ideas and insights with colleagues
   

  

 Agility and ability to adjust quickly to the changes
   

  

 What you'll get
   

  

 Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
   

  

 Market\-competitive pay and performance related rewards
   

  

 Flexible ways of working
   

  

 Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
   

  

 Time off to rest and recharge
   

  

 Ongoing learning and development opportunities
   

  

 Specific benefits vary by location
   

  

**Why join us?**
 This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed \- both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end\-to\-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
   

  

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
   

  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.


 Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
 If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy
description:
About The Company
 



 FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.
 



 In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point\-of\-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.
 



 Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state\-of\-the\-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.
 



 We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data\-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.
 



 This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides
 **who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why** 
 .
 



 About The Role
 



 We are hiring a
 **Lead: Unit Economics \& NPV Strategy** 
 to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney's existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision\-making, not just analytical artefacts.
 



 While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade\-offs. This role exists to close that gap.
 



 The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on
 **value creation vs value destruction** 
 , expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.
 



 This is a senior, high\-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Own NPV \& Unit Economics:** 
 Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision\-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut\-offs, and capital allocation
* **Measure Expected vs Actual Performance:** 
 Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions
* **Drive Experimentation \& Value Attribution:** 
 Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped
* **Influence Business Decisions:** 
 Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade\-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them
* **Embed NPV in Decision\-Making:** 
 Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline
* **Raise the Analytical Bar:** 
 Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney's mission of providing responsible access to credit


**Requirements**

 Must\-Haves
 


* Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors)
* Deep understanding of credit economics and how risk, pricing, tenure, and behaviour interact
* Proven track record of measuring expected vs actual outcomes
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders using data and logic
* High ownership mindset with bias toward action



 Nice\-To\-Have
 


* Experience in high\-growth fintech or scale\-up environments
* Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, policy tests, pricing tests)
* Strong SQL / Python / analytics tooling capability
* Experience working closely with Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams



 What Success Looks Like
 


**By Month 3**
* Existing NPV models are audited, rationalised, and standardised
* A portfolio\-level NPV view exists across all major products
* Leadership has clear visibility into where value is created or destroyed
* Experiments are routinely evaluated on NPV uplift versus control


**By Month 6**
* NPV actively drives decisions on:


* Credit cut\-offs
* Pricing bands
* Growth investment trade\-offs
* Gaps between expected and actual performance are measured, explained, and shrinking
* Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams operate using a shared economic language
* Leadership trusts NPV outputs enough to make difficult, high\-impact decisions



 Final Note
 



 This is not a passive analytics role.
 



 We are looking for someone who is comfortable challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, and holding the line on economic truth — even when it is inconvenient.
 



 If you are motivated by scale, complexity, ownership, and impact, this role will stretch you and reward you.
   

  




**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Flexible work structure



**Recruitment Process:** 



* A screening call with a member of the recruitment team
* Technical interview with the hiring manager
* Case study round
* Panel session based on the case study

title: Credit Analyst – Underwriting
description:
**About Us.** 




  





 We are a fast growing technology startup specializing in enterprise application development, catering to State Governments, Ministries, and leading Banks and Financial Institutions. Our core strength lies in harnessing cutting edge technologies like Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain to build impactful solutions.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  






 We're looking for a Credit Analyst with strong functional expertise in credit underwriting to work closely with our product development team. This is not a traditional underwriting desk role you'll act as the functional/domain expert embedded with engineers, product managers, and business analysts to help design, validate, and refine a credit underwriting product. Your job is to translate real\-world underwriting practices, policies, and edge cases into product requirements and logic the team can build.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Act as the subject matter expert (SME) on credit underwriting for the product development team, bridging the gap between business/functional needs and technical implementation
* Define and document underwriting workflows, credit assessment criteria, scoring logic, and decisioning rules to be built into the product
* Review credit policies, RBI/regulatory guidelines, and industry underwriting standards, and translate them into functional specifications
* Work with product managers and business analysts to create user stories, process flows, and business requirement documents (BRDs) related to underwriting
* Validate system outputs, test underwriting logic/rules engines, and identify gaps or inconsistencies versus real\-world lending practice
* Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by designing test cases based on real credit scenarios (income assessment, risk scoring, collateral evaluation, financial ratio analysis, etc.)
* Provide inputs on credit risk parameters financial statement analysis, cash flow assessment, credit bureau data (CIBIL/Experian/Equifax), ratio analysis, banking behavior, etc.
* Stay updated on lending products (secured/unsecured loans, working capital, term loans, etc.) to ensure the product supports varied underwriting scenarios
* Train and support internal teams (engineering, QA, support) on underwriting concepts as needed



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




  




* 7–8 years of experience in credit underwriting/credit analysis, preferably across retail, SME, or corporate lending
* Strong functional knowledge of underwriting processes  income assessment, credit bureau analysis, ratio analysis, risk scoring, and credit policy frameworks
* Hands\-on experience with loan origination systems (LOS), loan management systems (LMS), or credit underwriting platforms
* Experience writing BRDs/FSDs or working closely with product/tech teams (prior exposure to Agile/Scrum environments preferred)
* Good understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements in lending (RBI guidelines, KYC/AML basics, etc.)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business logic into structured, testable requirements
* Excellent communication skills  ability to explain credit concepts to a non\-credit (technical) audience
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, or related field; MBA/CA/CFA preferred but not mandatory



  





**Good to have** 




  




* Prior experience working in a fintech, NBFC, or bank's digital lending/product team
* Exposure to credit scoring models, rule engines, or decisioning platforms
* Basic understanding of SQL or data analysis tools (for validating logic/data, not development)



  





**What Quadcentrix has to offer** 




  





 We are in a rapidly evolving space so your role will not be immutable over time. You should expect that your role at Quadcentrix will evolve as the company grows in the years to come. This will provide you the opportunity to grow and to have a direct impact on shaping the nature of your contribution to the company. We do not fit in a box as there is no box today and we don't expect you to either.
 


* We trust you to execute your project deliverables and don't believe in micromanagement.
* We care about you and so we are going to be focused on making things better for you!
* We also believe in your potential, so we'll always focus on your learning, training, and development if it fits your goals!

Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. **Overview Of The Role**
 Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non\-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Stepping into a start\-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long\-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.

Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected\-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility\-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
